We scheduled this tour in mid-April. It was an unusually rainy week and the staff at Air Ventures went above and beyond to help us book the tour and work around the rain. They were constantly checking the weather radar and called us back with updates on our reservation. In the end, we didn't need to reschedule, but Air Ventures will reschedule or fully refund your tour if the weather is inclement. We took the

It not the only choice to get to base camp on McKinley or for flightseeing but it the most polished of the group. New building with the most used restrooms in town. The new building will give comfort to tourist who are a bit nervous about a flight but for climbers the original “packing” metal building will fit the bill.

review_title: Romantic flight and Spectacular views of Miami and Miami Beach
review_text:
Miami Seaplane Tours is on the top of my recommending list of things to do in Miami for locals and all all visiting out of state friends! Fabulous staff and great service! A must do!
We were celebrating my husband's Birthday and as he said "One awesome Birthday to remember"!!!!!!!!!  Jeremy Fisher & Isis Morales Fisher

Highly recommend the flight to Mt McKinley & the landing on the Ruth Glacier. This is just an incredible experience and the best way to see this vast beautiful area. The glacier landing and then standing on almost 4000 feet on glacier ice and viewing Mt McKinley up close and personal is almost a spiritual experience. Talkeetna Air Taxi is professional and makes the experience the trip of your vacation.

review_title: Excellent experience.  A must in San Fran.
review_text: The adventure you are looking for!  Do it when you first arrive and get a bird’s eye view of SF and the places you can visit.  Michael was great, and helped us reschedule our flight due to unexpected rain.  The pilot was a great adventurer and we really were impressed with the incredible views.   And yoi get to enjoy a seaplane!!!

We were in a time share for most of our trip and we were debating on a helicopter ride or a plane ride knowing they were both great ways to see the island.  We decided to go with Wings over Kauai so we could see the Na Pali coast from the air and also be able to do a boat trip and see it from the water.   The plane ride was amazing and we did it at the end of our trip and we were able to see so many places that we had seen from the air.  We could not asked for better weather and decided to go in the afternoon based on a recommendation from where we were staying.  

Bruce and his wife were great from the beginning until the end. Just going through some of the photos and the shots that I took from the plane came out great.  I am so happy that we decided to do it and it was worth the money spent - I guess the only thing that we could have had with the helicopter is the ability to hover but I am not sure if we would have seen more for the higher cost.

Well worth it!!!  Before we left they took a photo of us and when we got back we were presented with a CD that had our photo on it that they had taken along with highlights from the tour that were taken at another time - but still they were spots that we had seen on our tour.  They were so friendly and accommodating and even took photos with our camera that we could have from before and after the flight.

One tip is they do offer a AAA discount so make sure you ask if you have AAA.

We decided to go on a plane instead of the helicopter and we are so glad we did!! I am a photographer and the pictures that i was able to take were fabulous! Marcus, the pilot and Val in the office were very nice and accommodating! The cost was right, we were up for a full 60 minutes and were able to communicate back and forth with the other couple and pilot- very informative and comfortable. We were so glad that we were able to see the parts of the island that you cannot see via car. Would definitely recommend to everyone!

review_title: Awesome experience - all the reviews are correct!
review_text: Very happy with our choice to go with Wings Over Kauai - the price is reasonable and the folks are friendly and knowledgable - these people clearly love what they do.  Ride was surprisingly smooth despite very windy conditions on the day we took our tour.  We certainly didn't regret choosing fixed wing over helo...  We thought about taking a land tour of the island, but didn't like the idea of being stuck in a bus for 10 hours… See it all from the air in an hour or so - highly recommended!

Hands down the best flight experience ever! Bruce is such a kind person and excellent pilot. Thanks to him and his staff we had gained a lot of geographical knowledge of the island, as well as of the flora.
Their price of the flight was really affordable as well; less than $300 for 2 people for a private flight in the cessna.

Highly recommended!

review_title: 100% effort given by company and they WILL get you to your cruise ship in time 🙂
review_text:
Taquan Air created a highlight of our whole cruise.  My in-laws said "we didn't like it, we LOVED it!"  Booking was simple. Had a few questions so I called and were very helpful and professional.   The pilot was so friendly, talkative, and knowledgeable about the area.  The flight lasted the whole hour advertised and we flew over so much breathtaking scenery - my in-laws favorite was the high up mountain lakes.  The shuttle bus that took us back to our cruise ship was awesome..... our ship was at the end of the line of ships in Port that day and a decent walk from the pickup point but Taquan Air dropped us off right in front of our cruise ship.  We had been a bit stressed about it because we only had about a half hour from the end of the tour time until all aboard for our ship but, all stress was taken away when they said they could drop us right in front of our ship at the end. We were back on the ship well before our deadline time.
Thank you all so much and we will find you for another flight next time we're there!

This was my first time in a helicopter AND my first time at the Grand Canyon. My pilot was professional, funny, engaging, and knew a lot about the canyon and surrounding.  He was great about letting is know what to expect as far as the flight was concerned - which as a first time helicopter passenger I greatly appreciated! The flight was about an hour and we got to spend most of that over the canyon seeing the amazing beauty of it. Take off and landing were easy. I will definitely go on another helicopter tour - and most assuredly with these guys!

We had an amazing flight with Laura. Laura's knowledge on the tour was exceeded only by her piloting skills. They also let you fly the plane which was great. We will definitely be flying with them again next time we are here!

review_title: Sunny and clear day flying excursion
review_text: Although we were told that Ketchikan was the rain capital of the world we came and had our very best day of our entire Alaska tour. So on this beautiful sunny day we booked a trip from this very friendly young man at the dock in Ketchikan and told us we would have a great flight. He was correct we had a beautiful flight over the entire area and everyone of the flight crew and their offices could not have been friendlier and helpful. We even saw Dall sheep as we flew over the mountains

review_title: Amazing Action Packed Tour with So Much to See!
review_text: This is an expensive tour but worth every penny. We covered so much ground and saw so many amazing things that we couldn’t have seen any other way. What an amazing country and landscape. The Westwind team are absolutely amazing. Lindsey and her team went above and beyond to make our tour happen. I can’t believe how well we were looked after. Kip our pilot was delightful. He worked really hard to make sure every part of our tour was outstanding. He wasn’t just our pilot, he was our tour guide as well! I highly recommend this tour and Westwind!
We really enjoyed the experience.  The views of Kauai were fantastic,  All the crew was very friendly. and I would recommend tthis to my friends

review_title: We loved this round Kauai air tour!!
review_text: Exceptional all island air tour with a view from every seat, although the best views on this clockwise tour were on the right. Our pilot Nate was awesome and apart from flying the plane, he was a really great guide to what we could see over Kauai. Really enjoyed our experience with Air Ventures from checkin to take off, landing and goodbyes! Such a nice friendly and welcoming company. Would definitely do the same tour again. Highly recommended!

The flight was awesome and we were able to see some beautiful views! The only problem was our pilot/tour guide (Randy) didn't really tell us what we were looking at. He really seemed put out by having to have passengers. He just wanted to fly. Anyway, one tip I would give to people taking this trip: Bring a map of the flight path so you know what you are looking at.

My husband and I were originally looking for a helicopter experience, but were given the suggestion by our concierge to go on a more intimate plane ride with Eric of Maui Plane Rides. It was an amazing suggestion! We were able to have an experience with just the two of us and the pilot, I got to help fly the plane, and his plane is the only one that has an opening in the window for photo taking purposes. We were able to see all the views and sights that we had wanted to see in a helicopter, but in a much more intimate setting. Eric was a wonderful tour guide, giving us tons of information about what we were seeing. We were flying during the humpback whale season, and any time we saw a whale, he would circle around so we could see it better. The whole experience felt very personalized. He took some photos for us and after the flight, gave us a nice cold drink which was much appreciated! Out of all of our honeymoon activities, this one was my favorite, and I highly recommend Maui Plane Rides to anyone looking for an amazing aerial experience.
Piper was our pilot and she was so goooood! Not only experienced but knowledgeable about the island . It made our entire trip so much fun

Supper happy with this trip! From our arrival to the airport, the staff was friendly and welcoming. Our pilot was incredibly knowledgeable and went out of his way to make sure we had a good experience. I would recommend this to anyone!

My partner and I travelled to Kauai in June as part of a three island tour of Hawaii.  I'd booked the Wings over Kauai 'Grand Deluxe' tour over the Internet based on positive reviews and we were not disappointed.  The hospitality shown by Bruce and Ellen was fantastic and we felt more like family guests than customers.  The flight was perfect - even though it was a small aircraft it was perfectly smooth and the scenery.....   If you want to really see Kauai then it has to be by air and if you have to go by air then I'd recommend 'Wings'.  As a Scot, I also have to mention that the cost is far lower than the helicopter prices we saw.  And I must also mention Bruce's Bose noise-cancelling headphones - having suffered trying to hear other narratives in other places over the background engine noise these were fantastic.

Took K2 Aviation for a flight seeing tour and glacier landing on Mt. McKinley in Denali National Park, WOW what an experience!! This is definitely a once in a lifetime trip. Our pilot was knowledgeable about the mountain.

We so enjoyed this adventure.  It was a partly cloudy day but once in the fjords, there was a beautiful mist of clouds running through them.  The pilot had great commentary on the fjords and the background music was very peaceful and perfect for the setting. The landings were so smooth we almost couldn't tell when the plane was on the water! There was a little turbulence in the air but not so much that it made anyone sick and one in our group was prone to the that. We all loved the views and the ride!

Eric of Maui Plane Rides made everything smooth for our group to have the opportunity to see Mauna Loa erupting.  Booking was a cinch.  You’re in a small plane and Maui is known for its wind, but Eric has a very confident and calming pilot.  He also ensured we had amazing views on our excursion.  I will definitely book with MPR again when I have visitors!!!!

My wife surprised me with this aerial tour as a birthday present. It was fantastic. I'm a pilot and was able to log the ride as dual time. Great "island flying" tips even for the most seasoned pilot. Bruce is a personable, professional pilot who goes out of his way to make all aboard feel comfortable. The aerial tour is second to none with some of the most spectacular scenery we've ever seen.

The 30 minute seaplane tour of Miami Beach, South Beach, Virginia Key and Key Biscayne was outstanding. Captain Adriel was so much fun to fly with.  He is extremely knowledgeable on the history of the area and really enthusiatic about flying and sharing the experience with his guests. This is a "must do" experience when you visit Miami.

review_title: Neets Bay is NEAT---Best bear watching ever!
review_text: We were impressed with the concern for safety as well as scenery.  Just a wonderful ride to and from on the sea plane.  Everyone at Taquan Air so friendly.  Loved seeing the bears  interact with the salmon and other bears.  Very memorable trip!!

Highly recommend! We went on a windy afternoon- Marcus was a great pilot and kept the ride smooth and peaceful. Soaring above this beautiful island is a real treat. The hospitality from the time we arrived was top notch.

All the staff at Talkeetna Air were super wonderful. Flight was smooth with incredible views. We were blessed with rare clear skies as far as the eye could see. Able to see entire range of mountains. Thank you.

review_title: Great Floatplane Tour of Misty Fjords
review_text: Floatplane flying with Ed was fabulous. We hit a perfect blue bird day and smooth air. Could not have been better...unless it lasted longer. We saw a couple of brown bears, and so many beautiful lakes. So worth the time and fee to take in this adventure.

review_title: I'm 55 and it was the funnest thing I have EVER done
review_text: WOW , the day we were schedule to go it was cloudy so they gave us the option to go or reschedule, so we did, the day we went was so beautiful, and the ride in the Biplane was awesome ..... can't wait to go again.......

After driving around the parks and hiking to numerous locations it was perfect to see Arches NP and Canyonlands NP from the sky. We had a great time with Desi our pilot and Preston our Co-Pilot. They were very friendly and knowledgeable of the parks. We loved that our tour took us over both parks. There were great views of the Green and Colorado Rivers, and the landscape is just awe inspiring from the air. It was just the two of us with Desi and Preston so we enjoyed a more personal tour. The plane was a bit tight for us, not a lot of wiggle room, but we did ok for the 45 minute ride. Doug had his Go-Pro videoing out his window and I had my camera pointed out my window, clicking pictures like crazy! It was fun! The tour is well worth it!

review_title: Great Experience - not to be missed!
review_text: Our pilot took us up and around Mt. Denali and told us all about the mountain, expeditions, and the surrounding glaciers and peaks.  We lucked out because our flight was cancelled the day before due to weather, but when we woke up the next morning, the skies were totally clear and we could see Denali from our hotel lobby.  K2 was very cooperative in rescheduling our flight, and would have given us a full refund had we not been able to fly.  They stayed in contact with us throughout the 2 days, they kept our luggage while we were flying and got us to the train station on time.  They could communicate better with all the various people who answer the phone because we got different stories each time we spoke to a different person, but it all worked out.
Started our honeymoon in Kauai by seeing it from the sky. It was awesome the way the pilot went around the island so smoothly. He was great.What a beautiful island. Our pilot was very informative.

review_title: Fantastic trip and great customer service
review_text: We did the airplane tour over the west rim. We had heard that the south rim was better but the views from the plane were spectacular. An incredible experience! Our pilot Chris was funny and knowledgeable, we felt in very safe hands. We did have a bit of a mix up with the pickup location and missed our transfer but Kevin dealt with this very professionally when we got there and didn't make us feel stupid (when perhaps we had been a little stupid!) Brilliant customer service and meant that the miscommunication didn't ruin our experience in the slightest. Thank you!
We flew in an air conditioned C182 that was like new!  Very comfortable, great pilot!  Saw all the sights, just the two of us and the pilot.  Would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii!
Fantastic experience, professional and friendly team and lots of fun. Totally recommend it to everyone. We had 2 years old child with us and would absolutely do it again with him.
Excellent experience, memories that will last forever! TAT has the best service bar none. Friendly, professional pilots and staff!!

review_title: Excellent investment if weather is good!
review_text: Seeing Denali up close and personal in a plane is an experience I'll never forget. Rose Marie, our pilot, made sure the 3 of us saw both peaks of the huge mountain, climbing routes, glaciers, and pointed out other peaks in the Alaska Range. She knew elevations, she explained how tundra grows on top of glaciers and pointed out an ice fall from a calving glacier. It was well worth the cost. I was lucky because it was a sunny, clear day.

review_title: Kauai Deluxe Sightseeing was the best!!
review_text: Worth every penny.  The weather was amazing.  Views spectacular.  Our pilot was top notch.  Lots of good info while taking in the scenery.

Beautiful experience and once in a lifetime moment. 
Great to see Maui from the top. It was a top notch experience

What a wonderful way to see the Island of Kauai 360 degrees.  The view from the plane was picture perfect and the pilot was informative.  He even flew around the area that a whale was spotted so we could see and take pictures, but the whale wasn't cooperative.  We now have a great perspective of Kauai and where we would like to drive to when we land.  It is well worth the time and money to do the plane tour.

If I could give more stars I would. There is no other way to see Mt. Denali, the surrounding mountain ranges and the glaciers in all their glory. Landing on the glacier topped off a perfect flight piloted by an expert aviator and tour guide. This is a must do on anyone’s Alaska to do list!

This flight was incredible! The views were spectacular! We were going whale watching from Friday Harbor. The dilemma was that we were in Seattle for only a short time. I didn't want to waste the whole day driving to Anacortes then taking the ferry to Friday Harbor. Since it was my birthday, I decided to splurge and fly there instead. Jason was our amazing pilot, he was very knowledgeable pointing out landmarks and giving us little history lessons along the way. He is such a skillful pilot that the only way we knew he landed the plane was when we saw water splashing on the floats; otherwise you couldn't even tell because the landing was so smooth. Getting to Friday Harbor was such a fun and memorable experience in itself! We flew there and back in the same day. When we got back to the dock in Renton, the shuttle was waiting at the dock to take us to SEA-TAC. The door-to-door service was amazing!

Wow. If I could give more stars I would. We were warmly greeted at reception and then met our pilot Nick who guided us to our little plane for our flight to Mt Denali . Even though a nervous flyer I had complete confidence in Nick from the start and though nervous it was an experience I will never forget and so happy myself and my wife experienced. The flight up approaching the mountains was incredible where at one stage you could almost touch the mountain. The glacier landing and bEing in that pristine environment is indescribable. 
All I can say is hang the expense and just do it!
Thanks Nick again and to all the staff at Talkeetna Air Taxi

Our pilot Jake was excellent and very informative giving us a running commentary on the wonderful sights of Kauai. Fantastic flight over the Napali Coast and Canyon and what breathtaking views and stunning scenery. This really is the way to see the beautiful island of Kauai. Would highly recommend - I booked this trip months in advance from the UK and would imagine it is very popular.
Lovely, friendly staff and when we return we will certainly do this again!

review_title: Weather was bad and no refund
review_text: I was looking forward to going on this but due to weather two times we had to reschedule and not end up going.  The worst part is that Air Ventures stated they would refund our money but so far after 2 months, they have not done so and say its Expedia's fault.  No communication from them and won't return calls

This tour was so unique. We went with pilot Max, who was a great pilot. The staff took precautions in getting us up in the air. There was quite a bit of wind at our originally scheduled time, so they called to ask if we could reschedule to later in the day when the wind has died down, which we could. The views were breathtaking from the air. This was a unique experience & I'm so glad we did it! I would recommend it to a friend.
Thank you!
The entire experience was amazing!! The pilot was very knowledgeable and the flight took us through amazing terrain.

review_title: Excellent tour, great narrative and views of the island
review_text: Great tour and really gives you the whole perspective and views of the rugged terrain you can get no other way. Looking down on the water falls, flying in and out of the deep canyons is the only way to see this magnificent island. Bruce, the owner and pilot is very friendly and informative. As I am also a pilot, I did the flying and he managed the radio and navigation so it was a very relaxed and pleasurable experience. I would strongly recommend this tour to all who want to really experience the island that you can only see from the air and also to all pilots who would like to add this to their flying experience.

review_title: Once in a life time experiance
review_text: The K2 Aviation flight was my first time exploring over Denali. My Pawpaw and I took the Denali Grand Tour. This was my first experience with K2, but this was his second time. Even though I live in Anchorage, I had to experience the flight myself. The pilot was informative and extremely kind. It was a life time experience flying over beautiful glaciers and mountains. Since I graduate this Thursday, K2 Aviation employees gave me a sweet congratulations card (unexpectedly.) I would truly recommend this company to other friends, family, and tourists. We had such a wonderful time!
Best experience ever! Very unique! Highly recommended. Eric was great! Do this when you are on Maui!

review_title: Exciting is to say the least!
review_text: Wow! Just blew our minds.  Besides being a fabulous trip the employees were so very accommodating and mindful I will never go with any other company.

Es war ein Geschenk für meine Frau das voll und ganz ins Schwarze getroffen hat. Die gesamte Crew vom Shuttle Fahrer bis zu den Piloten ist wirklich super freundlich. Wir hatten 2 Piloten die wirklich alles erklärt haben. Vielen Dank Aaron und Collin. Der Flug über die Golden Gate Bridge und Alcatraz war einzigartig. Vielen Dank wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder. Es war jeden Cent wert. Thanks you very much

What a delightful and exciting adventure to fly over Kauai on a sunny morning.  We have been coming to Kauai for 29 years but we never realized how big and and the breath taking beauty of the island.  It is hard to imagine how many huge water falls the island really has without actually seeing them.  We were amazed at how clear the water was all around the island.  We could see the shallow areas, reefs, caves, and crashing waves. We learned about the vegetation by looking down on the changing areas. The Napali Coast is not really understood until you can see the huge valleys. It was the high lite of our trip. Thank you Air Ventures! Rick & Anne

My aunt visited and was disappointed The Mountain wasn't showing. I kept this a secret until we arrived in Talkeetna. Although weather had been troublesome, and the glacier landings were stopped due to softer conditions, going up with K2 made viewing Denali possible! The clouds cleared enough around Denali when we arrived to make it possible for her to see the summit. This was thanks to Daniel circling around for us and then getting in above much of the Alaska Range adjacent to Denali. Hunter and Foraker were viewable as well. Thanks so much to K2! I will share with everyone I meet that this is the way to go!

Our pilot was great. The views were unbelievable and we just couldn't get enough!  The ride lasted 2+ hours and we could have gone all day!  The pilot did land the plane on the water once and we all had the option to get out & stand on the foats. I would go again in a heartbeat.
Fantastic experience- beyond expectations- this was a once in a lifetime visit easily worth its price!

review_title: Great customer service for a trip to the Ruth Glacier Mountain House
review_text: We booked flights with K2 for a trip to the Ruth Glacier Mountain House for travel during the first week of May 2015. We are from Anchorage, and have a good understanding of Alaska weather. We were scheduled to fly to the glacier on a Thursday morning, but weather prevented K2 from flying us out until the following Saturday morning. Throughout the wait they were extremely communicative, updating us as often as they could on changing weather patterns, and keeping us informed of any possible windows. We spent two nights at the K2 Bunkhouse during our wait--the bunkhouse was clean and the staff was friendly. Being weathered out of the Mountain House was disappointing--for us it was a year in the planning and a high-cost vacation to have cut in half, but the attitude, communication, and courtesy of the K2 staff absolutely exceeded our expectations. And when we finally got up in the air, the flights were great! We would definitely book with them again. Thanks K2!

review_title: Float plane to black bears tour
review_text: Fantastic pilots, planes and the guide to the bears was great! Highly recommend this company and tour. Book early, limited number of people can go per day.

First visit to Hawaii. I knew I wanted to view the island via aircraft but was torn between airplane vs helicopter. I'm so glad we went this way. It was a great price  for what we did. Our pilot was extremely professional and informative. I enjoyed it thoroughly!

excellent adventure  well worth the price and our pilot was fantastic, he was knowledgeable of the area and answered all our questions. took the kids up and they had a great time. and we took great pictures.
thanks to all the staff, they were all very helpful and pleasant.

review_title: Seawind Aviation trip to Traitor's Cove was an amazing experience
review_text: They are a great company to do a tour with.  Amazing Bear experience at Traitor's Cove.  The landscape view from the float plane was beautiful, the pilot was nice and accomodating.  The Bear guide was nice, informative, and helpful.  Must of seen 7 or 8 bears eating Salmon from the stream.  My kids were amazed and then they fell in the love with the dog Max at the office, they must of thrown the stick 20 times in the water for him to go fetch.  Awesome experience from the 1st minute to the last!

review_title: Awsome way to see the island
review_text: Great experience.  Well worth the cost.  The pilot was very informative.  Learned a lot about the island.
Great time flying over the island. We saw many beautiful landscapes. Learned a lot about Maui history.

The experience was amazing the views Of the mountains was spectacular the landing on the glacier was flawless and a once in a lifetime experience. I would  highly recommend  this to anyone  and everyone

We were fortunate to have been blessed with a crystal clear day for our flight.  My daughter-in-law was very scared.  Our pilot went out of his way to make her feel comfortable and tried to stay away from the bumpy wind currents.  He did an excellent job of narrating and showing us the Grand tour.  I highly recommend K2.  Very organized, timely and friendly.

Maverick Helicopter Tours were professional from beginning to end. We called from Canada and they answered any questions we had. My wife's first experience so she was very nervous and didn't sleep much the night before or eat much before going but the staff was very reassuring and our pilot Billy was very caring and informative he was so knowlegable. The Grand Canyon tour experience was a once in a lifetime and Maverick tours made it a very enjoyable one. We would recommend this company to anyone even remotely thinking they could not do it, they will make the experience easy for you.

review_title: Displaced due to fire in Willow
review_text: A big thank you to Mrs Ann and the entire staff. While we're not able to fly to retrieve our personal belongings, everyone stopped what they were doing and made a plane and pilot, along with duffle bags available. They also went above and beyond to find us lodging..

Everything about this trip was enjoyable, from friendly check in to breathtaking flight. Went with my wife and 2 boys (age 8 and 6) and we all loved it. The views are spectacular and Capt. Bruce was informative and professional. We HIGHLY recommend taking this excursion!

Amazing trip, facilities 1st class, super organized and professional. Very nice facility. This is not a fly by night company (pun intended).  Merchandise at facility reasonable priced. I can’t say enough positive things about operations and excursion,

This was AMAZING! First of all the people were wonderful: the bus driver who picked us up at our lodge, the staff when we arrived, and our pilot. They were honest about what we may or may not see based on the conditions that day and we're extremely informative. The pilot was humorous and considerate. The views were beautiful and landing on the glacier was indescribable. It was fun, exciting, and the experience of a lifetime.

We did the Mountain Voyager with Glacier Landing on July 13.   Couldn't have picked a better day.   The whole experience was amazing and indescribable.   All the staff was great.  Our pilot Kris was very informative and gave detailed descriptions and facts about what we were seeing.  The flight had barely noticeable turbulence.   It's a must do if in the area

review_title: A great way to see an amazing island
review_text:
The best way to see Kauai. Our pilot, Harry, provided a running commentary of what we were seeing, which included both current topics (the US base!!) and the early history of human settlement. He even tailored the tour to take us to the area we were staying, giving us a birds eye view of our condo.
The true vastness of the canyon and the mountains can only be observed from the air.
As with whale watching, an Island flight is a must for all those visiting Kauai,

Heather at the front desk did everything she could to get us a flight seeing trip to see Mt. McKinley. She was great! Also our pilot Greg Sanoski gave us a wonderful trip. We can't wait to do it again.

review_title: Smooth, scenic flight around Mt. McKinley - terrific adventure!
review_text: My husband booked K2 as he had purchased the Alaskan Tour Saver book, and we had a 2 for 1 coupon for a flight to view Mt. McKinley.  Our flight was booked for 8:30 AM, but conditions were not good enough for the flight, and we ended up postponing it 4 times over the course of a couple of days. The staff at K2 was very accommodating and allowed us to reschedule the flight according to our travel plans. ...and it was a very safe feeling for a white knuckle flyer, like me, to know that they would not take the plane up until the conditions were optimum. Or actual flight was terrific - smooth and enjoyable with great views of McKinley, a friendly and competent  pilot, Chris, who pointed everything out to us. It was an amazing adventure - and one I would definitely repeat.  We highly recommend K2!

review_title: Kauai Big Kahuna Tour with Harry
review_text: Excellent tour. We were lucky to have very clear and sunny skies. Beautiful views of beaches and valleys that are inaccessible by roads.

review_title: Maverick helicopter tour was the highlight of our trip to Las Vegas
review_text: I'm surprised by some of the negative comments about this tour on Tripadvisor - we had a fantastic trip and it was the highlight of our holiday to Las Vegas.  The helicopter is expensive but we thought well worth it - and there are other cheaper ways of seeing the canyon if you are on a budget.  Maverick pick you up from your hotel (by mini-bus, rather than the advertised limo) and take you to their helicopter terminal at the airport.  You get to ride in a small helicopter (maximum 7 passengers plus the pilot, atlhough our trip only had 6 passengers) and get excellent views.  Our pilot swapped us around so we all got a chance to sit in the front.  On the way to the canyon we flew over Hoover Dam, Lake Mead and Boulder City - the views were spectacular and at times the helicopter takes you along the course of the Colorado river within the walls of the canyon.  You stop at a spot within the canyon and have their "champagne breakfast" - or rather, more accurately, sparkling white wine and cheese and fruit - and from the picnic spot there are amazing views.  On the way back we flew by the Valley of Fire - an amazing outcrop of fire red rocks to the NE of Las Vegas.  Our pilot did give us a commentary and a music sound track (including "Come fly with me" and the "Ride of the Valkyries"!).  I got the impression Maverick work the pilots quite hard and don't pay them a great deal - from what our pilot said - but this is a very efficient operation and an amazing way to see one of the great natural wonders of the world.

Flight onto Denali, it was truly amazing! Mike, our pilot was so accommodating, went in between the clouds for us to get a look at Denali and how many people can say they saw the very top of Denali up close and personal. It was a beautiful trip to and from the mountain with excellent commentary on the surrounding mountains, glaciers and rivers.

Had a stellar ride with Eric yesterday from Maui to the Molokai sea cliffs and Kalaupapa peninsula to celebrate my wife’s birthday. Waterfalls were pumping due to recent rains. Eric was an excellent guide and gracious host.
This 45 minute ride is not to be missed.  Sure it is expensive, but best value in the Canyon.  Everyone from reservations to departure was awesome.  Pilot was great- Bucket list worthy event!
We paid for the 1.25 hr. Grand Tour and were flying for nearly 2 hrs.  Safe and beautiful.  Also had a very comfortable facility, including picnic tables.
Amazing trip around the island! Our Pilot was incredible and made us feel at home. Would definitely recommend to anyone!
Wonderful flight. Heavy smoke meant no view of Denali from the ground or in the park. But a couple of thousand feet up and the view was perfect! Totally clear day. Great pilot and experience!
Amazing views - amazing trip! Absolutely worth every it. If you want to see Maui, you have to do it!

review_title: Great tour, but you are at the mercy of the weather!
review_text: We originally signed up for the Summit tour, but the weather did not cooperate and we were only able to do the Experience. The office there really has their hands full trying to get everyone the best flight given the weather at the time. The pilot was very knowledgeable and friendly, and the views are awesome from the plane! If you want to see Denali, this is the way.
Anbefalelsesværdig helikoptertur over Grand Canyon. Fin tur hvor man flyver rundt over Grand Canyon, og guide der fortæller samtidig.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: This was a must do activity!   Bruce the pilot and his wife Val are the best.   They went above and beyond to accommodate some last minute changes to our schedule.  So friendly and easy to work with.   The plane was very smooth and comfortable.   We have done helicopter tours in Kaua’i but much preferred our plane ride with Wings Over Kaua’i.  Bruce was so personable and knowledgeable and really made the flight memorable.   Top notch company and whole heartedly recommend!!

review_title: Don’t miss SF from the air!!!
review_text: Amazing flight over SF and yes, the city is even more beautiful from the air!!!! Our French speaking pilot was amazing, he had a lot of little stories to tell and was great with the kids on board. Everyone had a great time, I would definitely recommend this flight...

We had such a great experience doing the flight & hike up the the Grand Canyon. Booking w/ Westwind was easy and the people at the office were very helpful when we were trying to select the right package for us.  We hiked for about 1.5 hours on the Angel Bright Trail. It was great to see the canyon from below the rim. 

The tour was great! The flight up to the canyon via Sedona was so cool. Our guide for the hike was awesome as well. He was so helpful - had a backpack full of supplies and a wealth of knowledge about the canyon. It was 100+ degrees the day of our excursion and we really appreciated the guides preparedness. The pilot was also great!

For anyone considering this, flying up to the canyon is a treat. The scenery is awesome and it's a huge time saver. We felt like we really got to see the highlights of the canyon and we were able to do it from a 1 day trip from Phoenix. Way better than driving up and staying at a hotel we were not excited about. I'd definitely consider this company for a different tour.
I can't add much to what has already been said.  Bruce and his family are great.  I saw a whale from the plane, and we both appreciated the safety the plane provides.

Kaua'i had so much to do that we were running out of time to see Waimea Canyon and Hanakapi'ai falls.  The beneift of the air tour is it gave us a bird's eye view to see those sights, and so much more.  And indeed, the views were breath-taking.  

Our pilot, while nice enough, seemed a little bored and not especially knowledgable. Hence - 3 stars.

review_title: The vastness is amazing from the air
review_text: Picked us up on the dock and drove us to the seaplanes. Absolutely seamless take off and landing -- and the views from the air are amazing.  Our pilot landed us in one of the fjords and we walked off onto a pontoon.  So quiet, majestic and awe inspiring. The headset commentary had an unusual assortment of music; I would have preferred something classical, but that's perhaps just my taste. Worth every penny.  So glad we got up into the air to see a tiny portion of this vast wilderness of Alaska!
Glorious experience, felt like I was on a VIP trip soaring about the islands. It was amazing to see the islands in ways that I could never have seen away

What we could see was very beautiful. Unfortunately, cloud cover prevented us from seeing any of the canyon as well as the "Jurassic Park" waterfalls. Since most of our family are huge Jurassic Park fans, seeing the falls was one of the main reasons I booked this tour. Our pilot, Mark, was excellent. He did his best to make sure we saw all that we could and that people on both sides of the plane could enjoy the views. Another drawback was the time issue. We arrived half an hour early as directed only to leave half an hour late. This tour is not something I would do again.

This was our first trip to Alaska. We really had no plans other than hanging out with our grand children, daughter, and son-in-law and visit a friend’s home in Cooper Landing. 

Our daughter surprised us with a K2 flight seeing  tour of Mt. McKinley. We were thinking OK up and around the mountain and back to the air strip. But that was not the program. We actually toured the surrounding area including all mountains and learned the history of the area. We saw Mt. McKinley from every direction and then we landed on the mountain. Words cannot express the breathtaking beauty of it all and the hush of the mountain.

This is truly an adventure that each person has to experience at least once in their lifetime. Our K2 flight was the crème de la crème to a vacation that we have told everyone was the best ever.
Great memory! Definitely would recommend and do it again! First class staff and experienced. Thank you!
Air Ventures Hawaii one hour flight was the highlight of our trip to Kauai. The pilot was knowledgeable, the scenery amazing and the flights itself in such a small plane was excellent.

Expensive?  I guess it depends on your income and perspective.  I've paid more (much more) than this for a single night in a hotel.  This was my first ride in a helicopter, which made it especially interesting.  The weather was perfect the day we went out.  Pretty smooth ride; no one got sick.  Our uniformed pilot was very professional and attentive to everyone's needs.  They equip you with headphones and microphones that allow you to communicate with others.  They also play some theme music over the headphones that helps to set the mood.  We started out flying low over some flat wooded areas, and they played that Wagner composition from Apocalypse Now.  It was kind of like heading out for an attack mission in 'Nam!  Then suddenly the bottom drops and you are over the Grand Canyon.  Then they play music from Star Wars and 2001.  You don't just hover high above, they also take you in close to many rock formations so they are right next to you or right below you.  The length was just right.  I certainly did not feel like it was over too soon.  I went the day after Thanksgiving when it was really busy at the park, but still didn't see many other aircraft in the area.  Then we returned with some Indiana Jones music. 

Life-altering?  I wouldn't go that far.  But for me, it definitely fit into the category of "show me something I haven't seen before".  One more thing to cross off my bucket list.

We booked this same day since the weather had been iffy all week.  Had been in contact with the other popular company but went here bc they were rated #1, and also recommended by our helicopter tour pilot out of Palmer.  Liam was our pilot-super safe, friendly & personable.   He did a great job explaining things and taking us to see the vastness of the Alaska Range.  Denali was visible from Talkeetna part of the day and during our entire flight! What a treat.  Highly recommend this company.  (However, if you’re choosing between helicopter or plane flight tour for your vacation-I personally am in love with helicopters.)

This was my second time doing a flightsee of Denali and landing on the glacier.  Tales from the first time prompted some friends to come up from L48 and do one.  As with the first trip, it was epic, magnificent, and all-around spellbinding.  Our pilot was fantastic, very knowledgable about the mountain and the whole area, and just a great guy to have with us.  While the trip isn't cheap, I will continue to do it periodically in the future because I can't get enough of the whole experience.

My husband and I flew with Andy in a single engine Cessna. It was tiny but what a ride.  We did the South Face McKinley trip but McKinley, whilst pretty impressive, was not the main attraction for us.  We were blessed with great weather and the mountains and scenery was gob smackingly gorgeous.  Andy gave a narrative along the way and made sure we experienced the majesty of this mountain range.  We saw the glacier tour on the glacier and they were ant size which gave us a good perspective of how big these mountains are.  We flew within 25 yards down the side of a gully where you felt you could reach out and touch the snow.  If we had more time I would have loved to have gone again.  Well worth the time and money to do.  Thanks Andy, we had a great time.
This experience is once in a lifetime. Spectacular views of the islands. Would highly recommend this to anyone who is thinking of flying over Maui!!
Very fun and got some great views. The pilot was cool and professional. Definitely would do again with one of the other tours they offer
A buxket list worthy chance to see the island from a perspective that most dont get to see. Highly recommended, will be flying again!

This was a truly once in a lifetime experience. I saw a whale and learned a lot about the history of the island. My lover was actually the one doing the flying. So it was an amazing experience for us both, as it usually is when we’re both together enjoying life. Unbelievable experience. Really do recommend. More personal than a group helicopter tour crammed with strangers.

We had a wonderful time with Air Ventures on Kauai. My husband and I flew with Brian around the island and were amazed at the sights and the information that Brian shared with us. He was Extremely knowledgeable about the island and its history and our plane ride really made our visit to Kauai special. 
We highly recommend that anyone who travels to Kauai see its beauty by air and use Air Ventures. 
Chris and Sheryl from KC MO

We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves on the 60 minute tour over Nor Cal! The pilot was exceptional! Great tour guide! Weather was great! Highly recommend! Best way to see Point Reyes, Alcatraz, GG Bridge, San Quentin and so much more! The untouched beauty of the California coast made this a lifetime memory
It's a great fly. Mount Mckenley is so beautiful. And the glacier landing is spectacular.

I took my family from Canada for a SF tour.   

The pilot was funny, informative, and would modify his flight to show us areas we were interested in.

The highlights include the fly overs of both bridges, Alcatraz, and an amazing shot up Market street with the Ferry Building in front.    

He pointed out various landmarks along the way and issued antidotes that were great for the teens and adults alike.

My guests called it a highlight of their visit.    Would definitely do it again next time I have guests from out of the area.

only negative thing was the late pick up. there was a delay of about forty minutes.
other than that the experience was great.
the seaplane was great, something we havent done before. we flew out over the golden gate and then back over the city. the views were superb and the city looked fantastic from the plane.
reccomend this over helicopter trips as the experience is unique.

We chose Wings over Kauai based on their reviews on Tripadvisor, great ratings and reasonably priced. It was a good decision.
We booked the first flight in the morning @ 9:30 as per their recommendation, Josh was our pilot.  He was an excellent pilot and had very good knowledge of the island.  We saw couple of whales during our tour. It was amazing to see the island from the air. Breathtaking!!! 
A must  do tour in Kauai.
All in all 100/100 best experience ever make sure to pick Laura she is the best of the best super knowledgeable about the island smooth flying

Friends of ours had taken a trip with Seawind before so we were quite happy to go with their recommendation. We were on a cruise but booked this excursion privately. They picked us up and took us to their nearby office. I asked if we would need binoculars and they said it wouldn’t be much of a trip if you needed them. Whilst they do not guarantee bears they were pretty sure we would see some. The 20 minute flight is very smooth and we are met at Traitor Cove by our guide Drew and his very large gun. It is a quick drive to the sighting area and short walk in to a secluded “hide” to watch for bears. We knew they were around as there was some evidence. After a very short wait we saw bears coming down to the water to hunt for salmon, without much luck. However just watching the bears was a fantastic experience. Drew was an excellent guide, although the jokes he tells need some work. The flight back was great as well and the pilot even responded to a request to fly over a lodge owned by some friends. On arrival back at Ketchikan they were going to take us back to the ship but when we asked for a good place to eat they went out of their way to take us to a local restaurant. This was an epic journey. Seawind are a first class operation. Thanks guys.

I had booked tge Seaplane door as a surprise birthday gift for my son. He had taken some flying lessons I was very excited to fly to sea plane. The staff was very friendly the pilot was very knowledgeable and overall it was a great experience.

review_title: Unforgettable experience flying over the Grand Canyon like a condor.
review_text: Mavericks Helicopter Tours was an incredible way to really get a sense of the vastness and beauty of the Grand Canyon.  We went for our tour on Weds. morning and were not able to fly due to bad weather.  The tour staff helped us determine the next available date and time that would increase the probability for good flying weather.  We came back on Friday of the same week and we are so glad we did.  Ben the pilot was professional, informative, and fun.  I had never flown in a helicopter before and was a bit apprehensive but Ben's great piloting skills and the top notch helicopter quickly eased my fears.   The pilots are also able to choose the music that we listen to as we fly. Ben did a great job on his music selections.  My husband and I got the chills as we started are flight and really got a rush when we came to the edge of the forest and into the Grand Canyon.  WOW!!! It was awesome. Because we wanted to savor our memories of this special occasion, we also purchased the DVD of our experience for a reasonable charge.  Highly Recommend this tour company and the 45 minute tour.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_title: A different perspective on the Bay
review_text: It was awesome to see the Bay Area from above after living here my whole life! From the coastal views to watching the Bay Bridge toll traffic, there was so much to see and every detail seemed photo-worthy from a bird's eye view. Awesome weekend activity!

review_title: I LOVED Seeing Kauai By Air
review_text:
This was the fourth time my husband and I have been to Kauai but only the first time seeing it by air. We have never cared to see it by helicopter and the price was expensive. We found "Air Ventures" on the web and decided to try it. It was a great value too! It was a nice sunny windy day to view the whole Island.

I would recommend Air Ventures to anyone.

Alma Schlader
Swartz Creek, MI
Our guide was amazing! We were able to see whales, learn a few facts about the volcano and Valley . The colors this time of year were extremely vibrant and would recommend to any couples.

Mel was our tour guide and was amazing!! He spent the entire tour gifting us with his knowledge of the island, volcanoes and the history of the island. The tour was amazing.  Probably the best I’ve been on.  Highly recommend! The day flew by too fast.
tour_name: 15-Hawaii Volcanoes National Park Experience Departing from Oahu32_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_title: family that flies together, stays together
review_text: was truly the highlight of our Grand Canyon experience. While the kids were getting to the point of just one more view of spectacular Grand Canyon. From the helicopter it took on so much more meaning. Worth every penny you spend to see the areas of the Grand Canyon that the rim sightseers are not getting to take advantage of.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text:
Took friends from Texas to K2 for a Denali Flight on 28-August-2017.   It was an outstanding experience in all aspects.  

The weather mostly cooperated, but the top 25% of the moutain was fogged out, so we had to choose a different route than originally scheduled.  The pilot went out of his way to show great vistas and scenery.  

While Denali / McKinley was somewhat clouded in, the surrounding peaks and area were crystal clear and the scenery was stunning.

I've not been up in a light plane before, so this was a new experience for me. The pilot, Doug, was just what you'd hope a pilot would be; careful, considerate, professional and proficient.
This has to be the best way to see Kauai. Even though blustery winds changed the usual flight path for us we saw all that we wanted to see. We'd also be given the option of a refund due to the changed route.
If you have the time and the money I can't recommend this company and this pilot highly enough.

review_title: Fantastic experience -- a great way to see the Miami skyline and beaches
review_text: We did the hour long Miami City and Beaches tour -- it was great fun, and Tony was an excellent pilot and guide. Definitely recommended.

With limited options due to covid, we needed to charter a flight out of Renton to Vancouver Island and Northwest was our recommended option. The team of Michelle, Shane and our pilot Jim were helpful, professional and accommodating the whole way. 

Class act organization and a great way to travel. 

Thanks Northwest, we will definitely fly with you again.

My husband and I immensely enjoyed our entire experience with Wings Over Kauai!  It was a pleasure from start to finish.  Ellen was so welcoming when we checked in and Bruce was an excellent pilot and tour guide.  He is knowledgeable about Kauai and provides great commentary during the flight.  I was able to take lots of great photos and loved seeing Kauai from the sky.  I highly recommend choosing Wings Over Kauai if you are considering a sightseeing flight.

review_title: Stop reading reviews and book your flight!
review_text: The uniform accolades in all the reviews tell the tale. Just do it! This will be an adventure you'll never forget. Safe and comfortable, the staff were friendly, helpful and flexible (we changed our flight time with no problem.)

We've been in Kauai for a week and ended our tour with Wings Over Kauai.  Our pilot, Josh, was friendly and knowledgable.  The entire staff at Wings Over Kauai were super friendly and made us feel comfortable and confident...mom was a little nervous at first but would do it again!!!  We had a private tour with 4 family members with the cost below anything else we found.  If you find yourself in Kauai, book a trip with them, you will happy that you did.

We enjoyed beautiful views of the entire island and saw whales breaching in the ocean as well....our pilot was friendly and very knowledgeable..do not miss this fantastic experience! Richard and Angela from Ohio

This was such an amazing day. It’s a family owned business and the owner Steve took us on our flight this day. The views were breathtaking. He had music playing but any questions we had he would answer as we were all on a two way radio. If we saw wildlife he would make a circle so all of us were able to see it. We landed half way through our flight and got our for pictures and to take it all in. Then loaded back up and headed back. This was definitely a highlight of our trip. We will definitely fly with SeaWind Aviation again and highly recommend them.

We took the 30 min plane tour with Eric on the eastern slopes halfway towards Hana. We saw a lot of beautiful waterfalls and the coastline is so amazing. I also got to do a bit of "take-off" and "controlling the plane". The best part of this was that for a family of 3, any heli ride would have cost us atleast $750, this was only $299.

We have spent two vacations in Kauai and have done all the attractions.  This is the #1 - it puts the island in a beautiful perspective.  The pilot, Harry, was very informative and knowledgible of the history of Kauai.  $$ wise the best bargain of my lifetime.

Excellent, Amazing experience, your pilots will make you feel comfortable on your smooth ride to Neets Bay and we were blessed with an appearance of 6 bears and many eagles. Definitely worth the price! We booked through our cruise ship. Bring camera with telephoto lens, good walking/hiking shoes. We viewed the bears for about an hour. Approximately 25 minute fight to the area. Overall about 3-3.5 hours for excursion. They do have a salmon hatchery, which is the main operation for the site, it feeds the stream the bears search, so likely for bears to make an appearance but no promises are made. About 1/4 mile easy walk from floatplane dock to bear viewing. Bathrooms are available.

Ray, our pilot, clearly loves his work. He gave us extra time....about 90 mins. Very knowledgeable with a great sense of humor. Well worth the cost. Kuaui is gorgeous from the air. Very enjoyable trip with a real Veteran. Thank you for your service, Ray, and a really nice morning trip!
one of the most amazing things I,ve ever done. the pilot was excellent and very knowledgeable. Truly a must do while in Alaska.

The only proper way to enjoy Denali up close and personal "without" doing the 3 week climb to summit.  I have used this company twice now for flightseeing.  Both times were very different weather wise, yet equally mind blowing.  I have felt like I was in very safe hands both times.  The pilots are very knowledgeable and will not put you in danger so if you have a fear of flying, know that.  The views you get from any of these outings will really blow your mind.  I fully intend to go back for a third flight in fall.  You will absolutely no regret the decision to do this.
This was just beautiful. The views were amazing and the pilot made us feel very comfortable. Please do this.

I did the Everglades trip with Miami Sea Plane. The sparkling blue aircraft was waiting for me on the water. The Pilot was very friendly helped me climb on the plane. The seating is comfortable just beside the Pilot!!! It was a clear bright day. The take off and landing of the aircraft was amazingly smooth. We spent a lot of time looking at Key Biscayne, Slitsville, Fingers, Kay Islands and then Everglades. We even flew through a sea shower for a plane wash!. It was a 100% guided tour, music was played in between when we are not talking.  I clicked some amazing pictures to last me a lifetime.
Amazing experience with AWESOME views. Don't miss this opportunity of a lifetime. Staff was amazing with my 7 year old who had never flown before and the Captain was great.

What an amazing crew, so so accommodating and friendly!! Our pilot Eric was excellent and we felt safe throughout the flight! Jill was amazing with our 2 year old. Will definitely recommend Air Ventures to friends and family!

review_title: An Experience You Will Never Forget
review_text: Our pilot Wilbur did a wonderful job, you can tell he loves what he does and sharing his knowledge and experience of the Denali area and glaciers. The landing was something I will remember for the rest of my life. The weather was perfect and it was actually warmer on the glacier than I expected. Great photo opportunity so be sure to bring your camera or phone.  There are not enough adjectives to describe the experience - fantastic, wonderful, awesome! Be sure to add the landing to your flight.

I love flying smaller planes and so I had to try K2.  This turned out to be one of the best flights I have ever taken!  We set off in an Otter plane with room for 8 or 10 passengers.  Our pilot was excellent.  We flew over the valley and then did a circle of Denali and landed on a glacier.  Getting out and walking around in this snow capped place was pure magic..  I will never forget this experience.. The K2 staff and crew are super friendly and will get you the experience you are looking for with the choices the offer....  Can't wait to do it again and do yourself a favor and do it too!
Eric was really calm and enjoyable. Volcano and sunset was the best ever! Easy ride there and back. Landing was smooth as butter

Hi, I took the deluxe grand canyon trip from Phoenix. All was very well organized, friendly people at westwind and on our tour. Highly recommended. Jeff the pilot was knowledgable, flexible and a great pilot.thankyou

The views of the mountains, glaciers, rivers, and valleys was incredible. This was so much better than just seeing Denali from the ground.  The birds eye view was amazing. I highly recommend a tour with K2 Aviation for your Alaska trip.

Highly recommend doing a flight tour with K2!  They were great to work with and have upstanding and fair business practices.  How they approached our tours and rearrangement of them said a lot about them and I would absolutely use them again in the future.  We booked 2 flight excursions with them for mid-June 2018.  One was a sea plane/hiking tour.  The other was the Grand Denali tour w/ glacier landing.  Unfortunately, the sea plane/hike tour was cancelled because of the long winter and the lake had not yet thawed so they could not land and get to the hiking trail.  K2 was excellent in communicating this cancellation to me, explaining why, and refunding our deposit.  The Grand Denali tour w/ glacier landing was also modified.  The weather around Mt. Denali was not ideal for seeing the mountain, surrounding area, or doing a landing.  K2 easily worked with us to reschedule for the next day hoping the weather would get better.  When there still was no change in weather, they offered to give us a full refund or book us on a different flight tour which would go south towards Anchorage/Seward and would include seeing glaciers (but no landing).  They adjusted the price for this modification. The weather was better south.  We opted to do this tour instead and it was fantastic!   Seeing glaciers from the air and flying close to huge mountains was incredible.  The pilot was extremely experienced and narrated our tour with some great information and pointed out landmarks.  On the way back, he managed to catch sight of the very peak of Mt. Denali which had cleared for a few moments and we could see the top!  

A few people in our crew felt a little nauseous during the flight.  If this happens to you, I recommend removing the headset.  You won't be able to hear the pilot, but I found that removing the headset also eliminated the queasy feeling.  I think the headsets push against your ears/temples and can cause some people to feel sick.

We love K2 and are looking forward to coming back to Talkeetna again to hopefully get in the Grand Denali Tour w/ glacier landing next time!
This was a really cool thing to do. The plane and pilot were great. The views of the Grand Canyon were amazing. Well organized and comfortable.

What a fantastic experience.  Bruce is a great pilot while being very informative and funny.  We took the flight on the first full day of our stay on Kauai and used it to plan where to visit by car, although most of the views are only visible by air, so make the most of them.  We now have an hour of video and many, many photographs to edit before we show our family and friends our amazing adventure.  Bruce also involves you in the whole experience, allowing me to help him with his pre-flight checks.  Free pictures of us standing by the plane and a short promotional DVD were also included.  All this and still cheaper than the big helicopter corporations.  We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone wanting to fly over the island.

Such an amazing and memorable experience. Incredibly beautiful and unique way to see the island. We saw humpback whales breaching, incredible beaches and a breathtaking sunset! 

Our pilot was incredibly friendly and very knowledgeable! Would absolutely say this is a must do for someone looking for a truest wonderful experience!

I got a wild idea and managed to talk my wife into a flight seeing excursion. We had looked at doing it while staying in Denali, but had heard that the rates were better out of Talkeetna and this would also give my wife (prone to motion sickness) a chance to let the scopolamine do its thing.

We had our tour guide book the excursion. We weren't really into landing on a glacier, but we wanted to see the summit of Denali. K2 had us booked in an older, but well-maintained Piper Navajo. Our pilot, Chad, went over all the safety briefings thoroughly. Even pointed out that there was survival gear in the back of the aircraft as well as a satellite phone.

We lifted off and were on our way. Since we would be around the summit of Denali and the aircraft is not pressurized, we had to don oxygen masks. This was everything I hoped for as I looked at my wife and said, "Talk to me, Goose."

The scenery is unparalleled. The rugged peaks of the Alaska Range are all around as you see glaciers, ice falls, and even the various climber camps. Chad took us around the area several times, gradually gaining altitude until we reached approximately 23,000 feet, about 2 miles from the summit. I looked around and pretty much everyone else just had this look of awe and wonder on their face. It's certainly a view you will never get from the ground.

I can't recommend this trip enough. All too soon, we headed back to a smooth landing at Talkeetna Airport and we were left with memories.

Siamo saliti su questo aeroplano con le gambe che tremavano per la paura e ne siamo scesi con le gambe che ancora tremavano...ma ne è valsa la pena. Dall'alto abbiamo potuto ammirare una meraviglia della natura in tutto il suo splendore! Sconsigliato se si ha paura di volare e a chi soffre di nausea. Per il resto tutto fantastico!!

This was our first flight. The pilot was friendly and very informative. 
He made the flight pleasant. He removed all anxiety we had.

I bought this flight as a birthday present to my husband and I could not even think about a better present. The flight was awesome and I recommend it to everyone in the beginning of a Kauai vacation. The view was absolutely great and the comment of our pilot Bryan very interesting. The whole crew was so nice!!! We could only say  THANK YOU!

Ray is really an awesome pilot!He took us right up close to some cliffs,mountains,waterfalls,valleys and beaches without any kind of danger.You feel safe with Ray flying you.He gives detailed explanations of the stories and history of the places you fly over,as well as a very informative overview of Kauai's incredible history!Fly with him,you will be SO GLAD you did!!YOU DON'T WANT TO MISS THIS ONE!!!!

The best possible views over the beautiful Grand Canyon. 
Maverick were great throughout. Easy booking, efficient communications and great service.
Plenty of helpful commentary on the 50 minute South Rim tour.
A must-do experience.

review_title: Fantastic way to see Kauai - great service!
review_text:
My wife and I were visiting overnight on the Pride of America cruise, and decided to book the flights based on other very positive Trip Advisor reviews. The views on the flight were spectacular and it was a great way to see the Na Pali coastline and the Grand Canyon of the Pacific! The flight was very smooth and the commentary from our Captain Marcus was great. Highly recommended and arguably better than the more expensive helicopter flights. I particularly enjoyed riding up the front in the co-pilot seat! We were very impressed with the service from the entire team, particularly Ellen on the ground and Marcus. Thank you once again.

Mahalo,

Rob & Silvia - Adelaide Australia

We took the plane ride around McKinley.  It was awesome.  The flight was a bit pricey, but it was well worth it.  Landing on the glacier was quite an experience.  IT seemed like we could reach out and touch the peaks as we flew over and around them.  We'd spend this money again!  Things were well organized and ran on time.

I love flying and after trying seaplane in different part of the world I definitely wanted to try it in SFO...
A pick up was offered for 15 USD per pax at the Pier 39... Car was on time but was dirty, driver had no grooming and even stopped at a gas station to refill his glass of Coke!!! 
The terminal is old and dirty, as is the plane who is a stronger concern.
Smooth take off, beautiful view with a perfect weather, small engine problem ( a few sec ) over the city and perfect landing after flying over Alcatraz.
If the management was taking it more seriously it would make the perfect experience as the value for money for 30 min flight was very good and cheaper than in most of other part of the world 
On the way back I asked the driver to drop us at a different location as there was no other person.. He declined and did a drop 10 min walking distance from the hotel!!!

review_title: A must do...if you even thinking about it - JUST DO IT!
review_text:
Today - May 20, 2015 we took this flight (the Cessna tour).  If you read any of the reviews they will tell you how this is a family run operation, that Bruce the owner is an excellent tour guide, the check in is smooth and effortless, they don't take payment until you actually are there to check in, and the price is SIGNIFICANTLY less than a helicopter tour.

What you might wonder is can this all really be true, Is this worth it and should I book this?

The resounding answer to all these questions is YES!

The bottom line is this was the highlight of our trip.  We did ATVs, got stand up paddle board lessons, went to the Missouri, ate like kings, drank like sailors, went to the canyon, visited the light house, and even bought chocolate macadamias.  Don't miss this opportunity!  Family run company that really has your best interest at heart.

I really enjoyed my experience with Air Ventures Hawaii. It was super easy to book online, very reasonably priced, and I felt completely safe flying with Kevin. I booked my tour first thing (literally 1 hour after I landed in Kauai), and I'm so glad I did because Kevin was extremely knowledgeable and his input, as well as just being able to see the island as a whole, really helped me to get a good feel for the layout of the island and solidify my plans during my vacation. Kevin was very interesting, made the flight fun, and he offered cold towels and water to make as enjoyable an experience as possible. I would definitely recommend this to anyone interested in experiencing the beauty of Kauai, including places you may not normally get to see - beaches, mountains and valleys, and lots of waterfalls!
El piloto un encanto y muy servicial. La experiencia magnífica para repetir. Recomendaría seguro. Muy bonitas vistas

Easy to make reservation, everybody was waiting there, right on time. Flight incl taxi took 30 mins, flight alone 25 minutes, ok as promised. Flight was smooth, and pilot went twice over main attractions, once right, once left, so people sitting on either side could get their fotos. Only advice to pilot (John) would be to be a bit more talkative, he just informed us the bare minimum. Could say a bit more, also on conditions of flight. But overall great experience

We selected this trip on our honeymoon based on the reviews here and it did not disappoint.  Ellen was more than helpful when we contacted them via email in advance and due to some travel problems getting to Kauai - we thought we'd have to postpone.  She let us know that it wouldn't be an issue and made every attempt to accomodate us.  Great experience!

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Alaska
review_text: A highlight of our trip to Alaska! Seeing Denali and landing on a glacier. The pilot was informative.

We were thrilled with our flightseeing tour with Taquan Air Tours.  I am sorry I don't remember our pilot's name but he was a retired Navy pilot and he did a really great job.  He added his own special knowledge and flair to the narration and gave us a wonderful tour of the beautiful scenery.  One of our group was a first time flyer in a small plane, much less a floatplane and he gave her a great introduction to the adventure.  I would recommend this to everyone who wants an amazing view of some majestic Alaskan scenery.

Amazing experience! Each passenger has their own window to view the most breathtaking scenery. The pilot Randy was also an excellent guide. We landed on Pika Glacier and were the only people there. It was so quiet and surreal. Definitely a life-long memorable experience.

We loved the airplane as opposed to helicopter. The airplane flies higher providing better views. The staff was very helpful and we loved the experience. Less glare on the windows and the price makes this the best option and we are so glad we took this flight.
New and good condition aircraft, smooth flight and expert pilot commentary. I don't hesitate to recommend...
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text:
The clouds parted as we approached Denali and my jaw dropped. The glorious twin peaks came into view veiled with misty clouds and the sun drenched snow covered shear walls of granite blew my mind. We circle heaven for 30 minutes and then dropped down to follow Ruth glacier all the way back home. 

This was my second trip to Talkeetna. The first time it rained and I never saw the mountain so this time I allowed three days to stay flexible with flying times. Sure enough it rained on our scheduled flight time but K2 was very good about rescheduling for the next day and even suggested I call before my flight time to see if there was and opening for our group to land on the glacier. Unfortunately the rain made the glacier to soft for landing so K2 offered a one hour flight only tour. We all agreed it was an amazing experience anyway. 

My father was very afraid to fly on such a small plane. Our pilot took off and landed the Otter plane so quickly we could not even feel it. He gave us safety instructions before taking off and a good verbal tour of the mountain during the flight. 

Do it!
My wife and I had a wonderful time with them learned a lot about the island and yes we are going book with them on our next trip there

review_title: Not to be missed! Breathtaking Summit views!
review_text:
Wow! What an experience. My husband and I took the Summit Tour. I will first say a bit about safety. When we arrived we were notified that the flight may have to cancel. Yes, it was disappointing but we knew that the company making money was secondary to our safety.  We got lucky and the weather lifted and we got to check this flight off of our bucket list.
 
I wish I could remember our pilot's name but we have been on a 2 week vacation. Names are running together. I will say that my husband and I are both pilots and in the aviation industry. The professionalism that our pilot and ground service (rampers) showed was wonderful. We had an older gentleman that urinated on himself during the last half of the flight. The gentleman was on the last row and was first to get off. He told the pilot and ground crew that he had an accident. As any of us could imagine this had to be terribly embarrassing for the gentlemen. The pilot and ground crew stayed professional and never made any negative comments. The pilot made sure attention was taken off of the man. They all should get a pat on the back. Everyone from registration people to the other pilots were very friendly!

Now, the flight was unbelievable! Many things you do once in a life but this is something we would do again! The summit tour was breathtaking. Our pilot made sure we were comfortable. He checked with us regularly for cabin temps, ears on decent etc. We all had a window seat. So, basically there is no bad seat. Everyone gets an equal chance to see. The only thing we would have done differently was add the glacier landing. At the time we went glacier landings was not safe because there was not enough snowfall during the night. Facilities were great! Coffee, tea and hot chocolate provided. The only thing you need is a pair of sunglasses and your camera!

We highly recommend this flight for any age!

Book this flight right away....very personable company with an aim to please....smooth ride...great points of interest thanks to our pilot Bruce!...This is probably our best memory of our Kauai vacation. My wife received a lei before boarding and we received a DVD (previously recorded footage) with a personalized DVD cover (very nice touch!) Highly recommended!

My husband and I made an expensive detour to Las Vegas, especially to see the Grand Canyon.
He had never been there and we flew in from Washington late at night, spending a total of 31.5hrs in our hotel (2nights). But what a great experience and well worth the detour in our holiday.
The ground staff were timely in their hotel pickup and courteous. Mike our pilot was friendly, knowledgeable and clearly good at what he does as he is also the company pilot assessment officer.The company has a well maintained fleet.
We shared our five hours with two young couples and we all got to spend time in the front seats. 

A spectacular experience. Thank you Mike. Thank you Maverick!

We did the Base Camp McKinley tour with a landing on Eldridge Glacier on 8/16/11, and it was incredible! It was the highlight of our trip, and a highlight of a lifetime. The day we went it was extremely clear, so the views were breathtaking! My wife and I both agreed that because the power and the beauty were so intense, there were times when it was very emotional and even spiritual.

Was it expensive? Yes. Was it worth it? Absolutely! It was worth every penny! We found a discount coupon in the Bear Foot magazine that helped, but even without it, it would have been worth it. Also, if you decide to do this, I hope you get Bill (forgot to get his last name) as your pilot. He was a wealth of knowledge, and his commentary added so much to the experience.  

Friends look at our pictures and are amazed (as we were)! I know I sound like a commercial, but this was a fantastic experience in a place loaded with fantastic experiences. I strongly recommend it and Talkeetna Air Taxi; they were great!

We originally took this tour for $75 per person for a 30 minute flight and greatly enjoyed it.  But when we brought guests back the following year, they were given a 10 minute flight and a different  pilot who didn't explain as much about the area as with the original flight.  We found it very overpriced and not worthwhile. Ten minutes is too little time given that we spent a total of $225 for the three guests.  When I contacted the company, they told me the flight was longer, but that was simply not true as I stood on the ground and checked the time exactly when they began to taxi and when they returned.

review_title: Breathtaking way to enjoy the road to Hana
review_text: Instead of driving the road to Hana, we chose to fly.  Our outstanding pilot, Brad, hosted the tour and provided us with breathtaking views of the island as well as the rich history of the land.  Money well spent!!!

Taquan Air was a great choice. This is a big operation. Very Professional.They have 5 or 6 planes, a big dock and check in/waiting room. The flight was beautiful. We went to the Misty Fjords where he landed in a cove, we got out on the pontoons, took pics, & flew back a different route.
