There are alot of choices of planes that do this and I chose Taquan because I could use my 2  for 1 coupon from my Toursaver Book.But after seeing all the others, I think they have the best planes & biggest operation. We felt very safe with a competent pilot.

09:30 du matin. Nous sortons de Jailhouse café en nous demandant "comment" visiter cette région extraordinaire qu'est MOAB. Nous passons devant une boutique de vêtement, intrigué par les ours en peluche en costume de pilote. Nous levons les yeux et nous voyons "visitez Canyonland, et les environs en avion". 378 USD. Cher mais après tout, pourquoi pas ? Nous ne reviendrons plus dans la région avant quelques années. 

1 heure de vol, de pur bonheur. Une occasion unique d'avoir une vue globale sur tout le Colorado : Cayonland, The Needle, The Maze, Island In the Sky...bref, en 1 heure, vous en verrez bien plus qu'en un mois. 

EXTRA ORDINAIRE ! 

Pas prévu au budget, aucun regret : nous ferons l'impasse sur la limousine dans Las Vegas :)

Prix final : 322,91 euros. Franchement, pourquoi se priver ???
It's a little noisy and the wings and spars can get in your photos but it's romantic and nostalgic and Kevin is almost as long lived as his plane. It's a perfect fit for some!
The flight was excellent!  It was an incredible experience of Maui from the heavens.  It is more beautiful than expected.

Our pilot was so nice and accommodating to us and my elderly mother who requires a little assistance moving in and out of spaces. The flight was spectacular. Great lobby waiting area. Highly recommend this company, they deliver.
Just wow! Perfect for 3 friends., highly recommended!!! Gorgeous scenery very original experience!!!!!
The tour was an amazing way to truly see many ways sights in Hawaii! We really got a true feel on what Hawaii really is, a nature packed adventure with some amazing scenery!!

Our annual family vacation this year was to the Grand Canyon.  I had been as a child and can still remember how awestruck I was at seeing it despite seeing pictures before.  I decided to provide a surprise viewing of the canyon form multiple different perspectives via Westwind Air tours.  It was kept a surprise till the minute we arrived at the airport and was a huge success. Most liked the helicopter ride into the Canyon the most.  Our family of eleven had to take 2 planes and helicopters, but we were kept together the entire trip by our delightful and informative pilot/guides, Lowell and Carl. Despite the inevitable family drama, they maintained equanimity. The only drawback was the length of the whole event...we were exhausted!

Fun, friendly, a little less formal than the published brochure. Photography through a window is tough do to glare off glass - you will wind up with a reflection of yourself in most photos. Bring a polarizer if you can.

Everyone at K2 was great to work with. They took the time to help us pick the best option for our flight, and they were very professional at check-in which showed that our safety came first. Due to covid, we wore our masks from the moment we walked in the door until the time we left. Our pilot told us all about the plane before we boarded: where the life vests were, where the radio was, where emergency supplies were stored... you know, in the event we didn't make it back as expected. On the flight out, he told us what we were seeing, and although we didn't get to land on the glacier due to weather, we still immensely enjoyed our time. Part of our payment was immediately refunded once we landed due to the cancellation of the glacier landing. We left elated and with LOTS of great pictures! Advice, you'll see more of Denali if you sit on the right side of the plane. Go- it's beautiful and unforgettable! Highly recommend!

All were friendly and helpful.  They went out of their way to make sure that we enjoyed our flight and tour.  Saw wonderful views...smooth flight and landing. We have already recommeded rhis excursion to our friends who are planning a trip to Kauai in March!

user_location: Hyde Park, New York, United States
review_text: My wife and I had booked a flight several months ago and the crew at talkeetna air taxi could not have been better. We scheduled an AM flight with a glacier landing but the weather was not agreeable. Luckily we were able to be flexible and the staff did a great job of keeping us posted on updates and got us up in the air by late morning. Our pilot was professional and informative. The flight was very smooth and the views were amazing. Unfortunately we could not land on the glacier due to fog but our pilot took the extra time to show us some better mountain views. Personally I enjoyed the air time so I wasn't disappointed at all. When we got back TAT was more than happy to refund us for the glacier landing. Overall we had a great experience and our flightseeing tour was one of the best moments of our Alaska trip. The only thing I would advise is to be flexible with your plans to account for the weather.

Our pilot was very knowledgeable about the history of the plane we were in as well as the great Alaskan frontier.  The pilot stayed engaged with us throughout the flight and passengers were able to talk amongst ourselves to share our experiences. The glacier Landing was breathtaking. We could not experience the glacier and majesty of Denali in any better way.

review_title: Epic treat. Do it, even if only once in your life.
review_text: Besides being a fantastic pilot, Lou was incredibly knowledgeable regarding Glaciology and mountains. His tour gave us a deeper appreciation of what we were beholding.  I’ve been on many Denali flights and the majesty cannot be put into words. This was my first glacier landing and it was SO WORTH IT! Everyone at K2 was professional and accommodating.

Made a reservation to tour Mt. McKinley but the weather wasn't good enough.  K2 offered to reschedule, do a different trip or give us a full refund.  Can't ask for more than that.  We chose an alternate trip to the Knik glacier and it was a lot of fun.  Landing on the glacier near McKinley would have been better but I have no regrets.  K2 is a totally professional organization, and I heartily recommend them.

review_title: The only way to see the scale of this beautiful landscape.
review_text:
Sightseeing trip in a single engine Cessner. An 8 seater plane, but our party of four was on our own on the day with Chip the pilot. An amazing journey, which puts into much better context the sheer scale of the sights you see on the ground in this part of Utah. We flew over Canyonlands, Dead Horse Point and the Needles.  However, visiting the Needles Overlook a couple of days later made us realise just how little you see of it all from the road and view points, compared to this aerial trip. Fascinating to see the confluence of the Green and Colorado Rivers and the different colour shades of the two rivers as they converge.

Visibility from the plane was very good, and the ride was very smooth, on the day. Chip, the pilot, explained everything and the plane is also equipped to take a video, which he is sending us, to save us the trouble of taking photos constantly, although the sheer beauty of the sights meant the camera was still much in use.

A trip not to be missed if possible.

Flights go from the Moab airfield which is only about a half an hour or so from Moab itself
The retail store is so cute and the clerk was so super friendly that I bought a jacket and we’re booking a tour!!
What a wonderful experience.  The glacial landing is not to be missed.  A great operation.  First Class.
Magnificent. Breath taking. Pilot was knowledgeable about the area and his experience as a pilot was evident throughout the flight as he explained weather conditions.

review_title: This tour is a must when visiting kauai!
review_text: You get to see all the island attractions from above. As Kauai is such an spectacular place the trip is awesome. There are canyons and mountain ranges that are unaccessible from the ground and a plane trip is a chance to enjoy these unique views. The view from the Na Pali coast is breathtaking, unforgettable from above. The flight ride was smooth and thorough and the captain was friendly and professional. The check in process was smooth and the girl that handled it was nice and helpful. Overall a great experience. Money well spent.
Loved every minute of this tour. Very friendly staff. Lunch was a hot meal of fair value but who cares. The rest of the tour was awesome!

review_title: One of the best experience in my life !!
review_text: We did the south side explorer with glacier landing . Glacier landing was the best part of the trip . Enjoyed every bit of it .The people at Talkeetna Air Taxi was very courteous and helpful.

This is expensive, but worth every penny. If you visit the Grand Canyon and can afford it, we recommend you do it. For us it was one, if not the, highlight on our extended US trip which brought us to places like New York, Yosemite, San Francisco etc. You get fantastic vistas of the Grand Canyon. For our kids the Heli ride was in itself an experience they will long remember.  Maverick stands out as a provider. Security: we get the expression of a well run undertaking with very experienced pilots. Contrary to the local competition, they completely shut down helicopters between flights so that the helicopters can be refueled and briefly checked and the pilots can take a short break from flying. We find this is a great plus for security. Entertainment: Our pilot was motivated and contributed a lot to the overall experience. In flight we could talk and ask questions over the inflight system. We even saw some Bisons on the ground over at the north rim during flight.

This is absolutely one of the things to do when you visit Miami! We did the Miami Seaplane tour the 1st day and it was a fantastic trip! The pilot was so nice and cool, we listened lounge music during the trip, very relaxing! We loved it!

Ein absolutes Muss am Grand Canyon. Professioneller Kontakt, am besten den Online-Chat nutzen, alle Fragen werden sehr gut beantwortet. 

Im Vergleich zur Konkurrenz gibt es keine bezahlte Garantie, um vorne sitzen zu können. Wir konnten den Wunsch aber vorher hinterlegen und für den Fall, dass dies sonst niemand macht und die Gewichtsverteilung dies zulässt, sitzt man dann vorne. Hat bestens geklappt. 

Wir hatten aus Gründen des Wetters den Flug sogar noch einen Tag vorher um 1-2 Stunden vorverlegen können. Wir wurden von Alex mit coolem Soundtrack über die Rims geflogen (das erste Rim bleibt allen in Erinnerung - ein toller Kick).

Trotz Wind war der Flug ruhig, der Heli sprang nicht, sondern die Piloten wissen den Wind gut mit der Flugbewegung auszugleichen. Ich bin da recht empfindlich und hatte keine Probleme.

Das Video vom Flug lohnt sich, da die Kamera unter dem Heli befestigt ist - das schlägt alle Aufnahmen vom Sitz aus, wenn auch die Auflösung und Farbtiefe des Videos besser sein könnten (DVD).

Maverick fliegt auch ausschließlich mit Eurocoptern im Vergleich zur meisten Konkurrenz. Die paar Dollar mehr haben sich echt gelohnt, wir haben das aber erst vor Ort mit Blick auf die Anbieter richtig verstanden, warum.
Very smooth ride.  Definitely the best way to take in the enormous size of the Grand Canyon.  Excellent commentary and history of the canyon.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_title: A wonderful time in the sky...
review_text: We were quite hesitant before booking this seaplane adventure… and it was fantastic ! we first enjoyed to take off from the see. The plane is narrow and it was fun to share this flight with the pilote, nearly as a co-driver. This man was highly experienced and gave us confidence. The flight over the bay, SF, Golden Gate, around Alcatraz (visited later with the same ticket) and so many nice villas was very impressive ! to be tested without any hesitation and -I'm sure- highly appreciated !

Excellent company and tour. Bruce the company owner and our pilot was very personable and knowledgeable. If safety is a concern, fly a fixed wing aircraft. The GA8 is an awesome plane for sightseeing.

What a great experience. We took an early morning flight on the biplane with Harry as our pilot.  Harry showed us all around the island,  pointing out all the beaches and canyons.  We saw at least a dozen rainbows.  A surprisingly smooth flight.

We really enjoyed the flight around the Island.  We would never have benbeen able to so the island like we did and the weather was perfect.  Brian was very informative and fun to be with. review_title: Captain Harry...endless thanks for an amazing tour!
review_text:
We booked a 3:00 flight on April 1st. The experience was excellent from the moment we spoke with Nicole on the phone to schedule. Our Pilot was Harry and he was everything we could have asked for. He was knowledgeable, personable & had a sense of humor. He really cared about making our flight memorable and made sure to warn us to get ready for some great photos. I wish that we could have recorded his narration of terrain, all the falls heights and the elevations. He is knowledgeable about beaches and the locale as well. Harry, on behalf of my husband and myself I want to again say ~Thank you~ it was better than we expected. You definately have chosen a career that you seem to really enjoy sharing with others. We wish you and Air Ventures all the best.

~Mike & Karen Capps, Doty, WA

review_title: Weather Cancellation? Ask For A Reschedule - TERRIFIC!
review_text:
My wife and I spent two weeks in Alaska. We booked/visited nearly a dozen tours/events/museums and this was by far our favorite. Read the other positive comments and look at the photos from other reviewers - they are spot on! 

We were scheduled for a fly-over Mt. Denali on Aug 25th, the 100th anniversary of the National Park Service. The fog socked in K2 and we were alerted that our noon-time flight had to be cancelled. Later in the afternoon we met a K2 rep in our hotel and found out that weather was very promising for an early morning flight the next day. We took it - it was great! We were lucky but lesson learned -ask for a re-schedule ASAP.

If you are concerned about motion sickness or a bumpy ride, don't be! This take-off and landing was much smoother than the commercial flights we took to and from Alaska. Our plane was an 8-seater Piper Cub (see my photo). Everybody had a window seat. However, if you sit next to the pilot, your view is slightly obstructed by the instrument panel. We were all supplied with noise reduction headphones so the pilot could keep us informed to the viewing highlights. It was also cool to hear the chatter between the pilots and ground control. Apparently not all flights supply headphones. A couple we talked to later said that their flight from Fairbanks to the Arctic Circle was extremely noisy.

If you plan to take photos, go with a wide to medium-angle telephoto lens WITHOUT the UV Haze filter. There is no need for a long lens and not much room for extra equipment on the plane. They supply a large, secure locker for items that you would like to leave on the ground. 

This is one Alaskan tour that we would surely do again!
Excellent trip!  You will have a great time!  An exhilarating experience with great pilots.  The glacier landing is well worth it.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: The staff was friendly and informative when I called before our trip. The day before our scheduled flight was rainy and the weather was supposed to be the same the day of our scheduled flight. Staff was very accommodating in switching our flight to the following day instead, which was in the 70's and sunny. Our pilot, Andy, narrated as he flew us from one beautiful sight to the next. Seeing my 87 year-old mother's face as she stepped on to the glacier was definitely the highlight of our Alaskan trip!
Amazing experience with some amazing views! Great service and loved being able to fly the plane! Overall would definitely do again!

This was a once in a lifetime experience!  If you are considering doing this, I highly recommend you do it, you won't regret it!  Lou was an excellent pilot and explained a lot about what we were seeing. Landing on the glacier and seeing Denali are something we will NEVER forget.

We had the most amazing flight over Kauai with Wings on Kauai.
Our pilot Brooke was very nice and skilled, and a really good tour guide. She was so good at showing us all the cool places, and really good at telling us about it all.
We had considered a helicopter trip, but ended up choosing the trip in a Cesna, and we have not regretted it. It was the best trip.
The biggest recommendation from us. If we come back to Kauai, we will definitely have another trip.

TAT exceeded our expectations in every category, amazing customer service, highly skilled, and top notch pilots, just and amazing outfit that will allow you to experience the Alaska Range and Denali with all the amazing splendor that it has...  I recommend them

We recommend this flight and glacier landing to everyone! It was a cloudy day and the pilot, Greg, made the decision to land when he actually saw conditions on the glacier.  Greg was very knowledgeable about the area and was very patient in answering ALL the questions that our son asked! K2 planes are outfitted with emergency situation supplies and alert systems which also made us feel safer.  Our family of 6 was able to fly in one plane which was also a bonus.

what an experience! Fabulous views, felt surreal! Still can't believe the beauty of the place. We were lucky to go with Maverick Tours.  They were informative and determined to give the best views pointing out key features during the trip. My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed the trip and regularly talk about this tour as a highlight of our Route 66 road trip.
The views were amazing. Wric was knowledgeable and very personable. It was truly a VIP experience. I highly recommend!

review_title: Fly K2 Aviation! They don't disappoint
review_text: K2 Aviation staff was friendly, informative and flexible. We had to reschedule our flight time a couple of times and they were very accommodating! We had a lovely flight with great views and weather! We appreciated the smaller group and informative narration! Felt very safe and enjoyed everything about our experience with K2! Thank you for the memories!!

This flight was part of a Best of Kauai tour we booked but couldn’t fly due to the weather.  So we took it the next day which was a picture perfect flying day.  It was awesome!  Our pilot Kevin was exceptional , informative, fun and friendly.  This is absolutely the way to see the island!  We’ve done heli tours before but I would recommend this instead!  An hour flying around the island , up the canyons, over the waterfalls , etc.

As a pilot out of practice it was a great chance to get in the air again.  Strongly recommend Bruce and his team!  They even provided a DVD - personalized with footage from the Island.
Viewing the natural wonders of Kauai from the air is spectacular. The pilot and staff at Air Ventures make the experience very enjoyable. Highly recommended!

Everything was perfect!  The welcome made by a lovely lady and a very professional Jeff pilot, kind and reassuring. Competent as a pilot but also very knowledgeable throughout the entire plane trip. review_text:

On this season your options to have a glimpse of the amazing Napali coast are limited, and it is really worth it to see it, after you’ve come so close. 

Besides the price difference between a helicopter ride and the airplane one I really suggest the airplane although you do not have the “wahoo impression of the helicopter” because :

- You are sure to have a window seat
- the amazing views you’ll have require more distance than upclose 

We did choose the Cessna tour as we were two. Our experience was great from the welcome desk to the landing. We really got an overview of the whole Kauai island with beautiful scenery. Our pilot, Brooke gave us a very smooth ride and useful information while flying over the island. She was great. 

Because many places of the island cannot be seen from the ground Kauai really deserves to be seen from the sky. Wings over Kauai is really a very good option (the best ?) to reach that goal.

Mahalo for the experience and the amazing views.

WOW!!!!! Ray was an amazing pilot and very entertaining. This was the highlight of my vacation. I felt safer in a plane than a helicopter and from talking to other travelers we made the right choice. HIGHLY recommend this.

K2 was very good. They have lots of planes and the pilots are well versed in the area. Our pilot was Dallas, who was very helpful in explaining the area and answering questions. The office staff were efficient and friendly.

review_title: I’m at a loss for words!
review_text: This was my first helicopter ride and was lucky enough for it to be in Maui.  From the minute we walked in the front door to the minute we left, nothing but top of the line service.  Our pilot, Brad, was extremely knowledgeable about the area and encouraged conversation and questions. review_title: No bears to be seen, but a Great Ride!
review_text:
We wanted to do something really special and different while on our recent cruise to Alaska and thought a ride on a small plane to see bears in their natural habitat would be perfect.  As luck would have it, we were blessed with a warm, sunny day for our flight-seeing trip with Seawind Aviation to observe bears at Traitor's Cove.  

We were picked up as scheduled on the dock, driven to the DeHavilland Beaver 6-passenger floatplane, shown a brief safety video while we all settled our accounts, and led to the plane.  I have to say that I had been nervously anticipating this small-plane ride since the day we booked months ago, but the ease of getting my arthritic legs up and into the aircraft and the silky smooth takeoff melted away all my fears.  

After about 20 minutes of beautiful scenery, with pilot Steve narrating as we flew, we landed effortlessly at the dock, where a short walk brought us to the van that would drive us into the rainforest to a trail.  With some preliminary instruction in the event of a confrontation with a bear, we walked along the half-mile trail to an observation deck overlooking a creek, where we all had our eyes peeled for bears coming to feast on spawning salmon.  

Unfortunately, the unseasonably warm, dry, sunny weather - while great for the tourists - had not been good for bear sightings.  The water level in the creek was low, with fewer salmon, resulting in fewer bears.  Sadly, no bears were seen on this trip.  On the upside, we did see a bald eagle or two in the area which occupied our time for a time at the creek.  

Although we were disappointed that the bears did not come out to play, we still enjoyed the ride immensely and marveled at both the experience and the beautiful views it provided.  Owners Steve and Leslie run a nice business.  Leslie welcomed us warmly on arrival, and Steve provided a smooth, safe ride.  I would highly recommend them and hope to return one day for a ride over Misty Fjord.

review_title: Great experience, a must when in Vegas!
review_text: It's got to be done! We took the plane with Mavericks to the Grand Canyon. They did not disappoint! A very professional and fun tour. If you're in Vegas you must do this! review_text: Our flight over Kauai was a spectacular finish to our week on the Island. I only wished we had taken the flight at the beginning so that we would have a better idea of all the possibilities. Remote beaches, little known trails, secret waterfalls.... Kauai is a beautiful place, but flying over the island gives you a completely different perspective.  A gorgeous rain forest clinging to the face of soaring mountains covered with waterfalls. Our pilot was excellent and the flight was flawless. Crossing over the mountains and then descending down along the Napali Coast was amazing.

We lucked out with a fabulously clear day. Chris, our pilot, was funny and receptive to guest concerns and the whole experience was easy and fun! We will never forget this magical ride to denali and around its jaw-droppingly beautiful peaks and glacial valleys. Thank you, K2, for a wonderful time out of Talkeetna!!

My son is thru the AirForce ROTC program to become a pilot and Bruce let him co-pilot.  So fun.  Kauai is just beautiful and Wings Over Kauai was the perfect way to see it.  We loved it!

Awana was an amazing tour guide!! He was very knowledgeable and so friendly. It was a great tour! We got to see a lot of the Big Island! The best part was definitely seeing all of the beautiful sea turtles on the black sand beach. Thank you so much Awana!!

review_text: This was my second time on the Misty Fjords tour at Taquan. Being a pilot myself, I always enjoy flying on the DHC-2 Beavers, great airplanes! The views of the Canyon are simply breathtaking and truly the only way to get a sense of its vastness. We came back with plenty of incredible memories and the certainty that the money was well spent.

This was a humbling experience. We ended up having to wait 3 days for the weather to clear to take this tour. The mountains and views were spectacular. Landing on the glacier at the foot of Denali was humbling and breathtaking.

review_title: Far and away our best event in Alaska
review_text: We were in Alaska, in three different cities over 9 days.  We did multiple events each day but this flight was far and away the best part of our trip.  Two hours in the plane....flying around the peaks in Denali and then landing on a Glacier.  Our photos even from our cell phones were breathtaking. Andy, our pilot, was fantastic about explaining what we were seeing and making sure that both of sides of the plane got good views of everything.  I would HIGHLY recommend!!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: This trip was amazing and as advertised! Our pilot Marcus was a perfect guide...the entire staff from start to finish was super friendly 🤙🏽
The scheduled date was raining and they allowed us to postpone 2 days. We enjoyed a lot with a fine weather. Wonderfull, we Could see the summit and all the glaciers around, landing on one of them.

The weather was cold and some people had to buy extra clothing so ...... be prepared for any weather as we had left sunshine in Las Vegas!  The flight there was in a 16 seater plane. We landed and were transported in a bus to 2 different sights with instructions where to go to see the best views. Michael, our tour guide was great and said he was the best!  The views were spectacular and like paintings (almost unreal!)  The flight back was very bumpy as it was extremely windy - all the helicopters had been grounded. What an experience! We chose a fixed-wing air tour over a helicopter flight because all of the 8 seats had a window and were all facing forward. The flight was about 50 minutes long which took us on a circular route out over the canyon, along the North Rim before returning over Tusayan. There was a little turbulence as we returned over the South Rim but for the most part it was a very smooth comfortable flight offering truly amazing views of the canyon that can only be obtained from the air.

e li vicino c'è anche un servizio di noleggio bici automatizzato per tornare a Sausalito. Splendida esperienza!

Airplane tour fly a lot high up for an overall stunning views and most important much more comfort seats. Recommend to go with early tour (we went for the first tour of the day) if possible that way it is less busy and guarantee a good view and lots of amazing pictures.

We were given waterproof booties to wear over our shoes for the glacier landing.  Our daughter had flown with Clay before and had called in several days before and asked to go with him again.  Our request was noted and Clay was available to do our flight.  He was very informative and offered a lot of information about the the area and the mountain.  The day we went was very cloudy and when we left, it seemed unlikely we would be able to see Denali.  Clay was persistent though and kept looking for breaks in the clouds while showing us the mountain and glaciers below.  He was finally able to find a hole through the clouds where we could see the top 1/3 of Denali and make out both the North and South peaks.  After that, he attempted to land at the top of a remote glacier but conditions did not allow that safely. review_title: Amazing must-do activity on your trip to Alaska.

review_title: This is the way to get the whole view.
review_text: Ellen was truly a terrific help to arrange our trip.  She was prompt in her responses.  She gave us options on flights. They gave a DVD afterwards of a prerecording of aerials which was a very pleasant surprise that included pics that Ellen had taken of us prior to boarding the plane. review_title: Flight over Grand Canyon, Glen Canyon Dam and Monument Valley from Page
review_text: I cannont recommend this trip more highly.  The Grand Canyon was spectacular, but the Glen Canyon dam and Monument Valley was such a suprise.  Do the full trip, spend the money the scenery, geography and flight are MORE THAN WELL WORTH IT.  DO IT!

We had an amazing time on this air tour that takes you all over the beautiful garden isle. We saw everything from pristine white beaches, the massive red rocks of the waimea canyon, more waterfalls than you can keep track of, and the awesomely rugged and untouched Napali coast. The ride was unbelievably smooth and pleasant. One of my family members had had a terrible experience with a small plane in the past, but she said after the flight with Pilot Harry, that her opinion of small planes has been totally changed. Such an amazing, comfortable ride, and overall a great experience.  And so many outstanding photo ops!  We HIGHLY recommend this experience to fellow Kauai travelers.

The GCNP is amazingly breathtaking. You can spend hours just taking it all in. Every angle from every scenic overlook is priceless. This helicopter tour puts you right in it all. You cannot truly grasp the enormity, the beauty etc. any other way. This tour only covers part of the canyon that's how massive it is! There were six of us including the pilot. We all had excellent views we did not miss a thing!! The pilot was very informative and made sure we were always comfortable. The best money we ever spent!!  Now we look forward to seeing many other places this way!! Btw, I have anxiety, panic attacks and I was fine! I took anothers travelers tip...YOLO! Even on windy day, slightly bumpy, the serenity of the canyon puts you at ease. A MUST DO for everyone, an unforgettable experience!

A must do when visiting the Grand Canyon.  We chose to do a plane tour rather than helicopter.  The 45 minute tour was excellent, we traveling from end to end.  It hard to grasp the vastness of the canyon standing on the rim or hiking, but in the air, its incredible.
我和我妻子全家6个人分两趟玩了这个项目， 体验相当不错，按性价比来说比一般直升机要划算，因为多数直升机总有人无法坐在窗边。飞行员小哥全程各种讲解，分享了很多有趣的故事。我父母从一开始的担心害怕到后来享受其中，让我觉得这钱花得值。 比较遗憾的是我岳母恐高的关系一直比较害怕，最后飞行员小哥贴心的提早返航（但还是收了全价...）。 总之性价比不错，Eric也很友善。

I can't say enough good things about our experience with Wings Over Kauai. Everyone we interacted with was so friendly and welcoming. Our pilot Josh was very knowledgeable about the geography and history of Kauai. The views are out-of-this-world and so much of the island, like the incredible Na Pali coast, can really only be appreciated by air. They take photos of you with the plane and email them to you. We were a little leery about motion-sickness but Josh was really skilled and they do have a cooler with soda and ginger candies if you are feeling queasy. Would do it again in a heartbeat.
What an incredable thing to do!  A must do if you are there. The views are amazing.  I just can't say enough about the knowledge of our pilot and the views.

Stimolati dall'idea di vedere dall'alto la zona di Canyonlands (con DeadHorse) nonchè Arches (Delicate Arch) e dal rimpianto di mia figlia che vi aveva dovuto rinunciare per ragioni di tempo ed atmosferiche, abbiamo prenotato e poi confermato questo volo di 1 ora abbondante al prezzo di ben 240 $ a cranio. Prenotato per le 9 e creduto esclusivo, il volo è decollato alle 10 con altri 3 passeggeri....Le buone condizioni atmosferiche hanno consentito di vedere quanto promesso anche se il pilota (75enne !!!) ha gestito tutto con navigata esperienza.
In definitiva, il a posteriori, il rapporto contenuti/prezzo non mi ha soddisfatto

review_title: Fun glacier landing trip with a great pilot
review_text:
Another lucky day. They canceled all morning flights because of the sky visibility, but we got lucky not only able to take off but also to land on a glacier. 
Our pilot 🧑‍✈️ Tim was excellent. He briefed us with some funny jokes and his fun character. Once onboard, he used an internal communication system to tell stories/history of the mountains 🗻. The whole trip was smooth and enjoyable. We landed on the glacier after going around two rounds; double checked the safety. On the way back, after knowing our desire to see moose and bear, he went around the Delina national pack to help us to get closer to finding the animals. (although, I was only able to see one or two moose from far away) it was a fun trip. ❤️

"They" say that viewing Kauai from a helicopter is the best way to see the island.  Poor planning on our part, meaning all the helicopter tours were booked, meant that we opted for the view of Kauai from a seven seater plane.  It was AWESOME!!!  I'd highly recommend choosing Air Ventures as a first option to see Kauai from the air.  The knowledge of our pilot was wonderful and added to our experience immensely.

review_title: Shame about the commentary and safety aspects
review_text:
I know this goes against the other reviews but our trip was marred by a lack of commentary either by the pilot or the pre recorded...I mentioned it to the pilot but it fell on deaf ears literally. We landed in the lake and got out on to the floats which was quite exhilarating but I did fear for the safety of us as you could quite easily slip off the floats into the freezing water ,
I would like to do it again with commentary as the views and scenery are fantastic as is the experience of landing on water

My grandson & I spent 2 weeks in AK in an RV & we took the Grand Denali tour w the glacier landing.  Although the entire 2 weeks were awesome, we both agreed that this tour was the highlight of our trip.  The weather was excellent for our flight and the views were just incredible.  The clouds lifted off the summits & we took some simply stunning photos of the summits.  Our pilot (Trent) did an outstanding job of maneuvering the aircraft so that everyone got excellent views.  Trent also provided excellent commentary during the entire flight & during the time spent on the glacier.  Being up there & experiencing the vastness & beauty of our Gods' creation was truly a religious experience for me.  Talkeetna Air Taxi runs a first-class operation & I would recommend their Denali tours to anyone. If I ever get back to AK, I will definitely fly to the top of Denali again w Talkeetna Air.  Once just is not enough for me !!!

Our Pilot was very nice and knowledgeable also knows how to fly aircraft real smoothly. Our Friend's Brother came and took this tour and really liked it so he suggested us to take this tour and yes we did and glad that we did. We will sure suggest to our family and friends to take this tour when they are coming there. Have a lots of Business and nice holidays.

Wow!  Great new experience flying over the Grand Canyon. Views were spectacular and gave perspective of the differences between the South,  North, and East Rims.  Great way to see the canyon’s beauty in 45 minutes. Staff and Pilots were professional and operations were very efficient.
tour_name: 7 -110_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour_2025-02-27

review_text: This was an amazing flight. Marcus was knowledgable about the island's  history, landmarks, and general information. We were able to get lovely views of the entire island as well as a feel for the layout of Kauai. Well done! The video of the trip is spectular.

We had made reservations to take the one hour bi-plane tour of Kauai.  Our pilot was very friendly and took great time getting us into the plane and getting us in our gear (leather cap and goggles).  Unfortunately, when he did a final engine check he realized there was a mechanical issue with the plane.  He was so apologetic.  We were greatly disappointed but glad he made our safety a priority.  Thomas was working the check in desk and worked so hard to find us another flight.  The weather had been rainy and cloudy for several days prior to our flight day.  Because there was a break in the rain everyone was wanting to go up.  Thomas found us a helicopter flight with ANOTHER company!  That's making sure your customer is happy.  If I ever return to Kauai I will definitely try to fly with Air Ventures.

review_title: Land on the glacier- amazing Petspective
review_text: We were lucky to have a clear and sunny day. That said the trip was amazing from the fantastic views coming and going to landing on the glacier and even throwing a few snowballs. Amazing the scale huge mountains are and how little you are on them.  Our guide was interesting and fun and I would recommend it to anyone.

review_title: Surprise-- They do not honor reservations for their shorter tours- nor tell you!
review_text: We drove over from West Coast (147 miles one way) and  showed up early  for our tour that had been reserved and paid for on their website.   They were "No Shows" ...no one was there.  No Sign. Not even any Seaplanes.  Fence was locked up.  Extremely disappointing as :  1. They had our phone number but never called.  2. They had our email address but never e-mailed.   3.  They had received the credit card funds.  5 minutes after the tour was supposed to leave, we called the number on the receipt and were given a 15 minute run-around, including  demanding information that was not on our printed  receipt that they had provided and we brought with us..  Finally were told that we could go on a tour at 5 PM ... .then when we expressed interest in it,  they changed it to later.  Turns out it was a shorter tour than we paid for anyway.    They also blamed the computer .... but they knew we had paid. It appears that the shorter tours only happen if longer ones don't  get booked ( why give up a charter for a 15 minute or 30 minute tour?)... even after your reservation.  This might work for you if you live nearby.   We understand that things happen, planes get grounded or can't fly in fog etc ..... but we do not understand the terrible customer support and service.               We finally realized  that there was nothing that they were telling us on the phone that we could rely on, and decided to start our drive back to the west coast rather than also incurring the cost of a night at a hotel.  We did have a nice drink on the  nearby outdoor marina bar.,,, called 'Joe's .........'

Staff was great and knowledgeable.  Leslie even dropped us off wherever we wanted to go.  They even arranged for us to have a sunny trip.  I was a little worried about landing on water.  No need.  Smooth as can be.

Our guide was great.  Very knowledgeable.  The scenery was magnificent words cannot describe the natural beauty. We were so close to Denali I felt like I could touch its snow covered surface.  Thank you for this opportunity to view this spectacular piece of nature.  This is a must do adventure !!!!!

review_title: Kauai from the air via AirVentures
review_text: There is only one way to really see Kauai - from the air, and Air Ventures Hawaii provides the most reasonable and thorough ride over Kauai  you can get.
We had an awesome experience with spectacular views! The sunset was amazing from up high and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves! Must do for anyone on Maui!
Great day for a flight!  This rusty pilot liked holding the controls, and seeing whales from the air!
This was a special evening! We had a wonderful time and the sunset was gorgeous. The colors were magnificent.

We were celebrating our anniversary in Hawaii. Last day in Kauai we were able to book a Cessna flight with Ray. From meeting Jill at the pick up to having Ray pilot us, we could not have had a better experience!! The sights are majestic:) the Air Venture company: INCREDIBLE!! They went out of their way to make our trip outstanding.

We had questionable weather with heavy clouds and some rain, Josh gave us the option to cancel but also gave us some knowledgeable insights about what to expect, noting the cloud deck was high enough to ensure great visibility and numerous waterfalls due to the weather pattern. Boy were we glad to keep the flight! My wife and I, and two young boys had the absolute best experience, exceeding our already very high expectations. His knowledge of the island, insights that varied from Kauai history to agronomy to geological facts, just fantastic. Viewing what may be the most beautiful place on earth from above, was matched with the quality of the people we met with Wings Over Kauai. What a collection of expertise and character. We enjoyed meeting Bruce, Dori and Josh. If you are planning a trip to Kauai, this tour is a must. Everything else in your schedule will stop short of this experience. Mahalo Mahalo Mahalo!

review_title: Fun way to see the skyline of Miami from the sky
review_text:
Normally, the only way you get to see Miami from the sky is by watching the opening sequence of an old episode of Miami Vice or the new (now-canceled) Charlie's Angels.  Miami Seaplane Tours is a nice alternative.  It's a bit pricey, but if you check carefully, you might find a Groupon for half-off (like I did).  The plane seats 3 passengers maximum, so don't plan on doing this in a large group.
The pilot was about 15 minutes late for our scheduled departure, but he did give us the full half-hour flight that we paid for.  We flew over Downtown Miami, the man-made islands in Biscayne Bay, and South Beach.  The pilot pointed out some of the multi-million dollar homes owned by famous people and some of the other well-known landmarks.  Unfortunately, the mikes are only one-way (you can hear the pilot, but you can't talk to him), so we couldn't ask any questions.  The pilot also played a soundtrack of current pop hits to fill the gaps when he wasn't narrating.

Here are some tips:
Most taxi drivers will have no clue where this place is, so you have to tell them to go west on Rickenbacker Causeway and turn left at the road for the Rickenbacker Fish Company (and make a QUICK LEFT onto the dirt road just before you get to the Rickenbacker Fish Company).
Wear flipflops or Tevas, because you may have to wade through ankle-deep water to board the plane.
The Rickenbacker Fish Company is a decent restaurant a short walk from the Miami Seaplane Tours dock.  It opens for lunch at noon.  I had the blackened mahi mahi sandwich and fries, which were very tasty.  The Rusty Pelican restaurant is a bit farther away, and it was closed for renovation when we were there.
The staff at the Rickenbacker Fish Company are very friendly and will call you a taxi while you're finishing your meal (you won't have much luck flagging one down on the causeway).
Go with the half-hour seaplane tour.  One hour would probably get a bit boring.
If you use a Groupon, be sure to call for reservations and bring the confirmation number with you (either as a printout or on your cell phone).
Great air tour, great pilot and very informative, told us some history of Maui, saw whales and different colors of the ocean.

review_title: Fantastic tour!!  A must for Kauai!
review_text: We went in their small plane for the tour over Kauai, there were six of us including the pilot.  They picked us up at the ABC store, just up the street from the pier, where our ship docked.  If you don't want to take the ten minute walk you can jump on the free shuttle that takes you to the little mall where the ABC store located.  When I read all the previous comments about Wings Over Kauai we decided to go with them, and we're very happy we did!!  For $125.00 US we got a whole hour in the air.  If they keep that up they will continue to be busy and recommended by people like myself.  I've already told many people to go with them.  They were nice enough to offer us free water and pop during our flight, that was great!  The best part of the tour, is seeing Kauai, it's beautiful!!  For anyone sitting on the passenger side of the plane, you will see better.  If your on the pilots side, you will see everything but not as well and throughly as the others, but the pilot does try his best.  I think it's due to the time it takes to fly the plane around so everyone can see as well.  I would still recommend it anyways.  If price doesn't matter and you want a shorter ride then you can take a helicopter ride, which flies lower and takes you closer to the mountains.  Make sure to bring your camera!!  Go to the washroom and get in the plane!!  They do have good walk up steps to the plane, so even if you have some disabilities you shouldn't have a problem.  If you leave yourself three hours from getting to the mall, filling out the paperwork, getting weighed, get on the plane and the flight back, you should be good.  Ellen picked us up and was,so nice.  We met her husband and our pilot, Josh, along with Ellen's daughter, and they were all so nice and friendly.  Josh was an excellent,pilot, constantly talking to us all during the flight and answering any questions we had.  Can't lose taking this tour, especially as its the only way to see the canyon and the Na Pali coast without hiking and a boat, which would take days.  Kauai is so beautiful and you appreciate it more from the air.

We had an amazing flight - I took my teenage son on a trip where he got to his 50th state! It was the perfect cap to all of our adventures. Everyone at the company was professional and nice. They picked us up, explained all that was going on, and took us on an incredible flight. A once in a lifetime experience.

Wenn ihr etwas auf Kauai machen solltet, dann einen Flug mit Wings over Kauai. Für den Preis ein echtes Schnäppchen. Die ganzen Helitouren sind viel viel teurer. Wir hatten erst etwas Angst, dass wir nicht so tief wie die Helis fliegen und nicht so gut sehen können, dies hat sich jedoch in keinster Weise bestätigt. Tolle Sicht über ein wahres Paradies. Josh, der Pilot, hat sehr viel erklärt. Das ganze Team war sehr familiär und super nett. Wir wurden sogar an unserem Kreuzfahrthafen abgeholt und wieder zurückgebracht. Wir haben auf vielen Reisen schon viel erlebt, aber dieser Flug war ein absoluter Höhepunkt. VIelen vielen Dank an das Team für diesen tollen Tag!!
The flight was very good and enjoyable. Saw many sights that you cannot see from the ground. Pilot Bryan was very good.

We went on the airplane ride as part of another excursion. I'e done quite a few helicopter rides over the island.   This was my first time seeing Kauai in a small plane.  I'd always wanted to do it and am so glad I did.  It was very enjoyable and the sights were spectacular!!

We took a flight around the island with Air Ventures (Kevin Pilot) on May 16.  I would highly recommend Air Ventures - Kevin.  He has 26 years flying around the island and was very knowledgeable & fun.  The ride was extremely smooth and we all felt safe.  Not only does Kevin provide a bunch of great facts about the island, he takes you over spots you can't get to by car or foot.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND AIR VENTURES if you're going to visit Kauai.
Views were beautiful and the pilot was great. I enjoyed it very much. It was a lifetime experience and I’d recommend it definitely

review_title: Glacier Landing was a once in a lifetime experience!
review_text: K2 has a very professional and engaging staff from the minute you enter the building to the minute you leave the airplane doing everything they can to make your trip enjoyable and memorable.

Great experience. One of my all time favorite travel adventures. What a way to see Kauai. So informative and fun. Our Pilate Ray was great and he and his wife Jill are so personable. Highly highly. recommend

This was a great experience!! Breathtaking views from above. The pilot was very informative, and it was well worth it. Compared to helicopter tours, this is an affordable experience. Would definitely recommend

review_title: Wonderful flight and great way to see Kauai!
review_text: Want to do something you will be 100% happy about?   This is it!  Ellen and Bruce provide a wonderful experience.  Hopefully we can come back someday and do it again.

We booked a private flight, one person in front next to the captain and one behind. Doug explained a lot about the island and it's nature and history. We had clear weather conditions, could see lots of beautiful country sides. We also watched a group of 8 whales, that where kindly spotted by our captain flying an extra round to get a better view. Totally awesome!

We had a fabulous view of Kauia from a fixed wing plane. Kevin, our pilot was very knowledgable about the various areas of Kauia. The views of the Waimea Canyon and several waterfalls were breathtaking. It was a smooth ride and we would highly recommend this way of seeing all the island has to offer in a one hour trip.

Excellent flight saw a lot of unique landmarks of maui.
My flyer was very enthusiastic about the tour and we could really feel his energy.
Jeff took us on the flight of our lives with up close scenes of Denali national park. Learned a lot about glaciers and their life cycle. We got lucky with a sunny day!

Wij hadden de trip van 45 minuten geboekt en dit is zeker een aanrader. Ondanks de hoge prijs hadden we het niet willen missen. Tijdens de vlucht kregen we veel informatie van de piloot en konden we veel foto's maken. Daarna ook nog met de heli op de foto
Jon was a great pilot. He was informative, patient and flexible. The sights were amazing and we were lucky that Jon was able to get above the clouds.

Great Pilot with excellent commentary when it was required.  Very informative recording while we were flying, and we were so fortunate with the weather.  Views were amazing.
What a very professional company and I would highly recommend.

Flew with another air service last year, they were o.k. however, we didn't realize what we missed until we flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Our pilot Andy was great!!  He took us so close around the mountains, it was surreal!  I highly recommend you choose this operation for your aviation adventure!!!

We signed up on the "spur of the moment"
Called in the morning hoping to get on a flight and we were airborne by 1.
At $300/per it wasn't "cheap" but boy was it worth it.
Truly the only way to really "See" Denali park.
Our Pilot was Professional, Knowledgeable, Friendly and engaging.
We did not do the glacier landing but will try for that next time we get to AK.
If you have a chance, JUST DO IT....

July 12, 2024, took a "Misty Fjords Flighseeing". Pilot, Clark, did not have a welcome word when we took off and either a  thank you for us when we left.  Very little talk about what we were flying over.  Clark should have a better personality when dealing with that type of work.   I don't recommend a tour with him.

The canyon is truly amazing to see from above, and this trip brought us for long stretches over it giving us views that we could not imagine from the rim or inside it.  It's a once in a lifetime trip and deserves the birds eye view Grand Canyon Airlines offers.  The flight time and the cordial crew engagement with us was just fine.  One disappointment:  the taped commentary about the canyon that passengers can listen to by head phone did not work in English for much of the trip.  Ironically fellow passengers speaking other languages had their commentary functioning.

Very nice trip!  I liked it a lot!  Fantastic overview about Miami South Beach!   
The pilot explains us a lot ,quote nice!
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: Such a neat flying experience in a biplane with an open cockpit.  There's just enough room for two people up front and the pilot sits behind in a separate compartment  You even get to an old timey helmet and goggles.  Flight time in the air was exactly an hour.  Our pilot, Kevin, gave us a little history of the plane that we rode in and the sights of the island.  Waimea Canyon, Na Pali coast, Hanalei Bay, and Wailua Falls are all part of the tour.  You can pay them an additional $25 to have your GoPro mounted to the wing.

I had an excellent experience flying around Denali and surrounding mountains with K2.  I had average expectations for just another "touristy" type event.  The trip far, far exceeded my expectations and was truly a highlight of my 10-day trip to AK.  Very grand.  Our pilot was a great guide.
Treated courteously throughout the process of booking & flying. Ian was a great pilot & Sally couldn’t have been more polite. Thank you.
tour_name: 7 -110_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour_2025-02-27

review_text:
We are a group of 6 ladies from all over who met in Hawaii yo celebrate 2 of our 50th birthdays.
We included Kauai on our itinerary to see the Na Pali trail only to discover it has been closed for over a year.
We looked into options to see it from the sea or air and founds these guys and are so glad we did. The price point was great cheaper than a helicopter and not so noisy.
Bruce was a lovely fella so calm and caring about those on our party who were motion sick.

Can’t recommend highly enough.
A beautiful way to see Denali and the surrounding area. This trip is highly recommended. The pilot was knowledgeable about the area.
Great service it was a wonderful experience the views where amazing we had a great time I would definitely recommend it
The Views seen are absolutely breath taking, and our pilot was full of knowledge that she share while flying up to the summit and the glacier landing was a blast!!

We had an amazing experience with Maui Planes while vacationing in Maui. Eric, the pilot and owner, was an excellent instructor and guide! Our hotel concierge provided us directions that got us exactly to Eric with no problems. He greeted us with two colorful leis and waived us into the parking area. Eric was easy to get along with and made sure to snap a picture of us before taking flight. We spent two hours touring Maui, Molokai and Lanai from the air. My fiancé co-piloted the airplane and was really flying the plane- including take off! Yes, there were some bumps while we were up there but Eric assured us that it was normal for the plane when flying through a windy area which made us feel comfortable. He was very knowledgeable about flying and the sights below us. We saw numerous waterfalls on Maui, the road to Hana, Haleakala, worlds largest sea cliffs on Molokai, Molokai Leper Colony, Retired War Ship, Coral Reefs, and MORE! 

This will be a trip we always remember and recommend to friends! By far the best way to experience Maui. Highly recommend Maui Plane rides!
Seeing the cliffside of Molokai was really awesome!  Also the big valleys of West Maui. I really loved seeing Molokini in the afternoon with no tourist boats.
We were very happy with the flight, the information, and the scenery!  What a great experience.  I would definitely recommend it and we would do it again!

review_title: Uno de mis mejores tours en avioneta
review_text:
La organización estupenda, se olvidaron de venirnos a buscar pero finalmente llegaron e hicimos el check-in con tiempo más que suficiente. Muy profesionales y amables, sin duda, avionetas pequeñas y el piloto genial. 
Lamentablemente y por razones que no vienen  al caso, no pudimos aterrizar en el glaciar como teníamos previsto pero el tour fue tan fantástico  que casi ni nos supo mal. Los glaciares y montañas estaban tan cerca que casi se podían tocar, fue una hora y media de vuelo tan repleta de paisajes y emociones que no se podía aprovechas más. No dejéis de hacerlo, además Talkeetna es el sitio ideal, como el objetivo principal es ver de cerca el monte Denali, nuestra primera idea fue hacer el vuelo desde Denali pero nos aconsejaron Talkeetna e hicimos caso, menos mal, por lo que pudimos observar la opción Denali es mucho peor por zona y recorrido. Animo a todo el mundo a hacer el tour, no es el primero ni el segundo que hago en avioneta sobre montañas y este fue soberbio
Done with 3 kids, very smooth, very friendly staff. Would repeat. Amazing pictures. Very informative. Not as speedy as a helicopter but much cheaper
Fun and educational. The combination of wild life, horses, long horn sheep and blue heron and the folklore made it special.

My brother and I wanted to do something amazing for mom's bday. We originally looked at helicopter tours, but they are over priced and shorter- after discovering wings over kauaii, which by the way is also more eco-friendly then the helicopter option, we were all set. 
We had our mom blindfolded till she got to the plane and Ellen helped us put up a banner that said happy birthday. Needless to say mom absolutely adored it, as we all did!
Also, all seats have a window except for one- a great plus!!
Pilot was sweet and knowledgeable- we loved it!

Wonderful experience (with the company and the flight)!  I called during a very busy week looking for a flight when everything on the island was booked out and these lovely folks managed to make it happen (thanks Jill!)!  Our pilot Nate was terrific, he told us all about what we were seeing as we soared through the air over the incredible landscape.  Price was right too! I strongly recommend this tour/company!

review_title: One of the BEST things we did in Alaska
review_text:
Highly recommend taking a flight to see Denali, the glaciers, and other mountain ranges.
Talkeetna Air employees are honest with you about the weather conditions and what to expect.
Spend some extra time in Talkeetna for lunch or dinner a neat little town.
An incredible beautiful tour of Kauai.  Kevin's knowledge of the island gave us greater insight to the island.  Definitely will take this tour again on our next visit.

Wings Over Kauai sightseeing flight was an excellent way of seeing Kauai.  Doug's narration and tour was very professional and enjoyable.  I was concerned before the flight since I have a tendency to have motion sickness.  Doug was aware of this and did a great job in keeping the plane at an even keel.  I would definitely recommend this excursion.

review_title: Best time up in the sky!!!
review_text: We took my son on an incredible adventure!! Sergio our pilot was awesome and very knowledgeable about the area and sites. The trip went by so quickly!!! Could have stayed up there for hours!! Thanks, Sergio!!!

der Rundflug im Mai was wunderschön, bei wechselhaftem Wetter, tolle Wolken, Lichtwechsel in der Sonne, einfach überirdisch. Und die ganze Familie, die die Firma führt, einfach liebenswürdig. Es war eines der besten Dinge, die man auf Kauai unternehmen kann.

review_title: First trip to Grand Canyon for Kids
review_text: Extremely well organized.  Extremely safe.  Staff at terminal were most helpful.  Pilot went above and beyond to point out features and discuss the Canyon’s history.  A must if you get the opportunity!!!

7 Sterne Erlebnis, alles passte, sehr flexibel bei der Wahl der Bflugzeit, Man bezahlt erst, wenn man wieder gelandet ist, d. h., kann man wetterbedingt nicht auf drm Gletscher landen: keine Berechnung. Sehr nettes Bodenpetsonal, gute Anweisungen vor Abflug, erfahrener und sehr freundl Pilot. Das Erlebnis kann man nur selbst nachempfinden, es zeigt die Grösse des Denaliparkes. Unbedingt am Anfang der Reise machen. Es ist jeden $ wert!

Had a wonderful experience. Both the ground staff and pilot were very respectful and friendly. Can't beat the price either. The tour was about 1 hr and 15 min of airtime around every major part of the island. Learned a lot and saw pretty much everything you could want to see.

Nate was my pilot and he did an awesome job!

Wow! Why didn’t we do this sooner? What a great experience flying over the city, the bay and the ocean. Our pilot and tour guide was a native Miamian (who knew there were any) who brought his own special knowledge and passion for the city to life for us. From take off to touch down we were engaged by his stories and history lessons and blown away by the views of the skyline, the islands, the mansions and the stiltsville shacks. The most memorable part of the trip may well have been flying over Biscayne Bay National Park and seeing sharks, stingrays and schools of fish just a few miles from downtown. The trip really did give us a whole new perspective on the city and the environment. 
We can’t wait to plan our next flight!
Exciting flight with great narration by pilot (when not busy flying) about the area, the moutains and glaciers.  Being on the Ruth glacier was awsome!

review_title: Dirty windows and a RUDE pilot, made for a bad experience
review_text: 15 minute late start, pilot was rude and windows were dirty. The windows had a greasy film on them which made photography nearly impossible out the Eastside of the plane on this early morning flight.  My camera would only focus on the greasy film, see attached photo.  I had a napkin and cleaned the inside and that helped a little, but it was also on the outside and I could do nothing about that.  If you must take this flight make sure you sit on the side of the plane without the sun, as you will get better pictures through the greasy, dirty scratched windows.  Take a day raft trip down the Colorado, save yourself some money and you will enjoy it more.
I enjoyed the flight. It was a beautiful blue sky morning and we were able to see Denali up close. I took lots of pictures and will remember this flight as the highlight of my trip to Alaska.

review_title: They give you the best trip they can for the weather.
review_text:
It is not easy to fly to a mountain that is too often shrouded in clouds.  The staff of K2 are very transparent about what can be seen that day/hour and their pilots fly the best route that they can considering the weather and safety factors.

Although it was fairly clear skies in Talkeetna the day we flew,  the Denali Ridge, and most of the Alaskan Range in that area were in a storm. We still decided to fly (should have Bonine-d!) and although we didn't even get close to Denali, we still saw glaciers, beautiful areas of tundra, kettle ponds, forests, braided rivers, and lonely cabins.  The flight gave us a better understanding of what Alaska is all about.

My wife and I did this same flight two years ago, so we took it again today.
Harry did a nice job of pointing out areas we asked about.

We took the Grand Denali flight with glacier landing.  The entire staff in the office was friendly and helpful.  I was nervous, having never flown in such a small plane.  A nice lady behind the desk reassured me and eased my fears.  We flew in a 5 seater plane, and Tim was our pilot.  Like the people in the office, Tim was professional, informative, and friendly.  He helped us into our seats, made sure we were buckled properly, and had our headsets working.  I couldn't believe the flight was so smooth!  Tim was an excellent pilot and tour guide - he answered all of our questions, and maneuvered the plane so that everyone could see everything out of their own window.  The views were stunning!  We had a sunny day, with a few clouds near Denali, but could clearly see the mountain and surrounding areas.  I took well over 100 pictures.  We landed on Ruth Glacier.  If you are able to add a glacier landing to your flight, do it!  Walking on a glacier and seeing the mountains towering over us was just incredible!  Bring sunglasses though, since there is glare from the snow.  Flying with TAT was the highlight of my Alaska vacation, and if I ever make it back, I will definitely fly with them again.

We booked a private aeroplane tour for two around Kauai. It was the best. Friendly staff, great pilot, a brilliant experience for a reasonable price. This is by far the best way to see the island and I can't recommend this company enough.

As soon as I knew I was going to Alaska, I wanted to book a float plane trip.  Lesley was easy to book with (even though she was on vacation!), and we had no problem finding them at the pier.  We had a great trip, with our pilot playing beautiful music and giving us facts and legends as we flew above the Fjords.  The flight was smooth, the scenery breathtaking!  They even dropped us off in town and answered our questions about the area.  Highly recommend it - you won't be sorry!  Have your camera(s) ready.
It was my wife’s 5 year cancer free gift. We had an awesome flight and the pilot was very knowledgeable of what we saw. Highly recommended.

Rose Marie, our very competent, entertaining pilot flew us up the Tokasitna Glacier near “the Great One”, pointing out climbing routes and even an icefall. We flew on a sunny, blue sky day and I highly recommend this unique perspective on North America’s highest peak. Rose Marie explained how humans freeze at -70 and how trees can grow on top of a glacier— fabulous trip!

Until you've experienced this with K2 Aviation you cannot comprehend what seeing and almost touching Denali is all about. K2 treats you as if you are royalty. I highly recommend you do this with K2 and if you're lucky enough to have Daniel as your pilot...BIG BONUS!

My family booked our trip based on reviews on trip advisor and can say they were bang on. Bruce was an exceptional host and pilot. Bruce let the clients dictate the conversation topics and did not just spit out the same bla bla.... That so many other tours tend to do. No you don't get up into every valley but you really don't need to as the overall view on flight path are spectacular. In addition some of the must see attractions you can get to from road or kayak/boat. I would highly recommend this trip.

The opportunity to fly a plane and see Kauai from the birds eye viewpoint is a rare treasure -- thank you Wings Over Kauai for the flight of a lifetime!  You made two pilots' dreams come true -- Scott and Ruth, Phoenix, Arizona

review_title: Stunning views and very special experience
review_text: Really worth the money. The whole process was very smooth and the view was great. I am glad that they enforce mask policy so that we are still able to have fun during this pandemic.
The flight tour was the highlight of our trip. The mountain/glacier views were incredible. Highly recommend.

Our flight seeing trip was amazing! Incredible views of Denali and the Alaskan Range. Pilot was excellent, great narration and skill. The glacier landing was really cool too, no pun intended. You have to do this if you want the best view of the mountains. No comparison to seeing them from the ground.

review_title: DO IT!!  Great experience, well run tour company!
review_text: Excellent!  Well done tour.  Went on the Ultimate Adventure and one of the best experiences ever.  Never felt pressured or rushed and yet, never waited or was bored.  Ran like a well greased machine and the staff was excellent.  You may be asking yourself if its the worth the price (as I did) but have no doubts, it will be well worth every penny!
tour_name: 33_71_Grand Canyon South Rim Signature Ground Tour with PJX_2025-03-04

review_text:
The view was spectacular. Marcus, our pilot, was very knowledgeable and caring. We finally got to take the trip on the third try, the other two cancelled because of weather.  We weren’t able to cover all that was included in the flight because of weather conditions but we still got to see awesome waterfalls and scenery,  

The customer service for this company far exceeded our expectations. We were offered a full refund or reschedule for another day.  Due to the weather conditions we weren’t able to do the whole trip and they offered a partial refund. Excellent and very fair.

review_title: Great way to see Kauai by Air
review_text: The flight was great, had a good view and went completely around Kauai.  There is no weight limit like Helicopters and each passenger has a window seat too.  Pilot was good at explaining what you were seeing and turned the plane at places where someone on the other side might not have as good of a view so all could see.  The ride was very smooth and the checkin was very smooth.  Really good deal since quite a bit less expensive than a helicopter flight.
Very much  enjoyed our fly overbi Kauai.  Justin was very informative and it was a relaxing adventure.

As a semi-timid airplane flyer I was nervous before this flight.  Urged on by a native alaskan who ensured me of the safety and absolute beauty of K2 Aviation, I eventually decided that I would probably regret it for the rest of my life if I didn't go.  And I'm glad I did!  The pilot (Chris) was extremely personable, even after I told him that "I don't want to die today."  The take-off was extremely smooth and easy, and afterwards the rest was  a piece of cake.  We flew over glaciers, mountains, streams, and it was a truly beautiful and awe-inspiring experience that cannot be duplicated on anything except for a small aircraft.  I highly recommend it to anyone that wants to truly experience the extremes of alaska without perilously scaling a glacier or enduring an uncomfortable month-long hiking trip.  Spectacular.
Best glacier landing experience during the fall season. Visited during October for northern flights but got to know the winter explorer is open. This was once in a life time exp for us

review_title: best way to discover SFO by air
review_text: Must do experience, very smooth flight, on time and very entertaining. The check in process was smooth, the pilot was very informative and customized the experience for us. Super safe and fun. We enjoyed seeing the various landmarks from up close. You'd think seeing those by plane goes too fast but this was not the case at all. Highly recommended
Absolutely amazing experience, knowledgeable and experienced pilot, stunning views. We got to see Mt McKinley!!! Highly recommend

review_title: Amazing views of one of the most scenic places
review_text: 70 minutes encircling the island plus going inland into the canyon and rain forest.
Bought a flight for my husband and daughter for Christmas- they both loved it!  Thank you for the great experience

The staff we’re all great and extremely friendly! Pick up was prompt and on time from pier39 and got us to the city quickly. The pilot was very nice and knowledgeable of San Francisco’s history. Weather was perfect and view was amazing! Definitely recommend this tour to everyone! Thank you staff at Seaplane Adventures, you guys were all great and went above and beyond to make sure we had the best experience!

We arrived at Ketchikan, May 4, 2018 on Holland America and booked a seaplane tour of the Misty Fjords National Monument for four people, $239 each. 

When the weather looked like it was not going to work in our favor, I called Leslie to cancel. This was a same day cancellation, just hours before takeoff. I was afraid Leslie would not accept the cancellation or charge me a hefty fee, but she was incredibly helpful. She told me she understood and didn't want us to fly if we couldn't enjoy it. This is what customer service is all about! Often, we out-of-town folks get the short end of the stick, squeezed for our hard-earned dollars with overpriced activities. We also don't have control over the weather so we can be hesitant to book expensive activities dependent on good weather. But there are a few operators like SeaWind Aviation who will work with you. 

I appreciated immensely Leslie's help and professionalism, and though we sadly never did the tour, I highly recommend SeaWind Aviation based on their customer service and helpful cancellation policy. Book at ease, Leslie and her team will work with you even if the weather won't.

review_title: Fly Denali & land on Ruth Glacier
review_text: This is the company to fly with around Denali & to land on Ruth Glacier. This flight exceeded all my expectations! My pilot, Nick was just lovely. Mad respect for landing on & taking off from a glacier!! Worth every penny.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Fabulous plane tour by Redtail Aviation
review_text: Our plane tour of Arches and Canyonlands with Redtail Aviation was unbelievablle! Kim, our pilot, was the best.  He clearly loves what he does, and loves to share the joy and beauty of the area. We could see parts of Canyonlands (unavailable by car or vista points) that were out of this world! It was such a worthwhile trip!  I can't recommend Kim and his plane tours highly enough!

review_title: What a great tour of Kauai...
review_text:
Maren made us feel very comfortable while we were being prepped for the flight.  The flight was fantastic with Bruce making us feel right at home.  Dr. Bruce is a very patient and accomplished pilot and very knowledgeable about the Island (and a lot of other things also like Island agricultural issues).  The plane was very comfortable and smooth - I'm glad we didn't take a helicopter.  

This flight took us to view areas of the Island that cannot be reached by car and the scenery was breathtaking, especially the spires and the Bali Hi.  We even got to see some whales - from the air you can see how big they are in such pristine waters.

Loved the trip and would recommend it to anyone interested in personalized service at a very reasonable price.

Thanks and Aloha Bruce and Maren, and thanks for the great pictures!

The pilot Eric is great!  He made sure we saw everything that the island had to be seen!  Wonderful and smooth. Thanks Eric. We saw the falls that they filmed fantasy island. The Grand Canyon of the pacific. Coffee plantation and more
My  friend and I had such a great time and enjoyed every moment of it! Great customer service and beautiful scenary.

We took the flight tour of Mt Denali and a glacier landing on one of the nearby peaks.  It was awesome.  This was the icing on the cake on what may be the single most fun day I have had on any vacation.  Everyone that visits Talkeetna should do this!

We had a great experience with our group of six! The reservation process was easy - all through email several weeks before our arrival. Sherry greeted us upon arrival and put everyone in our group at ease. Paul was our pilot, and gave us a wonderful tour of the island. The views were incredible, and we saw everything in much more detail than I thought was possible from a small aircraft.  Book this tour if you have a chance!!!

My son and I took our first trip to the Grand Canyon for spring break and we were both excited to see the Canyon from a helicopter.  After reviewing all of the nearby helicopter tours, I selected Maverick (Spirit Tour) because of their professional image, emphasis on safety, and price.  We were not dissappointed, at all!  Booking was simple, no hidden fees, no gimmicks... everything as advertised.  Sean was our pilot... experienced former Army aviator who knew the landscape and kept the whole tour group entertained, informed, and engaged.  I asked for my son to sit up front and that request was granted... so just ask.  No guarantees due to having to balance the weight of the other passengers (safety).  They also offer a DVD of your tour as well as a commemorative plaque for purchase.  Great ride... we'd definitely do it again!
Patrick was an excellent pilot and provided us with a wonderful mountain experience and narrative and of course the glacier landing was the highlight of the experience. We are so glad we did this !!!
The world's tallest cliffs are AMAZING!!!  Eric is very knowledgeable and very friendly. Amazing views of the whales!

Our group of 5 booked the Grand Canyon Deluxe tour.  The Deer Valley airport on the north side of Phoenix was easy to find.  On arrival, we were greeted by a professional staff that was very safety concious.  We flew on a single engine Cessna that sat 9 passengers plus the pilot.  While I am not a fan of small planes, I felt very safe. The trip to the east side of the Grand Canyon took about an hour.  We flew over the eastern portion of the canyon for 20-30 minutes, and our pilot/guide, Bill, provided an outstanding narration.  We then landed at the airport by the south rim and took a van to the south rim.  Again, Bill provided us with a lot of information at the various stops. For those who have never seen the Grand Canyon, this is an experence not to be missed.

My cousin and I flew to a remote lake with K2’s Beaver on floats. The weather wasn’t great at our scheduled departure time so we delayed our trip. Jen was very friendly in making sure we had enough food and fuel for our float out, despite the fact that they would not be picking us up or be responsible for our safe return. Chip, our pilot, inspired confidence and was friendly and helpful getting our gear in and out of the plane. He knows the area and gave us useful background on campsites in the area. K2 is a professional operator that I would book with again.

review_title: A highlight of our Grand Canyon visit
review_text:
OK so I'm a bit biased because I like light aircraft flights, much better than soulless airliners. An aerial view of the Grand Canyon is a must see, we got some great photos as well as just sitting back enjoying the view and I suspect you would not see any more from a pricier helicopter flight.

As to the organisation, efficient, amiable, no delays; the aircraft was full but there was plenty of room (and I'm tall) with no restrictions on the views.

The Grand Canyon lives up to the hype and this flight enhanced the experience.

review_title: Highlight of my Bay Area experience
review_text: I loved every minute of this trip. The pilot was genuinely the nicest, most wholesome individual I met all weekend. He did NOT speak from a script, he answered questions genuinely and talked mostly about the things we were interested in. The flight was 30minutes but I wish it was 2 hours.

review_title: An amazing trip with memorable views that we'll never forget
review_text: We had a great trip, we saw way more than we expected and it was really great for our 3 year old who loved it! We appreciated all the knowledge the pilot shared and the extended trip around the bay, it was great way to celebrate my 40th birthday, thank you!
Laura our pilot was amazing and taught my daughter so much about the plane and flying. Really encouraged her to leave aviation. We loved every minute of it.

Thanks Bruce and Ellen
I have been on the helicopter, biplane and fixed wing.   Although the others were great the fixed wing tour with Bruce was by far the best value and a great personalized tour.  My son and I went for an hour and it worked great.  We will be return customers for sure.  
Bruce and Logan
Eric came recommended by a local it was an amazing experience highly recommend it’s one of the “must do” while on Maui.
