Fizemos uma viagem de helicóptero ao Grand   Canion com sky walk, o passeio de helicóptero foi ótimo,o atendimento excelente, mas o sky walk foi frustrante, rápido e sem graça, não voltaria,, mas ver o Grand Canion do alto e imperdivel.
Incredible views and an incredible experience with Eric. Once in a lifetime highly recommend!!! The views are sensational and Eric was incredibly knowledgeable about the island of Maui.
We enjoyed the flight.  Love the view and the information that was given to us. Eric was great. Totally recommended.

review_title: Excellent Trip with Superb Pilot / Guide
review_text: We had a great flight and saw glaciers and Denali. It was cloudy, so the pilot (whose name escapes me) talked with other pilots to find the best viewing angles; thanks to his flying all over, we were able to see Denali out of the clouds from both sides. The pilot doubled as a tour guide, giving us all sorts of interesting information as we flew. The glacier landing was fantastic; it was the high point of our two week visit to Alaska! Highly recommended
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Make sure you bring a movie camera or a camera period, or you will miss some of the most spectacular views in your life time . If you think the cost is too much think again you will never see anything like it and it something you will treasure your whole life .Our  pilot was great ,landing was smooth , and taking off from a glacier was incredible.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: An unforgettable  special birthday celebration - Fantastic
review_text:
Awesome, stunning, jaw-dropping, spectacular, exhilarating.
A must do experience. You have seen photos, films, there can be nothing like flying into the Canyon. Booked helicopter prior to departure from UK for 6 persons so had helicopter to ourselves. Highly professional company, excellent commentary. Pilot very knowledgeable. Take lots of pictures.

review_title: Wonderful customer service despite the disappointing weather
review_text:
Our family booked the 30 minute seaplane adventure as part of our cruisetour.  Due to rainy weather, we were not able to take the tour but I wanted to acknowledge the wonderful customer service provided.  The company reached out the day before to let us know the weather did not look good for our flight but they would keep us informed.  We had booked a morning flight.  They contacted us in the morning to confirm we would have to cancel but offered to postpone to another day.  Unfortunately we were leaving the next day to go to Denali so they offered to wait until afternoon and see if the weather cleared.  We were contacted again at noon time and weather was still not cooperating so they had to cancel.  Our payment was refunded in full with no headaches.  Although we obviously would have preferred to be able to take the seaplane flight, weather is the determining factor on adventures like these.  I was so grateful for the wonderful customer service.  I felt the company cared and really tried to find a way for us to enjoy our excursion.  
For anyone planning an Alaskan adventure, feel comfortable booking with this company knowing they try there best to fulfill their commitment and when they are not able to, you will be refunded quickly and without any hassles.

We actually did this tour in June 2011 but I still thought it was worthwhile to post a review! We booked a summit flight with K2 but they didn't get the 6 person minimum so they booked us on the Denali Grand Tour "green route" instead. Even though we didn't get to see the summit the tour was fantastic! Our pilot was teriffic and would tilt the wings for better pictures. The scenery was stunning and the highlight of our Alaska trip! The office staff was also super helpful in booking our tour and we left all our luggage in their office since we just got off the train. Overall a great operation and I highly recommend K2!

We've flown with K2 in the past and loved the experience so much that we did it again! We are from AZ and decided to stay in Talkeetna one night during our stay. We popped in to K2 without a reservation to see if by chance we would be able to join a flight, same-day. The front desk was friendly and informative, our pilot (Stan) was engaging and also very friendly. The overall experience was absolutely positive. We'll continue to be returning customers with K2!

The weather was iffy for landing on a glacier but in the end the weather gave us a window and we were able to land. So awesome to be surrounded by such majestic beauty. I even had to take a little bite to say I ate some of the glacier. Fabulous adventure... Indescribable beauty!
Great flight and glacier landing around Denali. Very professional and welcoming. Had a wonderful time

review_title: Amazing aircraft, pilots and facilities.  Unbelievable views.
review_text: This operation is first class.  Being a commercial pilot and turbine aircraft operator myself, I was keenly aware of the equipment and operational aspects of Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Everything exceeded expectations.  From the check-in process, boarding, the flight itself, the expertise of our pilot (Trent), the glacier landing - everything about this was outstanding.  You will not regret taking this tour!

Thanks very much for the pilot for his services was perfect. Safe and fun. Thanks to Ed for his communication even though our family was late about 15-30minute from the time that we suppose to be in the plane

review_title: K2 Aviation makes the experience seamless.
review_text:
It was an amazing experience overall. Smooth flight, incredible views and vistas. Our pilot Joe was fantastic, so professional and calming. Would go back in a heartbeat and highly recommend. 

We actually had to cancel a glacier landing due to weather, so we just did a shorter flight. But honestly, we were able to spend more time in the air over the mountains seeing the glaciers, which ended up being a blessing. I cannot imagine that a glacier landing would have added much to the trip. It was perfect exactly like it was.

review_title: Excelente paseo en hidroavión por San Francisco y el Sausalito
review_text: Excelente atención. Me comuniqué con ellos a través de su pagina web. Me contestaron rápidamente, y contestaron todas mis dudas. El paseo es excelente igual que el piloto.  Maniobra de manera que los puntos interesantes se puedan ver de ambos lados del avión. El despegue, vuelo y amerizaje fueron sorprendentemente suaves. Mas suave que un vuelo de linea. Completamente satisfecho. Muchas gracias por todo.

We booked our trip (Private Floatplane Experience - Misty Fiords) through Holland America Cruise Line. I can't begin to describe how wonderful the experience was. The staff at terminal were very friendly. Our pilot, Brent, was very knowledgeable of the area and took us on a tour of where he liked to go sight seeing. He answered all of our questions and pointed out many points of interest along the route, describing where we were and showing us on a map. We landed on a lake and he shut the engine off. We were allowed to get out on the floats and take in the impeccable view with complete serenity. He took a number of photos of us while on the lake and gave us some fascinating insight of the aircraft we were flying in and the lake we were resting on. I, myself am an aircraft mechanic and a pilot in training so I personally appreciated him answering my questions along the way. My wife and I couldn't be more pleased and you have our highest recommendation!! Thank you so much!

Even with my fear of heights, this is how we chose to see that side of the coast instead of driving the road to hana and I am so glad we did!  Eddie was our pilot and was extremely knowledgeable and our views were beautiful!

Even though we showed up early and were within 2 lbs of the reported weights, they said there was a weight imbalance and rescheduled us for later that day. When we came later that day, we waited a bit, then ultimately cancelled due to low visibility. Our next rescheduled flight was cancelled due to weather. Wish we could have gone on that first flight, but instead just spent a few hours of our time in the waiting area. The customer service people were nice, and we received a full refund, but I'm still not sure as to why there was a weight problem for us when our reported weights were completely accurate.

What great people. Eric was attentive, personable and went out of his way to make sure everyone had a great time.  I would recommend this tour to anyone. 
Eric took extra time to make sure we could see the whales off the Napali coast and did a fantastic job of narrating the whole tour.

The people in the office were professional, friendly, and helpful. The pilot provided a lot of great insight to what we were seeing and the views were incredible! The glacier landing is worth the extra money. I would do it again in a heartbeat!

I would absolutely recommend this tour and this company to my family and friends. 

Definitely take some anti motion sickness pills! The pilot did a wonderful job of keeping us smooth, but it’s a little plane and you’ll be taking a ton of pictures. Dramamine kept me from being sick.

Booked with maverick on the recommendation of the concierge at out hotel and having heard mixed reviews about Sundance!

What an experience! Our pilot was great and made the trip and the Grand Canyon is unmissable!

If I had one criticism it was the cost. The cost for my wife and I worked out at about £680 which I thought was a tad steep.

That aside the company are very professional and the trip really is a once in a lifetime experience!

review_title: Bruce is a great guide and flight instructure
review_text:
My wife and I took a tour today.
I am a private pilot and so Bruce let me take the left seat (pilot talk for pilot in command).
We taxied along with an Air Alaska 757 to the runway and were imidiately cleared for takeoff.

We took off with me at the controls, Bruce in the right seat and my wife in the back.

It was a wonderful flight with great instruction and sightseeing guidance from Bruce.
The views are incredible and for me the obvious plus was that I had the controls.

This familiy business makes things really special - there is even a surprize - but I am not telling.

We highly recommend this tour.  (Oh yes, bring your camera and make sure it is charged - ours ran out of juice.)

Service above self 
Great people 
Excellently  maintained aircraft 
 Not to mention experienced pilots know the area

The Floatplane trip to Misty Fjords was smooth from takeoff to landing, with amazing views and a terrific pilot. All of the folks associated with Seawind, from the driver who picked us up and dropped us off (at our restaurant destination!) to the pilot and the owners were friendly, enthusiastic and a pleasure to meet. We strongly recommend Seawind to anyone interested in a Floatplane trip in Ketchikan!

review_title: Over looking Miami Beach is one of kind!
review_text:
Thank you so much for an amazing tour!! The plane ride was smooth, plenty of room & the views were amazing! We had a blast! 
10/10! Thank you!

What a fantastic experience.  Soaring over glaciers and mountain tops and then landing on a glacier was a bucket list accomplishment!  The pilot Pat was great and informative.  The views were indescribably beautiful.  It was very cool to land on the glacier and get out and  experience the snow/ice.  I would highly recommend this trip.

Our children surprised us with a flight seeing tour while we were on our Alaskan vacation.  The day started out a little iffy, but turned out to be perfect.  Everyone at Talkeetna Taxi was professional and had our best interest in mind at all times.  We got to see Denali and the glacier pools were amazingly blue.  Landing on the glacier was an experience.  While we were wondering around it started to snow lightly.  By the time we took off, the flakes were huge.  Definitely worth the money, skimp some place else if you need to make a decision.

Bruce, Val and the whole WIngs Over Kauai experience were simply amazing. They add many special touches to make it even more memorablt.  The flight was perfection even on a windy day! There is no better way to experience the entire island. Bruce points out fabulous spots to visit on the island- every one we visited so far has been great! This is a tour we plan on doing again when we come back to Kauai the next time too!

Thanks for the perfect way to start our Hawaiian Vacation! - John and Katie

I have lived on Kauai for 30 years and have taken helicopter tours on a number of occassions. This experience with Kevin was absolutely spectacular! We so often take for granted the beauty around us, but this was beyond our expectations. Kevin was an exceptional tour guide to my family! Incredibly blessed!

It was a very memorable experience. You can’t go wrong with a smooth flight and a breathtaking view. It was the perfect thing to do on a date with my husband. The pilot was did an awesome job at explaining and making sure we were comfortable. We are like ok’ing forward to the other rides and places they offer! Definitely will be back . Thank you envi adventures!!!

My wife and I took the 1 hour flight around Kauai and it was a great experience.  Our pilot/guide was well versed in the terrain and Hawaiian history.  As the owner of a private pilot license, I watched his flying skills with great interest and was very impressed.  It was also a great value for the price.  I highly recommend it.

Had a once in a lifetime experience with Eric flying to Hawaii to see the lava flow. 
The flight was spectacular, Eric was a true professional and the whole experience was incredible. I highly recommend Maui Plane Rides.
What a unique experience allowing us to see Hawaii from a bird’s eye view!  Erik was calming and very knowledgeable. Definitely a lifetime memory that we’ll cherish forever.

review_title: Breathtaking flight memories with an awesome Pilot
review_text: Our Cruiseship Dock on this beautiful Island and the best way to see this isle tru  Air .Wings over Kauai is the most affordable company I found in the area and  Bruce the adorable Pilot has wealth of information about the wonders of Kauai island.ellen & Sophia are the beautiful ladies who welcomes us and able to pick us up from the nearest mall and take us to airport.there are free drinks lollies and necklaces which I think  a bonus.taking photos and video is welcome too.

review_title: This was the best experience of our whole trip!
review_text:
We really enjoyed this experience.  Flying around Denali and landing on a glacier was so surreal.  The Grand Denali Tour with Glacier Landing will cost you $942 for two people, including all taxes and fees, but will definitely be worth it. 
The only reason that I did not give it 5 stars is because our pilot, Patrick, was a real jerk.  He did a great job of flying, but I would definitely request another pilot if I knew better.  
K2 Aviation did a great job.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the island of Kauai
review_text: We had a wonderful time flying over Kauai with Air Ventures!!! Amazing views and wonderful staff. Was well worth the time and money. Highly recommend this for everyone.  ENJOY!!!

I am soooooo glad we booked our flight-seeing excursion with Wings Over Kauai!!!  Val and Bruce couldn't have been more accommodating, knowledgeable and hospitable.  Of all the islands we visited, Kauai was, by far, the most beautiful .. and we wouldn't have been able to enjoyed it to this extent without Wings Over Kauai!!  The pictures we took from our flight look like professional post cards or out of National Geographic.  And, all the additional commentary and insights from Bruce, our fearless pilot, made the experience just that much richer.  Plus, they offered nice little surprises that I'm not going to ruin by telling.  Just know that they're a first-rate organization.  Book with them.  You won't be disappointed!!  (Thank you, Val & Bruce - The Eyricks)

First of all Thanks to our amazing pilot Mr. JP from Envi. He’s really accommodating and nice. We had a fantastic and amazing experienced.  We really enjoyed the views. The Multnomah waterfalls are pretty.

Had seen the sunset a few times already, but watching it from the air is a new experience!  Stephen did a great job, and was very personable. Explained things, and gave warning of areas of potential turbulence. Would definitely recommend.

This was hands down one of the most humbling experiences I’ve had of my many adventures.  Landing on the Kahiltna Glacier at Base Camp on the south west slopes of Denali makes you feel very small in the grand scheme of things.  Patrick, our pilot, was stellar.  What an awe inspiring scenery.  It was a blessing to experience it.  We originally intended to do the summit flight with glacier landing, however due to storms the attempt was too dangerous.  K2 happily quickly and happily offered to get us on the Grand Tour with the glacier landing with the promise of better views flying amongst the towering walls as opposed to above them.  They were beyond correct.  I would highly recommend this experience!!  Well done K2 Aviation, well done.
Landing on a glacier with K2 on a brilliantly clear and sunny day with Riley as  our pilot was a great experience. I highly recommend it!

review_title: Canyon Spirt Grand Canyon Helicopter Tour, departing from the South Rim
review_text:
We are not 'happy fliers' but we drew on every ounce of bravery we had and took this trip...the only way to see the full majesty of the Grand Canyon. We took the 45 minute trip from the South Rim (no landing as that is a different section of the Canyon) and we were taken along the set flight path as permitted by the aviation authorities.  It was completely amazing and would recommend to everyone, to go all that way and not see it from the air and fly through its vast trenches is like going to The Magic Kingdom and not going on Space Mountain! 
I had been looking forward to the trip for months and it did not disappoint, I was so excited I didn't realise we had taken off! 
If you get travel sickness, take a travel tablet before hand just to make sure your stomach does not spoil your trip.

review_title: Saw the Napali Coast from above
review_text: Our pilot and tour guide was very knowledgeable. The views were breathtaking. Highly recommend doing an air tour of Kauai!

review_title: Awesome Hike but NOT at Denali National Park
review_text: This is a bit of a mixed experience for us.  The floatplane ride to Caribou lodge was wonderful - the guided hike from Caribou Lodge at Boomerang Lake was really awesome - Zack showed us amazing tundra plant life - his family at Caribou lodge opened our eyes with their lifestyle and their hospitality.  So full points to them for our delightful hiking experience.  But due to cloudy conditions  the flight service to view Denali National Park from the air was canceled (the float plane service reimbursed us very promptly for the missed portion of the trip).  Here's my issue - the blurb states "Experience Denali National Park from the air and at ground level"  The clouds made us miss the "from the air portion" and we accept with gratitude what Mother Nature grants us, but there was *never* a chance of experiencing Denali NP "at ground level."  So by following this ad, we missed out on visiting Denali National Park on a once in a lifetime trip to Alaska, and that was disappointing indeed.  The ad needs to be clear that there is NEVER a chance to experience Denali National Park *at ground level* with this service. If the weather permits, you see DNP from the air, but you never get to DNP at ground level, no matter what.
Wonderful flight! Mark was great and gave us lots of fun information about the area. We went almost all the way around the island and even saw some whales!! Worth every penny!!!

Enjoyed our tour over Kauai with wings over Kauai, had a nice flight and the price paid was extremely fair. However after we landed one of our group seated behind the pilot complained she didn't get to see much, Ellen confessed they normally don't sit anybody there because of the limited view. So we got pretty bummed after this, especially after being charged for all six. Again service was AWESOME and we had a GREAT time but thought it devious for her to admit they don't charge for the seat AFTER we flew and were charged for it. I tried to contact her after she dropped us of at the cruise terminal but  to no avail, she didn't answer our calls. If this hadn't happened they would have 5 circles!

The weather was "off and on rain" - so we weren't sure how it would turn out.  It was AMAZING!  Pilot was really engaging - and he was able to navigate around the weather to make it 10+++ !  The Island was goregous - we saw the outer edges of the island all the way around (the landscape changes dramtatically), plus some of the canyons and famous waterfalls! It is a highlight of our vacation!!!

Our pilots name was Samuel. He did a great job describing where we where and answering any questions we had . 
 I had never been up in a small plane and I was nervous but we had a smooth take off and landing.
And we enjoyed every minute of the flight .

Spectacular Flight in a small ski plane up close to Denali and through the surrounding Alaska Range.  Our Pilot Wilbur was experienced, calm and capable.  This was a highlight among many great Alaska experiences.  Highly recommend!

review_title: Flight over the island of Kauai
review_text: It was an amazing experience. Very worthwhile as it gave a great overview of the entire island as it circled right around the island. The weather was perfect and the pilot was professional and able to reassure even a passenger that was clearly very apprehensive.

I was traveling alone with my 3 kids all age 9, we were greeted kindly by Lindsey the sales person/manager and things "seemed" to be running smoothly and ethically. We boarded our small 4 seater plane with our young pilot and amazing hiking guide Craig from Aria, but halfway through the flight the pilot said we had to go back to the airport as we have a mechanical malfunction, which as a mom with her babies on board  this small plane with a very young pilot I was beyond anxious we were all going down.We got back and waited a while till they put us on another plane as the one that we were on could not be repaired, that was smooth and the pilot was experienced but the aerial tour that we paid for  to do over the grand canyon was "postponed" so we could get back on  their schedule.... After landing we were then put into a hummer to take us to the grand canyon to hike this company who owned the hummer was Buck Wild Adventures, the woman driver dropped us off on the side of the road as she said she could not get us to the trail head and to make sure we were there by 2pm (approx 3 hours later). We got back to the meeting place after an amazing hike (again the hiking guide was top notch) 10 minutes early and we waited and waited there is no cell service up there so we had no way to call for help. After waiting on the side of the road for an hour we finally had to walk more than an hour on a busy street with no sidewalk (with 3 kids!!!) until we could get phone reception, our hiking guide was so helpful and called his boss who quickly got in touch with Westwind and someone finally came and picked us up hours later than the 2pm meeting time. My kids had done a huge hike were exhausted and starving at this point.... when I mentioned the aerial tour the pilot said oh we'll do that now but at this point my kids were so tired they were asleep before the tour even began missing ALL of the sights! When we landed finally back at the Deer Valley Airport Lindsey had already left for the day with no call to check in or anything that evening... it was after 6pm when we landed and 7pm before finally getting a ride back to our hotel when we were supposed to be back between 1-2. I called the next morning to voice my disappointment and Lindsey did answer but unknowing to her she kept muting herself to talk to other people and every time she did it as music would blare (she had no idea this was happening)  so she wasn't listening to me at all. She blamed everything on other people and "promised" to make things right with some type of refund. It has been two weeks and I've yet to hear anything back from her even after emailing several times. Just can't believe businesses really run like this it's sad.

Jill and her team took great care of my wife and I setting up our flight and providing the flight itself.  Harry the pilot gave a great explanation of everything we saw and answered many questions from the passengers.
Seeing the beauty of the islands from the air was fantastic!  Great Trip! So much fun!  Such a beautiful place!

review_title: The best hour we spent in Kauai
review_text:
WoK was super nice and professional, and the tour itself is our best memory in Kauai.

I was concerned that my 28 week pregnant wife might have motion sick for the flight, WoK was happy to rescheduled for me a morning flight with a bigger plane. It turns out to be only my family was there so we actually get a private tour.  Our pilot speaks Chinese which is a big plus as my wife & kids doesn't speaks much English, and the pilot introduced so many attractions in the flight. They gave my wife and daughter beautiful flowers which is the first surprise. 

The weather was very good for flight and we were lucky to see the Mount Waialeale, the wall of tears. Needless to say we go to the Na Pali coast, the waimea canyon, we even saw some dorphins. 

I would definitely do this again in next visit.
Great customer service, reliable and safety minded operation.  Absolutely the best way to get to the San Juan’s.  50 minute flight compared to a 5 hour drive and ferry ride.  A very easy choice!
I was very nervous about flying on a small plane but the plane ride was great and the entire trip was wonderful.  This was a once in a lifetime trip and everyone should do this.

review_title: A thrill of a life time.
review_text: K2 provided my wife and I an experience of a life time.  This is a must do for your bucket list. The sights, the flight, landing on the mountain and throwing snowballs.  We cant wait to do this again.  Many thanks to the staff, Mike our pilot for giving us a thrill of a life time.

I didn't have a lot of time, still wanted to see nature's wonder called Grand Canyon.i booked this trip for 169USD and it was more than I expected. We were transported to boulder municipal airport from our hotel by the airline very comfortably. Our plane was a 17 seater Canada made vista liner with huge windows for full view.

Our pilots were friendly and expert on flying this sector. Plane has pre recorded commentary but you won't hear a lot foot due engine's noise.

This flight gives great view of Hoover dam and a small section of Grand Canyon. It's it for you if you want to spend time in or around Grand Canyon.

I strong recommendation for people short on time still wanting to have a flavor of Hoover dam, Colorado river and Grand Canyon.

review_title: First time visit to the San Juan Islands
review_text: This was our first visit to San Juan Islands. Taking a seaplane was an awesome way to see Seattle and the islands. Our Captain was great pointing out all the different sites below. The entire staff was excellent!

Phenomenal experience, from booking with ease with Lindsey to a breathtaking, unbelievable experience with Carla, I was blown away by all of it.  Lindsey is awesome at what she does, great communication and incredibly welcoming when we finally got on site.  Then we met Carla for our ANT tour, immediately felt confident with her as our pilot and guide, she was with us the entire tour which I never expected and was fun, knowledgeable, and clearly very skilled and experienced as a pilot.  The sites were just jaw dropping, you forget what you are seeing is not man made, it’s almost fake, then you remember it’s not and have this incredible feeling of appreciation and admiration for what you’ve just seen and experienced.  I am so very glad we chose Westwind, I thought this would be a once and a lifetime experience, but they were so awesome I can’t wait to get back and do another tour!!

Soooo Cool, I just wish I had gotten a longer flight! Already planning the next trip!! 😍😍🙌
The pilot was so friendly and gave us great information about every area we flew over! Definitely recommend to everyone!!
tour_name: 21-44_Stunning Air Tour of the Columbia River Gorge by Envi Adventures_2025-02-27

review_text: We had a trip of a lifetime and the pilot was very knowledgeable. The whole staff was friendly and the trip was safe.

My husband and I are living in Oahu for a few months for work and took a weekend over to Kauai. With limited time we knew this was the thing to do! We went our last day and the weather was amazing! 230 flight time made for nice lighting! Bruce was so personable and involved everyone in the plane (all four of us) in the flight and in conversation. I would recommend this to anyone! HALF the cost of a helicopter AND can accommodate larger people! (330 lbs) Everyone has a window seat and gets a surprise at the end. Loved every second!

Eric was a great guide who provided a phenomenal experience catering to what we wanted to see.  The private tour left opportunity for us to see the extra thing, Eric pointed out cool and knowledgeable places and he even let my girlfriend drive the plane (huge points for me and him!  Lol). The plane was well taken care of and Eric made sure he was attentive and that we were comfortable.  We would recommend this experience over the helicopters any time!

review_title: Sunny day - got to see all the mountains!
review_text: It was a perfect day to see the Denali mountain, and also the 2 smaller ones next to it (the "momma" and "baby"). Our pilot was Chad Smith. He said only 5% of people get to see all 3mountains at the same time, so it was our lucky day!  I was concerned about flying on such a small plane, but the ride was smooth, and I was so busy getting pictures of everything that I completely forgot I was on a small plane.  I would definitely recomment this tour for everyone!
Desi made a great flight..,,,making sure everyone on the plane saw all the sights. Very confident pilot.

I took the MT McKinley tour with glacier landing and it was one of the highlights of Alaska trip. Out pilot was very skilled and kept us at ease. The landing was smooth and we loved the time at the glacier. Awesome views and I took tons of photos to savor. I will try Grand Denali tour or McKinley peak tour next time.

review_title: A highlight of our visit on Kauai.
review_text:
We really enjoyed our flight with Bruce, as well as, our visit with Ellen and Carter.  We couldn't have asked for anything more or to be treated with more personal attention.  We highly recommend this family operation to anyone wanting to get an overall view of this beautiful island.  It is much lower priced that a helicopter flight and with only 4 passengers on board you have a window seat for better visability.  Noise quietening headphones are a definitely plus allowing you to communicate with the pilot.
Stan and Patsy Alexander
Hamilton, Texas

review_title: A very exciting and enlightening experience
review_text:
This was part a tour and we were very happy to have had this as part of our tour.  We very much enjoyed the flight and the descriptions of the pilot.  He kept of informed of all the different parts of Kauai and the many different terrains.   We had the experience of seeing many humpback whales off the west coast.  Flying over the canyon was also quite nice as our own trip up the canyon was not as good because we got clouded in before we got to the top.  We took some pictures and hope they turn out well.  
Dave & Judy

Had a blast and saw lots of waterfalls, pilot was friendly and informative.
Flying plane was great!!
The views on this private tour were neat and felt safe and smooth and the experience was really enjoyable. Highly recommended.

We did the Grand Denali Flightseeing tour with a glacier landing a couple of weeks ago. The staff here are very professional and attentive. Our pilot was Michael and we had a fabulous trip and were lucky to have had beautiful weather for a smooth and memorable glacier landing. This was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Alaska. Not to be missed!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Great experience nice service. Everything is very smooth. We are a family of six, and we have the entire plane to ourselves.

About a 70" trip around Kauai. Stunning and gorgeous views. Well narrated by our pilot Bruce. Family run business. Much cheaper than helicopter tours and more personal. Headphones to hear Pilots narrative and talk w/other passengers. Well worth the money-GO!!

Fantastic tour. Jill and Nate (the pilot) are very warm and friendly people. Nate is very knowledgable about the island and was a great guide. Got to witness some breathtaking aerial views of the island. Highly recommend flying with them.

Awesome trip to the Grand Canyon. We felt very safe flying to and from the Canyon. We spent a good bit of time flying over and around the Canyon...warning the flight can be a little bumpy in the canyon but it was a great experience. From check in to check out the service was top notch. The tour around the canyon in the jeep tour was very fun but very windy in March....wear layers bc it is 20 degrees cooler in the Canyon. Highly recommend West Wing.

This was my first helicopter flight, and it truly set the standard for all others that may follow. Our pilot, Chris, while extremely professional, was as friendly and informative as he could be. When "the bottom dropped out" as we cleared the mesa at the rim of the Grand Canyon, it was the most exhilarating experience of my life to date (and I've had a number of them, happily). It. Just. Takes. Your. Breath. Away. We saw so much (even wildlife "bathing" in a small pond on a mesa on our way back in)! Chris and Maverick made it incredibly memorable for our party. This experience will be tough to top. We will be back!

review_text: Booked a tour via our cruise ship to visit Neets Bay and they used Taquan Air to fly us there. Great trip, felt safe on the flight. Loved Neets Bay watching the Bears close up in the capable hands of Puck.
Awe inspiring, seeing the majesty of all that is beautiful in the world. Our pilot was interesting and highly competent too!
He was very informative and a great experience. He wanted to make sure that we knew what was going on.

I am not the best flyer but I had heard this was a tour not to be missed! Adam was our pilot and he was amazing! I appreciated his playlist as we flew over the Tongass National Forest and into the Misty Fjords! Words and pictures cannot describe the beauty of this adventure...you'll have to experience this yourself! Although it was a three hour tour, the time "flew" by leaving us wanting to see more! If you have the time, take this tour...you will never forget it! Ask for Adam...he's the best!

Our pilot was very friendly and a great tour guide as well as a wonderful pilot. The views of the coastline were spectacular and unmatched in natural beauty. We landed in the Hana rainforest and toured the plantation with a man from Peru who also spoke Arabic in addition to English and Spanish. I felt very safe in the chopper. Highly recommended.

review_title: Grand Canyon was amazing, getting there not so much
review_text:
We did the connoisseur trip to the South Rim.  Our bus arrived exactly on time to take us to the airport.  The driver did seem like he was in a hurry & was short with some of the passengers but they were late so I guess that is to be expected.  We arrived at the airport & didn't have a long wait to check in.  Once checked in we had approx 30mins before our flight left which was enough time to get some food & water at the cafe in the airport.
Our pilot was nice & friendly.  The plane was very cramped which I guess is to be expected but if you are taller than 6 foot you will find it very cramped.  Also the day was very hot & the plane doesn't have aircon.  It was also a very turbulent flight which made my wife & I feel quite ill.  The upside to all this is the views from the aircraft are amazing from the Hover Damn through to different parts of the Canyon.  There is an audio tour of everything you are seeing which is great, however the music that goes with it is terrible.  
We arrived safely & then were directed to a bus to travel to the canyon.  The bus driver again was quite short with the other passengers who didn't speak a ton of english so I don't think they understand what was required anyway.  The driver was nice to us but I believe there should have been more direction on where to go once we arrived at the airport & how much time before we left on the bus, so people knew whether to rush to the toilet or not.  Once arriving at the canyon it was everything & more than we expected.  Our travel back on the bus was fine however the plane ride back (which is about 1hr) was very turbulent, after the rough flight we were made to wait on the tarmac for a couple of mins in the heat for no apparent reason which added to the sickness.  The bus ride back to our hotel was quick & we didn't need to wait long.
If I had to do it again, a helicopter ride would be my pick.

We thoroughly enjoyed this trip today! We had the tour to ourselves - two 60 year olds and our respective 22 year old kids. The seaplane ride was a once in a lifetime for us and so cool! Our pilot Max was so kind and pleasant. He helped me when I struggled to get up and into the plane as I recently had foot surgery. Our tour guide and naturalist was Kim and she was the highlight of our trip! What a ray of sunshine! You can tell she truly loves Ketchikan and she knew so much about the flora and fauna in the rain forest. She led us down the most beautiful path to Traitors Cove to the bear viewing platform. I moved a little slow and she was so supportive and kind. We unfortunately didn’t see any bears coming to eat the spawning salmon. She said this was very unusual. We had gorgeous weather and truly enjoyed our excursion! Thanks to Seawind for providing such a wonderful experience. We will always cherish it!

review_title: for those visiting on a time budget--just be aware to have a plan B
review_text: I specifically booked on K2 for their reviews. Flew 7+hrs from houston to anchorage and this was supposed to be my highlight for my trip. i was booked with K2 for sat 9/3 for a tour+landing (they charge 1/2 on your CC and rest when you show up). Before leaving Anchorage called them at 803am that day to verify landing and the lady on the phone said "yes, we're landing this morning". Drove the slightly over 2 hours to talkeetna and during checkin at 1015am, the gentleman that was there (tall slim guy) mentioned they would fly for the tour but <1% chance of landing. When asked about other landings told to me on the phone, they said they never even landed that morning due to weather and also that its bad to land in the summer time. Clearly this was an expectation bummer to me from the first call that am to the reality check at the counter since i'm one of those that hate surprises. All they had to do was tell me the same on the phone that chances were looking slim to land today and that would have been more than enough warning to me to be atleast have planned for plan B incase this did not work. I asked for why the discrepancy over the phone with what the lady said just 2hrs ago vs. now at the counter and got absolutely NO apology for that. Yes, i did get my refund but again my point is for those on a time crunch since i visited alaksa for just the labor day weekend, beware that even if you do not get to land (if thats what you want, like i did) you may be still told on the phone to come in. (i wish that same gentleman i spoke to in person had answered the phone that morning saving me this review. It would'nt have been frustrating at all, had both the messages on the phone+in person were in sync). But obvisouly keeping safety in mind, it was best to not land (i'm just a little frustrated that the same could have been communicated over the phone to either help a customer avoid the road trip or have a plan B to do in talkeetna---that's all). The actual problem is as with any airline making $ from tourists, they would NOT like to say NO on the phone to any customer and K2 is no exception. Just be careful for those on a time budget, pls. try to check prior to your roadtrip as best you can since they do offer re-scheduling or atleast keep something else in talkeetna to do as plan B (which is what i did in the end taking the rapids cruise on the talkeetna river. i was lucky to find this on the spot there but i would suggest you plan for a plan B).

Our flight around Denali was an experience we will never forget! We were lucky to have amazing weather and the views of Denali and the surrounding mountains were phenomenal. The staff and captain were extremely friendly and knowledgeable and I highly suggest booking a flight and viewing Denali from above!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Most amazing experience of our lives.  Perfect weather for a perfect day.  Thank you so much for sharing your beautiful part of the country with us.  Pelley and Keller families.

Bruce and Ellen, as well as their children, are excellent hosts and run a great tour business. Bruce is a thoughtful and highly experience pilot, and - as a private pilot myself - I appreciate his concern for safety and for thoroughness. We had a wonderful circuit of the island, and Bruce and Ellen went out of their way to ensure we had a safe and enjoyable time.

We took this trip whilst on a cruise. Get off the ship walk no more than 10 minutes and we booked opposite the beach. Our plane took only 6 people. Family run atmosphere. The scenery was awesome and the pilot really cared that we enjoyed our time with great comentry. We learned more about Hawaii than any other time here. Safety and enjoyment are what they care about. You can't get this trip from the ship so its cost effective too. Our pilot was fun and polite and such a lovely young man.The C D was a lovely touch and renews our memories every time.
Eric was amazing! Not only did he accommodate for me and my brother but he also provided an outstanding helicopter tour! ❤️
Excellent flight in reasonable weather conditions, Ray chose great views and is a very knowledgeable and experienced pilot, great tour commentary

Awesome breathtaking flight. Flying in between and over mountains. excellent commentary from our pilot. The softest landing ever on a Denali glacier at 7000 feet. Never will forget such a fun experience thankyou K2

review_title: Bad Business Practice - No Warning for Canceled Flight
review_text: Due to weather we were not able to do the flight we had booked, including landing on a glacier. I understand that the weather cannot be controlled. I do not understand however the thought process behind not informing us via email or call to let us know our options. We are in Alaska for 10 days with plans down to the minute each day. Had we known we wouldn’t be flying we wouldn’t have even stopped in Talkeetna. They want you to come to the office to check in anyways so they can try and sell you a different flight. Seems unethical. Let us know ahead of time so we can make our own decisions. It’s not like they just decided not to fly when we got there.

user_location: Saint Paul Park, Minnesota, United States
review_title: Air Ventures Kauai in the air!!!!
review_text:
Wow- that is what you will be saying the entire time you are in the air...WOW! 
Paul our Pilot was great! He showed us waterfalls, coffee fields, celebreties homes, Napali coast and many other beautiful sites that you cannot see by car. I would highly recommend this flight to everyone that visits Kauai. The small plane is perfect for those that may not want to do a helicopter. We even saw a whale...looked like a torpedo in the water...awesome! 
Thank you so much Paul and Air Ventures!!! We all loved it. 
December 8, 2012... Dan, Jayne, JoAnn and Jolene (Jolene was our first time flyer, and even she loved it)

review_title: AMAZING!!!!!!  A must do to truly experience Alaska!
review_text: You can’t experience Alaska without doing this.  It was the highlight of our trip.  Words can not describe the incredible views that will be imprinted in my mind forever.  Our pilot was awesome!!!!  Bring your camera!  You’re  sure to take hundreds of unbelievable photos!!!!!!

The flight with Wings Over Kauai was a highlight. Do it as early in your vacation as possible, so you can get a feel for the layout of the island. We missed Ellen as she was gone, but Jeanne was delightful and Bruce was an excellent pilot and guide. The sky was clear and we saw awesome sights.  The little gifts you receive are just a wonderful bonus. So glad we did this. Jeff & Jan
This is a wonderful trip and I reread recommend it to anybody that wants to go on a nice magic Simon says play

We had the best experience with pilot Billy. Polite, detailed, and knowledgeable about his craft and the environment. Lucky to be a 30%er following rainy days. Thanks also to the young man who checked us in upon arrival. Articulate and friendly.

A perfectly sunny day to go see the beautiful Misty Fjords with our pilot Jim. We had a great time on our day off, he was very informative and friendly. Best of all he cranked some sick tunes (CCR) and pulled out his little hula skirt girl, all fitting for the ride into the mountains. Thankful for a one of a kind experience, would do again.

As soon as my husband saw that Air Ventures offered a Biplane tour he wanted to do it.  It took a lot of convincing on his part to get me on as I am afraid of flying.  Harry was our pilot and made me feel at ease at once.  This is a unique and awesome way to tour the island.  We had spectacular views and Harry was a great guide!  He made sure to point out key areas and would maneuver the plane to provide us an even better view.  It was well worth the money!  The entire staff was friendly and we would definitely recommend to anyone.

Worth every penny.  Very well-run service.  Astounding views of the canyon and the north rim, which we couldn’t visit this time of year by car.  Very comfortable flight; I tend to have motion sickness but was not bothered at all thanks to our excellent pilot, John.  I would take this trip again if we return to the Grand Canyon.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: Amazing experience in kauai! Was worth every ar i’ve spent on it! My boyfriend and I appreciated the whole tour! Amazing views, great team with a nice pilote! Thanks JT for your time! I recomment it for everyone- it’s an experience of a lifetime!

Northwest Seaplanes was awesome! They flew us directly to Sund's Lodge on Malcolm Is. B.C. and dropped us off right at the dock.  We had a spectacular flight as even saw Killer whales as our pilot dipped a wing so we could get a better view.  We had a fantastic time fishing at Sund's Lodge and then got picked-up right at our dock.  I recommend Northwest Seaplanes for all destinations in the Salish Sea!
Amazing views, amazing pilot. The views were spectacular amd i had an amazong time. Best landing of my life for real

As a former fighter pilot this was a fantastic experience.  The flight to the glacier was beautiful and the landing on it was great.  We were very lucky that the weather was not an issue at all. Would do it again in a heartbeat!

Nos pareció una experiencia que superó nuestras expectativas, escogimos Maverick porque nos habían hablado muy bien de sus helicópteros y la seguridad , y así fue.
Lo único que no recomiendo es comprar la foto Antes de subir, porque luego te haces fotos con tu cámara 

Por lo demás, una compañía estupenda, con unos helicópteros muy nuevos y nos dio mucha seguridad, además de disfrutar de la experiencia
Westwind managed to pack a great visit to the Grand Canyon into a day!  The pilots, tour by Pink jeep of the South rim were all very professional.

Rather than do the standard helicopter tour, I wanted to do something that would allow me (as a private pilot) to do the flying.   We booked the 172 with Marcus along as CFI.  Marcus handled the radio and suggested the route, but I was allowed to do all of the flying.   

It was a great experience, and probably the highlight of our trip.  I would highly recommend this as an alternative to a helicopter tour.
One of the most beautiful things I have ever seen. Very good experience. I recommend taking the flight before entering the park.

We got a great overview of the island in about 70 minutes. The pilot was very relaxed, and attentive to what the people in his plane were looking at. When he noticed that people saw something special, he never failed to add a tidbit of information for it.

Overall a great experience and a fun way to see the island from above. (Note that if you're worried about flying in a small plane: I found it much nicer to take off and land with a plane like that than with the big passenger planes, almost like leaving your driveway with a car :-) )

review_title: AirVentures great air tour of Kauai!
review_text: Very good tour!  Quiet and gentle with great visibility and coverage of the island. Good piloting.  Great price, too.  Highly recommended.

review_title: One of the must-dos, totally worth the money
review_text:
I was originally planning for a boat tour to the Na Pali coast and only changed my mind in the last minute.  Na Pali is one of the most beautiful areas of Kauai, and it's inaccessible by car, so you'll really have to plan to sail, fly or walk the 11-mi trail to see the coast line.  I was so lucky to be able to get a seat on the busy Christmas eve.  It was a beautiful day, and the ride was just so perfect.  The staff at Air Ventures were extremely friendly, and I was very impressed that Captain Harry took everyone like a family tour, as opposed to a paid guided tour.  He explained every place we flew by, detoured to the water and pointed out whales--I never knew it's so amazing to see the whales from the air.  You can actually see them under the water, and we were even luckier to see a whale doing a flip, making a huge splash of water.  Then we flew down the famous Kalalau Valley, spent 15-20min in the Na Pali coast area, and then continued to Hanalei valley, and before we returned to the airport, Captain Harry flow around the beautiful Wailua falls so everyone got a close-up views of the falls (much larger than what you'd see from the road).

I've taken flightseeings in Alaska and Hawaii, and my personal experience is when the weather is good, it's absolutely worth every penny--even if you found the price may be enough for you to fly a round trip across the continental US :)  But I'd always give it a second thought if the weather isn't good.  And finally, Air Ventures operates an air van (or more), which flights higher than helicopters, so you won't get a chance to fly by the water falls, but you don't really miss anything, and considering that the price is probably 50% lower, it's an unbeatable deal.  BTW, everyone has a window seat on the air van, and Air Ventures keep their windows spotless; while on a 6-passenger helicopter, only 3 people get window seats.

review_title: Logged an hour of dual, in paradise.
review_text:
I had the luxury of flying with my teenage son and Bruce this morning. There is NO better way to see the island than from a small plane. Our flight was smooth, well narrated, and the sights are absolutely amazing. Each person we interacted with was professional and fun.

If you are in Kauai, flying with this company specifically, would be a must do!

review_title: Misleading waste of time and money. Will be contacting priceline
review_text: I flew on "Air Ventures Hawaii" today and really "got took" as they say. First from booking on Priceline, what was stated there and on the trip info simply was not what I got. To ad insult to injury I was placed on the left side of the plane behind the pilot and missed most of the sites. A family with a tot all of maybe 4 or 5 got the cherry seats on the right side. A girl about 8 inches shorter than me got to spread out in front with the pilot. A 4 or 5 year old (again amazed by this) gets the big window on the right in the middle. Her Mother getting the last good window on the right. There I am 6'2" 210 pounds, crammed in this tiny plane behind the pilot with a great view of the wing and white bar holding it on. One of the girls on the right side was kind enough to snap a few pictures for me and also thought it was foolish how they arranged us. The rest of the trip consisted of me sticking my arm over to where the tot was and trying to get pics and then finally shutting my camera off and giving up. The waterfall was the only thing the pilot circled back for, for me to see. I missed the entire Napali Coast which was the main thing I wanted to see. Oh there is Julia Roberts house and there is Pierce Brosnan's place. (The tot does not know who they are.) I will never know with my view of the ocean, wing, and white bar holding the wing on. This was absolute crap. Do yourself a favor and wait until you are here and book a helicopter tour. I have been sick at my stomach all day from this tiny plane and also just feel very ripped off. I cannot believe the pilot gave a tot a cherry seat and stuck me where he did either. A short girl getting to spread out in front. I had a 20 dollar tip ready but I left tipping nothing. I guess I will go blow 15 on a beer at the St. Regis where I am staying. Did not like the reference that it was foolish to spend 15 on a beer. What was foolish was this plane ride. I think I should get refunded as I have booked a copter tour tomorrow and have to drive all the way back to that side of the island to get a decent tour. The place I went to book another tour right after this said I would get a seat I wanted. They said they did not think that was right giving two of three people in a group, especially a little kid the good seats. They thought I probably only paid 60-70 though. Oh boy, I paid much more and got to watch a family make great memories while I sat in the worst seat on the plane. Not as advertised. Avoid at all costs! What a waste of a day and now I have to drive out of my way again for a decent tour. If you can't tell I am writing this while I am still mad. Just terrible. As if all this is not bad enough if you are on the right side, the plane still flies very very high. Not up close and personal at all like it was made out to be.

Having only flown for the first time the week before this was the most amazing trip I've ever had. The flight was very smooth and the pilot very knowledgable about the canyon. If you're nervous about going in a helicopter, don't be it's great.

We had a fabulous time on our helicopter tour. Our pilot was very nice and gave us lots of interesting information during our flight and our tour of the rainforest. We will probably book another tour next year when we go back.

review_title: Wow!  The Highlight of Our Alaskan Trip
review_text: Family-owned and top notch in every way. Cannot say enough about the quality of the experience they offer. We had not planned on taking this tour but the guys on the dock told one of our companions they would make us a great deal if all 6 flew. My wife and I toured Ketchikan and kept saying we ought to do that.  Eventually, we decided to and just the two of ended up flying (so the deal wasn't quite as good but still better than the ship.)  This experience was truly the highlight of our trip (and we even used another flightseeing company to land at Base Camp in Deanli.)  Steve is firendly and seems knowledgeable.  When he spotted a couple of bears near a lake, he didn't hesitate to land closer for a better view.  Thanks!

We all really enjoyed our Seaplane Adventure today!  It was such fun to take off from the seabase by Sausalito and fly over the Golden Gate Bridge!  We had great views of the Marin Headlands, the beautiful coast of Marin County, the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, Angel Island, Treasure Island, and San Francisco. It was really fun to see so many iconic San Francisco landmarks from above.  Our pilot was great, too. I highly recommend Seaplane Adventures and I look forward to another visit in the future.

In 30-45 Min. sieht man die SF-Bayarea aus einem ganz anderen Blickwinkel. Der Captain unterhielt uns informativ und humorvoll. Der Start und die Landung auf dem Wasser sind schon ein Erlebnis für sich.

We (me and my mom) booked this tour while we were in port on a cruise in May. We had an afternoon flight so we wandered around the town for a bit before going to check in and get on the bus to get dropped off at the company. After checking in at the desk. We used a coupon from the Tour Saver book for a 2 for 1 price. This alone made the book worth purchasing but be sure to book early because I think they only accept a certain number of these coupons per day. After checking in we were offered water and coffee and use of lockers to store any larger bag (no backpacks allowed on the plane but i was able to bring a small cross-body bag and I saw some smaller camera bags). After storing our bags we watched a short safety video and assigned our pilots. We were with Tracey, she was full of facts and history about Misty Fjords. We landed on punch-bowl lake for a change to get out and stand on the floats of the plane. Landing and taking off from the water was so cool! Tracey was a wonderful pilot and this tour was amazing!

review_title: Trip to Hakai Lodge was incredible!
review_text: My dad and I booked a 4 day trip to their lodge up in the Queen Charlotte sound area, I cannot tell you how incredible everything was.  The staff, the seaplane trip the fishing was all world class.  We limited coho all in the 12 pound average and kings and even took home cod and black sea bass.  Super friendly people, everything was taken care of and you guide your own boat, really nice 17 foot whalers all stocked and ready every morning.  3 meals a day from a great chef and all our fish was packed and frozen for the ride home.  You owe it to yourself to book such a special adventure!

I just got back from Alaska today and I wanted to write a review for K 2 aviation.  We had a great time flying up to Mt McKinley as our pilot informed us of several interesting things about the mountain and the glaciers running through it. The views are breathtaking and it is well worth the money for a once in a lifetime experience.  We had booked a flight landing, but due to weather we were unable to land but the pilot made sure that we still got great views and got all of the time that we were expecting.

review_title: Excellent service and great air tour!
review_text:
Crazy lines during spring break at the Grand Canyon and the Westwind team pivoted to make sure we had a great time and didn’t wait in line to get in. Pilot was great and ground team was amazing! Highly recommend! 

Air tour from Phoenix was amazing, family of all ages really enjoyed!

review_title: Most exciting thing we did in Alaska
review_text: They set us up for the best ride. Got to take float plane on a 1hour tour that ended up being 2 hours with a land on a lake up in the glaciers to pick up and drop of tour guides that had been there for a week in a tent. We saw bears and moose in there element and beautiful Glaciers. The scenery was amazing. What a treat we'll never forget

My wife and I did the 3-hour flight to the Keys for lunch, and the trip was fantastic. I considered (and have done) jet skis, boat tours, etc. - but the seaplane tour perspective, which is to say view and informative point of view of our pilot, lacks parallel. In large part this was owing to Adriel Anderson, our pilot. He is a gentleman, innate tour guide, and teacher. We felt safe and, indeed, instructed as to the reasons for why the plane was being flown in the manner he did, how to take off and land, and ways that seaplane flying is unique from anything else, perhaps even commercial flying. Sprinkle in a natural, homegrown love for the area, its history, and its ecology, well, you have an exceptional trip. I read many reviews on trip advisor, and leave far fewer, but this is one occasion that deserves a commendation. And Adriel was so gracious that he ought to be recognized personally, and if you are lucky, selected as pilot for your trip as well.

Merci à toute l'équipe pour ce moment inoubliable.
Ce fut un survol complet de la région avec en prime les explications en francais.
Géant

review_title: The highlight of our Alaskan Adventure!
review_text: This was a spectacular tour.  Mike is an incredible pilot and very knowledgeable about the area.  He knows where to spot wild life, like the mama bear with her three cubs that we saw during our flight!  We were blessed with a warm sunny day and MIke took advantage of the weather by soaring us above the mountain tops for some spectacular views and then landing as smooth as silk on the lake for a chance to get out of the plane and snap some beautiful pictures of the majestic mountains and scenery around us.  This trip with SeaWind Aviation was a highlight of our Alaskan Cruise and I recommend it to those looking to see the beauty of Alaska and Misty Fjords.

I have had the pleasure to fly with Bruce as a co-pilot in the company C172. It was the best activity I have done in Kauai. 
Wings Over Kauai has very friendly staff. The pilots are very professional and all aircraft are really well maintained. 

Great job! 100% recommended.

review_title: Bruce and his team are really great
review_text: We chose our flight with wings over kauai in the cessna because it promised to be a private experience for us as a couple - with great views for both of us (which with other offers was not guaranteed - neither in planes nor in helis). It indeed turned our to be the highlight of our visit, providing us with views that especially on Kauai are only accessible by air. Bruce's expertise and experience as a pilot allowed us to enjoy even the windy weather during the flight. He showed and explained to us all the places of interest and gave us worthwhile recommendations for our further journey and stay on Kauai. We certainly got great value for the price we paid. Our picture, taken in front of the plane was included and the video of the flight was 40$ (no pressure). We recommend Bruce and Wings over Kauai 100 %.

This trip was very good & well managed. We were picked up and taken back to our original location. The flight was spectacular and the pilot during the flight gave us lots of useful information. This was a very special experience thank you

review_title: Spectacular mountains and glaciers everywhere you look
review_text: Had an unbelievably spectacular flightseeing trip around Denali, Moose's Tooth, and the Ruth Amphitheater!  Pilot Andy was super knowledgeable about the mountains and glaciers, and kept us entertained with nifty chatter about everything there was to see.  Andy's glacier landing was an extra special treat.  If you want to see Denali National Park and the Alaska Range, Talkeetna Air Taxi has the trip for you!

We thoroughly enjoyed this tour. Viewing the Maui northern coast and rainforest from above is out of this world. Very happy with Mavericks Helicopters. Their operation is very professional and we felt totally safe flying with them.

We booked a flight to Molokai with mauiplanerides.com to see the the highest ocean cliffs in the world. What an amazing experience. Eric is a great guide and pilot. And my son had the opportunity to take off and fly the plane which made it extra special. I would highly recommend this excursion. It’s a wonderful way to see the beauty of Maui from a different perspective.

We were able to enjoy the unparalleled views of the Alaskan range provided by the Otter and the excellent running commentary of our pilot.  Our glacier landing spot turned out to by at Denali Base Camp and we had a slightly cloud obscured view of Mt Denali, but otherwise perfect day and memorable experience.

review_title: Kinect glacier alternative - worth the ride!
review_text: The weather wasn’t conducive to view Denali so we were offered a tour to Kinect Glacier or a refund. We took the glacier tour and so glad we did!  Was well worth the money and our pilot, Ian, was great!

review_title: Great way to go to the San Juan islands!
review_text:
The views are spectacular,  The planes are safe and the pilots and all personnel were very friendly.  They even took my little luggage from plane to "airport".  The airport is spotless and a lovely spot to wait for the flight.  Did I mention free parking in gated area? 
It was perfect.

This is a truly once in a lifetime experience. I've always wanted to fly and I got a Maui Plane Ride as a birthday present. 
We took a tour of West Maui and Molokai and saw things that just couldn't be seen from the ground. I hike all over the Maui , but see it from the sky was totally amazing. The pilot actually let me ride the plane for a while and that was the best b-day present. Thank you Maui Plane Rides for making my special day unforgettable.

review_title: What a Kick in the Pants!
review_text:
The hour long flight is a blast. I thought we'd just tool around the Bay, but we headed up the Marin headlands past Mt. Tam to Tomales Bay & Pt. Reyes. The trip back south took in Pt. Bonita and the old batteries. You get a good view of both lighthouses without the long trek down the bluff. On a clear day (which we had) you can see out to the Farallons, and you'll get to do some whale and pinniped watching if you're lucky.
Aaron, the pilot, points out the sights and gives a bit of history and context along the way. I can vouch for his familiarity with the area and its history. You're likely to learn a bit, even if you grew up in Northern California and made it through fourth grade CA history.

Our family was on the Holland America cruise ship.  We BOOKED For All 6 of us!  Larry was our pilot.  He was awesome! Very knowledgeable and a PRO.  We had a great time and he landed like a PRO.  We would highly recommend this trip and Larry gets 5 Stars!   Thanks for a great float plane experience.  I was nervous at first but felt very comfortable and at ease as we flew around and took lots of pictures.

Fantastic!
The Grand Canyon is mind blowing sight but the helicopter ride take it to another level.
The team at Tusayan were brilliant and the pilot was friendly and knowledgeable while giving very interesting commentary during the flight. 
For anyone nervous of doing a flight, these guys make you feel very safe and flights are much smoother than many people expect.
Highly recommend these guys if you are thinking of taking a ride.

Although the view was awesome the flight was rough and half way through all passengers were feeling ill.The contract stated high wings & large windows for optimum viewing. Additionally it stated "window seat request $10 per seat". I requested this after reservations and was told decison would be day of. Day of I paid the extra money for 4 window seats. As it turns out the family of 5 on the plane with us paid nothing extra and they all has window seats because ALL seats were window seats! To make matters worse I had a seat that had the wing support right in front of my window. Also we were on a smaller plane with NO large windows. When I complained about the extra money it fell on deaf ears. No big deal about $40 but it's the point of it.
Thr flight eas awesome and amazing and I gotta say thus was a once in a lifetime experience and I'd recommend for sure.

We recently went flight seeing and landed on a glacier with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  We got a beautiful day with blue skies and just a few clouds.  Seeing Denali and landing on a glacier was one of the best things I have ever done.  The staff at Talkeetna are so friendly, good at what they do, and reassuring!  Highly recommend this experience and Talkeetna Air Taxi!

Flying around and landing on Denali was incredible.  My daughter enjoyed frolicking in the snow on the mountain.  The colors in early September are gorgeous.  Takeetna Air Taxi was fast and efficient getting us ready for the flight.  The pilot was very well seasoned and used to the terrain.  Would go again!

review_title: Air Ventures Hawaii - Kauai - Loved It!
review_text: Our flight on a sunny Sunday morning was awesome.  It was a great way to see the beauty of the entire island, from a different perspective than we could see by land or sea.   The pilot was great, sharing lots of interesting information as our guide, and giving us a very smooth ride.  The staff was great, reservations were easy to make, and they provided simple directions so we could readily find their site at the airport and we were well prepared for what to bring and what to expect.   We took advantage of the package pricing, doing the Air & Sea combo, and loved our dinner cruise around the Napali coast as well.

review_title: Worth every penny! This was an extraordinary experience!
review_text: We flew up to Denali, and landed on a glacier. Luckily, we had a beautiful sunny day, and Denali was out of her clouds to see. The only real way to see Alaska is to fly over her. I now know why people pull up stakes at home, and head to Alaska to live. It just feels like freedom. Every safety precaution was taken to make this a safe flight, and we checked with locals to see which service to use. Everyone told us that Talkeetna Air was the best.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Steve our pilot was filled with knowledge of the area. We had an amazing ride through the fjords. We landed in one of the lakes and explored the area. We cruised the harbor on the way back to the dock. Excellent tour!!

We had an amazing time! The best excursion we’ve ever done. We were in awe the entire time of the natural beauty of Alaska and Ketchikan. Getting so close to the mountains and seeing goats grazing plus the lake landing was beyond words!

We booked the air and sea combo tour with Blue Dolphin Charters and Wings over Kauai -- both were a great value. Unfortunately, the morning we were supposed to take our flight it was cancelled due to conditions. However, Bruce and his team were very accommodating about the short amount of time we had on the island and were able to reschedule for us. We ended up rebooking for the day we also had our boat tour -- not the best idea since you're driving from one part of the island to the other, but still doable.  We caught Bruce's last flight of the day at 4PM and were lucky to have the whole flight to ourselves. Bruce is very knowledgeable about the island and we were able to see incredible views. Part of the perks of doing the plane over the helicopter would definitely be the pricing  -- it's almost half as much. Though a helicopter is better able to get you down into those tighter areas, such as Waimea Canyon, we still had plenty of great views and picture ops. They were also quite alright with me using my gopro to record a chunk of the flight. Bruce provided complimentary drinks while we were up in the air and a nice, added bonus -- they took our picture in front of the plane and printed the pic out on the jacket of a DVD highlighting the views we saw during the flight (at no extra cost). It's a nice little touch to have a pic of us before our flight and a little highlight video. Thanks, Bruce and your team. Would definitely recommend!

We booked a helicopter trip with Maverick the day before we went as we were staying in the Grand Canyon and had a great experience. The service was excellent and our pilot was great. He gave us a brilliant description of everything we were seeing and seemed really happy to be sharing such an amazing experience with us. We had never been in a helicopter before but felt really comfortable with this company.

My wife and I were going to do a helicopter tour but after reading reviews went with Wings. No regrets. Bruce was great. He's incredibly nice and personable. His recommendations made the rest of our trip. My wife was also able to take some pretty amazing pictures. Go Wings!

We had an amazing time on the Colombian river with John! The view was absolutely breathtaking, and we thoroughly enjoyed every moment. John was not only a skilled captain but also a genuinely kind and friendly host. It was an unforgettable experience!

We chose the biplane for a bit of adventure and it was definitely that! Loved feeling the wind and the brief rain shower! Great views and we even saw a whale do a few breaches!!! Well worth it! He can only take 2 passengers at a time so not so good for families unless prepared to wait. Felt totally safe and snug.

review_title: Amazing Tour - I have no idea why this is not listed in the 'Blue Book'
review_text: The 'Blue Book' can't tell you everything, now can it? Don't be afraid to try something that isn't listed - TAKE this tour.  The tour price is reasonable, about half the price of helicopter tours, the flight was incredible, the service was far above our expectations.  The weather was perfect, all of the remote areas of the island were visable, spectacular canyon and waterfall views.  Our condo on the North Shore was easy to pick out, even the condo's little private beach was easily visable.  The views of the cliffs and shoreline just take your breath away.  Bruce and his staff know how to make an air tour of the island into a highlight of your trip.  Not to be missed!

This was well worth the money spent. Our pilot Patrick was so informative. The sites were Ah-mazing!!!  We only did the hour flight. Most people were doing the glacier walk. But the flight was perfect for me. A little advice. Take videos instead of pictures. The videos my husband took actually seemed to show the mountains better than my photos.

The views were spectacular! We saw delicate arch, needles, and zoomed over Canyonlands. The views were breathtaking! Our ride was a bit bumpy which caused me to get a little dizzy, but it the weather made the views just so much more spectacular! Some of the mountains looked like they were smoking!
Great pilot.  Sorry, his name evades me.  Very entertaining.  My son was our very important co-pilot.  Great views.  Flight was 40 minutes.  Great option compared to a pricier helicopter tour.

Nice pilote and team. Beautiful views of the glaciers, the best way to see them! Despite the clouds and the reduction of time and a suitable tour (adapted price) we had a flight without too many turbulances.

Had an awesome flight and tour with our pilot, Steve.  He did a great job pointing out different  areas on the tour.  Steve also used to be a flight instructor and did a great job explaining about the plane.  He made sure we were doing ok throughout the flight, since it was pretty bumpy due to the wind.  Thanks for an awesome experience and a chance to take some amazing pictures!

I've used them alone as my transportation for week long expeditions, tackling Denali summit, and sightseeing with friends and family.  Smooth operation that runs on time.  For expeditions, they run a detailed and accommodating schedule.  During one expedition on the Ruth Glacier, they picked us up a day earlier than planned so that we could beat the incoming inclement weather.  Bathroom on sight.

review_title: Just go for it! You’ll be glad you did
review_text: It was a great time and unique opportunity. I have tried many other land based services, and this is the first air base service I’ve tried. It’s worth every penny!

So wonderful so great so fantastic.
Just a brilliant way to see the island.  Paul was a great guy the pilot. Reception staff were all friendly and supportive of nerves etc. It is a MUST do wheb on this island. 
Thank you for thr experience

review_title: Small plane sightseeing flight was excellent
review_text: Plan ahead to assure you can book a flight! We cruised easily over the island with breathtaking views and waterfalls by the handful in multiple locations! Our pilot was friendly and answered questions as well as pointing out the historical sites and well known areas. He also took care to find places we would not be able to see on the ground. Overall, we enjoyed our trip and the team!
Beautiful! Should be on everyone that visits Alaska’s bucket list. Pilot was very skilled super smooth flight and landing.

We had the 11 o'clock flight. The pilots were really friendly. We all had a windowseat. The views were amazing. The left side of the plane did get better views though.It was a fantastic experience to see the canyon from up above. Ik would reccommend this adventure.

Absolutely amazing!!!! The view from the air cannot be described!  Our tour was pleasant from the moment we walked into the airstrip till we landed on the ground!  Pilot Larry was phenomenal- so very knowledgable - retired from the Forest Service!  Strongly recommend it!

Extremely nice experience. Michelle was fun and very professional to work with for making the reservations as well as our boarding experience. We  flew from Seattle to Friday Harbor to join an REI Adventure. 7 days later we flew back from Friday Harbor to Seattle.  The pilots were very experienced and pointed out things along the way. My lady friend even got to sit in the co-pilot's seat on the flight out in the DeHaviland Otter.   We flew in a Beaver on the return flight.  I would definitely use Friday Harbor Seaplanes any time I travel to the San Juans.

So much fun! Went with a few friends and had a blast. Cory was so nice and helpful in getting this booked for us, and our pilot was really laid back and fun to fly with. Flying over Portland was really pretty too lol

My 14 year old son and I just took the Grand Denali Tour with Talkeena Air Taxi, it was perhaps the most profoundly beautiful experience of our lives. Brought tears to our eyes. Can’t wait to come back.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: What a way to view Kauai.  Everybody was helpful and encouraging.  Nervous at first sitting in the open cockpit before takeoff, but were reassured by our pilot Nick that we were in good hands and would get over our nervousness once we were off the ground.  So true!!!!  Flying over the entire island up and down the valley's with spectacular views of water falls and the Na Pali coast.  Always in contact with our pilot as he pointed out the many spectacular sites.  If you want to see it all without having to share a plane window with a stranger this is the way to go!!!!  Well worth the money!

Great tour. The whole journey was impressing, with enough time to visit all different locations and great scenery views by air and ground, this trip is defintely recommended and worth the price. Be sure to book the Grand Voyager tour for the best experience, this includes airplane, helicopter and boat.

review_title: Best Birthday EVER!! Thank you to Gina and our pilot Jacob!
review_text: Thank you for an amazing tour! This was my first time in a Cessna as well as my mom’s. The sights were unforgettable.
