Jacob had prepared a great ensemble of theme songs that went well with the tour. I couldn’t get Hawaiian rollercoaster ride out of my head (first thing he played as we flew up). He was very knowledgeable and showed us his fave spots on the island and how to get there. I truly appreciated this day, it went down as the best birthday EVER.

The Majesty and beauty of  Denali is Spectacular. Words cannot do this scenery justice.The pilots are very experienced and handle the planes, and weather around the mountains with ease. We also did a glacier landing which was fabulous.The experience is something you'll never forget.
Amazing experience and wonderful pilot. I would absolutely recommend for anyone  even if you are a Miami native

We wanted to see Kauai from the air but my mom was nervous about taking a helicopter as she can get motion sickness, so we decided to take a flight with Wings Over Kauai.

This was the best decision we made on our trip - the view was absolutely incredible (the Na Pali coast from the air had us speechless), our captain was so informed about everything we were seeing and answered all of our questions, and we felt so safe the entire time.  The flight was very smooth, and my mom really enjoyed it despite her nerves and was so glad we had booked it.

From a logistics perspective, we were picked up from our cruise ship dock exactly when they said we would be, and the trip to the airport was short and easy.  We then had a safety presentation and went up in the air! Very efficient operation. If you are on the fence, book it!! You won't regret it.

I took my family on this flight and we really enjoyed the different aspect of the island. Easy check-in, pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable and the views were spectacular! Kids were given headsets to communicate with everyone during the flight (which can be a good and bad thing!) and also to listen to the pilot. Only not-so-positive was the cheesy movie music they played, a little weary hearing about Jurassic Park and having to listen to the theme music while on the flight.

We had perfect weather and a smooth flight. The pilot took special care to make sure both sides got see all sights. He circled a pod of whales...which was spectacular! The flight allowed us to see the inaccessible parts of the island. Highly recommend this charter.

review_title: Excellent service from SeaTac to Friday harbor
review_text: We booked with Friday Harbor seaplanes to get us from Seattle to Friday Harbor.  The service was excellent.  They provided excellent briefing materials on how the shuttle service worked and contacted us upon our arrival to ensure we had good directions to the pick up location and refined the pick up time.  On the return trip, they had us to the airport in plently of time for our flight home.

Our tour guide Jeffrey, was absolutely amazing! Jeffrey was very funny and knowledgeable! Jeffrey was very patient, kind and helpful, especially with our parents (both in their 70's). Jeffrey also made sure that everyone in our tour group had plenty of time at every stop and that we saw everything plus extra stuff on our tour.
Also, Jeffrey had his driving companion (Luna) she is an 11 year old Chihuahua and she is so sweet, friendly, and got oddles of attention and even got pictures!
Jeffrey, was top notch the best tour guide and id highly recommend Jeffrey every single time!
tour_name: 15-Hawaii Volcanoes National Park Experience Departing from Oahu32_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: We drove in from Sedona and this was our first stop into the Grand Canyon. We had never seen the GC before so you can imagine how exciting it was for our 9 & 11 year olds to lay eyes for the first time on the GC via a helicopter ride.... It was incredible and after the initial fear leaves you it is a breath taking experience! Maverick was beyond professional and I felt the pilot was safe and alert at all times while providing great details and information about the GC. Well done Maverick for running such a great company!
Great experience from start to finish, amazing views especially when you first go over the canyon and it drops away. The length of the flight was ideal as it didn’t feels rushed
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: This was an amazing tour! Although we had signed up for the Denali Flyer trip the weather decided to move in and they switched us to the Denali Experience tour, with a refund of the cost difference. Once we got into the Alaska Range, the clouds had cleared up a bit since their previous flights so we had some unbelievable views of the range and the glaciers below. Our pilot, Daniel, gave us great narrative info throughout the flight and kept us safe and comfortable even with the clouds and changing weather. If you're considering a flight tour- it's definitely worth splurging on and K2 gives an awesome experience!

A must do flight-seeing tour. The pilot was outstanding getting multiple views of Denali through the clouds turning often so each side of the plane could see. Well worth the price to see the mountain which we couldn't see any other day due to cloud coverage. Landing on the glacier is spectacular. This was an outstanding tour.

We chose the tour which included champagne lunch, first time for us all in helicopter but pilot made us feel very safe he was brilliant. He answered all the questions with confidence and knew what he was talking about. The flight was absolutely breath taking and the view was superb, Shame we never got to do the skywalk!

Our experience was awesome! 

They waterproof shoes that slipped over our own boots for the glacier landing. Our experience was during Covid-19 and the whole staff took extra precautions to ensure our safety and the cleanliness of their airport and planes along with other equipment we came into contact with. 

There was some questionable weather in the amphitheater (where they land the plane on the glacier) but our pilot said we would fly in and see how it was when we got there. Luckily, it cleared up and we were able to land. The landing was flawless - which I imagine is not an easy feat on snow and skis. Our pilot took photos of us, taught us so much about glaciers and the surrounding mountains, and was pretty funny as well. He turned the plane a lot to make sure everyone on both sides could see the same things. I have never seen anything more beautiful in my life and I am so happy we sprung for the glacier landing. He also gave us some local tips for places to eat and things to see. I even got to sit copilot on the way back - which was super cool. 

On the way back, the landing into Talkeetna airport was just as perfect as the one on the glacier. I was shocked at how smooth both landings were. I would do this again in a heartbeat - it was worth every penny.

This was the highlight of our Alaska trip. We flew a DeHavilland Otter which has room for 9 and everyone gets a window seat. This flight takes us really close to McKinley and gives us fantastic views of the mountain including all the glaciers that start from it. When we went the weather was fantastic and we got to land on the glacier as well. I highly recommend the glacier landing as part of the package. It is totally worth it. The pilot (Craig) was fairly chatty throughout the flight and described most of the scenery for us including a few tidbits on the history of the park. Overall it was a great experience and I highly recommend it for anyone travelling to Alaska.
The 5 island plane ride was spectacular. Eric is very easygoing and knowledgeable about Maui. Views were absolutely stunning! So much fun- definitely worth it.
Takeoff! Being at the controls was awesome! Sea cliffs were also a highlight. Stevewas great to work with!

I'm a local, and I won this flight off of the radio.
Making reservations was a breeze, they had plenty of seats available. Their webcam made it easy for me to monitor the weather before driving up from Wasilla. When I called that morning, they were able to give me a weather report so we didn't have to drive up if the weather was bad.
Check in was a breeze. I was a little nervous that my weight would be an issue. I'm pretty fat. But it wasn't.
Our pilot gave us a briefing and we loaded up in the Otter. Take off was smooth and we headed towards the mountain. The flight was perfect. There's was some clouds around the mountain, but our pilot worked around them.
The pilot narrated as we went.  I was able to get a lot of great pictures.
I'd do this trip again in a heartbeat, and I would recommend it to others.

This had to be the best way to see the island.  Air Ventures is economically reasonable, we were picked up on time at a pre determined location and had a short tour to the airport.  The Pilot was the best and the day was perfect.  Will never forget it and Highly recommend it to anyone.  .

Phil and I took the Best of Kauai tour, and the Air Ventures flight over the Na Pali coast was the best part of the tour.  Our pilot was very knowledgeable and we felt very safe on the flight.  He pointed out celebrity homes, the many waterfalls, crops and the rain forests and majestic mountains.  We also flew over the Waimea Canyon and Mt. Wai'ale'ale Crater.  The pilot was great about answering any questions our group of six had. It was a beautiful, exciting and unforgettable adventure.  We are so glad we took the tour with the flight.  It was truly the best part of the tour and one of the most exciting things we have ever done. Thanks for a great experience, Sharon and Phil from La Quinta, CA.
The views were breathtaking, flight gave a true perspective of the Alaska landscape, and touch down on the water was pure fun!

The air tour was a great. It was very informative.
I will say though that our narrator pilot needs to add a little live to his narration. It was as if he was tired of giving the same info over and over. A little flat.
Also want to say that if you do a combo tour, land and air and intend to tip on the combined price, the ground tour does not share with the air tour.

review_title: Miami Seaplane Roundtrip to Bimini, Bahamas
review_text:
OUTSTANDING SERVICE! 

Nicole was very patient and worked with us on every question and concerns we had regarding our round trip seaplane ride to Bimini, Bahamas. We left from Miami Seaplane Base in Key Biscayne and landed at Resort World Bimini within 40 minutes. The flight was very pleasant and Tony made sure we were all comfortable. Tony is a not only a great pilot but also very caring. I had my 70 year old mother with me and he was very nice in assisting her in and out of the plane. 

Thanks Tony and Nicole. We will be back!

I had a great time! I have a major fear of heights, but our pilot "Harry," was extremely professional during our flight. We did have rain and wind, but again due to our great navigator our flight was amazing! Thanks again to all the staff! 

Wendy and Bao

Friendly and accommodating staff and all star pilot made for a Denali flight I’ll never forget. Talkeetna Air Taxi have an impeccable safety record and it shows. The pricing as absolutely fair for this kind of once in a lifetime experience. Highly recommend!

Riley did an incredible job taking us on a flight-seeing tour and landing on Ruth Glacier. His demeanor was professional and I loved his dry sense of humor! I felt comfortable in his abilities as a pilot and the day couldn't have been more perfect! Thank you K2!

Was schedule to take the tour to Denali, unfortunately Mother Nature wanted me to see Knik Glacier instead!!  And that was OK with me!  The flight was smooth & the pilot was very confident in the ride.  The views were amazing, but try not to sit over the wing or all your pics will have the propeller in them..haha....but it's good!  This was definitely a high light of my trip!!
Was amazing! Saw all sorts of stuff from Waimea to Na Pali coast, flying low and slow, getting a full view of the beauty

Ray and Jill and the entire staff were wonderful. When the weather didn't look like it would cooperate with our original flight time they did all they could to rebook us on a later flight. When there weren't any spaces available, they added in a private flight for us to ensure we got to see the island in this incredible way. The plane was nearly new and the tour was absolutely wonderful. My husband and I will always remember this experience and are very thankful to have this memory as part of our "babymoon." We definitely recommend Air Ventures!
Unbelievable experience! I recommend to see Kauai from the sky and even more to do it with Rai. Amazing staff, very helpful and kind. I'd repeat if I come again!

We had a wonderful experience flying with Chuck when we were in Ketchikan. He calmed our nerves and we could tell he was very experienced. His plane was absolutely perfect. He gave us a lot of information about the area and was great with the kids. My son sat in the cockpit and got great footage on his go pro. His girlfriend was scared and Chuck was very attentive to her needs. She got passed it and had a great flight!! We highly recommend Chuck to fly anyone!!

review_title: Air Tour of Monument Valley, Canyonlands, etc.
review_text: My wife and I decided to take the 2 hour scenic air tour through Redtail Aviation.  This was and will be an experience of a life-time.  we had an experienced and knowledgeable pilot, Kim, who flew us over the National Parks and provided us with history and commentary that was excellent.  Before the flight, Kim made us feel comfortable with what we will see and do, provided us with earphones and made sure we were belted in and comfortable.  And away we went.  the scenery from the air is outstanding and memorable.  We will always remember and treasure this experience.  Obviously, highly recommended.

This was the best part of our trip.  The views from the air were Amazing.  We had considered the helicopter but opted for the AirVentures instead due to seating and price.  We were so glad we did.  This is one thing you can not miss while on Kauai.   Our Pilot was so fun and knowledgeable and pointed out many things we would have missed on our own.   Besides the many things you will only see  by air.   I love re-living it by watching our DVD they gave us at the end.   I would highly recommend this adveture to all.

Our family took a day/overnight trip from Vegas to South Rim of the GC and stayed in Valle.  We had booked the plane well in advance of our anticipated travel.  All I can say, is if you have been to the GC, but never viewed from air, this is a must do adventure!  A bird's eye view from above are just very inspiring.  Words/pictures can not explain how powerful.  The operators/pilots, etc. with Scenic Tours were awesome!  We all enjoyed the flight and learned a lot about the canyon as well.

We had taken the helicopter tour of the big island and decided to try an alternate (and less expensive) way of seeing Kauai.  It's different -- you have to keep moving, so there's no chance to hover in front of a waterfall -- but still gives you the opportunity to see places from a unique viewpoint.  The day we went there was weather in some spots, so our route was probably somewhat different from what they would take under ideal conditions.  The ride can get a little bumpy in spots, and when you're flying up Waimea Canyon and the walls are higher than you are keep in mind that the pilot doesn't have a death wish and will either climb to take you over the top or go back if the conditions don't allow that.  Our pilot was not terribly chatty, perhaps in part because of the flying conditions, but we still heard a good deal about the island, its history and its residents.  They sell a DVD of the tour taken under ideal conditions so you can see what you missed.  Keep in mind that this is a small plane -- there are bathroom facilities in the terminal, but none while you are in the air.

review_title: The best way to see Canyonlands!
review_text: Canyonlands is best seen by air to get the full effect. Our flight was wonderful and our pilot, Nick, a great guide!
It’s wonderful adventure! Would recommend to anyone? Awesome. Wonderful & experienced pilot, Eric. Love it!

review_title: Private Cessna is the only way to fly!
review_text:
We decided to splurge during our visit to Kauai and booked a private flight on Wings Over Kauai's Cessna 172.  It was a bit more expensive than the group flight on the Caravan, but so worth it.  Imagine having your own private chauffeured hour to fly around the island!
 
We were warmly welcomed to the flightline by Val.  She took our information and gave us a quick rundown of what to expect during our flight.  She also discreetly weighed us 
to ensure the weight and balance is set up properly for the flight.

We met Captain Bruce and after introductions were made all around, we all walked out to the plane.  So much nicer than boarding a commercial flight.  Yeah, the plane was smaller but no one was fighting you for overhead bin space! As an #AvGeek (read "plane nerd!") I called shotgun and my wife was nice enough to indulge me.  Bruce also teaches flying, so he took the time to explain flight dynamics and how the airplane respond to different inputs.  We both worked the pre-flight takeoff list and after waiting for a Hawaiian Airlines 717 to land and vacate the runway, we were off.

It was a beautiful day for flying.  Puffy white clouds dotted the sky and visibility was forever.  Mt. Waiʻaleʻale was almost totally visible, which is vary rare!  Bruce kept up a running commentary was we overflew Poipu Beach, the Waimea Canyon, the Napali Coast, then across Hanalei Bay and back down towards Lihue.  When we were halfway through our flight, my wife commenced the drink service with bottles and cans from the cooler under the back seat!

We were thrilled with our choice of Wings Over Kauai.  We highly recommend the private Cessna flight for a group of 2 or 3 people.  Even if you take the group flight on the Caravan, seeing the island from the air is a fantastic trip and should be considered a "Must Do!" during your visit to the Kauai.
An absolute blast. Once in a life time views. Great pilot. Very comfortable and safe. I must do trip when in Maui.

I honestly don’t know where to start except if you’re considering booking or looking between other flights, look no further -Book K2! They were wonderful to work with, easy to set up and this was a once in a lifetime experience.

 I surprised my parents with this Grand Tour with Glacier Landing trip for their retirement and they said it was the best part of our trip. Chris was our pilot and wow! He’s a local Alaskan who’s been flying since he was 15. He knew all kinds of history, geography, made the flight fun and made sure everyone got the spectacular views! 

Our landing on the glacier was breathtaking! The trip was smooth and amazing! Please don’t miss out on this amazing crew and trip! You won’t regret it!
Wonderful flight excellent pilot with a love and passion for what he does.  Very safe and absolutely beautiful. Very knowledgeable of the area.  Great Tour.
Awesome flight,liked it better than a helicopter.Pilot was very knowledgeable great sights, highly recommend.

Each seat had excellent views of the Grand Canyon. Taking the whole scene in by air is maybe the best way to understand the size and majesty of the canyon. The crew was professional, aircraft was top notch (nothing rickety here) and the cost was reasonable compared to other air tours we have done in different parts of the country. Highly recommend this flight experience!
tour_name: 7 -110_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour_2025-02-27

review_text:
Spend the money and do it!  We chose the 90 minute flight with glacier landing.  We were in Alaska for 13 days doing a land tour and then a cruise.  The glacier landing was the best and we had lots of great experiences throughout the trip.  Our pilot Jeff was great.  He flies for the company year round and has lots of experience and gave our group a fabulous tour.  He did not control the weather but it was way above average.....beautiful day, sun was out, and we got pictures of the peak of Mt. McKinley. 

We used Alaska Tour and Travel  800-208-0200 Mike Montgomery for our land tour.  He was very helpful and we found him through this web site.

Our group of 4 could not decide between a helicopter tour or airplane tour and based on the fact that one of us refused to go on a helicopter we opted for Air Ventures with pilot Harry!!  We are so glad we did.  We had a wonderful time and saw parts of the island we would not have seen had it not been for Harry!  The girls at the reception desk were very personable and did not say your weight out loud!!  We were a bit leary as the weather had been quite rainy but once in the air the sun shone and birghtened our trip even more.  We saw hundreds of waterfalls.  Thank you Harry and staff, great value for our dollars.  We will do it again.

My husband and I did this June 21, 2021. Chris was our pilot. He did an awesome job pointing out landmarks and telling us about the area. It was cloudy in Talkeetna but bright and sunny on the mountain. We did a glacier landing...its hard to put into words really, but if you are on the fence about spending the money, just do it! Totally worth every penny!

Our pilot, Mike, and the fantastic folks at Taquan Air helped Scott and I plan our perfect wedding at the Misty Fjords!   The flight out was thrilling, especially from the copilot's seat, and Mike's narration was interesting and informative.  We landed out in Rudyerd Bay and taxied to a large floating dock.  In this beautiful setting, our pilot became our officiant and we exchanged vows (Mike helped with those too!)  We spent a little time celebrating and taking in the stunning views before heading back.  The return flight was equally amazing, ending much too soon with a perfectly smooth landing.  

I can't thank Taquan Air enough for all they did to make our event so perfect.  Special thanks to Forrest who did photos, Faith & Deandra, our witnesses, and Mike, our pilot/officiant/planner extraordinaire!

review_title: Kids first time in San Francisco
review_text: We did the hop on/hop off by land, then SF  by air on day 2.  The kids as well as my wife and I loved it.  A bit pricey but worth every penny.

review_title: THE 3rd WAY -- see KAUAI from the AIR!
review_text: We had been able to see the gardens and the reefs...and now were able to get that unique perspective from the air.  Since Kauai is near impossible to traverse via hiking inland -- this is the way to go!  It is amazing to see the wettest place on earth in all its green glory!  It would be a shame to come to Kauai and not see this...the variations of the blues of the ocean and the greens of the volcanic mountains are unsurpassed from this vantage point.

We flew in a float plane over the mountains around Ketchikan and landed in a fjord. We got to get out of the plane and stand on the pontoon while in the water.  IT WAS SO COOL!!  The mountains and water is so beautiful. Our pilot, Jake, was professional and knowledgeable.  This is a once in a lifetime excursion and definite MUST DO!

WOW, WOW, WOW, WOW... the phrase I kept repeating as one beautiful view after another unfolded!  Our Wings Over Kauai Air tour was just amazing!  Dori and John were soo friendly and helpful.  We have visited the island three times and this is by far the best tour we have experienced!  I can't wait to do it again on our next visit!

With Clay as our pilot our family of 5 had an amazing tour of the Alaska Range!  Even got to see Denali! Felt very safe during flight. Clay was very knowledgeable!  Couldn’t land on glacier (which we hadn’t been told until checking in), but that turned out to be all right.
Sweet fun and the way to see maui. Eric was a wonderful pilot and guide.  The only way to fly across the islands of maui.

review_title: Wonderful start to vacation on Kauai!
review_text:
We booked our flight with Wings Over Kauai for our first morning on the island.  I'm glad we arrived early enough to be able to chat with Ellen a bit.  She is a wealth of information about the variety of ecosystems on Kauai, all of which we were about to see from the air!  Our pilot, Josh, was a great tour guide, giving us all kinds of information about the history, geography and culture of Kauai.  I struggle with motion sickness (in spite of aids to keep it under control).  Josh's steady and calm demeanor definitely helped, and I was amazed with the photos I managed to get as Josh pointed out features.  This introduction to Kauai was a great start to our exploration of the island!  We are very happy that we choose Wings Over Kauai!  Thanks Ellen and Josh!!
Connie and Jan, BC, Canada

Staff very courteous and professional. Had a very trustworthy experienced pilot. Weather was perfect so the sights were amazing. Landing and taking off from a high mountain lake just added even more to the experience. Would absolutely recommend based on weather.
Great way to see the expanse of the Grand Canyon. Maverick was very professional, safe, courteous. Highly recommend!

review_title: Most spectacular scenery, and fantastic people!!!
review_text: We looked forward to this experience for a long time , so when the day arrived and the Alaska Range was closed to flights we were heartbroken. However the great people at Talkeetna air taxi allowed us to reschedule not only once but twice till finally it cleared enough to fly in. We were able to see the the most beautiful scenery in the world and having the experience of landing on a glacier in the midst of those otherwise inaccessible peaks was a highlight of our trip to Alaska.

This is the way to see Denali. 
We had the most wonderful day of sunshine. We had booked a flight first thing in the morning with a glacier landing but was unable to land because the glacier was too icy. Suggest perhaps the 2nd flight if the day but you risk the clouds coming in and blocking the view of Denali. 
This company is definitely safety first. I'm actually afraid of flying especially in smaller aircraft but felt very safe.  Smooth landing and take off. Our pilot, Mike shared so much information.
This trip was by far the best part of our Alaska trip. Just spend the money and do it!

We decided to book this tour because we were traveling with our 3 yr old AND I am in my 3rd trimester of pregnancy. This was the easiest and BEST way to see the terrain of Kauai, given that hiking anywhere was out! The fact that my son slept the entire hour should tell you how smooth the ride was.  Our pilot was so engaging and informative. I tried to enjoy the views as much as taking pictures -- it seems unreal! Beautiful island,  beautiful people

review_title: Best thing ever to do in Hawaii
review_text: Okay so if you go to any of the Hawaiin Islands and you do not make the time for a tour with Wings for Kauai, you are missing out.  Bruce & Ellen were the nicest people that you could ever ask for when dealing with a tour company.  Right from making the booking, to meeting them at the terminal, the awesome tour with Bruce in his Cessna with Bose Noise cancelling headphones, the souvienger and Bruce calling me after I left a personal belonging on his plane, these two make a person enjoy the tour and island like no other tour that my wife & I have ever been one.  I almost forgot to mentioned the island is beautiful when seen and narraited by Bruce  !  Thanks guys for a great experience on Canada Day, July 1, 2009.
This flight took my breath away And the pilot was very knowledgeable. Would do it again in a heartbeat!!
Very friendly pilot. Definitely a 5 star experience.  It was exactly what I was looking for when planning my trip.

My husband and I booked a tour with Wings Over Kauai during our honeymoon in the Cessna and it was way over our expectations! 
First, Bruce (the pilot) welcomed us and introduced himself, then his son, Carter, made the check-in and showed us the route.
Carter took a picture of us with the Cessna and the flight could begin!
Bruce truly loves his job and commented the flight with a lot of very interesting information about the island. We flew over the waimea canyon, the breathtaking Na Pali Coast, the best beaches like Poipu, Tunnels and Anini, the most amazing waterfalls and towns like Princeville. We even saw a whale !
And after this wonderfull time Carter surprised us with some gifts ! 
Wings over Kauai is a family business, every members' job is to offer you the best moment ever ! So don't hesitate, book with them, you won't be disappointed !
And to immortalize this amazing moment we bought the video for only 50$ !
Ein tolles Erlebnis, sehr sehr nettes Team und einige hilfreiche Informationen. Wir haben den Flug ziemlich am Anfang unseres Aufenthaltes gebucht - ein perfekter Einstieg.

review_title: Amazing tour, great guides and friendly pilot !!
review_text: We chose this tour as part of a cruise excursion, KE21 Misty Fjords Sightseeing, run by Taquan Air.  The excursion was well run, the bus transfer from the pier, the prep for the plane ride.  The pilot introduced himself and got us situated into the plane by size and weight.   Everyone had a window seat and the seat belts were long enough to accommodate pretty much everyone.   There was enough air flow in the cabin that it was not stuffy for those that may get airsick.  The take-off was right on the water by the ships and we flew right over downtown Ketchikan to the bogs and fjords.  We saw bald eagles flying and landing in their nests.  Seeing the land from the air was amazing.  The pilot showed us and explained a lot about the area - it was a little hard to hear over the headset sometimes but for the most part it was okay.  We landed in a large Fjord and were able to get out of the plane and stand on the float and look around.  It was awesome.   We loaded back up and flew back.  We had great weather there but hit a weather front on the way back so it was a bit rough.  The pilot got us through that and safely landed us to the dock.  A great trip and recommended!!

While visiting relatives in Eagle River, AK, (near Anchorage), we took Talkeetna Air Taxi's Grand Denali Tour with a glacier landing.  It was fantastic!  The people at TAT were beyond helpful when making our reservations and answering our questions in preparation for our trip.  Our pilot was professional and knowledgeable as to what we were seeing from the air making it all the more interesting for us.  If you have the opportunity, do this!  Standing on a glacier in complete silence is an experience I will never forget.
Next to seeing my kids born and marrying my wife,the most amazing thing I've ever done. Would definitely recommend and can't wait to go again when my kids get old enough
Excellent company. All about safety. Great views. Smooth ride. Awesome pilot - Chris. We were unable to land on the glacier and a credit was already there.
What a spectacular trip of a lifetime. With a fabulous pilot Eric and we saw whales and colors and the unique perspective. Recommend this totally
Spectacular views f the island and coastlines and really was a repeat value and saw coastline and land really amazing experience

This experience was awesome! We had a lot of fun seeing the 5 islands from 1,000ft. Eric was an excellent tour guide and pilot and he even let us take the controls and fly along the coastline. Would recommend this to anyone who was considering a helicopter tour. This was a better way to see the island!
Booked air land and river through Bestof Kauai- had issue with  that but pilot  Eric was layed back and assuring during 60+ minute flight. Saw a few whales and the terrrain is s worth every cent.

My partner and I booked the Cessna flight in July. Unfortunately, the weather was misbehaving on the day we were supposed to go up and we had to reschedule - I would like to note that everyone at Wings Over Kauai went out of their way to explain the issues and to try and find a solution for us. We managed to fly the next day and it was magnificent! Bruce could have not been a more considerate pilot - I am prone to motion sickness and he told me a great tip which ensured I was fine for the whole flight. He was also great at checking in on me and making sure I was doing okay.

The flight was gorgeous and Bruce was super knowledgeable and friendly. We loved every minute of it - such a wonderful way to see the island.

review_title: See all of Kauai in one hour!! BEAUTIFUL.
review_text: The booking processfor the Big Kahuna Air and Land Tour was very professional, done thru the Air Ventures Airplane Tours website.... Billy picked us up near the Cruise ship pier and we were taken to the airport. The flight was awesome. The island is beautiful from the air, you can see the waterfalls, canyons, rivers, beaches and learn the history of the island - all within 60 minutes. After the air tour, Billy picked us up and took us to the Wailua River for a cruise down the river to the beautiful Fern Grotto.  Billy picked us up again and took us back to the cruise ship. It was a wonderful day....the tour included a FREE DVD of Kauai by air!!

My wife and I were celebrating our 10th anniversary. We choose to go on a cruise aboard the Sapphire Princess. We did not book our sea plane through the ship. We choose to book at the dock. We saved $100 Per person and we were able to book our experience with Taquan Air Tours one hour before flying. Steve was our pilot.  I was able to sit up in the co-pilots seat and enjoyed the views.  http://www.youtube.com/user/AlaskaCruiseJuly2011?feature=mhee is a link to my channel that I have created. http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j99lWMkArhQ this video shows our experience with the seaplane.  this was our first cruise and my wife and i were very happy with the pilot and all of the people that we came in contact with Taquan Air.We would recommend them if you want a safe and straightforward flight.
Ray, Jill and Kaycee made our journey wonderful.  Highly recommended. Have a light breakfast before the morning flight and enjoy your times. Years of experience piloting clearly shows!

review_title: If you only pay for one tour in Kauai, this is it!
review_text: Bruce, Ellen and Maron (sorry hon if I spelled it wrong) were absolutely wonderful! My fiancee and I were in Kauai for only 4 days and planned only to lounge at the beaches every day. But at the last minute, we decided to book a flight tour. We came across Wings in a tour mag and called Ellen right before she closed the office. She was able to get us a morning tour the very next day.. and even better, the price was much cheaper than helis, and we got more air time than helis too. I'm in my 6th month of pregnancy so was a bit worried about having to ride in a tiny little 4-seater plane but she assured me it would be completely safe. Next morning we drove out and met Maron - she is a doll! She talked us thru the logistics before we got to meet Ellen and Bruce who were the sweetest couple. When we finally saw the plane.... boy was I scared. Its a tiny tiny plane. But! the takeoff, landing and the entire ride was sooo smooth. Better than flying 747s. Bruce has 20+ yrs experience flying so you really are in safe hands. The sites from the sky are amazing - you cannot see this stuff from land or water so this is the only way to go. Well worth every penny for the ride itself, but for the experience and meeting such great people, I would've paid much more!!! Give Ellen a call, you won't regret it ... and tell them Heather & Andy said Alohhhhha!

We took the Mountain Voyager trip with a glacier landing. The day we reserved was perfect - sunny and warm (great snowball weather on the glacier). The pilot (Chris) took us on a trip between the mountain peaks above the clouds, which were patchy below us. We were amazed at the glacier landing and take-off --- very cool. Chis provided interesting information about area throughout the trip, including information about climbing expeditions.

The only improvement I'd suggest would be in the check-in office, to clearly separate large tour groups from the rest of the people checking in.

We were originally scheduled to take the biplane tour of the island, however the biplane had to have maintenance and would not be available.  We were informed about this a week before the flight and given the opportunity for a private flight in the Cessna.  We were a bit disappointed that we couldn't get the biplane, however the tour was wonderful!  Our son even got to tag along with us!  Our pilot, Harry, did a fantastic job of making us feel comfortable and giving us a grand tour of the island.  Communication with Val and the company was wonderful and we were very well taken care of.  Highly recommend!
Great experience with fantastic views. Daniel was an exceptional pilot and so knowledgeable and engaging. Highly recommended!!

review_title: What a great way to experience Misty Fjords...
review_text: Adam Weiland was my pilot on this fantantic scenic tour of the fjords....He is a skilled pilot and very informative, friendly and knowledgable.  It was a pleasure...be sure to ask for Adam...and tell him Victoria sent you...: )
My wife and I really enjoyed our flight. The views were stunning. We highly recommend Maui Plane Rides, and we are very happy that we found them.

review_title: Perfect way to fully experience the beauty of Kauai!
review_text: Marcus is a great pilot and tour guide. This was my 2nd trip to Kauai, but my first aerial tour. Kauai is a beautiful island, but even more so from the air. The stunning views over Waimea Canyon and the Napali Coast were breathtaking and this tour was the highlight of my trip! This is the perfect way to fully experience the beauty of the island.

This flight was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  Stan was our pilot and he was very knowledgeable about the peak names, glacier names, explaining how the glaciers/mountains have evolved over the years.  We flew between peaks, down into valleys, we got beautiful pictures and a wonderful closeup view of the mountain.  We did not see "The Tall One" on this day due to cloud cover, but what we did see was truly magnificent.

I visited Wings over Kauai back in February, I was Refered there by a local after my current flight plans had got canceled. I would have to say that it was the best thing that could have happened. Ellen and Bruce were very welcoming and friendly, they helped me decide how to customize my flight the way I wanted it and then Bruce and I went up for a flight lesson. Bruce was amazing as he was very patient and informative both about the Island itself and with my flight lesson. I kinda got the tour and lesson all in one it was truly one of the best expeirences in my life. thank you both. if your looking for a great sight seeing tour or looking for  flight lessons on one of the most beautiful places on earth. Wings over Kauai is the number one spot to go.

review_title: A must DO while on KAUAI
review_text:
I was highly recommended to see this island from the AIR and I admit I was a bit hesitant as I thought I might get airsick.  I bit the bullett and booked the trip with my friends and it was one of the best scenic tours ever!!

Jill on the ground staff was wonderful and suggested, I sit in the front....lucky lucky me. 

Eric the pilot was amazing & a very experienced/handsome pilot.  He made our trip so memorable, taking care that everyone was able to see different waterfalls that he pointed out to us all.

I also comment that everybody gets a window seat on the plane trip, compared to those who choose to fly in a helicopter and end up in a middle seat.

So don't be hesitant, book and you will be like and so glad I did.

Happy memories and the best tour ever, thanks to Eric, Jill and grand staff.

Mahalo.  Regards Wendy

We took a day trip to Kauai when we visited Honolulu. I would highly recommend six seater airplane over a Helicopter to do a tour of the island. Much cheaper ( paid $100 pp) compared to Helicopter (which was over $200 pp) for an hour ride. They had cold water available on the flight if you need it. The pilot very nice and showed us the whole island.

Well organized with personable and highly skilled pilots, this is a must to really experience the Grand Canyon. The special equipment cuts heli noise but let's everyone communicate with one another and hear music. The entire flight is video recorded and a DVD available for purchase.

You feel safe and exhilarated at the same time. Nothing compares to the first time you go over the edge into the canyon. The flight takes you to places impossible to otherwise see and experience.

Thanks to our wonderful pilot, Marcus for this special experience at one of the seven natural wonders of the world!

review_title: Best Way to see ALL of KAUAI
review_text: We met our pilot at the Lihue airport. He was very professional and really knew his Kauai facts. The flight was just the right amount of time (about an hour in the air). I really don't like flying but our pilot was great and made us feel so comfortable that I was able to just relax and enjoy the tour. (I'm sorry I don't remember is name. I think he is a retired Doctor).

This is an expensive tour, however if the tour followed the itinerary advertised it would be a 5 star tour despite the cost.  Sadly it failed on providing what was advertised.   The tour states 90 min tour into the national park in a 4 x 4 vehicle, giving the impression of a jeep type off road vehicle.  Plus lunch after this and museum and gift shop.  I cannot fault the flight part of the tour but on arriving at Monument valley it turned sour.  We were collected in a normal mini van, the type you see for hotel transfers.  Ours had a cracked windshield and only two functioning seat belts to add to the experience.  I assumed this would transfer us to our 4 x 4.  We were kindly offered lunch first and allocated 30 mins to eat.  No problems there, we were also allowed a short time at the museum all good.  We were then from leaving the lodgings to returning to the aircraft about 40 mins.  So we had about 20 mins in the park, which was the whole purpose of the trip.  We were still in the mini van and had two stops but didn't get to John Ford point.  The absence of s 4x4 and the less than half the Arial time in the park ruined the day for me, especially considering the cost nearly 800 dollars each.  Such a shame as the flight and pilot were wonderful.  Someone needs to send a rocket to Gouldings tours and sort out that element.  Sadly due to this I would nor recommend this trip to others, such a shame as the flight was fantastic.

This is an exceptional activity, so worth every penny it cost. Our pilot was very smooth, and very knowledgeable. The office told us that the weather was unpredictable and that we might not be able to actually land on the glacier that day. We were told if we took the flight and could not land, we would not be charged for that part of the flight. It was a win-win so we took the flight. Incredible, breath-taking views of the land approaching the mountains, and then once in the mountains, the glaciers!  We did land on a glacier, which was just magnificent. The sun came out just after we landed. After leaving the glacier and flying out of the mountains, we flew into a rainbow. Perfect day, very safe flight. So glad we chose to do this.

review_title: Grande Denali flight and glacier landing - Life Changing
review_text: If you don't have the capacity for a 3 week grueling expedition, flightseeing and a glacier landing is the only way to get intimate with this giant.  Being a mountain gal living in Colorado/Wyoming I'm familiar with big peaks, this place is incomprehensible.  I was overwhelmed with emotions and brought to tears by this adventure, it changed my perspective on remote, rugged, wild, peaks.  I booked with TAT because of their flexible cancellation/rebooking policy as many days just aren't right for this trip.  I am already plotting how I can return and have another Denali experience with TAT.  Thank you!

Our plane tour with Ray was the highlight of our Hawaii trip. We booked it as a birthday surprise for my son who wants to be a pilot and Ray went above and beyond to make it a truly inspirational experience. Ray is not only a great pilot but an incredible tour guide who is passionate about sharing his love of flying and knowledge of the landscape and environment of Kauai. Jill and Trisha also went out of their way to make the experience really special for all of us. If you are thinking about booking an air tour, Air Ventures Hawaii will wow you.

review_title: Best way to see Denali and surrounding area.
review_text: We really enjoyed our flight with K2. Our pilot, Rosemary, was very professional and engaging. She had great knowledge of the geography and history of the area. The flight was smoother than I expected, and the views were spectacular.

review_title: Fly Kauai: Experience of a lifetime
review_text: We did this the last day of our honeymoon, and it was spectacular! The views are stunning, and it is really nice to be able to get some perspective on the size of the island, and where things are. I would recommend doing this at least a few days into your trip, or after you have had the chance to explore the outskirts of the island, so that you can orient yourself better. Our tour was $125/person, a great deal in comparison to the helicopter rides, which were upwards of $235/person. The ONLY downside is that on our particular flight, we had a person who got sick and we found out what she had for lunch. :( So - due to possible turbulence, you may want to take some motion sickness medication before you go on this tour. But - the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon, Hanapepe Canyon, "Jurassic" Falls and Kalalau Valley are stunning from the air, and you get to see places where 'Pirates of the Caribbean' and other movies were filmed. You get to see places that are only accessible by hiking; so if you are short on time, this is an excellent option. One thing I would mention is that there is NOTHING like seeing Kauai from the air. Nothing. We did a sunset dinner cruise to the Na Pali coast, and - though beautiful - it was a totally different experience from the air.

Bruce greeted us with a warm friendly smile right off the bat, not far behind was sweet Mili the dog.  The females are given a lei & a plumeria for behind the ear. There are GoPro cameras attached in the cockpit & to the wings of the plane. You can buy the DVD or BluRay of your flight, which is highly recommended. Captain Josh was fantastic. He includes everyone into the conversation throughout the entire flight. The views are phenomenal. There are no words to describe how beautiful Kauai is from the air.

Tour was amazing, absolutely worth it! Adam was our pilot and he was very helpful with pointing out areas we flew over. Landing on the water and standing on the dock was breath taking. Bucket list for sure.

I have a slightly different perspective - I flew with both Bruce and Marcus as part of my ongoing training as a private pilot. They were both fantastic instructors AND fantastic tour guides. I also flew 3 times over three weeks, and during the last 2 flights I also brought my girls (one at a time - only one passenger at a time in the Cessna 172. A bunch of folks can fly in the Airvans). My girls had a GREAT time and I got to be the "pilot" even though I was the student.
Maybe the other tours have great guides, but I have a hard time believing they are better guides than Bruce and Marcus. Bruce has lived on the Island for nearly 30 years, and knows the geology, history, ecology - the best beaches and most importantly, the flying!
Both Marcus and Bruce provided great instruction on situational awareness, the winds aloft and terrain effects, and how to keep passengers calm and enjoying the flight. If you are not an aviator, let me say this - these guys are safety minded, vigilant, experienced, and exercise great flight discipline. I learned a TON flying with them.
THE TOUR: beyond beautiful! On every one of my 3 flights we saw new things, from barking sands, to the Na Pali, to the interior of the island, to the biggest resorts. My girls had an amazing time. I recommend doing this early on in your time on the island, as it gave me a mental map of how varied the terrain was, and quickly formed a list of things to see and do. I can also say that you could even do it twice or more, as a passenger, and get new things every time. 
If you are an experienced pilot, or just learning like me, you have to do this! If you already have your PPL, fly right seat, as the flights rotate around the island from south east to northwest (na pali) and you will see much more. I stayed in left seat as I wanted to be consistent with the controls for the time being. Having the freedom to fly on vacation was something new to me, and I plan on doing it in norway, out in Colorado, Florida, etc. It will be hard to top the beauty of this trip - one of the best things I've ever done on vacation. Bruce, Ellen, and Marcus run a great experience. 5/5!

Can't say enough about how professional K2 aviation is.  The  trip up to Denali and views was breath taking. Do everything possible to make a landing on the glacier. A trip to always remember. K2 thumps up👍

I traveled to Alaska for my 50th birthday and my experience with K2 sits on the top of my list and we did ALOT. We flew around Denali Mtn. on the 2 hour glacier landing trip. I loved it so much i did two different flight tracks in the same day !!!  The 1st trip we were lucky enough to have a picture perfect clear day to go around the mountain. The 2nd trip had some cloud cover but it was still amazing and just as satisfying. Stan and Chip were my pilots, both great guys and extremely knowledgeable with the history of the area. You could ask them any questions glacier, Denali Mtn, you name it they had the answers. I would say this is a MUST do on everyones bucket list, worth every penny. And spending a couple of days in Talkeetna what could be better. Such a quant town with great food, the Roadhouse for breakfast is a must. Oh yes, the staff in the office very friendly and helpful guiding you on the trip thats right for you. Next time i want to do a drop off hiking trip !!!

review_title: Fabulous and a Must Do in Alaska
review_text: This was the most exciting tour we did on our Alaska vacation. This is a definite  MUST DO. You won't regret it!! Worth every penny.

review_title: Trip was pretty good considering the weather
review_text:
We were there three weeks ago, and unfortunately the skies weren't clear.  Most  people we were with rescheduled for the next day, but we didn't have that option since we were leaving the next morning.  So after waiting a couple of hours we got the go-ahead.  In hindsight, we wish we hadn't gone that day since we didn't get to see much of the mountains and couldn't do a glacier landing.   Brad was OK.  I guess we were expecting more commentary during the flight.  
So…. if the weather is really clear, go for it.  If it's not, pass on the trip and save your money.

Superbe Ballade au dessus du Misty  Fjord  . Excellent accueil et Bonne Humeur  de toute l'équipe .
Découverte à faire absolument  lors de votre escale à Ketchikan .

I was driving up to Talkeetna Airport, looking for a flight to Mt. Mc Kinley. The first company I saw was K2 Aviation. I was alone, all by myself and nobody else was having a reservation. But they took me nevertheless. 30 minutes later I was in the air in a Cessna with Tony, a seasoned pilot.
He proved to be not only a good pilot but also a knowledgeable guide to the scenery below and above. I was looking to take pictures of Denali and Tony just knew how to get the best angles. I never had something to suggest, he knew what I wanted him to do. And Denali showed itself from the best, cloudless side.

review_title: Great experience! Plane can use some upgrades.
review_text: Great experience of seeing Maui from the sky!! Eric was a terrific tour guide and was so patient. The plane needs upgrades but overall great experience.

We rode with Dorothy and she was awesome, answered any questions we had and gave us lots of information and details about our trip and Denali. We had a great time and it was so beautiful! Absolutely would go again! Also rad to have a female pilot 🤘🏽

We chose this company based on the reviews we read on trip advisor - so glad we did. 
Our pilot was professional and informative and we truly enjoyed the aerial view of Kauai. 
This was one of the highlights of our vacation- don't miss out !

We arrived very early and because of a customers' error in booking the Biplane was available immediately.   Wind was to get rough later, so everything turned out on time.    Keven was our pilot/guide.  He was very personable and knowledgeable as was the greeting and support staff.   The flight was very smooth and the biplane was almost new , very clean and smooth running.  Keven provided much information, This is our 4th visit to Kauai so we knew some of it, yet learned so much more.  We have a favorite beach that was not on the route, Keven rerouted a little and gave us some great Arial views.  Confident that we were in good hands, we loved everything about it!
Absolutely Fantastic!  Our Pilot was so good and knew his stuff about the island.  We would recommend your company to everyone!  It was a great experience! Well worth the money!

review_title: 90 minutes of beauty in a comfortable plane with a great pilot
review_text:
We didn't have time to tour the parks on our own, and this was a great way to see the scenery. It was fun, everyone has a window seat. You can get great photos and our guide/pilot was fun, informative and safe. 

It was well worth the price for 90 minutes of amazing scenery and views of the parks we couldn't have gotten even if we had weeks to explore! I definitely want to go back someday and explore on our own, but this was a terrific experience. 

The airport is just north of town, easy free parking, easy check in, clean restrooms.

We booked a private charter through Air Ventures.  The pilot, Issac, as well as the rest of the staff were great, attentive to our needs.  Issac provided information concerning the island as well as making sure we had the best angles for photographs.  We really enjoyed our tour, but most of all the fact that the pilot was a native born son and his love for his home showed through in his conversation.

review_title: HIGHLIGHT OF  THE ENTIRE TRIP FOR THE SECOND TIME
review_text: this was our second time to fly  talkeetna air,   first time we took a flight seeing, this time we landed on the glacier, it was the most amazing feeling i could imagine, there were two planes  of us in a family, and  we were together on the glacier for  quite a while,the beauty of the mountains as you fly through them as they tower over you is impossible to explain, YOU HAVE TO BE THERE, it is as if you can reach out and touch them, and the  skill and confidence of the pilots left  each of us feeling very comfortable and safe,  for two trips in a row  we had PETE as our pilot,  and  Shiloh  piloted  the other half of our family  on this trip, you not only get to see the mountains close up and  mt. Denali  as you could never do from  on the ground,  but from the time you take off  it is a running narrative of the region,  the mountain range, history of everything  you see and fly over or around, for us it is a MUST DO EXPERIENCE when we are in alaska, and if you only go one time,  be sure and take the glacier flight, it is worth the small extra it costs for the experience you will have.   the entire staff of talkeetna air is part of what made this trip special,  and by the time you land you will not only  have had the experience of your life that you will  want to tell everyone back home about,  but you will have made new  friends with your pilots,  it was truly a great time and when i get back to alaska, our third flight with talkeetna air will be at the top of our list,  we covered  alaska from HOMER down south, to DENALI NATIONAL PARK to the north, and the glacier landing and flight was without a doubt,  THE HIGHLIGHT OF OUR TRIP., SPECIAL THANKS TO PETE AND SHILOH, our pilots,  we will be back.   barry payne

We recently took a cruise from Vancouver to Alaska, but the highlight for me, was at the end of the trip when we took the Talkeetna Air Taxi up and around Denali.  We choose to land on the glacier, and I would highly recommend that as it is a "once in a lifetime" adventure.

We booked the Misty Fjords trip in July 2017 and SeaWind was great.  The booking process was easy and efficient.  They accommodated our family of 11 in 2 planes so that we can go at the same time.  SeaWind made sure to get in touch with us before the trip and contacted us several times to make sure we knew where to be picked up.  Then the flight was spectacular!  Highly recommend for all ages!

SeaWind Aviation was a pleasure to work with and provided a first class experience to me and my guests.  Fred the pilot was professional and did an excellent job as well as the SeaWind Aviation staff.  We landed on a beautiful lake and had the opportunity to see two bears.  Provided shuttle service from cruise port.  Highly recommend if you want to see Alaska from above!!!

This was the highlight of our Alaskan cruise vacation as far as I'm concerned. The entire staff could not have been more pleasant.   Flying over Misty Fjords was simply magical.  The landscape was so unique and IMHO is best appreciated from the air.  We even landed on a small lake and were allowed to stop outside of the plan on the pontoons.  The music just added to the experience.  Thank you all for such a great memory!

Passeio imperdível!!! Helicóptero super seguro, pilotos experientes e super atenciosos!!! Meu filho tem pânico de voar em aviões pequenos, mas ficou super tranquilo pela segurança que eles nos passaram!!!
Very very good experience! If someone consider this tour, I recommend it 100%. The pilot was very kind and explained the landmarks easily.  My parents were satisfied with this great experience.
It’s a great tour. Beautiful views of the Island Unique experience!! The pilot was very kind and explained in detail each place we visited.

review_title: Great way to admire the majestic canyon
review_text: We had a very short time to explore the Grand Canyon. We decided to take the early flight and were completely satisfied in every respect. Of course the views were absolutely magnificent. The crew was very professional and helpful. Everything worked out like a charm.
tour_name: 7 -110_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour_2025-02-27

review_title: Breathtaking Views, wish I didn’t get motion sickness
review_text:
There are 2 companies side by side that offer this, we went with Air Adventures do to availability (the other co I found first but they were booked .. this co was rated exactly the same ).  The check in was easy and the people were very nice and personable .  Our pilot Eric was very nice, funny, and knowledgeable . He gave a history of certain areas of the island we flew over and kept asking if everyone was ok (especially me) . We hit a bit of turbulence soon after take-off but that stopped after a minute or so and then it was fairly smoothe going .  We were thinking of doing the helicopter tour originally but I read that you would feel more movement and that costs close to $600 for 2 people  While they may get closer to some areas the small plane we took a smoother ride and you got to see everything and it was $270 fir bothering of us plus every person gets a window seat . In the helicopter .. if you sit in the middle .. you can’t see. 
Now the bad.... nothing to do with Air Adventures... about 10 minutes into the flight I had severe motion  sickness . I took a Dramamine before the flight but it didn’t help . I don’t get sick on regular planes , I guess this one was different.  The lady next to me was a nurse and she kept putting cold towels (which they provide) on my neck and legs.  The views were stunning and I managed to take a lot  of pictures regardless. My husband sat on the co-
Pilot seat up front , I sat behind the pilot .  Finally when we landed the person at the front desk gave me ginger ale to drink. I will say it took a few days to get feeling back
To
Normal . I highly recommend this tour and company , but if you get motion sickness, take precaution.

The people who run this place are extremely nice, helpful and accomodating.  I'm glad we chose the small plane rather than the helicopter.  The price was reasonable.  The ride was comfortable so you can relax and enjoy the views.  You will not regret spending you money on this trip.

review_title: This was the best experience on my trip
review_text: This was one of the best things to do in Denali area, I have never seen something so majestic , I loved it. Will definitely recommend. The mountains were beautiful. The customer service was very nice. The pilot took such amazing pictures, we spent 30 minutes on the glacier. They also picked me up and dropped me off for free, they are so nice people.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: My wife surprised me for my 30th Birthday. It make for very memorable birthday one of the best experiences I had. I recommend it.

All 10 of us squeezed into the perfectly sized DHC-3 Turbo Otter for a fantastic 2 hours flightseeing trip of a lifetime. Immediately after take off from Talkeetna airstrip we climb towards the Denali range and we soon get the first views of the Glaciers that we weave their way down through the mountain valleys. Our pilot is a local and extremely knowledgeable of all the geology of the area and with almost perfect weather we fly quite close to some of the near vertical edges. We cannot fully see the top of Denali itself due to small pockets of cloud but we make our way towards Ruth Glacier to set down gently, we all get out to take in the awe and natural splendour of our surroundings, we are advised that the snow / ice beneath our feet is approximately 4,000ft thick, quite reassuring ! Our land time is soon over and we take off for our descent back to Talkeetna - an amazing adventure which I truly was looking forward to.

Great experience! Staff was a bit rude to any two year old son while waiting for our flight. Repeatingly asking us to keep him quiet......he is an excited two year old....have some patience and understanding. Otherwise, on the flight experience, it was amazing! Best way to view the Bay Area!

review_title: Amazing air tour of San Francisco
review_text: What a very nice and pleasant flight, done in a DeHavilland Beaver, with a funny pilot (who also speaks french for the frenchies... I’m. !!!)Golden Gate, Alcatraz, downtown and many other places with live comments :-)A great experience to absolutely do when visiting SF

Our party of two couples booked this trip about 2 1/2 months before cruising around the Hawaiian Islands on NCL's Pride of America. Everything - having questions answered, booking ease ,being transported to and from the airport, meeting friendly owners, and having a very capable, knowledgeable pilot was first class. We had a private flight with just the four of us and the pilot. I had taken a helicopter ride over the island about.30 years ago and believe this equals, if not excels, that experience. Since the plane can go higher,you get more panoramic views of beautiful Kauai. We were fortunate to have a beautiful, sunny day for our 2:30 PM flight.
Had an amazing flight with Eric. He is a fantastic pilot and tour guide. We loved seeing Maui from the air!

The other reviewers have said it all but I am still compelled: You will like Bruce and Ellen (and their family) and entirely trust Bruce's professionalism. They will treat you well. Bruce will keep up the interesting observations even if you don't comment, and is well versed in any subject matter you might bring up. We've done helicopter tours on two other islands and I prefered this by far. The viewing was just as good, and comfort just as high (with the Bose noise cancellation headphones.) The only thing I noticed was that the helicopters would take you down into a coastal canyon, but having seen these from the ocean and the ridges, the (intrusive) flight in would have added nothing. 

(And the reviewer who just mentioned the tip was right. The Coulombes are without any hucksterism that the tourist industry thrives on. You could tell that Bruce really, really, tried to make an effort by way of a joke, but at the same time the concept was plainly abhorrent to him - it made me smile to myself. In fact I felt strange giving a "tip" to a consummate professional so I snuck it in to Ellen later. Remember - they really treat you right at a great value.)

review_title: If you have a full day - this is how you want to spend it!
review_text: Well coordinated day trip from South Rim to Page with lots of handoff from one tour company to another perfectly coordinated: 1 hr flight to Page with stunning views, 4 wheel drive to Antelope Canyon with amazing light play, bus ride to Colorado River for a 15 mile float (not white water at all) with incredible and constantly changing scenery, bus ride to trading post on the Reservation (mostly tourist crap with an overpriced gallery immediately adjacent), and bus ride back to airport where you left your car. Never an issue with food, water, bathrooms, etc. 12 plus hours with a small group.

Joel was our pilot and he provided a great experience for us as we flew over all the major sites of downtown Miami. We got to pass over Kendall, Coral Gables, Miami Beach, and Key Biscayne all while enjoying the sunset. Would definitely recommend this experience and would come back again.
I loved it! My girlfriend and I had a safe, fun flight, and got to see amazing views. Our pilot was comforting and experienced!

Eric was a great tour guide and pilot, it was a vey smooth flight overall.  This was my first trip to the island and this tour gives one an excellent reference point to further my experience, would I go again? Absolutely!!!

review_title: Flight with glacier landing, a fairytale
review_text: Will never regret we took this flight with landing on the glacier. It was nicely narrated  by the pilot with lots of details.

My husband and I went in our honeymoon. This was such a great experience(even though I got motion sickness lol). This is worth the money. They fly you over the Grand Canyon and you get a much better view that just the ground level view. David was our pilot. He was friendly and knowledgeable. Recommend doing this while in Arizona!
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: On a recent trip to Hawaii we were after a helicopter flight but they were all fully booked so instead we opted for a fixed wing flight which was fantastic, the pilot/ owner was an ex commercial pilot as well as a Vietnam vet, so we were put at ease right from the off in regard to our nerves etc, he also had a great sense of humour, which also made us feel at ease. We all had a great unrushed experience and it was one of the main highlights of our trip with Ray our pilot showing us some amazing scenery, so to anyone reading this I would fully recommend this company for a casual, unrushed, and safe adventure in the air, and I would certainly book again the next time I am in Hawaii.

Our flight to see Mt. McKinley was wonderful and quite thrilling.  We enjoyed the close-up view of the mountain and landing on the glacier.   We highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for both an adventure and a spectacular view of the mountain.

My first time in a helicopter and it was a great experience.  Everyone at the facility was helpful and very friendly. It was amazing to see the Grand Canyon from an aerial view.  However, book directly through Maverick, it's cheaper.  Trip Advisor did not email me confirmation and that was a big hassle.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_title: Better the weather, better the experience.
review_text: We had a clear day. Rare, I'm told. The experience was amazing. To float above, among, between and land on the Denali mountain range with a photo to be had every 20 seconds makes you go 'should I not just be looking and soakin' it all in?' or 'shouldn't I be taking every photo I can?'For those who choose looking and soaking, then bring your polaroid glasses, it gets bright up there with all that snow, not to mention clouds. If you are landing on the glacier then sunburn cream is a good idea to wear, and take gloves and hat to keep your ears warm (it'll be 5-10 degrees colder than at the airport).For those who choose taking every photo you can, then a polaroid filter will bring out the best shots. Also if you can sit up the front this is definitely the time to use your panorama photo feature on your phone as you'll get front and side views that can only be captured this way, unless you have really wide angle lense. The advantage of not sitting up the front is that your windows are not curved and your camera can focus a whole lot easier on your subject. If there are two of you going on this trip make sure you sit on either side of the aisle so you can get different shots, you can share them later.Generally the air is smooth, its not the tropics with air rising and getting turbulent, this is cold air not doing much. But if you are airsick prone, looking through a camera eyepiece looking at land in motion, with the airplane turning will only make you more airsick sensitive. My advice (being a pilot)   in that regard is to a) take your motion sickness tablet at least half hour before take off b) have something in your stomach already ie breakfast or lunch b) take a piece of candy you can suck on the first time you get a hint of sickness c) take pictures angled forward rather than directly out the side (sense of motion is less) d) don't take pictures when the plane banks. e) look at the horizon after every photo to get your sense of up or down reset in your mind.Last suggestion, for those who put their pictures into photo books, you might want to take a few pictures of the video being played in the snow shoe fitting area. The shots I took were of the aircraft flying and landing on the glacier. These are going to be difficult to get in real life and will be handy for your photo story. This trip on a clear day is a must do for those who appreciate Gods handiwork, for those who love geography, for those who love flying and mostly for those who love photography.
We had a great tour with a very profesional staff, from beginning to end. They told us a lot about the area we flew over. Thanks for a great tour

review_title: A Birdseye view of Maui & Molokai
review_text:

review_title: Best Air Tour Bang for the Buck!
review_text: Had the pleasure of flying with Air Venture Hawaii in June of 2010.  My wife, son, and myself spent a wonderful hour in the air seeing all that Kauai had to offer.  The Grand Canyon of the Pacific, the rugged Kauai coast line, beautiful beaches, waterfalls, mountains, cliffs....all laid out below us to view!  Large windows and a wing-over aircraft made everything easy to see, photograph, and video.  Our pilot was eager to make multiple passes of various areas so that folks on both sides of the aircraft were able to get maximum visibility for all passengers.  Keep in mind that this is a small aircraft, although very spacious inside. Kauai's trade winds may make this flight somewhat uncomfortable for those used to the "I'm sitting at home in my living room" feeling in today's larger modern jet aircraft.  For the rest of us, the flight is a true "air venture"!

Would thoroughly recommend this tour with maverick if you go to Vegas 
The helicopters ( and I'm a nervous flyer) are beautiful and the pilots really make you fee settled and comfortable 
The views are breath taking the canyon itself truly peaceful and picture perfect 
We had a great time and flew back over he strip which really brought the tour to a brilliant ending 
Amazing !!!!
Thus was a phenomenal experience! Five islands, whales, lava flows, coral reefs. I’d it again in a heartbeat! Eric was an entertaining and knowledgeable guide!

My wife and I were in Ketchikan for a few hours (cruise stop) and had originally schedule a flight tour with another company.  They cancelled on us about 2 days prior!  But we were able to find Seawind on Viatour, and we salvaged our visit!  They couldn't have been nicer.  We were picked up just outside our ship and taken the short distance to the "airfield." All around great experience.  Knowledgeable pilot.  Beautiful day!  Everyone was very polite and organized.

Great ride! Very friendly. Amazing views across Miami.

This experience was so fun! The plane was peaceful and we got to see very pretty views! Definitely worth it!
