review_title: One of a Kind SoFlo experience!
review_text:
My 11 year old son and myself rode in the Cessna 172 pictured on this page. We booked a 1 hour "Ultimate Tour" and had picture perfect weather.  Initially, I was a little concerned because the location on Rickenbacker Causeway seemed like a backup or satellite location (Better signage would help), and when no one was there 15 minutes after our appt timed, I called.  No sooner than this, Capt Adrian appeared with the plane.

Once on shore, he immediately apologized and took ownership, stating the cause of the delay (Honesty and responsibility? +10 points!)  We then loaded quickly, had a quick safety review, then the engine started. We started gliding across the water, and quicker than I thought, we were airborne!

We were airborne in no time and headed out over the main beach.  For anyone not used to low level flying, prepare to be amazed and what you can see, and the overall experience!  Amazing detail, and you experience Miami and the earth in a whole new way.  Being overhead also gives a new dimension to the water, which you can now see through to the bottom in most places.

But nowhere is this better than flying over Biscayne National Park, which is entirely underwater.  Our pilot/instructor Adrian narrated the entire flight, explaining sites, significance, history, and even one illegal lobster trap!  

The water here spans the full pallet of blue to green, with an emphasis on unbelievable glowing light blue that my camera sadly couldn't duplicate.  Depths of water here ranged from 10" to 8 feet, and you can easily spot lots of rays and sharks, especially when we dipped low, and slowed a bit.

Yes, this is a bit more expensive, but any type of aviation is not cheap. But the dividends are well worth it, and formed memories for my son that will last a lifetime!

Great Job Miami Seaplanes! We will be back!

The choice for our excursion on Kauai was either a plane ride or helicopter ride. My wife was a little unsure of the helicopter ride and I was actually leaning toward a plane ride thinking it might also be a little more leisurely. We decided to take the plane and we were not disappointed. Josh the pilot gave us beautiful views of the mountains and valleys as well as very interesting commentary all through the hour long ride. 
Everyone at the airport was a pleasure as they prepared us for our flight. The plane offered excellent views from every seat and Josh ensured all of us got the views we wanted while in the aIr. The flight was smooth/no bouncing around, the commentary interesting and the views were simply spectacular. We got several close up views of the waterfalls, valleys, coffee fields, etc.
The surprise at the end was a DVD of the ride with our pictures on the front making this one of our best excursions of the week!
We highly recommend this tour and commend all the staff at Wings Over Kauai for a most enjoyable time.

If you want to experience not only the most breath-taking views of Kauai, but also the warm and wonderful welcome of the islands, then Wings Over Kauai is for you.  Ellen and Bruce are truly very special people.  Their passion for the island and its beauty enhance the entire experience.  From the moment Ellen greets you with a flower and a kukui nut lei, you just know you're in the right place.  And Bruce, with his knack for ease of conversation and broad knowledge of the island and its environs, makes you feel right at home.  There are dozens of organizations that are willing to take you around the island, but how many can wrap it up in a warm and fuzzy package and make you feel like you just took a spin around this beautiful island with an old friend?  Priceless.

This flight was fantastic and worth every cent! We thoroughly enjoyed the commentary from our pilot Kevin   and saw some of the most wonderous scenery imaginable... and Pierce Brosnan's beach place! I can recommend this excursion and this friendly, professional company.

review_title: Best Thing I've Done in Hawaii
review_text: This is clearly the highlight of any of my 3 trips to Hawaii while visiting 4 of the Islands. If you are trying to decide between a helicopter tour or this, do this first or last, but just book the WACO Bi-Plane tour. Whichever helicopter tour you choose probably doesn't matter, there are hundreds it seems and they are interesting. I've done 7 so far, 3 in Hawaii and others in other parts of the world. This Bi-plane is just another thing altogether. Open cockpit and throaty engine really gives a different experience. Also, consider that in a helicopter the chances are that you will end up in one of the back middle seat in a vibrating bubble. On this flight you get right or left and full front view. Our pilot Paul put us through some thrilling maneuvers at different points during the tour and I could just go back and do this again and again. I have a gopro and used their mount. It was perfect, however I did pull out my phone to record some of those fun turns and drops and climbs. I would recommend that if you can, try to record from your seat, but come prepared to secure your camera to your body. I didn't secure my phone but gripped it until my knuckles were white and certainly kept it behind the windscreen since it was clear that if I stuck it into the wind, it would rip it from my hand. Air Ventures is a professional outfit, from booking through flight. Thanks for a great experience. (I was trying to upload pics, but TripAdvisor kept rotating them upside down)
This trip is a must do for anyone wanting to see Denali! The mountain and Talkeetna Air were STELLAR!  Knowledgeable and friendly team at Talkeetna Air.

This was the most amazing and beautiful thing I've ever seen and been a part of. Bruce, our captain, was amazing and his staff were as well. I cannot say enough about how beautiful it was to see Kauai from the air and Bruce made my husband and I feel very comfortable and safe. He even played music in our headphones that went with the scenery we were seeing. The entire trip was fantastic and I wish we could have stayed up there for hours. It went by so fast. The whole experience was amazing even though I thought I was frightened to death beforehand. You really must try it and don't be scared to do this. As far as the cost, I justified it after pricing helicopter tours and boat tours. We were given a lot of info about the island by our captain while flying over. It was just so beautiful and unforgettable. Must do!!!

Great,  more than I thought it would be.

review_title: Left that Omen in the Clouds
review_text:
My husband and I said we would  NEVER fly in a small plane due to safety issues.  Well, there were two ways to see Kauai from the air, helicopter or a small plane which was operated with Air Ventures.  We decided on the plane.  We set out from Princeville three hours ahead of time, wanted to do some additional sightseeing on the south end of the island.  We arrived at Air Venture around 2:20 for our 3pm flight.  When we arrived the young lady apologized because our flight was delayed an hour due to staffing issues.  The delay did  not pose a problem for us, we had some other things that we could do to fill the time.  The only problem it did cause, it made me think is this an omen?  We returned 10 minute before our schedule time and my husband attempted to check in.  This is where the real problem came into play, the young lady that had greeted us before was having a personal conversation with another worker from another vendor and continued her conversation for about 5-7 minutes while my husband stood there.  Then she turns around and says how over worked she had been that day and she had just cleared her desk.  My husband is not one to hold his tongue and told her she couldn’t have just cleared her desk because he had been standing there waiting while she was having a personal conversation that she had started before he walked in.  Of course by then he was ready to cancel the tour due to the delay and his wait to check in.  After we talked we decide to take the tour. 
 I did inform the pilot, I believe his name was John, of my fear of flying in a small plane.  He did insure me that I would enjoy my tour and he would take care of me.
First, the take off was smooth, beautifully executed.  I did not know we had left the ground, until I looked down.  The narrative was very good,  he pointed out many interesting towns and sites with explanation.  When he went over an area where he knew we would get turbulent winds he would let us know, so that we would be prepared.  I appreciated the preparation and it calmed my fears.  The landed was as smooth as the take off.  You could tell that John loved his job and took pride in what he did.  It was a great tour.  And that omen, I left it up in the clouds.  For our inconvenience (flight delay)  we were given a DVD of what we saw on the tour, it was a prerecorded DVD.  I am rating this tour a 4 and not a 5 because of the office person.  But, the tour and John our pilot were more than a 5.

review_title: Canyon Dream Tour - Worth Every Penny!
review_text:
We took the Canyon Dream tour from the Vegas Strip offered by Maverick Airlines. We were picked up on time at our hotel by a courteous driver. After a stop or two to collect other passengers, we made the short drive to Henderson Executive airport. There we waited a short time before check-in. There was a snack bar and gift shop available at the terminal. 

We were greeted by our friendly pilots who doubled (tripled?) as knowledgeable tour guides and  expert photographers. Plenty of photo opportunities on this tour! There was also a professional photographer who got a great family shot of us which we purchased after the trip.

The plane flight was approximately 45 min in each direction. The plane was comfortable and offered a great perspective of the landscape below. It was a treat to move around the cabin mid-flight, Our teens enjoyed visiting the cockpit for a front row view. 

The most thrilling portion of the trip was the 25 min helicopter flight over the canyon. This part is not to be missed! Our pilot Luke was amazing. There's not a bad seat in the house and the views are breathtaking.

The trolley ride was fun, our tour guide Bruce was polite, funny and offered interesting commentary. Your time on the ground is short but more than enough to appreciate the vastness and beauty of the canyon.  Even the boxed lunch was better than expected. 

If you are considering it, go for it. Worth every penny. It was the highlight of our trip!

My husband and I had a terrific time.  Bruce seemed to know everything about the island and showed us all the most beautiful places.  The flight itself was wonderful as well.  Bruce and Ellen are the best and we'd recommend Wings Over Kauai to anyone who is vacationing here!

You haven’t seen the Golden Gate until you’ve seen it by seaplane!  My husband and I took this exciting adventure and had a great time.  We chose the optional pick up and return shuttle. The pick up and drop off was at Pier 39 and it was a great service to get us to the seaplane and back.  We had nice weather and the views were spectacular.  We could see the bridges, islands, city, bay, and surrounding areas.  Our pilot let us know what we were flying over and both sides of the plane had good views. The pilot was very good and we felt safe.   Really a unique experience that we loved and will never forget...

This tour was incredible!! Everything about the operation was smooth and easy!! The pilot was very skilled, helpful, and knowledgeable! And the sights were out of this world!! It will be hard to top this experience!!
The views the crater were incredible.  We saw several whales and were able to get great photos. The flight was smooth and pleasant.

We took the 1 hour tour of the Island which gave a good overview.  You wear headphones that allow you to listen to the pilot's narrative of the Island.  I would recommend this highly and hearily agree with all that has been said by other recent reviewers.
Our flight with Garrett was spectacular. The mountains were showing themselves and I can’t imagine a better day in Denali.
Un très bon moment passé à bord, pilote sympathique et vue unique de la baie. A recommander sans hésitation !

Eric was masterful, a confident and smooth pilot, a well informed and enthusiastic guide, reverent of our experience and my husband’s 50th, flexible and accommodating, a great listener. It was magical!  It was the best gift I’ve ever given my husband of 21 years!

This was one of the most amazing things I've done,  even after traveling all over the world! Well worth it! Stunning scenery and sights of mountains. We even took our 22 month old.  He did just fine and even slept for part of the flight.  Jonathan was a wonderful guide!

First time taking a seaplane and WOW!  We were a group of 3 and got the whole planes to ourselves and the pilot.  We spotted bears and landed in the water where we walked around a secluded shoreline.  Spotted bear tracks and even tried a salmon berry!  Our pilot graciously took our picture in front of the plane with the mountains in the background.  He was a better photographer and knew my camera better than me!  Thanks for making this a once in a lifetime experience.

review_title: The most amazing way to take in the splendor of the Grand Canyon!
review_text:
This experience was unparalleled! To see the Grand Canyon from the air was breathtaking. Our pilot, Brandon, narrated throughout the flight, pointing out items of interest.  

We are a family of 5 and intended to do the Grand Canyon as a day trip by car from Sedona.  
We are so glad we decided to take the Westwinds Tour. To take in the Grand Canyon via air was truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience!

Thank you to Brandon and Westwind for an experience we will never forget!

Bruce and Ellen were very welcoming and engaging when we arrived. Once we got signed in and prepared for our flight, Ellen took our photo in front of the plane and introduced us to Shane, our pilot.  Shane was great!  We saw incredible sights from the plane that we never would have seen any other way and had a very smooth ride to boot.  Shane was informative and took great care of us.  There were 4 of us and we all had a great view!  A must do!!

Everything about this flight tour was excellent - Leah & Lesley were so helpful booking it and accommodating our schedule. Their customer service was outstanding!  The views from the plane were beautiful! Being so close to everything was just breath taking!  The pilot was great too - answering all of our questions and providing us with lots of fun information.  We would highly recommend this tour! Definitely a highlight of our trip to Alaska!

We had a wonderful experience flying with Wings Over Kauai.  We booked it to basically see the whole island from the air but as airplane enthusiasts we decided to go for the flight instruction option.  It was definitely the highlight of our whole trip to Kauai.  
What a fun time we had!!!  We went around the entire island and my husband got to actually fly the plane through most of the trip.  We had such a great time that we booked another day where we each got flying lessons.  It was an experience that we both will never forget and will always look back on fondly.  What a beautiful place to fly for the first time!

Wings Over Kauai was very professional, and if you choose to take a tour with them you will definitely get a wonderful experience without having to be with a larger group of folks you don't know.  Its designed to be more intimate and I believe you get more out of your tour of Kauai this way.  
All I know is that they are very professional and we had a fantastic time with Wings Over Kauai.
It was a really cool tour… beautiful view of the island and the guide was very knowledgeable with Steve. The weather was perfect too! I do recommend taking this tour……..

review_title: Amazing Value & Great Tour Guide - Justin
review_text:
Booked Air Ventures Hawaii on Kauai for a same week excursion. We found them on Tinggly and saw their reviews on that site before booking. It was an amazing decision! I have been on a Kauai helicopter ride as well so I was able to experience both.

Air Ventures is definitely a value for the experience! Our pilot Justin was considerate and caring. He answered all my questions about the island and really made an effort to show the best of the island including pointing out a humpback whale off the Nepali coast!

A few notes on the services itself:
- $149 per person is a deal!
- The right side of the plane sees more of the best of the island including waterfalls and the Napali coast, but Justin did an amazing job making sure the left side got to see everything too with some awesome turns.
- The plane is not like a doors off helicopter. It's a smoother ride, and the views are less dramatic. For those who are prone to air sickness, I highly recommend over the helicopter.
- Parking and check-in is a breeze, it's right by the FedEx and has a designated parking lot
- Very organized operations and the staff are super friendly

I would highly recommend Air Ventures Hawaii in Kauai!

My wife, myself, and our two 11 yr. old granddaughters recently took the Misty Fjords Tour with SeaWind Aviation out of Ketchikan.  Steve Kamm, owner & pilot, provided a wonderful flight for us all.  The flight through Misty Fjords was breathtaking.  At on point, Steve spotted a mother bear & cub in a meadow near a lake in the wilderness.  We landed nearby and were able to take pictures & enjoy the experience.
Steve is a wonderful pilot; a family man with three daughters; and very knowledgeable of the area.  The float plane was well-maintained.  I highly recommend this company.

My husband and I recently spent Christmas 2009 in Hawaii. We were in Kauai for three days and decided the best thing to do first was to take a helicopter tour of the island. We did a lot of research on helicopter trips, but couldn't find anything under $200 per person. We took the advice from some Trip Advisor comments and booked a plane ride with Wings Over Kauai because it was half the price of all other helicopter rides. We made the right decision!  The plane is a small 4 passenger plane that makes you feel safe and secure. We were pleasantly surprised with the personal service that we received from our pilot, Bruce (the company’s owner). The plane ride was amazing and both my husband and I had our own window with an amazing view – there’s not a bad seat. Bruce was very knowledgeable about the island and called out every point of interest. Bruce provides noise cancelling headphones which we didn’t care too much about until Bruce showed us the different with and without them. It was an expense he could have skipped, but he didn’t. Wings Over Kauai is a small family run company, so they don’t advertise a lot and you probably wouldn’t find them in your travel book. Highly recommend.  Great value for your money.  Check them out at www.wingsoverkauai.com

review_title: Wow!  A wonderful way to see the beautiful island of Kauai
review_text: I had a wonderful flight over Kauai with Wings over Kauai.  It was wonderful to be able to see so many things while only paying $125.00 rather than $300+ for a helicopter.  Josh, our pilot, was very friendly and ensured that everyone got a good view.  However, I will say that I think that you are better off if you can be the co-pilot or be in the right hand side of the 'plane as there is more to see on that side.  We saw some wonderful waterfalls and the Napali Coast looked stunning.  Considering that later in the day when our cruise ship sailed past the Napali Coast, the clouds had come in, it was so nice to know that I had seen the Coast in all its' glory from the air.  I was then so surprised to receive a DVD of my adventure at the end of the flight.  What a wonderful memento of this wonderful experience.  I highly recommend Wings over Kauai flightseeing over Kauai for all visitors to Kauai.

My family and I had a great scenic flight over Denali and landed on a glacier. It was an amazing experience us as a family and one I’d recommend. Our pilot Billy was excellent. Had a super clear day, so count ourselves very lucky!
We did the flight to Molokai and had a great experience. Our son loved it. Eric is passionate about his work and it shows!
The Maui Plane Rides team we’re truly amazing and very professional.  We saw some amazing waterfall along the road to HANA route.

On our recent rip to Kauai we had the pleasure of taking a trip over the island with Air Ventures Hawaii. Our pilot Makoa was friendly, professional and knowledgable about the island. A great experience and time well spent!

Can't say enough good things about this. We had a beautiful clear day to see Denali. It's unforgettable. The only thing I would change is that I wouldn't lose Rock, paper, scissors, this losing my opportunity to sit in copilot seat on the way back! Unbelievable fun!!
clear sky, mountains are covered by snow. I can see perfect view. I want to visit one more time, if possible.

I enjoyed the exciting flight, especially for the sake of my photography. We didn't get to hardly see the Denali peak due to the weather, and apparently it would have to be an absolutely perfect day to do the Denali Grand flight tour which I was planning to do. The only reason I got to see the peak of the mountain barely through the clouds is because the pilot turned the plane around to see a coyote down by a river. I got great pictures of the glaciers, but I wish the pilot would make sure everyone got a chance to see the top of the mountain when its visible when flying back to Talkeetna.

What an amazing day!  My dad, husband and I booked the South Rim Deluxe package. We were lucky in that we were the only ones on the trip, so it was just us and Bill, our pilot. Bill was great - super friendly and very knowledgeable. We had a cool day - just below the freezing mark at the rim!!  But, as Canadians, still warmer than home. The day was bright and clear and we could see for miles!  
Walking around the rim and the State Park, there were few tourists - pretty much had the place to ourselves. Even saw a 12-point buck and his doe on the path near the museum. 
Flying over the Canyon, seeing Sedona and Tonto Forest was just breathtaking   This is something you should really do

Can't say enough about the staff at Westwind. From booking, to arriving to the end of the day, we all had a fantastic time!!

review_title: A Native Resident Sees the Bay Area from Thousands of Feet Above
review_text: I'm so grateful to have had this experience. If you've ever wondered why it costs so much to live in the Bay Area, take this flight and you'll quickly understand the reasons. It's breathtaking. Highly recommended!

Our pilot was so knowledgeable of the island.  He made sure we were all having a good time.  
It was an amazing flight- highly encourage

review_title: Mt McKinley at it's most sectacular
review_text: Oh so lucky! We went to the airfield directly from the train.  The weather was clear and calm.  Our very capable pilot flew us into the Denali National Park, around three sides of Denali and the auditorium.  Spectacular views, departing along the great glacier and back to Talkeetna.

We took a flightseeing trip on 3/28/21 with K2 out of Talkeetna.  What an awesome experience and views.  Well worth the cost and time.  I felt totally comfortable with our pilot Chris.  He provided us with lots of facts and information along with the awesome views which he made sure we got from both sides of the aircraft.  As this flight took place in the time of Covid I also felt very comfortable with the safety procedures in place both prior, during and after the flight.

A big thanks to Bruce, Ellen, and Captain Josh for the excellent service they provided to our group of 6 cruise ship passengers yesterday. Bruce picked us up at the Anchor Cove Mall, which is close to the cruise terminal, and he and Ellen checked us in and took pictures of us in front of the plane before we took off, which we received via email today. Our pilot Josh provided very informative comments as we flew over the Jurassic park waterfall, Waimea Canyon, and the Na Pali coast and he let us know when we were approaching the best sights for photos. We were blessed with a clear day, so we got some amazing photos!

My only criticisms are that the seat beside the window in the back row has very little leg room and the 2 of us seated on the left side of the plane missed a lot of the best sights because most of them are on the right side. The AirVan has 1 passenger seat on the right beside the pilot, 2 seats in the second row, 1 seat on the right in the third row (which is where you enter the plane), and 2 seats right beside each other to the right of the fourth row. It is very difficult for the person seated on the left behind the pilot to see out the right window because of the space between the seats. The two seats in the back row where my husband and I sat are close together, but the windows in that row are smaller, so the person sitting beside the window obstructs most of the view of the person sitting on the left. Had I known this in advance, I would have booked the plane for 4 persons instead of 6 persons so that we could all sit on the right side (if that is even possible). Despite these issues, I saw some wonderful views and highly recommend Wings Over Kauai.
I was sitting on the left side of the plane - as was my husband. Saw very little as most of the scenery was on the right side of the plane.
The route is wonderful, the attention is spectacular and the historical data made everything seem like a movie.

review_title: A wonderful and personal way to view Kauai
review_text: Taking a flight with Wings over Kauai is a wonderful way to see the beautiful and magnificently stunning island of Kauai. I was really pleasantly surprised by all the personal touches that Wings had included in their flight (from the warm and friendly greeting, to the really interesting information they had during the flight, and the lovely complimentary gifts they gave us) and I would highly recommend this if you are visiting this island. It is well worth the price. Thank you Bruce and Mary (and the rest of the gang) for offering this service and allowing me and many others to see this beautiful island that you live on :). Mahalo and Aloha!

This was my first seaplane ride.  Im not fond of small planes, but it was actually a very enjoyable experience.  The pilot was great.  The scenery from above was fabulous.  And it was a far better option for me than the ferry.  Would absolutely travel with this company again on my next trip!

During these uncertain times, Talkeetna Air Taxi was spot on about carrying out the COVID-19 mandates but still providing a life changing experience. The staff was exceptional and our pilot was the owner and thee best. Our take off was so smooth that we didn’t even realize we lifted off. Paul was informative about pointing out highlights along our trip. I have never taken a flight sight seeing tour and if I could make you understand how worth it this was.. this is my plea. It took my breath away. It’s definitely bucket list material. I didn’t know it’s what I always wanted. 😆🏔❤️

Thanks Harry for a smooth flight and delightful information about the island.  The sights were spectacular. You can really see the differences of each side of the island.  My only compliant was my setting, near the wing and supports; it was difficult to get some shots with out including them.
But overall, LOVED IT!!!
ellajeff96

review_title: The only way to see Denali
review_text: This was the highlight of my vacation. The entire experience was terrific! Dorothy, our pilot was excellent, from the information she shared, the route she took and complete flight process. I was extremely lucky to be her "co-pilot" and had to best seat in the plane. It's truly an amazing way to see Denali!

Awesome experience of flying with Talkeetna Air Taxi. All the representatives were very helpful, warm and welcoming. Pilot was very friendly, explained everything about the trip, Denali mountains etc., also, patiently answered all the questions that we had. They picked us from our hotel and also dropped us to the area of our choice, hence it was very convenient for us as we didn't have any car and quite a bit of luggage. Overall, we feel that we made the right choice to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi, would love to visit again.
WOW! This excursion was amazing & afforadable! We saw the Maui coastline and beautiful waterfalls. Our Pilot Eric was fantastic!

Our pilot, Andrew, was fabulous. Knowledgeable, confident, professional. The time in the plane as well as on the glacier was worth every penny spent. It was an amazing, awe inspiring, spectacular trip!

review_title: One of the best flights we've had
review_text: This is our fifth time to Alaska and we have flown around Denali multiple times. Chris was our pilot, and this was the best flight yet. He was a great narrator and the fact it was a beautiful day made it better. I would highly recommend the extra $ for a glacier landing.
The pilot is very informative. Flight was very smooth and pilot show us some of the beautiful spots in maui. So amazing experience!! Will recoomend

The customer service staff are less than helpful. We were given the wrong time to turn up so had to wait over an hour; and instead of being greeted with a friendly welcome we got a "give me your credit card" which tainted the experience somewhat. But when we eventually got to meet the pilot, Rivers, he was friendly. His tour narration was excellent - not irritating and egotistical as many of the other tours have been - and the flight was excellent. We went right into the canyon, 45 min tour and it truly is the best way to see the Grand Canyon (we flew from Tusayan airport). We were both sat in the front and had excellent views. Highly recommend this tour but hope the counter staff sharpen their customer service.

Great ride amazing views! Every island had something to offer. The drink at the end was refreshing!

Highly recommend and the pilot was skilled and the landing was calm.

My wife and I had a fantastic time on our flight and it was one of the highlights of our trip to Hawaii. I booked this flight as an instructional flight because I have my license and wanted the experience of flying in Hawaii. Ellen helped me with the reservation and was extremely friendly and helpful. Bruce was our tour guide and flight instructor and allowed me to handle the controls on 99% of the flight. He made the flight relaxing and easy for me and provided some great information about flying in general and flying in the local environment. At the same time he provided my wife, who was riding in the back, with some great information about Kauai as we circumnavigated the island. We both had an outstanding time and would do it again in a heartbeat. I highly recommend this company as it is a family business and they provide excellent service and are very knowledgable. Thank you to Bruce, Ellen, and Allison for a great time!

Our family of 4 did this trip and it was absiluetly spectacular.  The pilot was great and shared a lot of info with us.  The glacier landing is a must.  Really cool.  Highly recoomend and worth the price!

Our flight in the Snoopy two Bi-Plane with Pilot Kevin was the most exhilerated, fabulous time ever!!!!! A dream come true! Beautiful sites and lts of interesting facts about Hawaii. 
This is a must do!
Thanks so much, Kevin and AirVentures!
Elisa
We flew with Talkeetna Air Taxi on three consecutive days:  twice heli-hiking & once flight-seeing.  Customer service is exceptional.  Our pilots were incredible.

I was not going to take a Denali Scenic Flight because of the cost. But, my husband said that I should really see the scale of the park from the air. I am so glad he insisted! It was one of the highlights of our trip! We did the Mountain Voyager Flight. Our pilot was Nick, whom we actually knew from business back in Utah (small world!). The flight was spectacular, flying over Ruth’s Glacier, past the Moose’s Tooth and by Mt. Hunter. The views of Denali itself were breathtaking. I was in awe and silent most of the flight!
TAKE THIS TOUR if you are in Talkeetna!
This was a great flight.  We had Zero complaints.  It was definitely worth it.  Our pilot, Mike, did a great job; very smooth ride.
Great place, clean and efficient. Arnie was a fantastic host - went out of his way to make our experience great. 45-minute tour is the right amount of time. Thanks for a great experience.
Breathtaking views, amazing flight. Once in a lifetime experience that you will never forget. In Maui you gotta put this on your list of things to do

review_title: Favorite thing we did in Alaska
review_text: I went back and forth about doing this tour, both due to the cost and because I'm a slightly nervous flyer. Our original date was cancelled due to weather. I almost ended up taking the refund, but am so glad I rescheduled instead. This ended up being the favorite thing my family did in Alaska. We did the glacier landing, which was absolutely amazing. It also allowed us to actually see Denali, which we weren't able to do in Denali National Park (due to clouds). Our pilot has been flying since he was 6 (!) and I felt more comfortable as his passenger than on any commercial flight I have taken. (He's also a pretty good photographer. He offered to take pictures of our family on the glacier and I'm so glad to have some of all four of us). He let our 9 year old son sit in the co-pilot's seat, which I am sure my son will talk about nonstop for years. If booking this, I recommend building some flexibility into your schedule, in case of cancellations. We stayed in Talkeetna for two nights, so were able to easily move things around once our original flight was cancelled.
The flight was amazing, we saw the north shore with waterfalls. The pilot was wonderful, and very helpful. Came with my mom and younger brother, great for kids.11/10!!
An amazing flight and the pilot/guide was incredible.   Loved the sites and whales Must do experience of a life time.  You will not regret it

review_title: Book it now you crazy fool!!
review_text: HOLY BALLS! WORTH EVERY CENT!! This was one of the most amazing things I’ve ever done. You have to add the glacier landing too. The whole thing was breathtaking. Chris was the best pilot! He shared lots of knowledge on the area as we flew. Do not pass up this opportunity. BOOK IT!!!
Amazing views, got to see the whales from up the skies. Best experience ever! Also the views of the ocean were very pretty. I highly recommend to book!

What an awesome day! This was such a special way to experience the Grand Canyon from the sky, land, and by water. The day was so well organized and the simplicity of transitioning from one event to the next was so nice. The cost for this trip was the only thing that caused us pause, but ultimately we found it to be worth the investment.

This was my first time on a flight tour.  It was well worth the money to see the islands.  The pilot was very professional and courteous.  I felt very comfortable with his expertise and skill of flying.

I wished for this flight for my 50th birthday and I couldn't have asked for anything better.
The communication beforehand was very friendly and helpful.
The pilot was super nice and told us a lot about the features of the area during the flight.
It was an exciting adventure that I can only recommend to everyone.

One of the highlights of my stay in Miami. Incredible views. You really get to see the beauty of Miami:  the beaches, the skylines, the turquoise blue sea and the homes of the stars. Tony the pilot is a legend. So friendly and clearly loves his job and Miami. I have already recommended Miami Seaplanes to a few people. It's a treat, and great value for what you get.
Sunset was beautiful. We got to see 2 rainbows and the champagne was amazing! Service was amazing!!!

review_title: 1 hr flight over Miami, Miami Beach and Key Biscayne
review_text: One of the best moments of my vacation...with the best pilot, he got passion and love for his job. The panorama from the sky is WONDERFUL. This words cannot describe how beautiful this experience is. You HAVE TO DO IT!!! You'll fly over Miami, Miami Beach to North Miami Beach, Key Biscayne, Coconut Grove.

This was a side trip from the Alaskan cruise in late August.  Larry our pilot was very knowledgable and asked if we had a veteran in our group of 6.  I'm a navy vet, female, and 74 and he invited me to sit in the co-pilot seat!  He had to help hoist me up there and down again and was extremely polite and respectful! I didn't take photos because I didn't want to miss any of the sights. The tour was exciting as I had never been in a seaplane before. Would definitely recommend it as a once in a lifetime experience.

Can't say you will be flying in comfort plane's cabin is small, no leg room, noisy, warm and the head gear is hot.  However, the view of the island's many waterfalls, the beauty of the terrain and the skilled, knowledgeable and friendly pilot will make the discomfort of the cabin a small inconvenience. Would recommend to anyone.
This was the highlight of our trip! It was significantly cheaper than doing a heli ride and the pilot really knew what he was doing

Fabulous flight with Eric, who ensured all pre-flight safety, confidence & comfort of our passengers, checked the “must-see” views before departure, then created a bespoke itinerary to match our requests. The journey enabled us to have fabulous views over land and sea, with an informed and engaging commentary. A fabulous way to see this lovely island of Maui.

The checkin process was strained and tedious. The lady in charge of our checking in seemed to almost resent us being there. I was concerned!!! When we met our pilot, Marcus, I relaxed. He was outgoing and personable. He handled the controls and flying expertly and pointed out numerous things we would have missed. He swung around for another look at a whale he spotted so we could all see. The flight was dreaded by one of our group due to a previous bad experience but he was smiling throughout this one and we all enjoyed ourselves!! The takeoff and landing were both smooth and not at all scary. Would highly recommend. Would definitely do this again on any return trip.

We took the Denali Grand tour and we were just speechless the entire flight. The views were out of this world. The entire experience from check in to landing was top notch! Completely worth the money!
An incredible way to see the Canyon. Thoroughly enjoyed our flight, all staff friendly and helpful. Would recommend.

review_title: Great way to see the geography!
review_text: Our Air Ventures flight provided amazing aerial views of Kauai, including the Napali Coast, the Waimea Canyon, several beautiful waterfalls, bays and beaches. Seeing the remote waterfalls, and coral reefs from the air was a special treat. The friendly staff greeted us upon our arrival at Air Ventures, and our pilot introduced himself before walking with us to the plane. The plane was clean and comfortable. The smooth ride and big windows made it easy to take pictures.
Talkeetna Air Taxi could not have been more accomodating in every way.  The customer service was exceptional as was the entire experience.  Would highly recommend.  Don't miss this!

This was our favorite part of the trip. Seeing the island from the air is amazing. I was a little nervous but it turned out fine. Our pilot Doug was amazing and very knowledgeable about the island. If you get a chance definitely put this on your list of things to do.

Absolutely stunning views and our pilot, Chris, was very knowledgable about the area. We were fortunate enough that the weather played along and were able to land on the glacier, which was the highlight of the flight. 
Complimentary champagne and snacks on the glacier would have made the experience extra special...hint hint.

review_title: Beautiful, Comfortable, Fun, We Would Do It Again!
review_text: My wife and I did this air tour and thoroughly enjoyed it.  In addition to the pilot, Randy, there were three others on the flight.  We flew in a very well maintained 1958 deHavilland Beaver which alone is worth the trip, but we also saw the beauty of Dinali and the glaciers from the air.  As described, each person has a headset so that they can hear the description offered by the pilot and so that they can ask questions.  K2 picked us up at our hotel at the designated time and returned us after the flight.  We had a fairly good day weather-wise and were able to take a lot of beautiful pictures; the flight itself was very relaxing with little to zero turbulence (this is weather dependent I suppose), and the pilot/guide was very informative.  We would certainly do this again in the future and recommend it to others.

Wonderful experience! The pilot, Tony, was very nice and flew very smooth. I am afraid of flying but the tour was amazing. It’s only 30 minutes but it’s worth it. Aniel, the boat pilot that took us to the seaplane is also very charismatic and gentle. I definitely recommend and I will tour again next time with them.

We had the 'Red Baron' experience, surely the flight of a lifetime !!
Harry, our pilot, was as professional as kind, very  caring and so  easy-going. He was happy to spend some time to explain us some details about the plane/engine  and  cheerful while giving  us instructions to be safe and  to fully enjoy every moment of the flight. 
Harry and the staff went out of their way and  took photos of us before and after the flight: such  great memories! 
Flying inside an open cockpit is completely different from your usual flying experience on small airplanes or helicopters. WOW !! Unsurpassable !!
We were  at first worried to be cold, but this wasn’t the case :  a simple t-shirt makes you feel comfortable as if you were on ground. And the whole experience is really AWESOME !!
We enjoyed very much the one hour flight and would surely recommend the Red Baron as an excellent experience. We’ll be back !!   Thank you !!

Booked through Holland America and well worth it. Our pilot, Larry, went out of his way to put a nervous passenger (me!) instantly at ease and provided an unforgettable two hour trip which my husband and I would highly recommend and would repeat in a heartbeat if ever in Ketchikan. Fabulous scenery, wonderful background narration by Larry (which included a great selection of music) plus great chat from Larry. Landing in the Fjord was so special and tranquil. (PS. Larry gives great hugs too!)

June 21 8:30am Grand Denali flight was amazing, awesome, beautiful.....! Brad was our pilot and did an outstanding job. It was a beautiful clear day so the summit was in full view. Amazing seeing the base camp and trails of the climbers. Glacier landing was pretty cool. Flight was very smooth. Highly recommend Talkeetna Air Taxi. It was the highlight of our entire trip.

review_title: The only way to see the whole Napali coast without walking.
review_text:
The trip was easy to book and also easy to find (at the Lihue Airport). The limo was ready at the gate but it was only a short walk to the plane, no limo required. The weather was perfect and we had the added excitement of seeing a passenger aircraft heading down the runway towards us before take-off. 
Because of weight distribution, I sat on the left side of the plane but throughout the flight our young pilot kept asking "did you get a good look, "and would turn the plane around so that I could also see the spectacular scenery of the Napali coastline.
This is a highly recommended tour as its the only way to really see this spectacular piece of Kauai.

I asked my fiancé  to marry me at Cavallo point and planned this flight for afterwards. I actually used the flight as a decoy to keep the proposal a surprise and make sure she knew we had something fun planned. The flight was perfect. Low stress, remarkable views and great customer service.  There was another family on the plane (a couple with a young child), and the two of us. You will be on the plane with 2-3 other people potentially but that doesn't detract from the magic of the fight at all. You scoop over the city, the bay, the golden gate bridge and Alcatraz. I've lived here in Marin & SF for 7 years and can't believe I haven't been up in a plane! It really gives you a dramatic perspective of the beauty of the Bay Area. Afterwards you could easily pop over to Sausalito and grab a bite to eat or hop a ferry back to the city. I would highly recommend this to anyone looking for a fun adventure, tourists and locals alike!
Fabuleux! Un voyage inoubliable de 45 minutes au dessus de San Francisco.  Gardez les yeux ouverts. C'est magique!

I came to TripAdvisor looking for a Kauai helicopter tour recommendation and stumbled onto the superlative reviews for "Wings Over Kauai".  Changed our plans and REALLY glad we did.......the experience was the BEST ever and really was the highlight of our 25th anniversary trip to Kauai and the Big Island.

Here's why:

1.)  Bruce is an excellent pilot and the flight was extremely smooth.  Even though he gave tips to avoid motion sickness I felt nothing but glee and delight on being aboard and seeing the sights.......couldn't get enough.  The avoidance of symptoms was I'm sure in large part due to Bruce's flying abilities.  

2.)  Ellen and Bruce were VERY VERY accomodating in rescheduling our flight due to overcast and cloudy conditions which plagued us during the majority of our trip.  We were rescheduled from Tuesday to Wed to Thursday AM (right before we left Kauai) in order to allow the best viewing conditions possible.  I seriously doubt many copter tours would have done the same.  Ellen and Bruce knew how special our trip was to us and wanted us to have the same experience with our Kauai flight. As a result, we actually saw Waimea Canyon and several North shore beaches in bright sunshine vs. our road trips earlier in the week.  Saw the NaPali coast in all its glory and admired all the named and unamed waterfalls gracing this magnificent island.  

3.)  Ellen and Bruce are the friendliest folks ever.  They are wonderful proprietors of their family-run business and treat you like they would a friend or neighbor.  They even loaned us one of their guidebooks and gave us suggestions on the North shore when we mentioned we would be driving there.

I could go on and on but suffice it to say that taking a flight with "Wings Over Kauai" will be one of the  most enjoyable and memorable experiences ever  (ono ono).

Mahalo Ellen and Bruce!  :-)

-Sandra and Phil C.

We loved our scenic flight over Arches National Park.  Tim is a great pilot and pointed out many highlights and shared background info.  We took the driving tour of Arches in the afternoon and it was neat to see from the ground after having the aerial perspective.  It was a lot of fun and Tim did a great job!

Nuestro viaje ha sido maravilloso en compañía de "Tony" el mejor piloto de Miami !
Recuerdos y momentos inolvidables

Notre voyage a été merveilleux en compagnie de "Tony" le meilleur pilote de Miami !
Souvenirs et moments inouviables.

review_title: Only way to see Monument Valley with Navajo reservation locked down
review_text: Excellent tour! This was the only way for us to see Monument Valley since the Reservation is still closed. We flew around Lake Powell and landed at Monument Valley after flying around for us to view. A Navajo guide told us about Navajo life and then drove us out to see part of the valley that is currently accessible. We then took off and flew over to view the Grand Canyon from the air. Awesome!

review_title: Classic Misty Fjords Flightseeing Taquan Air - Rude Pilot Behavior
review_text: I did this excursion today on 06/20/2013 and I had a bad experience on this ride which I would like to share especially from the pilot of of our float plane.  First of all he tried to accommodate 6 people on the plane and I was asked to sit all the way in the back where there was no cushion for your back.  My back is still hurting.  Taquan air says guaranteed window seats but they do not tell you that their back seats do not have cushions on it.  The reason I did not create a fuss on the spot was because that was the last tour and my ship was leaving in 1 hour and there was no other tour available so us it as an advice and if you book it through Taquan air make sure to ask at the counter that they are not asking you to sit in the back.  I forgot the name of the pilot but he was the oldest pilot in their team and it was my bad luck that I had to fly with him.

Flew to and back from Friday Harbor.  What a cool experience.  They give ya a tour as you go over the islands.  We were fortunate enough to see a Trident sub on the way back.  Very cool.  Sadly no whales.  Great flight - smoothest take off and landing we've ever experienced.  The fly low enough for great views.  They even went out of their way to mail back my hat!  They picked us up at Sea-Tac and took us back.  Well worth the little bit extra.  Definitely a great part of our trip out to Friday Harbor.

review_title: Thank you for the experience K2
review_text: Our trip was spectacular!   Worth every dime we paid.   Our pilot Will was so informed and put one of our nervous travelers at ease.  K2 runs their business like a well oiled machine.  So much of what we have done and seen here in Alaska, seems like things have been MacGyvered or not top quality,  but not the case for K2. Their facilities were spotless and each employee we were in contact with was on top of their game.

review_title: Great, but small plane !  Worth doing !
review_text: The plane is small and hard to get into if you on the heavy side. Hard to get a good photo without the wing struts getting into the way. Feel safe in the plane ! The pilot was friendly ! Would do again if they had a longer flight that went around the mountains ( Mt. Hood or Adams ). Teens and small kids I think would like it !

The pilot was amazing and put everyone who was nervous about flying on our trip at ease.  Excellent flying and landing.  Super friendly and helpful staff.  Beautiful sights of the glacier and summit.  We had good weather and did the glacier landing, which was well worth the extra money.  By far the best tour of our trip!!  Everything about the tour was perfect!

review_title: Spend the money and do this!
review_text: This was the highlight of our trip... though costly, the tour with the glacier landing is unforgettable. The views of the mountains and glaciers are stunning, making for some great photos. It's amazing to land on a glacier and have it be 60+ degrees. Save up a few dollars and do this, you won't regret it!

review_title: A must do at the Grand Canyon
review_text: The experience was amazing.  Great views of the Canyon.  You can't get the birds-eye view, except in the air.  Skip the touristy photo-op before you get on, just do a selfie on your own and save $20.00

review_title: The best guys to do a flightseeing tour with!
review_text: I organize trips and it's been 2 years since our first arrangement with K2. They've always been amazing and overdeliver (longer flights than promised, outstanding pilots, friendly service)

Experience was great, we schedule the flight at 7:30 til 8:30 because we wanted to have the chance to watch the sunset, unfortunately the administration that is in charge of this did not make it at the time it was schedule for, we also arrived 30 min before to not have any issue and be in the sky before the sunset instead of that we waited for a hour in the lobby, the city was still beautiful during the night time and the person flying us was really nice and attentive.
Amazing experience! The view from the plane is gorgeous. I recommend doing it, it’s worth it! Thank you

Booked at the very last minute due to another operator cancelling and was so glad we did. Great flight with amazing scenery, we even caught an avalanche. Good knowledge from the pilot made the journey even more interesting. 

I’d highly recommend this company!

We weren't able to do the tour we wanted to do due to clouds and wind at the summit, but K2 did everything they could to get us on another tour.  We weren't disappointed!  Pilot was awesome and the views were, of course, breathtaking.  Definitely something not to be missed.

We recently did the air tour over kauai with Air Ventures Hawaii. We really really enjoyed seeing the island from the air and the prices were great! It is the only way to see alot of the island. We are recommending this tour to everyone.

Had a wonderful detailed flight over Kauai.  We saw many waterfalls, beaches, mountains, and volcanic formations. We saw the coffee plantation and where "celebrities" live. Pilot very informative and professional.

Muy profesionales y te dan seguridad en todo el proceso. Es importante saber que el aterrizaje en el glaciar dependerá del clima (y en promedio es bastante malo), pero aún así no puedan aterrizar las vistas de los glaciares y del Monte McKinley son impresionantes!

I can only recommend this tour. It's a little family business. The flight was absolutely amazing and worth every penny. Captain Bruce is super friendly, a very experienced pilot and knows everything about the island. 100% recommendable. You won't regret it.

We had a great time with our pilot Steve. He was very friendly and knowledgeable, and he showed us breathtaking views of Maui and the surrounding islands, especially Molokai. The flight was one of our favorite parts of a wonderful trip to Maui.

One tip: Steve told us that it’s generally better to fly earlier in the morning. There are fewer clouds, so the views and turbulence are better, and there’s less air traffic.

What an incredible way to see all of the island, especially the waterfalls, the Napali Coast, and the North Shore. We were staying in Poipu and could pick out our condo from the air, as well as see all the way we had walked a couple days before from the Hyatt to Gillens Beach. Tunnels Beach and its reef as well as Waimea Canyon also stood out as aerial viewing treats.

All 4 passengers were on the right side of the plane, so everyone could see everything, and all had unobstructed viewing out the large windows. We had a lovely day, and Josh our pilot was first rate. We got a free DVD at the end, with our picture on it in front of the plane. Just one word of caution to those who get motion sickness. I don't, and thought the flight was pretty smooth, but my husband had taken 2 Bonine and even so was a little queasy by the end of the one hour flight.

We took this plane tour of the island and Captain Marcus was great!  He pointed out all the sights below and was very knowledgeable about the island and history.  Very smooth flight and a great way to see the geography of the island.

review_title: Girls trip--traveling with one in a wheelchair!
review_text:
I was assured traveling with one in a wheelchair & enjoying this plane ride would not be a problem.  
Everything was perfect.  She was lifted from her wheelchair up into the seat on the plane,  Eric our pilot was wonderful-very informative --great personality!  Highly recommend this company!

Glen was a great pilot and we had a beautiful trip in the air and over the grand canyon. Glen was knowledgeable and kind but more importantly he kept us all safe. We really loved this trip and would highly recommend using Maverick!
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_title: A great part of our trip to Kauai
review_text:
I would highly recommend this tour.  A very competent, accommodating family-run operation.

We waited till we got to the island and saw what the weather was like, then phoned Wings over Kauai directly.  They were very helpful and gave us a number of options for times over the next several days.

When we arrived at Lihue Airport, check-in was fast and friendly.  As they promised, all four of us got seats on the right-hand side of the plane, which gives everyone a nice view of the various coastlines, especially the Na Pali coast.  The pilot Bruce engaged everyone on the two-way conversation, and included very informative commentary without making it seem like he had given the same patter on each of the 5000 or more times he has flown the circuit.

Sure, you don't get as close to the scenery as you do in the helicopters, but it's still a great view.  Very comfortable plane, no weight restrictions like the helicopters have, and a guarantee of a view out the right side.   Good value for the money.

review_title: Beautiful day flying and landing on glacier
review_text: So thankful for a perfect day to fly and land on a glacier in beautiful Denali National Park. Everyone has a window seat and headset so you can hear the pilot describe all you’re seeing

We had taken a helicopter trip the last time we were in Kauai, but we were both pleasantly surprised that this plane trip was much more enjoyable. Josh, the captain, gave a great narration of all the beautiful sights we were seeing. We were able to see more of the island; the service and quality of the flight was excellent! Would highly recommend this company to travelers!
Our pilot was very polite and a lot of fun! 10 out of 10 would do it again! Thank you for the great tour
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: Everything from booking the flight to the actual flight itself was great.  Our pilot had a lot of great information to share with us about what we were flying over.  I would definitely fly with them again.  Next time I'd go for the glacier landing.
We had an amazing experience. The sunset flight was stunning. I loved how our pilot explained everything so we wouldn't worry about air bumps, etc. Absolutely recommend it!

review_title: Put this on your list of "Must do's" whilst in Miami
review_text: Truly fabulous experience! and a great way to see Miami and Key Biscayne. Full of interesting information and fantastic views. Our pilot was very friendly and his enthusiasm and knowledge of the area made the trip extra enjoyable. This is a must do when you're next in Miami - cannot fault these guys, well worth it!

review_title: The highlight of an amazing trip!
review_text:
It was a little disorganized and I was unhappy that they refused to transport my mother’s wheelchair on the bus. However, our pilot was just fantastic!!  This should not be missed.  The views are just incredible.  
I also left a cell phone behind and they retrieved it for me. A+

We took a flightseeing tour (and all-you-can-eat crab feast) during our cruise on the Sapphire Princess.  The tour group met us at the bottom of the gangway, escorted us to the lodge for an early lunch, and then we traveled back to Ketchikan during a 30-minute flight on a DeHavilland Beaver.  I had always wanted to take a flight from the water and this was a great time.  Three couples were on-board and my wife and I volunteered to sit separately.  She sat in the back and I got to fly "right-seat" with the pilot.  WHAT A THRILL!  The price for the tour was a bit high, but what a great time.
What a way to see the beautiful island of Kauai. The view from the open cockpit is amazing. Kevin is a great tour guide and pilot. Don't miss the chance to enjoy Kauai in this unique, fun way.

This was amazing! Presley was great and super friendly! The flight over the Grand Canyon was beautiful, Antelope Canyon was like being in a different world and Trey was our guide through there….he showed us some of the best views to get great pictures…. Kelly took us out on the boat and let me just tell you, it was amazing! This was soooo worth it!

I have a fear of falling - so just getting on the plane was a LOT of work - once we were airborne, the flight was so smooth - I was completely relaxed and enjoyed the INCREDIBLE views of the Canyon and Page Arizona!  HIGHLY recomended!

review_title: Amazing trip to the Grand Canyon
review_text: We wanted to visit the Grand Canyon from Las Vegas and chose the Connoisseur trip offered by Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines. We didn’t fancy a lengthy bus trip, so chose this option as it involved a 30 minute bus from our Vegas hotel to Boulder City airport and a 1 hour flight to the Grand Canyon airport at the South Rim. Not only was the flight quicker but we got some great views on the way flying over the Hoover Dam, Lake Mead and some of the Canyon. We then transferred to a bus where our excellent driver and guide Steve took us to two different viewpoints - Bright Angel and Mathers Point where we spent about an hour at each. We would have loved longer to absorb the amazing views, but it still gave us enough time to enjoy it. Overall spending about 3 hours at the Canyon is probably longer than the average tour coming from Vegas. The flight in terms of view and reduced travel time was worth the extra cost. Not cheap for a family of four but well worth it.

We had a wonderful experience! Patrick was a charming and knowledgeable pilot.  Spectacular views! We were fortunate enough to see an avalanche in progress! The trip overall was outstanding and we had a perfect day for it!

This was a beautiful, memorable experience.  Our pilot, Cameron, was very informative, knowledgeable, and took us to see some awesome sights of the island.  He circled back a few times, because we couldn’t quite see the waterfalls ( they were under us) or we wanted to get a better look.  There is no better way to see the whole island, waterfalls, Waimea Canyon, and especially the NaPali coast than from the air.
Best experience while on the island!  Unforgettable!  Mahalo Cameron!

I booked a tour to Misty Fjords. We were greeted by friendly staff and smiles all around. The process was easy and organized. We watched a simple video on plane safety then walked outside to meet our Pilot. We were paired with Jake who split us based on weight and seated us quickly and we took to the sky. I was in the co-pilot seat and Jake made us all feel comfortable with an awesome music selection. He told us about sights below but respectfully left space for quiet reflection. Every moment of this flight was beautiful and we will be flying with Taquan Air the next chance we have. When in Ketchikan, don't pass this up and go with Jake. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

review_title: Best view of geologic wonders! Ask for pilot Dave.
review_text: Amazing view of geologic wonders. To get an idea of the scope and variety of this unique area you must see it from the air. Pilot Dave was wonderful explaining the vistas, pointing out famous locations and answering questions. Smooth low flying flight. Stunning!

We had a glacier experience canceled due to weather!  There was no apology or attempt to rebook or even a voucher for a discount on a future flight!  It put a huge damper on our entire trip!  It was cloudy but never rained where we were!  Very disappointed!

I can’t say enough about this experience. It was absolutely one of the highlights of our vacation. I was apprehensive about taking a small plane anywhere,but landing on a glacier was so worth the concern. Everyone was professional from the staff at the office to the pilot. I was brave enough to sit in the co-pilots seat  on the way back and enjoyed every second. The pilot was amazing showing us as much as possible of the area. We considered ourselves lucky to have such a spectacular trip.

We had a great experience with Talkeetna Air Taxi, from the scheduling phone call, the pickup service, the front desk ladies, the pilot. Trip up and landed on the glacier. Yea we know its alot of $$$, but if your here and the weather permits, DO IT!!! It is well worth it, Just WOW !

review_title: Would not have missed this for the world
review_text: Our pilot BJ was brilliant and funny. The trip took us over the forest before taking us over the edge! The colours of the canyon were spectacular and ever changing. Good views of the Colorado River and you could see rafts running the rapids. Spectacular view of the North Rim and when we flew over the forest it opened up into open grassland where we saw herds of Bison just to cap off our trip.

review_title: Simply spectacular -- our best tour ever
review_text:
From our first contact with Wings Over Kauai, through to their “thank you” email and photos, everything was simply first class.
Friendly, personalized and professional are the three adjectives that best describe their service.
Captain Bruce, as well as being a considerate pilot (comfortable, smooth flight) is a wealth of information about the island.
The flight was spectacular and we enjoyed aerial views of inaccessible terrain as well as features (Wailua Falls, for example) we had seen on our road trips.
We had a rewarding and memorable experience and thoroughly recommend the team to all visitors who wish to see Kauai from the air. Thank you Bruce, Ellen and Maren.
We booked the mountain voyager tour through Talkeetna Air taxi on our recent trip and it was a great experience! The pilot was really nice and it was a smooth ride.
My boyfriend booked this for our last sunset on Maui. It was perfect. He got to help drive the plane which added to the fun.

review_title: WORTH IT! (Pick pilot Joe, if you can)
review_text: Our trip was amazing. Well worth the time and money even if you have done that kind of thing before.  Our pilot, Joe was awesome. He made the trip. Not just giving a history lesson but really telling us what's it like to live and fly in Alaska. Thanks Joe.

What an awesome flight we had!  The whole experience from first contact to de-planing was top notch!  I was concerned that my husband who is 6'8" would be able to fit and was told his height would not be a problem - he sat in the co-pilot seat and had the time of his life!  Lesley in the office was a delight to work with and Steve our pilot was so knowledgable and professional.  We had the flight of our lives!  To be able to soar above such pristine forests and lakes was a flight we will never forget!  Thank you Steve for an unbelievable flight and Lesley for your lovely kindness!

This was the most amazing experience we have ever had. Leaving the earth in a beautiful, classic bush plane from the 1950’s. Our pilot, Maury, was clearly in love with the plane and his job. He could not have done a better job of safety orientation, or educating us about what we were getting ready to experience. He was also very good about preparing us for the possibility of turbulence, although we had almost none. There are no words to describe this flight - it was surreal. With headphones, it was amazingly quiet. We saw no other planes while in the sky. Maury did a great job of narration, but also gave us quiet time to just experience this remarkable adventure. We strongly recommend this magical trip to you.
Fantastic flight which was safe and smooth and a great experience and we were able to see some whales and we’d do it again. Brilliant.

Took the airvan tour with Marcus and it was the best decision ever! Kauai is absolutely gorgeous and we can’t traverse all the vistas on road making the air tour a must! Marcus was amazing with his calm voice explaining everything about the plane, route and Kauai’s history and tour details. The company overall gave me warm and genuine vibes which I loved. Even the check process was great.

Breathtaking views, wonderful tour guide, private plane, thoughtful and spiritual experience! My husband and I just did this on our honeymoon (we were able to book same day!), and we will remember it for a lifetime! Thank you to our guide Erik! 
We were greeted with leis, and a VIP golf cart and ended with a refreshing beverage. Can’t say thank you enough!
Our pilot was great! And the day was so clear everyone got to see the summit.  Hardly any clouds at all.

It was a nice experience seeing the mountains from the air. Daughter also had fun Cosplaying on top of the Denali. We went to both glacier landing and day cruise and we all agree that glacier landing was much better time/ money spent. The flight was smooth and the pilot was nice and friendly. I suggest making the appointment in early time/day of your trip so you can rearrange another flight in case weather condition not allowed. 
Recommended camera lens: Any focal length between 35mm to 70mm should work well, from the sky or on the Glacier. I brought 24-105mm on my full frame DSLR but I would just bring 50mm if I come again.

This was a fantastic way to see the islands - our pilot was super about explaining what we were seeing with some history, some humor and a big dose of Aloha spirit.  Don't miss this experience - from the moment I booked the flight until we landed we had fantastic service.  Thanks Val and Eric and everyone involved in our once-in-a-lifetime adventure!

I was stoked to see the Jurassic Falls and that was the main reason why I went on this tour and of course, to see the beautiful island. Our pilot was super friendly and kind, we liked her.  My husband and I really enjoyed the tour and it was a beautiful sight to see. Totally worth it and the price is great!!

Eric, my son, Tina his wife, and I were happy that we had added a Talkeetna Air Taxi flight that included a glacier landing to our itinerary. That flight was awesome to Mt. Denali, the tallest mountain in North America. I felt as though we had landed one level shy of Heaven -- total silence, pure white snow with diamond crystals, the bluest of skies, white fluffy clouds. The only words I could utter were "Thank You, God".

This review is long overdue as we did this back in January 2012.
This was one of the best experiences of my life so far. I got to sit in the front and be co-pilot which was so much fun. The views were amazing. There's so much of this island that you can only see by air or by water. My husband and I decided to do the aerial experience by plane as opposed to helicopter because it is quite a bit cheaper. The two of us could go for same price as one in a helicopter. The family that runs this tour are so nice and you get a souvenir photo and DVD to take home and share with friends and family.

Our daughter gave us an air tour over Denali for Christmas!  The people here were very friendly and easygoing.  Our pilot was very capable and knowledgeable. AMAZING up close views of No. America’s highest peak.  My husband and I were a little uneasy about the small plane ( ?185, 2 seater + pilot and copilot, smaller than the one pictured) but our pilot, Chris, was awesome!  Smoothest flight we’ve ever experienced!  An expensive excursion but well worth it!  If you are going to visit Alaska, save your pennies and do this, it’s well worth it!!

We had a fantastic experience. Eric was our pilot, and he was engaging, informative and considerate. He was thoughtful in asking questions of the little girl on our tour and engaged the future pilot with us as well! He was able to answer our questions, had a great sense of humour and appeared truly genuine in his passion for flying. The flight itself was fantastic. Our Napali boat trip had been cancelled due to weather; while this had been our second choice, we were really glad it worked out this way. We were able to see way more of the island than we'd thought possible and enjoyed every minute of it. Would definitely highly recommend!

review_title: The nearest I've been to heaven
review_text:
Since I was unable to parasail or zip line, I decided to take the plane to see Kaua'i.  It really completed my trip to Maui and Kaua'i.  I wanted to jump right out of the plane - the beauty is like nothing I've ever seen.  The flight and crew were wonderful - we had doubts in the beginning if we would fly that morning but we did!  The Napali coast is truly a wonder of the world.  My seatmate and I kept switching our cameras-we each had pictures of the right and left side of the plane.  I felt like I had seen "it all" after taking this flight - it just went by too quickly.

Mary Statsmann

It was a christmas gift for my girlfriend and we just did the champagne sunset tour on a late sunny Sunday afternoon. the team of seaplane adventures was wearing masks all the time and handled everything really responsible. It felt safe all the time. the pilot was awesome, was making jokes, but was also telling a lot of information about the points of interest. it was just great. after the flight we had time for some little more talk and the champagne in the sun. I will definitely surprise my parents with that, as soon as they are able to visit us.

Absolute best flight tour company in miami! Incredible service and so much fun. Great prices and super safe.
Thank you for making our vacation fun!!!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We had the opportunity to tour Kauai 3 weeks ago. I knew we were off to a great start when I noticed the Virginia Tech decorations in the office. Bruce is able to combine Aloha spirit with Virginia hospitality. The flight was smooth and so relaxing that I almost forgot to take photos. His knowledge of the island is outstanding and the view from the plane was unbelievable. Thanks for a  memorable addition to our vacation.

This flight over Mt St Helen's is AMAZING!  Spencer is a great pilot and explained what we were seeing and what occurred in May 1980.  The mountain was steaming in several locations - how many people do you know can say they flew over an "active volcano"!

Trip Advisor review

Our family group of 5 decided to take the Floatplane bear watching shore excursion.   It was a bit pricey but we expected it because you’re flying in a floatplane Believe me when I say we all agreed it was definitely worth the money. 

They picked us up where the cruise ships dock and took us where the floatplanes were. We were given our instructions and loaded on the plane. Our pilot was JR and he was wonderful and knowledgeable. The takeoffs and landings and even the flight itself were all smooth, actually smoother than we thought they’d be. We flew for 30-40 minutes and landed. We were met by our guide and we walked an easy trail for 10-15 minutes and arrived at a platform high up and next to a stream. Besides the mother bear and her cub that we walked by on the trail, there were at least 15 bears catching salmon. Oh and a bald eagle too.  The time we spent there was unbelievable watching the bears in the water fishing salmon out of the stream and some even fighting over their catches. Could have stayed there for hours as it was so fascinating. They allowed us 1-1 1/2 hrs before we headed back. Once again our pilot JR treated us well with a nice flight back. We were then taken back to the cruise ship. 

We all agreed if we ever come back to Ketchikan we are definitely doing this again. No doubt!

Looking at Kauai from above was a wonderful experience.  One of the highlights of our Hawaiian trip.
My husband was fearful of the helicopter ride, and chose the plane and he was so happy he did this trip. I would recommend this to all.

review_title: Canyon Lands & Arch’s National Park Flying Tour
review_text:
Wonderful experience! 
Great pilot, service was too!
Highly recommend doing this especially for first time visitors to Moab!

Such a fantastic thrilling opportunity for my 13 yr old son.  The pilot was incredible, such a nice guy.  Everyone with Redtail was friendly and helpful. My son flew in the bi-plane and can't stop talking about it.   They offer regular flights and helicopter tours but the bi-plane is so unique.  Great value for such an awesome experience,  a must do in Moab!

This was the trip of a lifetime.  A fascinating flight from Phoenix via Sedona to The Grand Canyon with a good 30 minutes flying across and around the Canyon.  The views through the whole journey were incredible but the actual flight across from the South Rim to the North Rim was awesome.  Randy, our pilot was great -very informative and did a great job calming the nerves of those of us who were nervous flyers.  We cannot recommend this trip enough.  If you have the cash then don't miss it.

review_title: A must do in Miami and best way to the Keys
review_text:
I had the most amazing experience at Miami Seaplane Tours for Valentine's Day. Antonio and associates go out of their way to make sure your adventure is scenic, comfortable and informative. Tony let me pick our playlist (B-Tribe) which was the perfect backdrop to the beautiful waters.   Thanks Antonio, you are an amazing pilot!! Our next trip, the Bahamas:)

 

..

Totally incredible! Breathtaking views!!! Our pilot was personable and knowledgeable about the history of the area as well as other interesting facts.  The process was very easy.  Highly Highly recommend.

Dude flying the plane was cool as heck, personable, and informative as heck. You will not be disappointed in this experience. 
 this was one of the best times of my life. 
   buy these tickets as gifts and make your friends and family happy. 
this is what you're looking for. 
 I'm a real human and not a spam bot.

This was a surprise birthday present for a friend and she loved it! It was so gorgeous, the pilot was amazing, and the company was so understanding that we were traveling from South Bay to let us know about potential issues with the weather well in advance. We saw whales too! I would do this again in a heartbeat with this company
We traveled to Maui during our honeymoon and we booked this excursion, it was definitely a highlight of our trip! I would give 6 stars if possible

The flight around Denali and the glacier landing were the highlight of our Alaska vacation.  The pilot gave great explanations about what we were seeing, and made a point of turning the plane so that passengers on both sides could have great views.  This up close look and immersive experience really helped us appreciate the majesty of Denali and its sorrowing mountains.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Experience the sheer size of GC
review_text: There’s a nice spacious area to wait and parking outside. You can’t take any baggage so leave it in your car. There’s a shop and vending machine but no coffee. The pilot was Dave, a lovely young man and experienced pilot who truly loves the GC. He gave us great information and was very friendly. You need to be weighed on arrival ( it’s discrete) and you are sat in the helicopter where they want to balance it. There are 8 seats inside with 3 in front next to the pilot and 4 behind. It isn’t bumpy and lurching - although there are a few twists and tips. It’s just exciting. It’s not like rollercoaster stunt flying, it’s very smooth really, and I was pleased I didn’t feel at all travel sick.i know it’s a costly trip, but it’s really worth it. The very best way to see some of the Grand Canyon.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: Absolutely wonderful experience - great customer service, amazing experience, personable and engaging pilot! So so so glad we took the opportunity to see Mt. Denali from the air and land on a glacier. Highly recommend K2!

We were a group of 12 and half of us did a bear tour and the other half did Misty Fjords and carb feast. Both groups agreed that the Seawind Aviation tours were highlight of our trip.
