From the moment of booking, customer service was impeccable... and we drove them crazy with last minute changes. They were able to accommodate all of our requests and communication was always timely. It was a pleasure working with them and we cannot recommend enough!!!

This is probably the only way you will want to view the Grand Canyon. We were there when it was still covered in some snow so the viewing had more depth. However, if you're seated between 2 people you can forget about taking photos as they will be in your way.

review_title: Only way to really see Canyonlands!
review_text: Much of Canyonlands National Park is not accessable either by hiking or by 4-wheel vehicle so we took to the air.  Redtail offers a 1-hour air tour of the park and it was the perfect way to see many areas that we otherwise wouldn't have seen.  Shane was our pilot in a 6 passenger Cessna.  He was an excellent pilot and guide.  We wore earphones so that Shane could speak to us.  We will never forget this outstanding one hour experience.

5STARS ALL THE WAY: once in a lifetime moment! OK but so this is really a response to another  4 star review that honestly I had a problem with reading because everyone is such a critic these days and so easy to just put your low blood sugar moment on the internet forever and end up not realizing it: My Son and I had the time of our lives, he’s 5 and flew until he got bored, our flight was exactly as expected and even more! We appreciated being asked to leave our feedback to this small business who makes real effort to provide the experience of a lifetime!    We were given our photos BEFORE paying, not after, and the pilot only stood over us to give us shade from the hot sun!  He was trying to guide us, nothing more!  He helped us through the review process which to be honest isn’t as simple as you might think and we’re happy to support such passionate and kind people!  They were so kind and helpful throughout and the only reason they would suggest what to say is obviously when told “ummm, I don’t know what to say”.  So here’s the thing, clearly we had the time of our lives, a thousand people did, and one person clearly just goes on vacation looking for nitpicking things to Yelp about, well, we wanted our 4 Star 5 Star review to put some balance into things for this passionate operator. We Enjoyed every minute! Professional Fun and so so Classy!  More than memorable! The best!  This is my honest review based on my own tour experience and wanted to support this truly exceptional small business. Thanks so much!

Nice scenery, horrible treatment by front desk staff. Wish we went with a different company, others had better prices and all fly from same space. Reserved summit tour over phone, but when we arrived were told that we may need to take a different tour because they need to make money and would not take a party of 3 on summit tour. We asked gentleman at front desk about alternate tour, but we were never given answers and treated like our experience did not matter. In addition, credit card information was taken over phone and charged half the fee completely unauthorized. The woman over the phone asked for information but did not say over 400 would be charged before I arrived. Guess we were not only ones dissatisfied, we heard over our headsets that someone else had issue and would receive a credit.
It is a perfect way of trying to grasp the magnitude of Grand Canyon. The pilot flew calm and safe and I can recommend this company. We were only five passenger in the helicopter.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: Simply They are both the same. Great quality. Great Pilot Thanks JIm. The bit that got me was as we were taking off from Henderson airport over the PA System was the music for "Top Gun"Hence I believe Maverick Helicopters. Go you Good thing a wonderful experience Yes expensive But how many chances does one get to do this? Whilst in Vegas DO IT!! You will regret it thinking as the years pass by golly should've done it. Yeap DO IT>!!!!!!!!

Wir wollten ursprünglich eine große Tour machen mit Gletscherlandung und Denali - leider hat das Wetter nicht mitgespielt und es war nicht möglich +++ als 2te Variante haben wir dann die Southside gewählt und wurden mit faszinierenden Gletscherbildern belohnt +++ ein MUSS +++ es gibt viele Anbieter - Talkeetna Air Taxi kann ich empfehlen - easy Check In - kompetente Piloten mit viel Erfahrung - Talkeetna als Stadt hat nach dem Flug auch seinen Reiz... +++ Preis/Leistungsverhältnis ist OK +++ es geht hier ja auch um persönliche Sicherheit!

| Leighan Falley, 
It was a beautiful day to fly around Denali. Our pilot was Leighan Falley. She is an excellent pilot and was very informative about the history of the area.  I would request to fly with her as she is known as “Denali’s Raven”! The views were spectacular! It was a great day to fly with minimal cloud cover.

review_title: Flying as a student pilot with CFI Bruce was amazing.
review_text: Val and Bruce made the experience of my piloting the Cessna 172 a wonderful experience. Bruce's over all relaxed demeanor, knowledge of flying and information of the beautiful island of Kauai was priceless.

Hawaii is a long flight that I've taken on other airlines... never again, when I go back it will be Hawaiian for sure.  Plenty of leg room, free TV,  cell phone charger on every seat, free carry on, complementary meal and blankets.   They make sitting on a plane for 8 hrs as comfortable as humanly possible as you can!

review_title: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour with glacier landning
review_text:
Booked using Northern Lights Discount coupon for family of 4 (25% off). Worth every penny. Office staff very helpful. Flew on 10 Sept 2018, first deprture 8:30am. Pilot: Michael from California. Superbly skilled and professional pilot, sunny and clear weather, pitch perfect take offs and landings. Michael provided much commentary of history, geography and geology throughout. this was definitely the Highlight of our Alaska trip! Doesn't matter where you sit on the plane, you'll get equally good views of Mt Denali if the weather is good.
Remember to collect your 7 day National Park Access Pass which you can use in Denali National Park.
Don't forget to tip the pilot :)
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: The flight, pilot and waiting area were very good, clean and well organized.  The flight, while more bumpy than a commercial jet, was a good way to see the island's interior.  The pilot was very knowledgeable and handled the plane well.  He gave ample opportunity for photos from both sides of the plane.

review_title: Highly recommend this trip you won’t be disappointed!
review_text: South Side Explorer with Glacier Landing was the highlight of our trip. The pilot was exceptionally good, a great take off and landing, he was so informative.

review_title: A must do when you are on the Island!
review_text: Great views to give you an overall impression of the island without trying to drive/hike everywhere! Our pilot "Piper" was an amazing lady - bubbly,informative, wrote down some turtle spotting tips for us afterward, and yet still professional in all her dealings with other aircraft and air traffic control. We felt a fixed wing plane outing was a better dollar value than the helicopter rides but with similar great views!  Definitely, worth the time and money.

Got the chance to fly with Brian at Air Ventures.  Took the family out for about a 70 minute flight.  We got to see the entire Island from an amazing point of view.  Very comfortable and super informative. Brian was professional and so knowledgeable about the entire island, geography and history.  So many waterfalls that you would never see or know were there.  Definitely a highlight of our trip.  Thanks Brian!

review_title: One of the most amazing days of my life
review_text: I am an outdoors, adventure and travel journalist and I have seen some amazing places and enjoyed the most fantastic trips but this day will be a highlight for a very long time. The trip was very well organised and professional. What we saw in just one day including the small plane ride, helicopter trip, boat trip and Skywalk was absolutely ideal. I would have loved to stay for longer at the Grand Canyon but my schedule did not allow for this. I highly recommend this company and this trip. You can see further details on my blog Fiona Outdoors .co . uk
Absolutely amazing..... Money well spent. This was an incredible experience flying through the clouds, seeing many waterfalls and the coastline. This is a must do activity while you're on the island.

We booked an excursion through our cruise on Silverseas to take a float plan to an all you can eat crab feast on George inlet.  Was terrific. We had mike as our pilot.  Lucky for us, the day was sunny.  Views from the plane unbelievable!
Loved the experience and very friendly pilot. Lots of great info on the islands. Awesome views. Eric was good.

Outstanding tour! Kevin (pilot) was professional and friendly.  We saw a countless number of waterfalls, the Napili coast and canyons, and flew through clouds and rain.   Kevin narrated with facts and personal experiences.  Like no other plane flight we have ever been on.

review_title: Wonderful way to see the island!
review_text: We had a group of 12 and another tour company wouldn't take us all together because of their weight limits.  Air Ventures had no problems with taking our group. We also saved money by booking the luau package deal with them. Jill told us to book early in our trip so we would be able to reschedule if weather was bad.  That turned out to be great advice.  We re-booked twice and were finally able to go out on our last morning for a beautiful tour with perfect weather on our last morning on Kauai and easily made our departing flights.  Ray was the perfect tour guide/pilot. Jill and Ray were wonderful! It was the perfect finale for a great week in Kauai.

review_title: Surreal views - do the glacier landing
review_text: My wife and I went on the Denali flyer tour and it was incredible. Our pilot Randy was wonderful and very informative. We landed on Pika glacier which was a one-of-a-kind experience. Walking on it and being in the middle of such enormous mountains was unforgettable.
Perfect day for a flight. Easy check-in procedure and availability of waivers online in advance. Excellent and courteous staff. Friendly steady and knowledgeable pilot.
Very friendly and hospitable owner pilot.  He was guiding all attractions and showed how to fly to my son.  Would love to fly with him again.

This was my fourth time taking friends up to Talkeetna for the flight. The airplanes are beautiful and very well maintained. Flying through the mountains and landing on the glacier is magical. I highly recommend this amazing experience.
Josh our pilot was fantastic along with the staff!  Don't miss out on this tour! Excellent views and a great way to see Kauai!!

Air Venture Hawaii is the only way to see Kauai!  All the beauty, all the breathtaking diversity of land and sea was covered.  The staff couldn't have been more accommodating, from reservations to a souvenir photo waiting in our e-mail when we returned home.  And the price made it the best deal of our vacation!

It is no surprise that they got the Best Flightseeing Tour award for three years in row (from what I know, they might get more than three times!) from the Anchorage Daily News. They are customer-friendly business. The pilot is informative, and told us about the mountains, glaciers formation and many others. I will definitely recommend this activity to whoever that comes to Alaska. No regret!

Es impactante ver el Gran Cañón desde el aire. Los empleados, el piloto y todos los empleados muy amables. Importante es decir que no me mareé y eso es difícil pues me mareo hasta en un columpio. Se lo dije al piloto y estuvo magnífico.
Tener en cuenta que hay obras en el parque y a veces te paran hasta media hora, cosa que te puede hacer llegar tarde a la cita de salida. Nosotros llegamos sólo 5 minutos antes!
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: Bus was clean n comfortable.  Driver was knowledgeable and friendly. The guided tour information on the bus was nice n interesting. The ride was smooth and we had plenty of time to see all of the canyon.  Heat was super depressing but there are plenty of accessibly for everyone. Lunch was include n was good. Take plenty of water n extra snacks! Dry heat can be difficult to beat.

review_title: The best tour of our lives
review_text:
I have no words to thank all of Wings Over Kauai, which provided an unforgettable experience in our lives. Special thanks to Ellen and our pilot Josh. If you plan to go to Hawaii, you should go to Kauai, the most beautiful island and, being in Kauai you definitely need to do this tour with Wings Over Kauai, simply the best.
I need not give more details, just fly and see with your own eyes.

Thanks again, 
Alvaro and Vanessa

I knew the first thing I wanted to do when I got to talketna was fly around Mt. Denali.  I had heard good things about k2 and they defiantly didn't disappoint.  There office was easy to find only about 2 blocks away from down town.  When we walked In the staff was very welcoming and accommodating.  We were lucky enough to get right on the next flight. The pilot was very professional and even though the plane was small we had a smooth flight and I felt completely safe the whole time.  It was very clear that day and views from the plane is one of the most incredible things I've  Seen. We flew over Mt. Hunter and the base camp for the climb of Denali we flew around the mountain getting very close to peaks and mountain walls.  Seeing beautiful glaciers and Ice fields.  I would definitely recommend this trip to anyone and would love to do it again with the glacier landing package.
Our flight was amazing! The experience of being able to fly the plane was once in a lifetime experience. The colors of pacific ocean you see from the above are mesmerizing

review_title: Loved every second of the trip.
review_text: We read that this was a "must do" and it certainly was. We were lucky that the sun came out in the afternoon. I could have stayed up there all day (I took a Bonine beforehand just in case). This is a very well organized operation. The pilots are skilled and the views are just stunning.

We booked a flight with their small Cesna plane and experieced an exceptional tour allover Kauai. Luckily, we had an early morning flight, not a single cloud allowing us to see everything. Thanks to the whole team and especially our pilot Eric who did an amazing job and a butter smooth landing :).

Flying over the Grand Canyon offered great views because you not only saw it from overhead, but also viewed different areas of the canyon. The plane held around 8-10 people and all seats were on a window. One side of the plane had a better view than the other based on the direction of the flight. We went counter-clockwise on the tour, so the left side was always looking at the canyon. It is a small plane, so the ride was very choppy.
tour_name: 7 -110_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour_2025-02-27

review_text:
Booked a last minute Denali Glacier Landing flight on K2 after being on an AK cruise. I spent a dozen summers in AK when I was younger, and have flown with many of the best and not-the-best, well-known and not so well-known air taxis in AK, and K2 is absolutely top notch. Their operations are down to a science and their pilots and crew are extremely well-versed in the area, the route, and the conditions (which can change on a dime around Denali, as it makes it own weather). Our pilot was a very experienced guy, had great information for us during the flight about Denali and the history of the area, a was a pleasure to ride with. 

We had crystal clear weather for Denali and got some amazing views, and we were able to land on a glacier. Epic day.

review_title: Absolutely fantastic start to our Kauai trip!
review_text:
We LOVED Captain Bruce and the entire staff at Wings Over Kauai!! They were so nice, and very knowledgeable. I was concerned about motion sickness, so I got hooked up with some ginger candies to help just in case...I also got a little Kukui nut necklace and a flower, and they took a couple of pictures of my husband and I before the flight. They really understand how exciting these things are for island newbies, and they totally embrace it!

As for Captain Bruce - he was great! He has a total love for what he does, and it shows big time! He points out everything, answers all your questions on the tour, and has little tidbits about just about everything! Flying with him was a total pleasure.

The flight was great - very safe and little turbulence. We saw some absolutely BEAUTIFUL sights and took some fantastic pictures. Captain Bruce opened up the windows a few times to let my husband take a few glare-free pictures of the highlights: Waimea Canyon, the Na Pali coast, and Wailua Falls. We have some gorgeous pictures as a result! Again, they understand how much these tours mean to us tourists, and they totally go with it!

Seriously - consider this as an option to your WAY overpriced helicopter tours. For $100 a person, instead of $160-$350, we got a fantastic, personalized tour of this beautiful island. I also recommend starting your trip with this so that you can decide what you want to see up-close later. We will definitely fly with Wings Over Kauai again on our next trip.
Awesome way to see the area. Pilot was amazing, landed so smoothly. We were greeted by a lovely young lady who took us to the area where we boarded the seaplane and everything was so smooth.

Der Flug war sehr toll der Pilot sehr symphatisch und erfahren 
preis leistungs V. war Top. 
empfelenswert !!

review_title: The peak of our Alaska trip
review_text: We were lucky in our private flight over Denali to have clear skies, and it was the most incredible experience of our Alaska vacation.  There’s no way to describe it in words.  Our pilot was very communicative and informative.
What an awesome experience! Absolutely priceless! Going to go again each time we are here! The pilot was absolutely amazing!
The view was so beautiful and amazing, absolutely stunning and the waterfalls were gorgeous . We loved every moment of it

Absolutely fantastic the view of Kauai from the air as amazing. Our pilot was super narrative, super accommodating treated us with utmost respect. Quite commical as well. I will recommend it highly  o my friends and relativ s.

review_title: You can fly... You can see... You can feel...
review_text:
You can fly... During more than an hour you can see beautiful places... Canions... glaciers... When the plane take off in a lake you can feel the wind on your faces...
You must do it once at life.

What a beautiful way to see the island, especially, the jewel - the Na Pali Coast. If your budget allows, do it,  we were in the AirVan. Captain Marcus doesn’t miss a beat with every question we threw at him. He gave us extra time to watch some whales from above but circling around them. A very smooth ride. There were 5 of us but we could have had another person on the plane for the same price. Can’t say enough praise for the service. I highly recommend this company.
The pilot was very knowledgeable of the plane and the island. One of the best air tours I’ve taken. We were able to wear tanks and shorts in the plane. Great experience.

The overall experience was good. There is a fuel surcharge of about $16 dollars that you must pay once you arrive so have some cash  or credit card ready. The planes are pretty small so you wouldn't want to fly on them on a windy day or you might get air sick. The views are stunning! The pilot was very knowledgeable and would answer any questions you might have. You are provided with a microphone so you can communicate with the pilot and an aviation headset so that you can hear the pilot. The only recommendation I have for the Air Ventures Hawaii team is to update the in-flight communications system so that passengers don't have to hear air-traffic communications during their flight and also hear less static coming through the headphones. It was a little hard to understand the pilot sometimes. Other than that, I recommend this to anyone wishing to get an up-and-close look at most of the island and its beautiful landmarks. When considering either a helicopter or plane ride, remember that while helicopters can get you much closer to landmarks, Air Ventures Hawaii planes fly very low too (~1,000 ft) and can cover much more of the island. In general, airplane rides are between 5-10 minutes longer than helicopter rides. Also, every passenger gets a window sit so they can take pictures. The plane sits 6 passengers so you are always flying with a small group.
Fantastic experience. Do not hesitate. Book it right now. Everything was spectacular and unbelievable. Life changing experience

review_title: Bucket list item, check!  If not on your list, perhaps it should be :)
review_text:
My wife and I are from Vancouver, Canada and were celebrating our 30th anniversary on Maui (so nice to travel a bit after these last few years). We really wanted to imprint an experience into our memory of something so special and beyond what our '30 year ago' selves could guess we could do.

There really are no words to describe how superb and wonderful this experience is. You will see views only seen by an exceptionally small amount of humanity and will likely find it hard to not be awe-struck. We had Eric as our pilot and he skillfully navigated the tour-guide of the flight along with the flying and ATC interaction. He gave my flying tips that no other instructor ever did (and what a place to receive them!).

Long story short (as I could go on for many more paragraphs); if you want a lifetime memory and can find a way to line up a time to get in the air, it will be something I suspect you will treasure as much as we do.

We had a great time flying over Kauai with Air Ventures. The pilot was entertaining and knew the island well. The entire operation was efficient, punctual, and safety-conscious. The plane is not air-conditioned so heat is a concern. Cold compresses and water were available if needed.  Ladies - do not wear earrings! The head-sets you have to wear will be very uncomfortable if you do, and without the head-sets you won't hear the commentary!  This was a great way to enjoy the beauty of Kauai. You just can't see the Nepali coast from the water or by land nearly as well. And the views of Waimea canyon are amazing. If you're afraid of heights, this is a much better option than a helicopter, you feel much more secure!
Exceptional opportunity-very organized and very safe! Highlight of my trip to Moab. Pilot was very accommodating and images were spectacular! I’d like a return trip!

Due to weight restrictions, our flight was delayed until a smaller pilot could arrive. That was a blessing in disguise as both the weather improved, and we got Piper for our pilot. Piper was great! If you can have a choice of pilots, I'd choose her. Very knowledgeable. Very informative. Very fun. 
We saw the whole island and got great airel photos. 
The only complaint was an equipment issue with the headphones behind the pilots seat. It had a short, that made the narration cut in and out. 
Overall, I highly recommend this tour, and I can't say enough good things about our pilot, Piper.

review_title: Highlight of Our Trip to Alaska
review_text:
Amazing is the only word to describe for our experience with SeaWind Aviation.  From the scheduling of our flight to the most beautiful scenery you can ever imagine, our trip to Misty Fjords was outstanding.  Though I must admit a couple of us seniors were a little concerned about the small plane, it was a very smooth and pleasant ride. Our pilot,Ralph, went out of his way to assure our comfort, hats off to him!  Price was good, less than what you can arrange on ship.  We were picked up and delivered back to dock , with no concern about "missing the boat". Lesley, Steve, and Ralph are a great group.  Would highly recommend to anyone of all ages, and will definitely do again. Was truly the highlight of our 10 day trip to Alaska!!
Thank you SeaWind Avaiation for a wonderful experience.
We had a great ride with Harry and saw the entire island. We went at the end of our week so we got to see aerial views of all the places we had been. Great to support a fellow Lion!
Great flight, Thank you Sergio and owner, We enjoyed the great view of Miami from above, We will definitely be back.

review_title: Up close and personal with the mountain
review_text: Awesome experience with K2 Aviation. We booked this through Princess Cruises. We were only in Talkeetna for a short time and did not have time for a glacier landing, but the flight itself was well worth the experience. Views were awesome, sunny blue skies. Definitely the highlight of our time in Denali. And Mt. McKinley happened to be out in all its glory. Couldn't have been a better day.

Worth every single penny. We flew to the Grand Canyon, and I'll never forget this experience as long as I live. I feel like Westwind Air Service is my family...that's how amazing everybody is. See you guys soon!
Misty Fjords was Breathtakingly beautiful and our pilot Brentwood from Taquan Air was amazing! Such a personable guy and smooth piloting. Thoroughly enjoyed this tour!

This was a highlight during our first visit to Kauai. There were four in our party and Captain Harry was a great pilot and tour guide. The ladies who greeted us for check-in were wonderful, very friendly and welcoming.
We would definitely recommend this tour to anyone looking for a view of the island from the air.

review_title: Highly recommend K2 air tour of Mt Denali
review_text:
Had a beautiful day. Mark (our pilot) was extremely knowledgeable. My second flight on K2. My family enjoyed very much.
Had a mix up on flight time, my fault. They worked hard to get us up as soon as possible. Great customer service.

Our original intent for booking this excursion was to secure sold-out Alcatraz Tour tickets.  Wow . . . we we pleasantly surprised by how much we enjoyed the seaplane tour.  The 30 mins(+) we spent was a blast.  The pilot/guide was professional, engaging, funny and very knowledgeable.  He even circled a spot in the bay to allow our group to see a surfacing whale!  We learned things about the history and the present about the area that we had never heard before.  And, of course, we saw S.F. from a perspective that few get to see.  This is much more enjoyable than a 10-15 helicopter ride.  

This ended up the highlight of our 4 days in the city.  Highly recommend it!

The views were fantastic,  The weather was great, so visibility was great.  Saw several whales.  Our trip was most  was enjoyable, our pilot's professionalism, informative narrative & pleasant manner added to that enjoyment.  My first trip on a fixed wing plane for sight seeing.  So much quieter than a helicopter.  Would definitely reccomend.

review_title: Seaplane from Seattle to Roche Harbor and back
review_text: We had a great experience with Friday Harbor Seaplanes. The pilots and staff were very friendly, informative and helpful. The flight was fun and we saved a lot of time.

review_title: Canceled flight with VERY little notice
review_text: They canceled our flight 20 minutes before our check in time after driving over two hours. It would have been nice to get more of a heads up so we didn’t waste our time.
It was a beautiful, informative flight. Great highlights of the Grand Canyon and surrounding area. Courteous crew and comfortable flight. Large windows for taking photos.
We visited K2 on a bad weather day but the staff is super nice and took our kids to see the flights. They are awesome staff. We will defiantly come back and fly with them. Thank you for your service

review_title: If you want to see Denali, DO IT!
review_text: My wife and I flew with them in 1995 and did a glacier landing.  We just returned to Alaska this year with our grandson and knew we wanted to do it again.  Conditions weren't suitable for a glacier landing this time, but the views were incredible.  After spending several days in Denali NP, hoping to see the mountain with no success, we were especially glad we had booked this flight.  These folks have been in this business a long time and they are the experts!
Ed was our pilot- the flight was the highlight of our 14 day trip. In the air u can see the vastness of Alaska
This was a great experience!  Multnomah Falls from the air looks so different!!!  Weather cooperated.  Pilot was great.  Highly recommend the experience.

From the time I booked this flight online this was the best experience. We were picked up near our cruise ship. Taken to Lihue airport to start our filight.The ground staff are friendly and make you feel welcome.Our pilot Josh was the best.We felt safe and in capable hands the whole flight.His narration of our flight was informed and interesting.Sights we saw were amazing. This flight was great value. We experienced much more expensive helicopter flights on the nearby islands but this was the best for both value and sightseeing.We couldn't give a higher recommendation.

review_title: Flight to Denali with Glacier Landing
review_text: We flew around Denali then landed on a glacier.  There really are no words that can describe this tour.  It was beyond amazing.  What you get to see is so incredible, and walking on a glacier that has been untouched by man is breathtaking.  I cannot recommend this tour enough.  Chris was our pilot and be was the best!

We were lucky enough to be in Talkeetna with great weather over McKinley.  Fantastic experience. We did the glacier landing on Ruth Glacier and it was an awesome experience.  Definitely recommend this even though it was pricey. Our pilot, Tony, was really knowledgeable about the history of the mountain and the climbing attempts. One of the passengers, a young man from Turkey, said "This is the greatest thing that had ever happened in his life!"  Everyone on board seemed ecstatic about the flight. Weaving through the mountains was awe inspiring.  We felt very safe and at ease with K2 and Tony.  Thanks!

review_title: Not a Bump in the Sky!
review_text:
We did pre-book (via Titan tours UK) and flew at 9 am, weighed and put into groups so you will fly with other people, 6 in our helicopter. You get pre-flight notes to read and a small life preserver to wear (scary) in case you ditch into the Colorado river!

The take off was so smooth, straight up and you skim above the trees. They pipe music into your headphones like from 'Top Gun' and your pilot also talks you through everything, landmarks, speed etc. It takes a good 5 minutes to get to the rim of the grand canyon and I was very nervous about this part as I had heard that the 'up draft' will make it bumpy or push you upwards but no absolutely no change in our flight.

You think you are hovering but get told your speed is 200 kph. The view from up top is unbelievable, you just do not grasp the size of this place otherwise.

I would say to anyone put a helicopter flight on your list of 'Must do's' for the Grand Canyon.

I would also mention that when we later visited the rim in the afternoon by bus it was quite windy, is morning the best time for a flight?
The pilot was so accommodating to my wife.  She made sure she had a great view when we landed  on the glacier.   This flight was the highlight of our Alaskan trip!!

review_title: Views like a James Bond movie
review_text: This is a very well run and professional company.  Our pilot provided a good explanation of what we were seeing and turned the plane around so passengers on both sides could get a good view of all of the sights.  The magnificent views were like flying through a James Bond movie.

We took the flight to the Tongas rainforest to see bears fishing for salmon. The flight was great and our guide to the viewing platform was knowledgeable and friendly. We came across a bear on the path, Mark calmly made sure we stayed safe. The sight of a bear with a salmon was truly wonderful.
Awesome experience very fun.pilot was full of knowledge. Flew over the city of Miami , downtown and south beach
tour_name: 11-_131_South Beach Miami Aerial Tour  BeachesMansions and Skyline_2025-02-27

review_text: Called on June 1st , which was a sunny day.  My husband and I decided we wanted to wait until the next day to make this trip as our camera battery was dead, I was talking to Annie and she said not to wait as the weather changes and tomorrow might not be as nice.  When I explained to her that we did not want to go because our camera was dead, she offered us a camera to use.  Well we went and what a wonderful time we had.  When we arrived in their office after being picked up we were greeted by Beverly, who was delightful, very knowledgeable and helpful.  Trent was our pilot who was great also excellent at pointing out different things on our flight as well as a photographer once we arrived on the glacier.  After we returned Beverly drve us to town.  My thanks to Annie, Trent and Beverly for making this a very special trip.  I would highly recommend using Talkeetna Air Taxi.

We were 3 friends that took the sunset trip - we left at 6pm with our pilot - Justin.  The helicopter seats 8 people and there was another family of 3 with us as well. The nice thing was that they allowed the family of 3 to sit in the front seats for the first part of the trip and when we stopped to refuel, we got to swap over to the front seats.  The flight was very smooth and I enjoyed the pilots selection of music during the flight and the interesting facts and stories about the area.  The sunset trip was great as we got to see Hoover dam, Lake Mead and the Grand Canyon by the light but by the time the sun went down, we had returned to the strip and we got to see the lights of Vegas.  Mavericks were very professional and offered a complementary shuttle service to the airport and back again to your hotel.  I would highly recommend using this company for a flight through the Canyon and over the strip.

We flew on Friday Harbor Seaplanes from Renton (Seattle) to San Juan Island. Oh, the views were amazing! The flight was smooth, the arrangements were beyond smooth and the pilot was super-informative. Smooth flight and soft landing. I flew with 2 kids (9 and 14). They loved it also. I highly recommend these folks! -Chris
If you visit this, do take glacier landing. It is worth the experience. Just the ride won't do the justice to the beauty of Mt Mckinley.
If you're in the area, don't miss this, it's well worth the price! Go for the glacier landing package, you won't regret it!

Although flying is not my favorite activity (it is one of my spouse's favorite activities), both of us  really enjoyed our flight over KAUAI with Bruce.  He honestly did "WOW" US with his knowledge of Kauai, the flora, the fauna and the physical attritudes of possibly the oldest and undoubedly the most beautiful of the Hawaiian Islands.  Ellen, his wife and partner, was very engaging and extremely helpful and courteous. Even though we had to reschedule our attempt at flying due to cloudy weather, Ellen accomodated us , even advising us of the weather as we traveled to the airport.  Some of our pictures, taken during the flight with Bruce were really fantastic; i.e., Bruce kept the plane masterfully under control.  By far the BEST ACTIVITY that we experienced during our 2 weeks on Kauai! Thanks guys for a wonderful 40th Anniversary adventure. F & R
Sept, 2008

review_title: Amazing - a once in a lifetime experience
review_text: The experience was like straight out of a movie - I really enjoyed it, the scenery, clouds, mountains, was surreal.  Definitely recommend.

Five of us had a chopper to ourselves for our tour of the Grand Canyon - what an experience!!  This excursion was doubly exciting for us, as it was the first time we had been in a helicopter AND the first time we had seen the Grand Canyon.  We came straight to the airfield from Sedona, checked in quickly and were soon escorted to our copter by our pilot.  After a brief safety talk we were strapped in, put our headsets on and we were off!

The pilot was a lot of fun, making some good jokes along the way.  Of course the real star was the Canyon itself, which is beyond description.  Nothing can prepare you for its grandeur - and flying along at 200 feet off the ground en route makes for a staggering experience as the ground drops out from under you and you are over a mile above the Colorado River in a blink of an eye!  Lots of gasps from everyone!!

This trip comes highly recommended, and Maverick did a great job showing us the sights and making us all feel safe and secure.

This was the best thing so far on our vacation trip from Fairbanks to anchorage and Seward, mountains where clear we pick a great day to go out, we had a glacier landing, The staff was very informative about the weather it was rainy and cloudy, so we picked the next day at 11 am instead oh boy was that a good choice.

I'm fortunate to have taken this tour twice, including the glacier landing, both in the summer and in the winter.  I can't say that one was better than the other.  Both were breathtaking, but on the winter tour there were fewer tourists and I got to sit up next to the pilot in a smaller plane.  I am especially thankful that, on my last trip, they diplomatically put up with my fearful, hysterical sister, who initially refused to board the plane.  I was so embarassed, but they took it all in stride.  There was a little audio problem with one of the traveler's headset on my first flight, but I never had any audio issues myself.  The pilot's running commentary, while nice, is really not all that necessary anyway to enjoying the tour.  The views are so incredibly breathtaking that who care's what the name of this or that mountain is. A once (or in my case twice) in a lifetime adventure well worth the expense!

This was our second time flying with Jason. We took a family vacation last year to Alaska and we loved it so much that we came back this year. The one thing that we wanted to do again on this trip was fly with Alaska Bush Floatplane Service so we called them up and we scheduled another flight. The office staff was very friendly and making the reservation was simple. Our first flight with them last year was an hour tour of Mt. McKinley so this time we scheduled a one and a half hour tour which included Denali National park and the Talkeetna Mountains. We were able to see everything from glaciers to caribou and moose! We came a little later in the season last year so we were very impressed with all the flowers that were still in bloom at their office. The float plane base is very beautiful so make sure to bring your camera with a large card and plenty of battery. We highly recommend this business. Jason, thank you for this beautiful experience!
Loved it! Trip up the gorge was beautiful. I felt super safe. Our pilot was friendly and competent. Can't wait to go on another trip!
This was a wonderful thing to do, with lovely friendly and helpful staff and pilots. I would highly recommend it to anyone who is thinking to take this flight - all ages!

review_title: Flying High... to see the Sea Cliffs of Molokai
review_text:
Yesterday we took off from Maui to Molokai on a wonderful trip with pilot Eric. Eric was kind and informative. The flight was amazing despite a little wind. We saw amazing views, waterfalls and beautiful landscapes.

We landed at the leper colony and read all about the history of Father Damien. Such an amazing place!

I highly recommend the Maui County flight. It is the same rate as being in a helicopter, but not as many people and you see so much more!!! 

Fabulous way to see Maui and Eric is a great guy! 

Mahalo Eric!
The experience was definitely worth it, Joel is the best, he made the trip fun and informative. Will do again

review_title: AMAZING - a highlight of our trip!
review_text: We were on a cruise and found AirVentures independently while in port on Kauai.  Intended to join a group flight but (fortunately) ended up on an private flight on the Cessna with Captain Eric who was very knowledgeable and took great care of us!  What a spectacular way to see the Na Pali coast and Waimea Valley!! Was my husband's favorite part of our trip.  Thanks AirVentures!
Our pilot Harry was the best! Me and my husband came for his 30th and it was just amazing! The flight was beautiful fun and very thrilling.

Me and a friend went for an event that they hosted called Free Flight Friday. Although we were a little apprehensive about flying in such a smaller plane than what you would fly in commercially - there was absolutely nothing to be worried about! Both the takeoff and landing were completely smooth, and we were lucky to have absolutely no bumps while in the air. The pilot was extremely knowledgeable about the area and made sure to point out things to keep our eyes out for. I am so thankful for this introductory flight and we're already planning on another one later on in the summer. Thank you guys for an awesome flight!

K2 gave us the most incredible tour of Denali! The weather cooperated the evening of our tour to the summit. Our capable pilot took us to Mt. Forager, Mt. Hunter and Mt. Denali. We got very close to the summit of Denali. We were the last flight of the day which gave us a little advantage in that we flew several minutes longer than we normally would have. Very memorable, great photos, not to be missed!

K2 took us around Denali State Park and we landed on a glacier. We got lucky--the day was absolutely clear and sunny and our K2 pilot took full advantage of the beauty of the day and the stunning scenery. We couldn't have been happier with the experience we had with them--very professional, friendly, safety-conscious. We were a couple and an 80 year old granny and we all had a fantastic time. Our pilot, Chris, really made the whole thing special--a once in a lifetime experience
Amazing way to see Miami! Our pilot was funny, knowledgeable and ensured we had a great experience. You have to do this 1 hour flight when you visit Miami!

That flight was amazing. More importantly, the pilot was professional, kind and informative.  It was the best combination for this type of guided tour. The price is a little steep, but after seeing the quality of the plane it made sense. Other companies had planes that were not as well maintained.

review_title: Amazing, incredible way to see Denali
review_text: Earlier clouds in front of Denali had cleared by the time we took off from Talkeetna at 7 pm on K2’s last “Denali Flyer” of the day. Pilot Daniel was both an excellent pilot and knowledgeable commentator as we flew the face of the mountain. He made sure passengers on both sides of the plane were able to get good views and didn’t skimp on time of trouble. The weather was perfect for flying and especially for the unforgettable glacier landing. An amazing, incredible, never-to-be-forgotten way to see “The High One.”

Amazing experience! One of the highlights of our three weeks trip to four of the Hawaiian islands! The weather was beautiful with only a very few clouds and our pilot Marcus expertly explained to us what we saw below. All seats allowed for taking breathtaking pictures of the canyons and the coast. We would definitively recommend doing this and will do it again should we ever have the chance.

From setting the trip up with Jill to flying with JT, this was an awesome experience for my family of four.  Flying through Waimea Canyon, aside the glorious Napali Coast and over waterfalls was magical.

The ride was smooth, the views were outstanding and the entire crew had two things on their mind: your safety and your pleasure.  Both were handled expertly.  Do this and enjoy talking about it later.
Was a great experience, got to see all the island very clearly and our instructor did a great job telling us about the history and facts about each.

This was an absolutely amazing trip for my boyfriend and I! We were the only ones on the flight and had an amazing time laughing at jokes from the funny pilot and also getting an aerial view of the city. The pilot also allowed us to take lots of pictures and really made it a wonderful experience. We highly recommend, you won't regret it!

A great day out to the grand canyon it all started with our pilot jarod . A really nice guy who went out of his way to make our trip interesting and funny, (even though his flying is better than his comedy ) everyone was encouraged to join in and all questions answered even though he must have answered them all hundreds of times he still managed to keep it fresh and interesting. Also special thanks for taking the time to do some comedy photos with my wifes work mascot they have been the source of amusement at her work place .also enjoyed the explanation of how you fly  a helicopter thanks all at maverick

This was our first time ever seeing the canyon so from the sky- breathtaking. Our pilot was funny and knowledgeable, we felt safe the whole time. This tour was incredible, worth every penny- once in a lifetime type experience
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: We tried for glacier landing at 10 am. Due to weather constraints, we were unable to land. The pilot tried his best. Got amazing views of the glaciers. The billing for the tour was reduced. Good glacier shoes were provided and glasses were also offered
This was one of the coolest experiences I’ve ever had. Flying through snowing mountain peeks and cliffs was mind blowing. This is a must do when in Alaska!

We were very pleased with K2 Aviation.  We did not have a reservation, but they were able to fit us on a flight.  Our pilot Tony did an excellent job pointing things out.  He helped to make this wonderful trip even better.  The views, planes and staff were very professional.  The glacier landing was breathtaking!  Amazing!!!
Was a great experience! We definitely will be doing it again, very soon!  Beautiful Views! Highly recommend Maui Plane Rides!

We went on a flight with them on 2nd July. We wanted to do the summit tour but were unable to as the minimum was 6 and we were just two. So we agreed on Grand denali trip. As it was very cloudy they were not sure if we would be able to land on a glacier but our pilot ( Paul - turns out he was the owner of the company) did his very best to make sure we landed on the glacier safely! He waited for an opening in the clouds and landed at the right moment so that we could get our best experience! This company is the best to fly with for the once in a life time experince!

Was initially skeptical about price since one of the least expensive tours, but found a few reviews and they were great. Went to website and was also reassured when I read tour would be on plane not helicopter thus fuel savings could be passed to us! All staff excellent, from shuttle driver Shirley, Pua in reception, to pilot- of course! Very professional, views were awesome, pilot very knowledgeable and made us feel very safe! Pay less and you'll surely get the best!

Our pilot was AWESOME!!!! He was a local and had great stories about the area as we flew by different locales! He was even able to point our sharks and stingrays..... His name started with and A and he was superb! We also flew by the Miami OPen tennis tournament..... Very cool!.

review_title: Wonderful Flight and Service to Denali Mountains!
review_text: We just came from Alaska Trip for 4th of July Holiday.   Talkeetna Air Taxi trip was the most wonderful trip out of our entire Alaska Trip.  They were so well prepared and entire flight was incredible.   Landing on glacier was such a wonderful experience to us like from LA and so smooth.   The scenery was magnificent and especially weather was incredible.  Talkeetna Air is the Best and you don't want to miss this wonderful trip to Beautiful Denali Mountains when you visit Alaska.  This is a MUST trip.   Thank you, Talkeetna Air.

We were extremely lucky to have a very sunny day for our tour of the Denali mountain. The pilot was so good and guided us through the mountains while describing everything we were seeing and the altitude height as we climbed. We went to 15,100 feet! The glacier landing was a once in a life time experience. A must do!
This is an amazing way to see all of Kauai, whales, Waimea Canyon, waterfalls, Napali Coast.  Our pilot did not disappoint!

Went for the Glacier landing.  Was fantastic!  can be best summed up from the fact that a couple on the flight with us had flown the tour the previous day - was unable to land on the glacier - so decided to drive back the next day from Anchorage to do so -& they were happy they did!  Highly recommended for all ages

review_title: Grand Denali Tour with glacier landing
review_text: This is the one thing you have to do before you die. It is absolutely fantastic! Words cannot describe it and photos are inadequate.

review_title: TAT knows how to fly and land!
review_text: My friend and I signed up for the glacier landing and were told at the desk that no landings had occurred for a few days, so they asked if we still wanted to go.  We chose to go at a lesser price, and Clay, our pilot, was the first to land on a glacier on the mountain-- he was soon followed by at least five planes.  The safety measures and the customer service of Talkeetna Air Taxi staff is among the best I've experienced.
Such an amazing experience!  A must for anyone wanting an exceptional, memorable time! Definitely worth doing on my return trip to Maui.

I took my Dad in June, we both thought it was really neat. He has never seen much snow before and being on the mountain in the snow, seeing the glacier ice and all the beautiful scenery was breath taking! Very impressed with the staff they were constantly checking the weather situations and making sure it was safe. The pilot knew the history and pointed out a lot of stuff to us. He was also great about taking pictures for all of us. Next time I will take binoculars as I did not see the animals or the climbers when pointed out, but several others did.... so take binoculars!

review_title: The quickest and best way to see all of Kauai's beauty!
review_text: We had a great experience with the air tour.  Eric, our pilot, made us feel at ease right away, and we had a lovely trip.  He spent a little extra time circling a couple of whales we saw in the ocean, and we got as close as we dared to go to the beautiful cliffs and scenery.

review_title: Canyon River Adventure – Plane, 4x4 Vehicle, River Raft, Motor Coach
review_text:
I booked the “Canyon River Adventure” tour directly with Grand Canyon Airlines but you can also book thru Papillon Grand Canyon Helicopters, GrandCanyon.com, or Xanterra Parks & Resorts. This tour departs from the Grand Canyon Airport in Tusayan (8 miles south of Grand Canyon Village / Grand Canyon South Rim).

This comprehensive tour is operated by the partnership of 3 companies: 
GRAND CANYON AIRLINES - flight over canyon in fixed wing 19-seat Vistaliner plane with over-sized windows; 
ANTELOPE SLOT CANYON TOURS – four-wheel drive vehicle tour to Antelope Canyon; 
COLORADO RIVER DISCOVERY - 15-mile smooth water float trip on a river raft, beginning at Glen Canyon Dam and ending at Lee’s Ferry. 

At the end of the full-day excursion, a motor coach returns you back to Grand Canyon Airport.

Tour Description and Video: http://youtu.be/_Qi2Lpemuyc

Tips for hot days:  Sunblock, wide brim hat, a small towel or bandana to soak in river and wrap around neck. Store all electronic devices in a waterproof bag. My boyfriend’s cell phone and iTouch were both ruined by a splash of river water on his backpack. The seats and floor of the raft can also become wet with small puddles of water.

If you are prone to motion sickness, consider taking a half tablet of Bonine (or similar antiemetic) before the plane tour. Wind gusts over the canyon can occur, making the ride intermittently bumpy.

The 2-mile journey on the 4x4 vehicle to Antelope Canyon is very bumpy and dusty. You will travel over an unpaved road in thick sand. Those with back problems and contact lense wearers should beware. Antelope Canyon is a natural marvel and a photographer’s oasis.

Understandably, and as clarified on K2's website, the flight tours are dependent on the weather. While we were still able to fly, our route was adjusted (not sure to which one) from the Denali Grand Tour + landing (K2 did reduce the price). We did not get to actually see Denali, unfortunately, so that was definitely a disappointment though not the fault of K2; we appreciated how seriously they take safety, as wind conditions were a concern on our day. The pilot knew a lot about Alaska and its landscape and the views were incredible. Getting to step out on the glacier was an amazing experience. This is an expensive tour and while K2 is good about refunds and adjustments if you don't get to do what you signed up for, this tour is not necessarily a guaranteed way to see Denali if you don't build in an extra day or two.

Originally I was scheduled for the 9:00am Grand Denali tour but mother nature had other plans. Denali was still rained and fogged in but K2 was able to offer me the chance to instead fly over Knik Glacier. It was a beautiful flight and the views were gorgeous.  Our pilot was willing to answer any questions we had and it was a once in a lifetime experience I greatly enjoyed.

We took the airplane tour of the Grand Canyon on a Friday morning and thoroughly enjoyed the trip.  The people were great and everything leading up to takeoff was very smooth.  The flight itself was wonderful...no better way to get the tremendous views of the Grand Canyon and see so much in a short period of time.  We would always recommend taking a flight earlier in the day as heating will tend to make the ride a little rougher later in the day.  We had a great time and would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting the Grand Canyon, especially if it is your first visit!

review_title: The best way to see Mt. McKinley!
review_text: My sister and I did this flight on our second day in Alaska and after traveling 1200 miles in one week, we are still very happy we spent the money to see Denali close up like this.  It was well worth the extra dollars to land on the glacier.  Taking off and landing that close to shear rock was very exciting.  The pilot was very safe and gave us a great flight making sure we had plenty of views of the mountain.  My sister even got to ride co-pilot on the way home.

review_title: Flying the Friendly skies, for real!
review_text: Timely, safe, knowledgeable!  We'd never done anything like it before and feel we were able to experience, in a short time, areas we otherwise may not have ever been able to see.

Like many others, we decided on our flight with Wings over kauai based on previous reviews.  I'm not crazy about flying in small aircraft (or large ones for that matter), but the flight was awsome and I highly recommend it.  Bruce and Ellen were out of town on the day of our flight, but Maren and Shane took excellent care of us.   We are telling our friends, "If you go to Kauai - book a flight with' Wings over Kauai' !"

Wings Over Kauai is a must do!  My husband and I were blown away by the scenery.  Our pilot Bruce was so personable and told us exactly what we were seeing. Our expectations were high to begin with and this experience exceeded them.  It was also a very smooth ride.  Bruce is very experienced and has been flying tourists on this route safely for decades.  Waimea Canyon, the Nepali coast, waterfalls…holy holy!  Just book this treat.  Nothing beats the views and perspectives from the air.

This was nice. We originally booked the longer, higher trip and added the landing at the glacier. However, due to  the weather they were only able to fly lower and were not able to land. The trip was still very nice and the pilot was excellent.

review_title: Amazing way to see canyon lands!
review_text: Canyonlands by air over the 4th of July?! AMAZING. Chip is the coolest pilot ever! We flew with a family from France and the couples daughter was in a wheelchair. They made her feel right and home and she had a blast flying! We purchased an hd video of the flight and that was worth every penny. I can't say enough good things about the way we were treated and the experience. Thanks Chip and Redtail Aviation for making our stay one of the most memorable trips ever!!!

Fantastic experience from first phone call until disembarking. Booked for a morning flight but day before the weather was clear and sunny, rang Talkeetna Air and they happily changed me to last flight of that day albeit on slightly different trip which I was informed of and happy with.
Turned out to be the right decision, glorious sunshine and views of Denali, perfect glacier landing with a wonderful and informative pilot( Chris, I think?) 
Office staff were great, even supplied me with a snack as I had come straight from another tour that afternoon which was much appreciated. By the time I disembarked I had received an email re refund for difference in tour price.
Thanks to everyone concerned! Keep up the good work 😊

review_title: Friendly, Fun, Fantastical Foray into the Alaska Range
review_text: Taking any of the flights offered by K2 Aviation will be a lifetime experience you will never forget. The pilots are not only seasoned and skilled in mountain flying, they also help transport you into a world you can't even conceive or imagine until you are completely finished with your flight.  Your eyes will not only feast on the spectacular ruggedness of the landscape but you will learn the history and landmarks of the area.  I took two flights with K2 while visiting Talkeetna.  My first flight was a scenic tour which included an expansive view of the eastern lowlands of Denali National Park area as well as up-close views in and around the Alaska Range.  My second flight included a landing on Ruth Glacier and gave me intimate views of Kahiltna base camp and other geological features directly under Denali.  Both of these flights were unique, informative and gave me different but complimentary perspectives on the area.  K2 is a class organization and I whole heartedly recommend them for anyone seeking to maximize their Denali adventure.

Wow, wow, and wow again!! Thanks Jason, Elbert and co for the memory of a lifetime! 16 in our group ages 7-75 and nothing but smiles and amazing photos. The weather was beautiful and taking off and landing in a floatplane on the water is something everything should do once in their life. We also landed on a second lake in the mountains which was awesome as well. Both aircraft were in beautiful condition and each of us had our own headset for communicating. The flight took us over the climber's base camp and through some of the most beautiful scenery in the world. It was smooth and comfortable, the pilots informative and fun! If you have time for only one activity in Talkeetna, this is mandatory! We highly recommend the Alaska Float Plane Company!

Wow...hard to explain such a mind blowing experience. I am not a person with a lack of things to say, but this trip left me speechless.  The feeling of being so close to these majestic mountains that were so far away from our hotel is amazing.  Your mouth will hurt from smiling so much. Our pilot EO, was so fun and knowledgeable too. He answered all of our questions and even pointed out base camp so we could get a feel for how high we truly were.  WELL worth it....I can't wait to do it again!
The scenery of Kauai was great seen up close from an airplane. The staff was friendly and helpful. Many thanks for the experience.

We couldn't have asked for more....flight is life changing!!!  Weather was perfect for flight.  Our pilot, Ed, was so knowledgeable and friendly...if there were any doubts or nervousness about flying in a smaller plane, he erased all thoughts.  We flew  around Mt. McKinley and surrounding mountains; saw glaciers and all of Nature's mountain glories.  Company stored our packbacks etc. in a secure storage bin while we were on flight and also drove us to our hotel in Talkeetna.  Highly recommend this venture....this COMPANY.  Beatty Houston Texas
We lived the air tour. Much better than the helicopter one. I will come back for sure! The experience is unique and JT took care very well of us. Although very young, he knows what he is doing.

Having 37 years as an Airline Pilot, I've seen plenty, but landing on a glacier was one of the most memorable moments I've ever had.
Our pilot Jack was a true professional and I knew.my wife and I were in good hands. You could tell that Jack absolutely loved what he was doing and his narratives were first class and informative.  Add to that a fleet of beautifully maintained aircraft and K2 becomes hard to beat.  The views, experience and memories are worth every dollar.
Best experience ever, cheap, friendly with a good quality tour. Pilots are friendly and responsible.

review_title: Great way to see the Grand Canyon
review_text: We had a great flight. Check in and loading was easy. Our pilot was friendly and gave us a great tour with lots of information. The views were amazing! Unfortunately everyone doesn't get a window seat. The back row has four seats so seeing is limited.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: This flightseeing tour is a must-do! I am an Alaskan and have flown a lot around the state in small planes. I was blown away by how beautiful this was! Our pilot was skilled, chill, competent, knowledgeable, and easy-going. The plane was larger than I expected and the ride was sooooooo smooth! I highly recommend TAT.

Awesome Airvan tour.  The owners, Ray and Jill were a delight to work with.  Our original morning tour with another operator was cancelled yesterday and we hastily booked for an afternoon tour for today with Air Ventures.  Early this morning, I called to  see if we could change our tour time and Jill was very accommodating.  Despite being very busy due to a cruise ship coming into port, she called me back when a couple seats opened up on an earlier flight.  She even picked us up near our hotel along with another family from the cruise ship.  Ray piloted our tour and was delightful for the entire trip.  He has spent a career flying airplanes, and he obviously loves flying every chance he gets! He made sure everyone was comfortable....even a reluctant father who didn’t like to fly, but went along with the family.  He explained everything and told us a lot of first hand information about the coastline and waterfalls we were seeing.....he has hiked most of the trails we were flying over.   When we returned, Jill was kind enough to drop us off to pickup our rental car.  Truly a pleasure working with small business owners that enjoy what they are doing and understand good customer service.  Thanks to Ray and Jill for a great Kaua’i memory!
The sights you saw on this trip was definitely worth the cost. It definitely made our short trip to Denali worth it and we did not regret the decision to fly with Talkeetna Air Taxi.

This was a surprise for my wife, neither of us had ever done anything like this before. She was a little nervous never having flown in a small plane but once in the air the view takes your mind off of everything else. We went around the entire island and were able to see everything. The weather was perfect. The pilot would go into an area so one side of the plane could see and then bank around so the other side could see. He would always ask if everybody got their pictures as he would go again if they had not. It was never an issue. We had already seen much of the island by the time we took this tour but totally different experience from the air.

We booked this before we flew out as the recommendations were so good. Best thing we did!! Adriel, our pilot, was an excellent guide and he also very kindly had waited for us as we had got stuck in traffic (when they tell you it's only 10 minutes from Miami Beach beware, took us 40)
We did the Miami tour which lasted a good 30 minutes and took us all along South Beach, over Downtown and out to Key Biscayne. It was absolutely amazing - this is the way to see Miami! The plane is very comfortable too with super views, way better than flying in the bigger planes and I speak as a nervous flyer normally. We're hoping to get back to Miami in the not too distant future and this will be the first thing we book! Do not miss this opportunity!

This is my second time flying with Bruce.  First time back in 2012.   Both Bruce and Ellen are extremely friendly and are always helpful in providing you with any information you need on the islands.  Very good weather for today's flight.  Got some awesome photos of Waimea Canyon and the Napali Coast.  Would definately fly with them again.

My friends (4 total) and I took the flight because I wanted to see Denali from above.  The staff was so friendly and accommodating.  We postponed our flight one day due to weather and it was no problem.  The day we got to Talkeetna Air Taxi it was raining on the ground but when our pilot Michael got us going we suddenly were in full sunshine.  We had a beautiful and informative tour and our landing on the glacier was perfect.  The time on the Glacier was just enough.  Overall the experience was unforgettable, and was my favorite part of our time in Alaska.  Thank you to all especially Michael.

Just returned from an amazing ride on a biplane with Kevin. The views were unbelievable, and the accompanying narration was very informative.  We have taken helicopters before, but the biplane was something really special. Smooth ride and experience.

review_title: K2 Glacier Landing Flight - Do It!
review_text: We took the Glacier Landing Flight.   Fantastic trip!  I was speechless at the beauty.  Walking on the glacier was a great experience.  Chip was our pilot and so knowledgeable about the areas and what we were seeing.  (See, Chip, I remembered your name ).

We traveled to Kauai and flew with Bruce on Oct. 20. It was a super experience for us, especially since we both love flying. Certainly seems to be the best way to see pretty much of a beautiful island. Weather was perfect too. Thank you Bruce and Wings! Alan and Pam, Wyomissing, Pennsylvania

Surprised my husband got his bier throat and he loved it!  It was so fun! Clear weather and the views were beautiful!  Flew over SF, Mt Tam, Stinson Beach, Golden Gate Bridge, even saw some whales breaching.  Highly recommend this adventure.

My sister and I took this tour on our special vacation together.  We enjoyed hearing information about the island and appreciated the welcoming attitudes of our pilot and guide, Bruce.  It was a wonderful way to see the sites of the island.  We were very pleased with this unforgettable experience.  The price was reasonable and the plane was accessible for persons over 55 years of age. Thanks so much-Sharon and Denise

Bruce & Maren are wonderful. My dad & I felt right at home. The flight was the best we have had on Kauai. We have been on a helicopter & bi plane but this was the best. It was so enjoyable that we hope to fly again tomorrow with Bruce. My dad is a pilot from Idaho & he got to be the co-pilot.

review_title: Fun flightseeing in a tiny airplane
review_text: We took off in the smallest plane in the fleet, which turned out to be perfect, as the day was cloudy and we were able to dart among the clouds until we were above them, with gorgeous views of Denali and the surrounding mountain range.  Our pilot was knowledgable and friendly.  He did everything possible to make our experience special, which it certainly was.  This is not a cheap activity, but if your budge can handle it, it's worth every cent.  Do it!

Very friendly staff and knowledgeable pilot.   Our original booking was cancelled due to fresh snow preventing the landing on the glacier.  The Cruise Line just canceled and offered us no explanation.    We were walking in town and saw the K2 sign.  Went in and asked a few questions.  They explained then booked us on a different flight.   Awesome time!!!   Saw peak of Denali, then down into valleys and followed the glaciers.   Well worth it and one of the highlights of our time in Alaska.

We did an excursion to see the Misty Fjords while our cruise was in port. I am so thrilled that we did this trip. Our pilot, whose name unfortunately escapes me (it wasn't the owner), made us all feel incredibly safe the whole time. He played music, gave us information about the area, and let us ask any questions. We had a beautiful day and had tremendous views. Even my wife, who is scared of flying, felt comfortable the entire time. Everybody gets a window seat, and it is truly an unforgettable experience. They pick you up right from the port exactly when they say they will, and bring you back once the trip is over.
Wonderful experience, beautiful views. Definitely the way to see the Canyon and all the beautiful scenery. Took my daughter who had never seen the canyon and it was a great flight.
tour_name: 7 -110_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour_2025-02-27

review_text: The flight was the best way to experience seeing the Grand Canyon and especially the floor if you can not hike down. It was the perfect start to our stay!
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_title: Amazing pilot -- we flew with James
review_text: James made the whole experience amazing.  For a nervous flier, he made the flight easy to handle.  I would fly with them again for sure.
It’s the best way to see the eruption devastation. The flight is one hour out and back, which is pretty short for the value.

review_title: Great option for an aerial overview-Affordable and Great Service
review_text:
We were looking at Helicopter tours, but I read so many great reviews for Wings Over Kauai, that I preferred the plane. My husband wanted to do a doors off helicopter but there were weight limits and the potential of being crammed in a middle seat. I didn't want to pay a lot and be stuck in the middle. My husband, friend, and I decided to try this option. 

We did the airvan tour. Booking and check-in were smooth. There was plenty of parking near the office. The plane also had plenty of room. We went with one other nice couple. Customer service was excellent. The flights were pretty full but they squeezed us in for a 4:00 p.m. flight and it was perfect. The sun was out and the lighting was great for pictures. Bruce personalized the tour and gave us a good background of the island too. They also had drinks in the plane if anyone wanted them.
After the flight, they gave us a CD with music and our pictures in front of the plane at no extra charge, which was a nice gesture.

I also think you got more minutes in the air with the plane and less rocky motion so if anyone is subject to motion sickness, this would be a smoother ride and nice way to see the island.
In sum, we highly recommend this as it is a great value for an aerial tour and excellent customer service.

I highly recommend Redtail Air/Pinnacle Helicopters to see Moab and the surrounding area. It was better than I expected, and our pilot, John, was very friendly and personable, and was also very knowledgeable and put us at ease as this was our first helicopter experience.

We just got back from our Wings over Kauai tour with Captain Bruce. It was absolutely the highlight of our trip.  As an airline pilot myself, I am very cautious about safety, that is why I chose an airplane tour instead if a helicopter tour, and I have to say that I would highly recommend this outfit. Captain Bruce was safe, cautious, smooth, professional and an overall excellent pilot. Not to mention an excellent tour guide with a wealth of knowledge about the island. We brought our two young children with us and they treated all of us very well and went out of their way to make all of us comfortable. I highly recommend Wings over Kauai! You will love it too!!

review_title: One of the most amazing taxi rides you can take. Once in lifetime! Amazing!
review_text: We took the talkeetna air taxi adventure to about 14,000 feet on one of the largest glaciers in the world deeper then the Grand Canyon well over made wide. We landed at the base camp and had the opportunity to get out wonder around in very fresh snow on the glacier. Their were many hikers staying at the base camp getting used to the altitude and practice hiking so they could hike to the next camp level. On this particular day we crossed paths with the first small group to reach the summit of Denali and return back to take the taxi down. I have done 3 of the most amazing adventures in Alaska. The plane ride up with the plane driver talking to us about the different glaciers and how high we were going was exciting and amazing. I hope I get one more time to go up and wonder around perhaps stay over night on the glacier it was incredible and I wish everyone could take this trip once. It changes the way you think when you realize how big that glacier is 45 miles long, deeper then Grand Canyon and at least mile or more wide. Hiker look like ants on the glacier from the small plane. Adventure of a life time.

We took the Denali Experience with K2 Aviation and it was one of the key highlights of our 2 week Alaska trip in late July. 
The staff at K2 are a wonderful set of people. Professional and at the same time, so very personable. Because of uncertain weather, we had to change the date & timing of our flight a couple of times. They worked with us through several options to find something that would fit in with our schedule and provide us with a memorable viewing experience. 
We did the 90 min flight in a 6 seater. Our pilot was experienced, relaxed, safety conscious, highly knowledgeable and keenly observant of the weather and modified the route to ensure optimal viewing of the glacier, the surrounding mountains and Mt. Denali itself and all along, provided a rich commentary to enhance our experience. I still get goosebumps when I think about that incredible flight. A big shout out to K2 for making it such a once-in-a-lifetime flight.

We flew with K2 in 2013 and enjoyed the lower glacial flight but had hoped to be able to fly around the summit of Denali.  On our return trip July 2015, the weather finally cooperated and we were able to check one more thing off our bucket list.  Truly a wonderful experience with extremely capable pilot, Patrick.

review_title: Incredible views of Denali and mountain glaciers
review_text:
My wife and i loved our visit to Alaska. We happily chose to fly over Mount McKinley/Denali using Talkeetna Air Taxi.  A first class outfit, we flew in a Dehaviland Otter with Tyler,  a superb young pilot who inspired confidence and was helpful as a guide. We experienced once in a lifetime views of Denali and the Alaskan Mountain range and actually landed on a glacier!
I was very impressed by the integrity of the administrative staff, also. Service oriented, safety-conscious and attentive to our needs, we received an unexpected partial refund when cloud cover did not permit the airplane to circumnavigate the whole of Denali.

we had a great tour of the island of Kauai,, the pilot was very good and also with humor as he would point out different things on the island... we would recommend this tour to any friends of ours who would go to Kauai.

My friend and I was on Regent Seven Seas Cruise and could not get onto the cruise-offered Bear tours in Ketchikan as they were all full.  We then happened to try this Seawind Floatplane Bear Tour which was sold at the pier (by a gentleman called Terry Chandler).  It was a fantastic and well organised tour. Seawind is a family operated aviation service run by Steve and Lesley Kamm.  They were such nice people and you feel safe as well as being well taken care of at the same time.  Not the big commercial feel at all.  The guide, Drew, who went out with us to find bears was also extremely hospitable and professional at the same time.  I am actually very happy that I did not get onto one of the big Regent groups - I am sure the Regent Tour would have been good too - it is just that there is a caring and non-big-corporate feel to the Seawind Aviation Bear Tour.  My friend and I joined up with another family of three, which makes up a cosy 5-people group to go out on the floatplane to see bears!

AND WE SAW BLACK BEARS HUNTING SALMON ON THE RIVER AND WE WITNESSED A CATCH WHICH WAS FANTASTIC!!  Drew was helpful throughout the tour to look for more bears (we saw cubs on trees with their mother keeping watch, too!). Overall a most wonderful tour.

Thank you, Seawind Aviation, for looking after us well.

I went on this tour and highly recommend it. The flights were very easy from Oahu and back from
Hilo to Oahu. My tour guide was Mel and he was EXTREMELY knowledgeable about each topic he discussed. He even told a very long informative story on Capt Cook on our sojourn around the southern half of the island. I could have done these things on my own but why? Mel had a ton of history, culture and facts to offer at each stop and we had a very comfortable air conditioned bus taking us to multiple sites. This was well worth the price during a week long trip to Honolulu and I left the big island feeling much more educated and enlighten on the area. The volcano was the pivotal part of the tour and ended the day. This was a great experience! 

Tips for others be prepared to walk and get in and out of the van many times. Bring extra water if possible and a good camera for numerous amazing shots of the local area.
tour_name: 15-Hawaii Volcanoes National Park Experience Departing from Oahu32_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: We can’t recommend this experience enough! Our pilot KJ was friendly yet professional. We were flying to celebrate our son’s birthday, and KJ let him sit up front. We felt safe the entire time and had a great trip. Our son is completely hooked and now wants to be a pilot too, and KJ talked with him a lot on how to make those dreams happen. We’ll be back to fly again soon!
The Pilot was  an amazing guide. We had so much fun and the experience was mind blowing. A once in a lifetime experience. My son got to even fly the plane. Thank you so much!!!

First helicopter ride for us and we liked it.

We departed from the Grand Canyon airport, and be aware that Maverick is the second airport turn after the turnaround, not the first.

The reception area is very modern and nice.  You have to pay, show ID, get weighed (done very discreetly), and read an advisory page before meeting the pilot (who will call your name when he is ready to roll).

There were 3 other people sharing our flight.  The pilot does introductions, provides a short trip and safety briefing, and then takes you out to the machine.
