They snap pictures of you with the helicopter and pilot (to sell upon return), do a few more safety briefing things, have you snap on an inflatable flotation device around your waist, and then place you inside the machine.  They use your weight to determine where you should sit and you may not sit next to your party.  We soon understood that isn't a big deal as you also must wear headphones and speak into a microphone so everyone hears everything said for the entire trip so it's not like you can be whispering to your spouse anyway.  You also get belted in via a 3 point system that is pretty robust.  You have to sort of climb in, and there is a guy to help.  It is no harder than getting into a mini-van.  The cabin is heated/cooled so you don't need a coat.  It seemed like the back row seats were a bit more spacious--but they all may be the same.  One of us sat in front, and one in back, and we thought the views were equally good.

The pilot is very good at describing both the aspects of the ride, and also the Canyon below.  The best "buzz" feeling is when the helicopter first goes over the canyon after the run over the woods--it is pretty thrilling.

The entire ride was smooth as glass and we never had a whiff of fear.  It was really both thrilling and calming.

This is a fairly expensive attraction, but we thought it was worth the money.  Upon landing there is opportunity to ask more questions and take more pictures, and they also offer to sell you their professional-taken picture just before take-off, and also a CD.  The pilot lingers to see if anyone is going to tip him and that is a bit awkward but there is zero pressure.

We were glad we went.
This trip was awesome! Got a totally unique and special perspective of the true beauty of these islands. Our guide was knowledgeable and made us all feel super comfortable. Would highly recommend!

We scheduled two flights that were canceled due to weather. We reallly wanted to see Denali from the air. However, they went Over the Top when we went to their office after the flight was canceled. They offered us other flights that, again because of weather, couldn’t go very far but we weren’t interested. But then the lady got on the computer, looking at allll possibilities of things we could do to see more of Alaska. The time she took, the effort she made was phenomenal especially considering that us doing those things would be of no benefit to K2....so I can only begin to imagine how awesome their flights would be, being that concerned for their clients enjoyment. I am sooo impressed!! Will definitely be back next year! Sooo nice!!!
Personnel and Kevin (pilot) were simply amazing.....the weather was a little rough due to the high winds but Kevin made sure we were comfortable and eased our fears...

This was a last minute decision we made and we are "so happy" that we did fly with Seawind Aviation! The scenery and views were spectacular! The pilot was so nice and the staff including the shuttle driver went the extra mile in helpfulness and showed their generosity by celebrating our anniversary with complimentary "Alaska Beers" ! What a Great Time and Great Memories!
Thanks Seawind!

review_title: One of the best parts of our trip
review_text: We had originally booked a day that turned out to be bad weather-wise, so we rebooked. The day before our rebooked date turned out to be gorgeous, and they were most happy to let us change again. The flight was in a DeHavilland Turbine Otter, a little noisy, but everyone gets headsets so that was OK. The pilot was good at narrating as we went. Certainly the highlight was landing on the glacier. If you go, do NOT miss that. It was so cool. And the weird part is where you land is still only around 10,000'. Not even halfway up. This was kinda pricey - but don't miss it. Hint: There is no copilot. That right-hand seat is fair game. TAKE IT!!!

I was really nervous about flying but our pilot Eric made me feel so comfortable about it. It was honestly the best experience and would do it again with no hesitation! This was the best way to start our wedding vacation! We saw all of the island and whales in the ocean. Once in a lifetime view!

An excellent flight, with great views of Kauai and a very informative narration by our pilot Paul.
This was a great way to see this very scenic island and added enormously to our understanding of the island as a whole.  We would highly recommend this activity.

review_title: Amazing Taquan Air trip to Misty Fjords
review_text: This was my favourite of all the excursions we did on our Alaskan cruise and we only booked it while on the ship because my friend liked the look of it. So very glad we did. The beauty of this place cannot be described - its vastness and silence, with nature laid out below and in beautiful action. The ice was just starting to melt in May so the waterfalls were still running, and we had a spectacular cloud-free sky. Glaciated valleys, forests and swamps - what an amazing landscape. I could have stayed in the plane for twice as long although the trip lasted over an hour in any case. At one point we landed in a fjord which was spectacular - I had never flown in a float plane before. The commentary was superb as well. All in all, what a superb way to feed your soul. Do not miss.

review_title: Air plane ride around the island.
review_text: Our pilot was so great.  We flew on October 4th,2018 and although windy, we had lots of lovely views and great information.

review_title: Best way to see the island
review_text: We have just returned from a week in Kauai, Hawaii.  We went on the Air Ventures flight a day before we left and it was great.  The weather was wonderful.  I sat in the co-pilot seat in the front and the view was great.  The pilot was very knowledgeable of the island and the flight was really smooth.  I would recommend Air Ventures to anyone that is going to Kauai, Hawaii. I would recommend you go on Air Ventures early in your vacation.  Thanks Air Ventures.

review_title: Bucket List Trip to Ruth Glacier
review_text: Chatty and excellent pilot.  Smooth ride.  Gorgeous mountains and glaciers.  Smooth and safe landing on Ruth Glacier.  We loved walking on the glacier and viewing Denali Mountain up close.   Wonderful

Very nice and informative ride… spectacular views. Eric the pilot was a great cheerleader the whole trip and very knowledgeable ….only downside is we did not get to buzz The Four Seasons on Lanai, Larry Ellison‘s private island for  big shots.

We booked the Grande Denali tour with glacier landing.  The weather threatened to abridge our tour but, gratefully, the clouds cleared and it was fabulous.  We saw an avalanche in real time, and rainbows made an appearance on our way back to the airstrip.  The flight, glacier landing, and 2nd takeoff were fantastic beyond words.  It was THE highlight of our Alaska trip, worth every penny.  The people were very nice.  We can't more highly recommend it.
Great experience! It gave us a unique view of Maui, we saw the invredible color of ocean, shores and rain forest! I reccomend this amazing experience

We missed this tour on our previous trip and were so glad to take it this time.  Beautiful views of the mountains and glaciers!  Our pilot did a great job with narration and keeping us informed of distances and other planes.  We even got a look at Denali which we missed the previous day in the park.  This was the highlight of our trip!!!

My friend booked this as an excursion in Ketchikan for our cruise. There were 10 of us and it was amazing. Jackie picked us up and she was great ( also being a Buffalo Bills fan due to her nephew playing on the team and most of us were Bills fans made it fun and great conversation) Steve our pilot was awesome too. He was very knowledgeable. I highly recommend Sea Wind Aviation!
This was hands-down the most memorable experience I’ve had in Hawaii. Eric’s love for flying and knowledge of the island made this trip beautiful.

Wer hier mitfliegt, muss auch damit rechnen hinten in der Mitte zu sitzen (2 Plätze). Dann hat man nichts vom Flug. Man kann nicht runter schauen. Man sieht nicht, was gerade vom Pilot erklärt wird. Der Blick ist dann so, wie von einem Parkplatz an der Canyon Kante mit viel Sitzlehne vor einem. 
Wir hatten leider dieses Pech. Kostet aber das gleiche.

review_title: Perfect Way to See the Misty Fjords in Ketchikan
review_text:
Leslie and Steve Kamm are the owners of this Misty fjord flight seeing company. I booked directly with them. Leslie was extremely helpful and just a delight to deal with. We where picked up just steps from our cruise ship by another friendly staff member. After a short drive we arrived at their office where we were given our safety demonstration and were ready to go. Steve loaded us in and took us on just an amazing tour of the fjords. He is very knowledgeable about the area and educated us about life in Ketchikan. 
I would highly recommend this tour and thank Leslie and Steve for their professionalism and pleasant staff. Our experience was fantastic!
The pilot was a gentleman and very knowledgeable about the history and geology of the canyon. Pre flight crew was professional and detail oriented.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text:
Paul was our pilot and was a wonderful tour guide as well as excellent pilot.  This was my first trip to Kauai and if I could only choose one of the several activities we did while there - this would be it!  The views were fantastic and the history and local education during the tour was extremely interesting.  This is a fantastic way to see the whole island and the variety of beauty Kauai has to offer.
I will say that if you have never flown in a small plane or are prone to motion sickness that taking something prior to the flight would be a very good idea.  Although I was with friends who have flown on many small planes and they commented that the pilot did an excellent job!
Thanks for helping make our vacation memorable :)
Diane F - Reno NV

We had a limited amount of time to visit Kauai due to the cruise ship itinerary so decided to take this bi-plane adventure and glad we did. Jill picked us up and delivered us after the flight; she was very welcoming; weather cooperated. Our pilot delivered and surprisingly the bi-plane is only two years old. A warning to avid photo buffs with cellphone camera - try to anchor your cellphone to your body - during an overview of a waterfall my cellphone accidentally went a couple of inches outside the cockpit and was whisked away in the slipstream. A bit of a downer particularly when Jill indicated that the pilot had an accessory we could have used to avoid this.

What do you need?
A great weather (thats luck!)
A working aircraft and
A pilot,who explains and gives you the safe feeling from taxiing out to touch down, like Greg Sanoski.

Came w/o reservation - as it was a beautiful day. Got a flight within 30 min. and it was simply unbelievable.
JT our pilot was wonderful! Such an awesome experience and absolutely worth the price! Very informative and smooth take off and landing.

review_title: Amazing plane ride experience with Eric on our Honeymoon
review_text: We had a fantastic experience flying with Eric to see the wonders of Maui, Hawaii. Eric is very entertaining and fun and provided water and drinks and took pictures of us for amazing memories. It was a lifelong experience. Thx Eric!

What a spectacular flight!  Our captain was a great tour guide, very knowledgeable about the people, culture and history of the island. So much of Kaua'i' beauty can only be seen from the air and it is amazing!  The rugged west coast and variety of rock colours up the valleys was a wonderful surprise.  Well worth the adventure. 
Wendy C.
Great experience!!! It was my first time on this type of excursion and I am truly glad that I took the leap into the unknown!

Took a one hour trip with a glacier landing - K2 McKinley Experience. Weather was mostly clear and we saw Denali, it snowed a little when we landed on glacier. Pilot was great and explained what glaciers and mountains we saw. Great trip
Amazing! The pilot was excellent. Perfect flight along with a wealth of information of Denali. Would recommend this trip to everyone.

review_title: No Trip to Las Vegas Would Be Complete Without It
review_text:
Having booked a week in Las Vegas over the 4th July weekend, one of our top priorities was to get to see the Grand Canyon. We originally planned on hiring a car and driving there, but were put off by the lengthy drive and the idea of a whole day cooking together in the car !
Instead, we decided to look at our options for taking a flight over the Canyon. Taking our place in the human mass that ebbs and flows up and down the Strip, we were occasionally cornered by sales or timeshare agents trying to persuade us to part with more of our overdraft (!) in exchange for a variety of trips, shows and events. We quickly established that booking a flight through these agents was going to cost a minimum of $130 each (around £80 in real money) for a plane trip, and substantially more for a helicopter ride. We also learned the hard way, that it's sometimes difficult to extract yourself from the clutches of these agents, if they get even the slightest sniff of possibility that you might take your wallet or your credit card out. So if you intend speaking to them, you have to be prepared to walk away if you don't want what they're selling !

Once we'd established the 'ball-park' cost of a trip, we returned to our hotel and accessed the internet to compare prices direct. Keeping to our budget, we wanted a short plane ride which wouldn't take up all of our day. After some searching, we found GrandCanyonAirlines.com who have a broad spectrum of both helicopter and airplane options available. Their website is easy to use and their prices are far better than most. We booked 2 tickets online for $94 each (around £60), opting for the early morning (6am) flight. Be warned though - the website allows you to check flight availability for the next day but it doesn't tell you until AFTER you've made your selections, that you have to book at least 3 days in advance !?!?! So don't leave it until the end of your holiday to book in. Having negotiated this minor hurdle, we then discovered that our pick-up time would be at an ungodly 4am ! Not the easiest time in the morning to rise after a night of Mojitos and Margueritas ! !

Anyway, on the day, our pick-up was running 10 or 15 minutes late (no big deal) and after collecting four other couples, the drive to Boulder City airstrip took around 40 minutes. The set up there is pretty good and certainly better than I imagined it might be. They have a fairly new terminal building with a small coffee shop / gift store, and enough seating for most. Each passenger books in and is then weighed, to calculate distribution around the airplane cabin. This was particularly pleasing as it made a mockery of those who had raced off the bus to be first in line, shouldering children and elderly folk out of the way to get the best seats - I'm joking of course but there was a stampede to be first in line ! Outside on the apron were numerous helicopters and around the corner sat the airplanes. Lots of people were arriving from different places for a number of early flights. Unfortunately for us, only 4 of the 8 passengers booked on our plane had managed to drag themselves out of bed for the pick-up, and our flight was cancelled. This is something else to be wary of, although you have no control over it. If they don't have the minimum number on the day, the flight is scrubbed. We were offered alternative flights and chose to return next morning at a slightly later time (so we could get more sleep ! !).

Our pick-up next morning was more eventful - Running late again with another family already on the bus, we were then delayed a further 20 minutes at our hotel while we waited for members of said family to visit the restrooms !  What it is exactly that takes 20 minutes, I'll never know ! ! !  However, this is another drawback of these trips and you should be prepared for the possibility that your pick-up may run very late. It clearly caused some concern with those waiting further along the Strip to be collected. Nonetheless, we still arrived at Boulder in time so there was less time sitting around.

So to the flight. The plane was small and cosy with large viewing windows. The crew were very friendly and accommodating. We had headsets that alternated between playing an audio travel guide with useful information on the area, and a cheesy soundtrack that I reckon was taken from "Blazing saddles" !  The flight was nice and smooth (taking into account the odd airpocket that wouldn't constitute turbulence, but which still caused my other half to attempt to surgically remove my left bicep, using only her fingernails and her teeth ! !) And the Grand Canyon itself... What can I possibly say that far better writers than I, havn't already said...?  It was an experience we'll never forget. It was utterly magnificent. It's impossible to convey the sheer scale and magnitude and it was so humbling to fly over it, through it and around it. Driving to the rim would never have afforded such views, so taking the plane ride was money well spent. It was a fabulous journey which also took in the Hoover Dam and it's new road bridge, as well as Lake Mead.

Would we recommend Grand Canyon Airlines? Definitely. 
Would we fly with them again? Absolutely. In a helicopter next I think !
What should you take? Cameras, spare batteries and memory card, cash (for the coffee shop / gift store), sunglasses, water (it can get pretty stuffy if the bus is full).

My flying was cancelled twice due to no fly days because of high winds. Finally good weather & great time. Pilot Billy very friendly & provided narration for entire trip. Unable to have glacier landing but csr service very prompt on crediting my credit card. They also keep you up to date on flying status & weather via email. Well worth the wait. Did have bit of headache afterwards due to vibration & noise but would do it 
again (& again)
Amazing bird’s eye view of the five islands of Maui county! Niece got to fly the plane for a bit (including take-off — what a thrill!). Appreciated all the ocean blues from the air. So much fun!
What a fantastic experience! Jill the owner is amazing​! We saw more of the island with a longer ride than any copter ride! The plane itself was so smooth! Highly recommend this company and tour!

This was definitely the highlight of our trip. Pilot Alex was fantastic. We had a great experience landing on Ruth glacier and getting some fantastic inflight views of Denali. You'll get to see 360 views of Denali. I highly recommend the glacier landing as it's a truly unique experience

review_title: Definitely a great way to get from the San Juans back to the real world ...
review_text: Loved the flight ... the plane came in to Friday Harbor a bit late (about 10 minutes), and for those of us used to constant updates on delayed flights on the regularly scheduled major airlines - and in this case, no news at all - was slightly anxiety-raising ... but the pilot was delightful, friendly and knowledgable, got us under way with no fuss - and the flight itself was spectacular: the views were great, and the flight itself extremely smooth (our flight from SeaTac to Chicago, on a 737, was a study in contrast, with harried passengers, stressed flight attendants, and a bumpy ride).  And the coordination on the Reston end was perfect: the van was waiting for us to take us to SeaTac, the driver was helpful, and the trip to SeaTac blissfully short.  Highly recommended!
Lovely flight, great commentary from pilot. Wish we could have seen all sides of the mountain, but wind prohibited it and no reduction in fee was offered.

Had a fabulous tour.  The scenery was breathtaking.  The jet helicopters were smooth.  Our pilot, Laith was very professional and "Looked real good"...an added bonus.  We all thoroughly enjoyed the trip and the Grand Canyon was impressive.  Was worth the money.   Would do it again next trip to Vegas.

I  flew Taquan Air on 7 August 2012 and found it an excellent experience.  The company is very professional.  We flew to a site about 50 miles north of their base and landed.  We were met at the dock with a van that took us about a mile to a path we would take to watch the bears.

Our guide knew the history of Alaska, its plants, and its animals.  I felt very safe with him around.  And, we saw bears eating at a waterfall.  I got some great movies of this experience, one I will always remember.

So, use them or not is the question.  I say use them.

Prior to coming to Alaska, we were on the fence as to whether to spend the money on a Glacier flight. As a consequence, it wasn't until we were in Talkeetna, having a homestyle breakfast with other travelers, that we heard so many people raving about this experience, we decided to take a last minute trip. Luckily, there was just enough space on the plane for 2 more and less than an hour after breakfast, we were at the Talkeetna Air Taxi depot. This was one of the most incredible experiences we have ever had. It is nearly impossible to describe how it feels to see some of the beautiful vast wilderness, coupled with excellent descriptions from our tour guide/pilot. This is a must do!

The company is friendly, talented and interactive throughout the experience.  They are focused on making this a comfortable/pleasant experience.  This is the only way to get closer views of the full variety of gorgeous features that Kauai has to offer, throughout the island.

review_title: Great activity to see the city
review_text: I took my fiancé as a surprise for his birthday. We both loved it and got to see the city from a new perspective. Our pilot and all of the staff were friendly and safety oriented.

We scheduled an airplane tour with these folks three weeks before visiting the Canyon.  On the day of our tour it was snowing and they called the hotel and told us they couldn't fly.  They offered later dates but we were leaving the next morning so they did a full refund to our credit card which posted the next day.

They were super professional and super easy to work with.

Eric was an excellent pilot!
Fun, Funny and full of knowledge. 
He checked up on each of us during the flight to make sure everyone was ok.
Thanks Air Ventures and Eric for a great tour of the island.

review_title: Do it - best tour - you won't be disappointed
review_text: Our deluxe Grand Canyon air tour on 3/10/2015 was fabulous. Every personal interaction was extremely professional, courteous and helpful.  The pickup at the hotel, greeting at the airport, conduct during the flight and tour all were great experiences.  The views from the air are indescribable and the pink jeep land tour on the south rim was wonderful, with a passionate tour guide named Frankopedia.  Randy, our pilot, did a great job explaining our route, the sights and the history, and went above and beyond what was required to have a great day. I've been on many tours all over the world, and this one ranks among the best. You won't be disappointed.

review_title: Flightseeing with K2 Aviation was Fantastic
review_text: The flightseeing tour was one of the highlights from our trip to Alaska.The glaciers and mountains were beautiful. The pilot was very friendly and knowledgeable. He provided great commentary during the flight. You will see things that just cannot be seen any other way.
Thank you for a fantastic adventure!! My husband,  three boys and I had an amazing day- It was a perfect trip for our entire family!
Never knew so much about Maui until this trip. Felt extremely comfortable and the guide was just Amazing just like the title
It was a great flight. The pilot was very caring and navigated us through the air. It's a fun trip. Very different from the other attractions on the island

We both had an amazing experience doing this tour. It was the highlight of our honeymoon so far. The views from the plane were like nothing we’ve experienced before. We are both nervous flyers, however, Nate put us at ease and was a brilliant pilot. Would recommend this to everyone who wants to experience the whole of Kauai

review_title: Do this trip…you’ll never regret it!  AMAZING!
review_text: This was the highlight of an amazing nine-day trip to Maui.  This trip really has it all.  Seeing the shoreline/cliffs while buzzing over the ocean…whirring above the rainforest tree tops…exceptionally cool landing in the valley…interesting learning from a very knowledgeable pilot both on the ground and airborne…and views that will last you a lifetime.  Worth every single penny without question.   Highly professional experience.   Oh…and if you think you’re scared of heights…relax and enjoy this experience.  This is a complete joy!  Thanks Maverick!!

review_title: Fantastic View Over NaPala Coast and Kauai
review_text:
We wnt on a fantastic flight yesterday aboard the Air Ventures Kauai!!!  We had an hour flight to the NaPala Coast and saw incredible sights that almost take your breath away.  We were here before and took a helicopter ride to do the same thing and this little plane was far better.  We each had a window view of everything.  You didn't have to look around someone to see the sights.  Also the flight was very smooth and slow so that we could take in the sights.  
The pilot was knowledgable and personable and seemed very capable.  The price was right and the experience was one that we will remember always.  
When we spotted whales down below jumping, the pilot took the time to go closer to the whales so that we could see them nd take pictures.  He also answered all our questions. 
We were not able to go to the wettest spot where it rains because it was raining and a very cloudy morning, but he took us up by the North Coast and all over. I appreaciate that because it wasnt safe to go there, we didn't go!
It was a wonderful experience and well worth our time and money. I feel like I have seen Kauai and the wonderful island. 
Bill and karen Grant

If you don’t have the time to visit the whole Island, this is the way to see it!  You get to see the beaches, ports, canyons, farms, ranches, falls etc.  The colors are absolutely beautiful, blue waters, green fields and trees, red canyons.
The pilot will point out all the areas of interest. Don’t miss it!

We were booked on a 45 minute sky experiencing tour with Meverick Helicopters as a part of our itinerary with Vegas Insider Tours visiting the Grand Canyon.. and the experience was worth it all the way..

From check in, the staff were very friendly, taking our ID's, weight and explaining the entire process. We were very lucky that the winds were more calm when it was time for our tour as they had cancelled a few heli tours due to the strong winds. We were very lucky!

Our pilot - young, handsome and very knowledgeable (Rivers), was very pleasant during the entire tour, from explaining details pre-flight to being in the air, he knew everything one needed to know about the Grand Canyon, even the sights that formed a dragon to the names of each temple shaped grounds. The flight was very interesting and we felt immediately that safety was on their top priority as Rivers explained about the winds and the turbulence we would be  experiencing during flight.

We all filled the special bags during the flight, and amazingly on arrival we were greeted with cool towels and bottles of water as Rivers radioed in the request before arrival. His attention was amazing and a true asset to the company.

We would have loved to have our trip on the DVD but unfortunately they had technical problems but they provided us with a generic DVD of a heli tour on the Grand Canyon. Not as special, as it was a lifetime experience and our very first heli ride, but better than nothing.

If you are planning to see the beauty of the Grand Canyon from the air, the best way to go is with Meverick Helicopters, they know their stuff and their hospitality is excellent. Well worth the monies spent!

We had an amazing Denali Flyer Tour with the glacier landing. From our initial contact with Ernie we were impressed. Our pilot Stan was outstanding and highly informative. The following morning we had a little car trouble and Chad jumped right in to help us out. 

A flight tour around Denali is a must for any visitor to Alaska and K2 is the company to trust for an outstanding time.

We booked with Mavericks Helicopters the the Canyon Dancer tour.  It is a 45 minute helicopter tour of the canyon.  
When we first arrived, we were at the wrong part of the airport.  We ended up in a building that belonged to another helicopter tour company.  There were SO many people and  it was utter chaos.  
When we arrived at the Mavericks facility, it was calm, clean, and so peaceful.  We were checked in by the super friendly and very helpful staff.  Our pilot was ready for us right on time for our flight.  We were lucky enough to have Vern as our pilot.  He was a great pilot and so personable.  He kept us updated on the entire journey of the helicopter and our beautiful surroundings.
The helicopter seats 7 plus the pilot.  No matter where you sit on the flight, you will still have a great view.  Whats to say about the view, but majestic and spectacular.  Words cannot describe.  The pilot told us about each part of the canyon we were viewing as we flew over. 
We were in the air between 45-55 minutes.  
After landing, the pilot offered to take our photos in front of the helicopter.  This was well above and beyond because prior to take off, a photographer comes and takes your photo that you can purchase upon return.  
Whatever this tour costs, I would HIGHLY recommend it when visiting the Grand Canyon and I would STRONGLY recommend going with Mavericks.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: Excellent experience! Truly recommend to other travelers! Despite it was a bit late due to windy weather, everything went smooth and friendly!

We took our flight while the cruise ship we were on was in port.  Ellen provided transportation to the airport and back to the ship at no extra charge.  The views were spectacular and Bruce was great at sharing his knowledge of Kauai while piloting the plane.  The entire staff was personable. I recommend taking the Grand Deluxe Tour if you visit Kauai.

Beautiful experience to see the Bay Area from the air. Taking off from Mill Valley/Sausalito, soon after Tiburon-Belvedere, Ángel Island, Alcatraz, Treasure Island, Bay, San Francisco Financial district, over the Golden Bridge, Stinson Beach, Bolinas, Point Reys light house, Inverness, Nicasio, Lagunitas, Woodacre, Fairfax, San Anselmo, San Rafael, Corte Madera, landing back in Sausalito. Total time, 1 hour of incredible views.

Joe & Miriam

review_title: Rundflug um Doppeldecker über die schönste Insel
review_text: Als Geburtstagsgeschenk für meinen Freund gönnten wir uns den Rundflug im 'Biplane', dem roten Doppeldeckerflugzeug. Man sitzt zu zweit dicht nebeneinander in einer offenen Kabine. Ein einmaliges Erlebnis. Die Onlinebuchung ging sehr schnell und unkompliziert. Wir wurden freundlich und mit hawaianischer Gelassenheit begrüßt. Unser Pilot war sehr erfahren und erzählte während des gesamten Fluges viele interessante Dinge über die Insel und ihre Einwohner. Das durchwachsene Wetter mit kleineren Regenschauern wurde bei der Flugplanung berücksichtigt, sodass wir trotzdem viel sehen konnten. Alles in allem war der Flug ein echtes Highlight und sehr empfehlenswert für jeden der Kauai besucht!
what an amazing adventure Chris was informative, could not have asked for more.   Will definitely spread the word

My wife and I took a flight seeing tour in August 17.  We had great weather and were just blown away by the scenery.  There is no substitute for flying over Denali in a little plane.
I am also a wheelchair user and the kind folks at Talkeetna Air Taxi were very helpful and accommodating.  It was a huge transfer up into the plane but we got it done and I was so grateful to be able to take the flight.
Laura is our pilot and she’s so amazing and professional, that we really enjoyed our time with her. Had wonderful time in the plane, and Laura provided explanation along the ride. Thank you so much!

The flight was absolutely stunning! Our pilot Spencer kept us entertained the whole flight! These guys go above and beyond to ensure your safety as well as ensure you have a fun flight no matter the weather or unforeseen circumstances.  Such a perfect date night idea!

The seaplane is a de Havilland Beaver, bright yellow. It’s so cool to look at and and amazing adventure to be part of. Ed assisted me with my booking and he was very helpful and accommodating. Fred the pilot is a gem; very experienced and so passionate about both the airplane and about flying you around. His knowledge of the area is sublime and he made us feel very safe. I travel to San Francisco quarterly and I will definitely fly with Seaplane Adventures every time I am in town. Well done guys, you rock!

I didn’t have plans today and contacted Lesley who was able to get me in on one of the trips with an open seat. I’ve never been on a float plane before, but it could not have been any better. The pilot was confident and knowledgeable. Steve and Lesley are great. Take offs and landings were smooth and the fjords were beautiful. I highly recommend this professional company for a wonderful time.

The trip was on a classic Dehaviland Otter retrofitted with a turbo-prop engine.I hadn't booked a landing as part of the package, but other on the same excursion had, so I was able to land on the glacier too. This ended up being my favorite part of the trip. Standing on the glacier, there was a beautiful sense of quiet, and the views of the surrounding mountains were superb.  It was easy to get great photos. This is not to say the rest of the trip wasn't great as well. On the way up and back, the frozen ponds, lakes tundra and rivers were striking and otherworldy. From the vantage point of the airplane, we were able to see the flow of the glacier and the slight signs of melting water brought by spring. The pilot was an excellent and genial guide. Definitely worth the money.
It was really fun and our guide was really funny and he was very good at explaining the history of the island.

review_title: K2's flights to and in Denali National Park
review_text: Of all the flights I've taken in Alaska this was both the most exciting and smoothest ride of all.  My pilot (Phil) was also well versed when talking about Denali.  He could maneuver the plane as if it was a part of him.  Such smooth turns when flying up along the glaciers in Denali.  I'll remember this for a lifetime.

What an amazing way to see Maui... Through The Valley to Molokini crater..  I could see the ocean floor; five islands at one time!!!  Such wonderful customer service and nothing better then the kāmaina rate.
Next trip big island!!!

I signed up for the longest flight but the weather didn't cooperated.  Denali decided to invite a warm front that generated a lot of clouds and rough air.  However, the pilot did what he could to make the flight and give us the best experience he could, under the circumstances.
As a result, the company responded with a sizable refund so I felt I received the best value I could.  The people were extremely friendly and accommodating.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_title: Great pilot, talented beyond his years!
review_text:
Our young pilot was Makoa and he was awesome! He was very good at making sure everyone was having a great time and to share the views as best he could with both sides of the aircraft. He did everything in his power to give us a smooth ride. 

The views were exceptional and we had a nice cool morning. I work on the water around Kauai and would have to say that seeing both angles on our coast and canyon really enhanced my love for this place! Everyone should take a flight!
It was absolutely amazing! Sergio was wonderful and it was so worth it! I will definitely come back!

Took the summit and glacier landing tour and it was great weather and superb flying.  Our pilot Chris was very informative and helpful. he made easy takeoffs and landing.  It required headsets to be worn and Oxygen above 12,000 feet.  We topped out at 20,000 ft with Denali.   Landed on Eldridge Glacier for 15 minutes and took some memorable photos.

review_title: The absolute best part of our trip!
review_text: This was a once in a life time plane ride to Ruth Glacier. The pilot and staff were excellent. We had the best views and it truly was breath taking. My husband got to sit next to the pilot on the trip back.

review_title: Tour and check ride rolled into one
review_text:
We flew with Bruce in 2016 and I couldn’t wait to go again!
I’m a piolet but don’t get to fly any more because of the expense!
My instructoral air tour was amazing micro know I can still Handel a 172 and of course the sightseeing was top shelf!

review_title: Great experience and way to see amazing landscape
review_text: Did a flight tour with K2 recently and thought they were great. They were incredibly careful given COVID - we felt completely safe throughout. But they were also incredibly accomodating given the weather and made it a really great tour. People were great, pilot was great, and the experience was great. I highly recommend it!

I ran into an issue with K2 because of my height.  I was unable to see anything on the flight because I was the last person on the plane and got stuck over the wing.  K2 resolved the issue to my satiasfaction.

As an FYI, if you sit tall in the saddle, talk to the pilot and get either the front seat or the rear row seat.  If I had, it would have been a great filight.

My wife’s first helicopter ride was a great delight for her. Michael gave us a smooth ride, and was very informative. Being in a helicopter we were able to get lower, and closer to the formations. Only regret it was only 20 minutes, but it was worth every penny.

No fault of K2 Aviation, we just went on the wrong day - wrong week - wrong year.  Cloud cover kept us from doing much more than seeing two glaciers.  No landing.  Awesome views of glaciers and moraine and the terrain to and from Talkeetna.  Kevin did the best he could in a shorter flight than planned.  We did see a black bear.  Limited photos.  Just unlucky, frustrated and disappointed on our once in a lifetime visit to Alaska.  We were in the Talkeetna and Denali N.P. area for five days and never saw Denali.  Maybe we will catch a glimpse when we return to Anchorage next week via the Glenn Highway.

A fantastic experience.  We flew from Henderson in a small plane, flying over Lake Mead and the Hoover Dam over the Mojave Desert.  Our pilots were fantastic, allowing us to visit them in the cockpit and get a birds eye view.  Transfer to the chopper was seamless, with a short wait in a very comfortable lounge.  After safety briefing, off we went.  This was the most amazing flight and I must say that once we caught our first glimpse of the canyon, I started to sob and was unable to stop.
The beauty and immensity of this place in indescribable.  After our 25minute flight, we bussed to the Grand Canyon National Park and had a very nice boxed lunch.  Plenty of time here to wander about and some great photo opportunities and viewing points to enjoy.
A must do experience.

Wonderful pilot!!! He was very informative of the glaciers and mountains we were viewing along the way.  Would do this again in a heartbeat.  Stunning vistas!  My husband said that this was the highlight of our trip to Alaska.  We went right over the top of Mt. Denali with the "Summit Tour".

review_title: Talkeetna Air Taxi flight with a glacier landing
review_text: Leanne the pilot was exceedingly professional and knowledgeable.  She obviously knew the area very well and was an excellent pilot.  We had no worries or concerns and could enjoy our adventure to the fullest.
What a wonderful experience! The colors, the land, the history and the hospitality can not be beat.  The most pleasant plane adventure ever.
Very well run operation and they were extremely accommodating.  Regardless of the flight option you select, the glacier landing is an absolute must- wow!

review_title: Most magnificent joy ride over the bay
review_text: We had a hilarious, informative tour guide and the most accommodating staff. We got to see the gorgeous sights around the city and Marin. I would most definitely recommend!

My family and I had a great time on this air tour around Kauai.  The views were unbelievable.  Dori and Josh were GREAT too!  Dori checked us in, talked to us a little bit about the course our plane would be taking, and she took a few family photos of us in front of the plane prior to take off.  Dori also offered us complementary beverages and ginger snacks in case anyone got nausea during the tour (which none of us did).  Josh was an excellent pilot, and he was very knowledgeable about the island.  Probably the best landing I have ever had in a plane too!  Definitely the best tour and the price was great!  These air tours are much more affordable and environmentally friendly because the planes use less fuel than typical helicopters use.  Once the tour was over we meet with Dori again and she gave us a 10 minute DVD highlighting the sights we saw on our trip with one of our family photos on the front of the cover.  Overall had a great time and would do the tour again in a heartbeat.  Ohh and we also loved meeting Milly!!!

review_title: Once in a lifetime experience - Highly recommend
review_text: Highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Kauai. This tour takes you along the coast of Kauai with spectacular views of the coast, island, mountains and the valleys. Some of the places are not accessible by land and their beauty can only be appreciated via the air tour. The tour is run by a family who were extremely friendly and made sure our flight was as comfortable as possible. Our tour was rescheduled due to inclement weather and we were immediately shifted to a new day and time without any issues. The pilot has 30+ years experience flying and all along the tour he pointed us to the important spots on the island with a background about it. This made the tour both personal and informative. Have added some views from our trip below.
I had the most amazing flight tour with this company. I recommend this once in a lifetime experience to anyone.

review_title: Awesome way to see the island of Kauai
review_text: Bruce Coulombe was not only an excellent flight instructor, but a very knowledgeable tour guide as well.  The staff was very friendly and the airplane was great.  Highly recommend to visiting pilots!!
awesome views great day, great information. would recommend to everyone wanting to get a real experience inside Denali.
Very professionally managed.  Smooth process and safety precautions.  Good commentary by pilot overlooking each side of the aircraft, takin his time as we flew over the bay area.  We loved it.

Sherry and I took the air tour today.  Captain Marcus was at the controls.  We have seen this island on the ground from “tip to tip”, have been on many sunset cruises up the NaPali Coast.  We’ve also taken a helicopter tour of this island.  This tour was by far the best way to see the island!  The ground crew was fantastic and the captain was very informative and handled the plane marvelously.  Highly recommend this tour!

We chose to fly with Wings over Kauai because their rates were very competitive (especially compared to the helicopter tour with the Pride of America!). I was greeted with a kukui nut lei (one per couple) and we were offered ginger candy and peppermints to help with motion sickness. Our pilot had great knowledge of the island and a perfect soundtrack to accompany the sites we were seeing out our windows. There was a cooler with cold drinks and towels as there was limited air circulation in the plane itself. I did get a little motion sick because I was taking too many pictures - there's a lot to see! The flight was a good length for me (1 hourish). I will say that helicopters seem to be able to get closer to the sites than planes, but other than that, highly recommended. When we got back, they gave us a pre-recorded DVD of some of the best sites from the Go-Pros all over the plane with a cover that featured a picture of us before the flight and the opportunity to purchase a DVD of our specific flight - we did purchase the DVD which was mailed to us about a week later - it's excellent quality.

review_title: Un de nos meilleurs souvenirs aux USA ! 🤩
review_text: Extraordinaire expérience, une équipe tellement Sympathique ! Un grand merci spécial à monsieur le Pilote, vous êtes au top nous nous sommes régalés 😄 Nous n’hésiterons pas à revenir vous voir la prochaine fois 👍🏼!

review_title: Misty Fjords Seaplane Trip .... An amazing journey
review_text: Absolutely breathtakingly beautiful flying out of Ketchikan, Alaska on the seaplane over the fjords.  We'd never experienced that sort of beauty so close up before.  The pilot was excellent explaining everything to us, showing us waterfalls and trying to spot bears and mountain goats.  A wonderful experience if you get the chance.

review_title: Be flexible and you will have a great experience
review_text: Safety is their #1 priority, and that’s a good thing. Therefore, you trip may be postponed or changed. Most of the negative reviews on here are because the company wouldn’t fly/land in bad weather, which is absurd that people would even be upset about that. We wanted to do the Summit Tour, but that was not available due to COVID. We booked the Grand Tour with a landing, but when we got there, we were only offered the Denali Flyer with a possible landing as the weather was fluctuating a lot. We decided to go ahead and do that and we had an amazing time, we were even able to land on the glacier! When coming I would recommend being flexible, not having your heart set or a particular tour, and if possible, stay in Talkeetka for a night to give even more options. One of the best things we did on our trip, highly recommended!

review_title: Put This On Your Bucket List
review_text:
Seeing the Grand Canyon from the air is essential to get an overall sense of the vastness and majesty of the canyon. We chose the plane instead of a helicopter because it was going to be a longer trip and take us further.

We were delighted by the entire experience, especially when we were able to skirt around a coming storm front and saw the sand/dust it kicked up as it approached the  rim. The pilot said it was not something he's seen very often in his many years.

Highly recommend this experience. The Buckwild Hummer Tour was also awesome!
tour_name: 7 -110_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour_2025-02-27

review_title: Pilot J.P. is a Guaranteed Good Time
review_text: Hello!! My (now) fiancée and I just took a tour of Portland with Envi. Our pilot, J.P, was phenomenal and accommodating. I have a phobia of flying and, while being in a smaller plane is certainly more exciting than a jumbo jet, I felt safe and had an amazing time. I proposed to my girlfriend during the flight and J.P. was great about naturally conversing and being part of the moment without interrupting at all. I would highly recommend him and Envi to anyone!!

review_title: Amazing day for everyone in the family
review_text: We just took a 2+ week vacation and this tour was unanimously the highlight of the whole vacation for everyone in our party (2 families, both with kids 13 and 11).  The plane ride over the Grand Canyon is incredible and Antelope Canyon is unspeakably beautiful.  The hand-off from one tour company to the next throughout the day was seamless -- they really handled a lot of moving pieces so well.  Definitely recommend bringing water shoes, water bottles, and a great camera. Can't say enough about this tour.

When the 5 of us arrived at K2 for our flight around Mt. Denali, we were asked if we would mind our tour changing and being upgraded to a Glacier Landing tour!!!  Obviously we accepted the upgrade and joined 5 other people on the trip.  We had excellent weather, a very knowledgeable pilot who answered all of our questions about the area and we thoroughly enjoyed the glacier landing at the base camp of climbers for Mt. Denali.
Our family of 9 did a Denali Grand Tour with glacier landing and it was awesome! Pricey but how often will you land on a glacier in front of the highest peak in North America?

This is a fascinating way to see Kauai and with great pilots good narration and many fun facts it is absolutely worth it - not to mention that it is twice cheaper than the helicopter tours (we were 2 adults) . This was certainly money very well spent and I highly recommend it to everyone.  You have to remember if you have not seen Kauai from air - you have NOT seen Kauai. Wings over Kauai should be your top choice.

review_title: Better than a helicopter ride must do
review_text: Not sure what to expect initially but we were definitely not disappointed.  The ride was an hour long with history a very smooth ride and so much quieter than a helicopter!  Can’t wait to do it again!  Bruce the owner made our trip so special.

This was by far the best part of our four-month trip around the Yukon and Alaska. If you get a chance to get on one of these planes, especially on a really clear day, your trip to Alaska will be a success!

This was a lot cheaper than a helicopter tour, and I was worried that I would get sick on a helicopter, so we chose this instead.  It is a very small plane, but we had a pretty smooth flight and I thought it was comparable to a large plane.  My wife, however, did get a little sick, but she was more sensitive to the smells and the stuffiness of the plane.  This still surprised me because I am the one that can't handle roller coasters and the like. I enjoyed the flight a lot.  The path we took was ideal.  You could see everything easily.  Taking pictures was occasionally a challenge because I was using autofocus and it sometimes focused on the window.  Setting the focus to infinity can help.  I got to sit in the co-pilot seat, which was kind of cool.  Most of the views were on the right side.  The pilot gave a really good presentation about everything we saw and we could have asked questions but we all just listened to him and enjoyed the view.

Absolutely awesome! Kevin, our pilot was great. He was informative and really seems to love his job. The ride was smooth and not rushed. Beautiful views you won't see from the ground. 
Be sure to ask for Kevin,  for two reasons: one, he's great, and two... Harry, the other pilot doesn't wash his hand after using the bathroom...... and I don't mean number 1. Worst part is that I followed him out of the bathroom and watched him walk right up to a group and shake their hands......

review_title: A double Bucket List checked off😍
review_text: The experience was incredible! Our pilot Devon was amazing as was everyone else at Maverick helicopter tours. The flight, soundtrack and views were absolutely breathtaking this should be on everyone's bucket list, an unforgettable trip of a lifetime and a must do for anyone creating memories.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_title: Amazing flying next to the mountains
review_text:
The flight seeing tour was one of the highlights of our Alaska trip. The pilot was great, he navigated very well. He flew very close to all the peaks and more than the glacier landing it was flying next to the ice clad mountains that was exhilarating. 

The pilot landed us at a nice spot and we spent about 30 mins on the glacier. The overall tour was very well managed. We had an 18 month old with us and they were kind enough to give ear covers for her as well. 

Since it gets quite noisy in the flight, our child didn’t enjoy the flight too much but she had fun on the glacier.
We went on the 45 minute tour and it was incredible!!! Highly recommended tour!!!! Well worth the price.  The pilot was charming and was very informative.  Can't wait to do again!!!
The views were incredible and Russell made sure that we felt safe and comfortable the entire time. It was an incredible experience and I can’t wait to go up again!

review_title: very beautiful views and amazing customer service
review_text: I absolutely loved everything about the experience. Pilot was super friendly and made us feel safe. Communication between the company and us before flight for signing of waivers and other material was very efficient and made the whole process super easy nd convenient. Pillot was very informative about sights throughout the flight which was very nice. Would definitely fly with them again and recommend to anyone looking for a fun, safe and calming experience. Perfect for families, and planes were very spacious making for a very comfortable flight. :")

review_title: Wings Over Kaua’i is a MUST DO!!
review_text:
Hands down, exceeded all expectations! I wish there were 6 stars to rate here! 

Bruce was our pilot with over 17,000 hours (that’s a quote, not a typo!) flight time.  They took safety very seriously, including weight and balance.  I’m a pilot myself and would be looking out for safety.

My wife and I took the 65 min private tour in their Cessna and the views of the coast, inland valleys and Waimea canyons were astonishing!

Pricing is VERY reasonable considering what the helicopter tour charge, and was less than 50% less during our trip.

We would recommend, as we did, taking the flight toward the end of the trip as we got a different perspective of all the places we visited (and didn’t).

Wings Over Kaua’i was the best.
This was our first float plane trip. We flew in to Roche Harbor for our 35th wedding anniversary. It was fantastic. We had the best time.
Great experience.  Loved it.  Highly recommend.    Very nice people to deal with.  Worth every penny.  Wonderful part of my birthday trip to Hawaii.

You really appreciate Kauai when you are able to see the entire island from the sky.  Only experiencing a small area where you can drive and go to the beach is not enough.  Seeing all the waterfalls that start up high and go down from one to the other is truly beautiful.  We also get to see the Napili Coast and many areas where you would never, never be able to drive too.  It was a stunning experience.  My 11 year old and 8 year old both loved it.  She had a hard time hearing in the headphones but the views were good.  The windows are large.  I got to sit in the co-pilot seat because I normally get seasick.  I did not get any motion sickness!!  Ray was a pro pilot!!   He also let me put my hands on the wheel to steer.  That was AMAZING!!!  When is that ever going to happen??  The team here is very professional.  Completely worth it.  ALSO, just wear normal clothes -shorts and t shirt.  The weather is the same in the plane as it is on the ground.

What a great way to see Kauai from a different perspective. We were a bit nervous about small aircraft but Josh and Dori made us feel comfortable from the start. Josh shared lots of stories and history of the island as he pointed out the various sites. I would highly recommend this excursion to anyone that is at all hesitant about flying in a small craft. You get the best of both worlds; yes we didn't get as close to waterfalls as the helicopters but we were close enough for some great views; and without the turbulence.
This safe smooth and very enjoyable flight where the scenery was spectacular and the coastline was lovely. And the pilot made it possible to capture stunning unobstructed photos. Do it.

It was an amazing experience! Really smooth flight, both taking up and landing went perfect. We took lots of fantastic pictures. Both pilots were very friendly, polite, welcoming, checking on you all the time during the flight. A “must have” activity for a trip to Maui!

review_title: THEY TAKE YOU TO A GLACIER!!!
review_text:
I don't know what more to say to give this company a stellar review.. They take you to a glacier! Like hands down one of the coolest experiences of my life and will be talking about forever. 

As far as service, the lady at the front desk was extremely nice and got our group squared away quickly. 

Our pilot Chip, seemed very knowledgeable and calm. Gave us a lot of fun facts while flying to the glacier, and the flight was very smooth, and BEAUTIFUL.

Would definitely go back a second and third time

My now wife and I spent out Honeymoon on Kauai. We were told by one of our friends that we should try Air Ventures, and they were absolutely correct! Air Ventures was by far the best way to experience the island, I would have not done it any other way. In just over an hour they took you soaring by ridges over the island, up through canyons, over coastlines, and into the hard-to-reach places of the island (like the Na Pali Coastline). It was by far the coolest thing we did on our entire trip and we HIGHLY recommend it to anyone reading this.
Amazing experience. Best views same day booking and he presented us with Lei! and the pilot had sweet mustache the pilot had!
The staff was knowledgable, courteous and friendly. The person who passed out the boots was funny and fun. The pilot was smooth. Good time.

What a wonderful experience not to be missed. Our pilot was amazing and we learned so much about the mountain and the surrounding area.
Add this adventure to your Alaskan trip!

review_title: If you are on the fence, do it!
review_text: This was 100% worth every penny! Wow What a beautiful trip. Our pilot was informed, a great educator, and super helpful, too!
Very good excursion, the views of the island are magnificent. Brooke was very professional and introduced us to many local attractions. I highly recommend.

review_title: Seawind Aviation Misty Fjords Seaplane Flight
review_text: Great experience, a must do trip when in Ketchikan. Definitely a trip to remember. This company was very easy to deal with and very accommodating. They provided a very personalised experience and nothing was a problem. Will be recommending them to friends and colleagues.

Everything about this tour was top notch.  The price is right.  Ellen and Bruce are some of the nicest people we met while on the island, they even knew someone from our hometown on the Alabama coast, which was kind of cool.  Bruce is a fantastic pilot and narrator, he involved everyone in the conversation while we were up in the air.  Super smooth take off and landing.   We highly recommend Wings Over Kauai!
Larry and Pam Engel
Foley,  Alabama
Captain Marcus is beyond good in flying me over Kuaui.  He pointed out all interesting sight along the way.  The flight was very smooth.

review_title: Grand Denali air tour with Ruth Glacier landing.
review_text: We took the grand Denali air tour with a landing on Ruth Glacier. Incredible views of Denali and the surrounding mountains and glaciers. The landing on Ruth Glacier was unbelievable. Our pilot was wonderful. Incredible flying skill and detailed descriptions of what we were seeing. He was very good at making sure both sides of the plane could get the same views. This is a once in a lifetime trip - take it if you are in the Talkeetna area!
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: If you're looking for a great way to experience the Grand Canyon but you only have a day...and you're not really within driving distance...and you don't mind paying for what you get, then this is for you. We were staying at the Boulders Spa and our adventure started with shuttle to a local airport followed by an awesome 75 minute flight in a 9 passenger, single turbo prop plane to the West Rim. Next up, a helicopter flight dropping off the rim down to the Colorado river where we boarded a pontoon boat for a powered ride upstream followed by a drift back to the dock. Helicopter back up, followed by lunch in a wild-west style town. Lunch was good and the town's a little silly but fine for an hour. A bus then took us to Skywalk which is at once, terrifying, awesome and anticlimactic. Be prepared to pay for pictures as they do not allow personal cameras out on the glass bridge. As a stand alone feature, it is okay, but as a part of the day it's perfect. Another bus ride to Guano Rock, which is breathtaking and another fabulous opportunity for pictures (you'll be doing this all day anyway). Back to the plane and back to Phoenix. If you get the chance to sit co-pilot, absolutely do. Our pilot and tour guide for the day, I'm embarrassed to say I'm not certain his name was Jim, was a fountain of knowledge about the area and just a genuinely nice guy. Just ask for the pilot who lived in Alaska and used to fly reconnaissance for the police and fire department in the greater Phoenix area. I would go out of my way to request him again. Total time was around 10 hours. As I mentioned up front, the trip's not cheap but worth every penny. All of the staff at Westwind were personable, professional and helpful.
Way to much comprehending needed from the ledge view available by the park services! Spend the money and let thr experts show you natures beauty first hand!
tour_name: 30_115_Grand Canyon Landmarks Tour by Airplane with Optional Hummer Tour2025-03-01

review_text: This was absolutely incredible, highly recommend! The sights were beautiful and it was 100% worth it

Our family of 5 thoroughly enjoyed the Adventure trip.  The trip itself is amazing and spectacular, something to truly be seen in person; pictures don't capture the scale of the canyon (4,000 ft to the bottom!). Westwind service was excellent, with particular emphasis on our pilot, Mark.  Mark made the trip very enjoyable.  Professional, engaging, humorous and patient.  However, the highlight was the helicopter tour to the bottom of the canyon.  (The helicopter tour is booked through a separate company that Westwind hires.) Also, the staff at the Canyon is mostly local tribe people and they were also very friendly and offered very good service.

A few suggestions:  Westwind offers water and snacks at the departure airport.  Take plenty as there was only a fixed lunch offered.  We had a back-pack to stuff items in and it came in handy.  I would have taken more as we didn't stop for water except at lunch. Arrive early/or at least on time.  The area up at the Canyon gets very busy with tourists (primarily Chinese) from Vegas.  Westwind has planned the trip to get there a few hours before the tour groups descend on the area.  Our group was delayed (we were put with another family) about an hour and we saw how things could really get busy.  It worked out OK, but something to keep in mind.

review_title: An amazing excursion idea and fun for all....
review_text:
First.. I would like to thank Steve, the owner of SeaWind Aviation and also our pilot for the excursion.  He was full of fun fact and knowledge on the areas we flew over/through.  The background music he played couldn't have been more perfect for the duration of our flight.  The views were AMAZING!  I was with my fiancé, my Dad and my Aunt on this and we all were in awe of the beautiful scenery you get to take in from so far up.

When I knew my cruise ship was going to be doing a stop in this town and I asked online what was the best excursion to do in the area, several people on social media responded to check out SeaWind Aviation AND I'm so glad we did!  I highly recommend this to everyone, you wont be disappointed.

We had spent 2 weeks on the island and decided to try the flight on one of the last days.  It was really excellent rapidly seeing so many of the places we had visited from a whole different point of view.  The mountain valley, the W side cliffs, Southern coffee plantation and North Side storm damaged town + many other points of interest.  The pilot was considerate of all passengers questions and the challenges of seeing things from one side or the other side of the plane.  Visit was March 2019.

The stuff is nice , pilot so professional I would highly recommended even that we came late they were so nice to us 
Best agency ever
Enjoyable ride with beautiful views and whale viewing. Pilot was great about circling around spotted whales. Fun!

Had an incredible flight with Redtail Air Adventures. Tracy was our pilot and he flew me and my husband from Moab to Glenwood Springs as part of an arrangement with the Rocky Mountaineer Railway. The air tour was just a fantastic experience and Tracy's enthusiasm and passion for the area was infectious. Highly recommend if you are in the area!
Eric was very professional and knowledgeable. He gave us an excellent bird’s eye view of the different islands. We felt very safe the entire time. The beautiful sea cliffs were the highlight !

Alaska era sonho de infância. Parte dele realizado pela K2Avuation. Pessoal super profissionalizado, desde contatos anteriores à viagem até a concretização dela. Durante o vôo o piloto demonstrou muito conhecimento da região tanto geográfica quanto historicamente! Tivemos um dia de sol radiante o que ajudou muito na viagem! Recomendo MUITO!!!

review_title: Flight Seeing of Denali from Talkeetna
review_text: On a trip to Alaska for a family wedding, we decided to spend extended time in the state exploring Talkeetna and Denali National Park.  We opted for a flight seeing excursion from Talkeetna to see Denali rather than a lengthy 10 hour bus trip within the National park as we had heard bus trippers made the effort but never saw Denali (even tho weather was clear earlier in the day). Made reservation with K2 several days before so we knew the forecast.  Our pilot, Chad, gave each side of the plane many opportunities to view Denali plus offered comments regarding climbers’ base camps, named glaciers, blue glacier pools, ski tracks from climbers, etc. Our flight landed on Ruth Glacier and allowed about 20 minutes to get out of the plane and walk on the glacier.  We took hundreds of photos as the day was clear with few clouds.  Although we dressed for warmth for higher elevations (thermal ski clothes liners), Chad was wearing a short sleeved Hawaiian shirt so needless to say, he expected fabulous weather which is exactly what we got.  Sunglasses were a must!  The biggest thrill for me was that I was allowed to sit in copilot seat on return to Talkeetna and able to video takeoff from glacier curving up and thru a canyon to save and re-experience this once in a lifetime event. Definitely a highlight of our Alaskan adventure!

While in Anchorage we realized that a drive to Denali National Park requires more time than we had, so we decided to venture into an aerial view with landing on a glacier. We contacted Talkeetna Air Taxi and spoke to Lisa. She furnished us with great information about the flight and the momentary change of weather patterns in Alaska. We lucked out. Weather was clear allowing for a fantastic view of Denali from the air, and a beautifull landing on a glacier. The four seater plane was piloted by a young man who handled it expertly. Everyone was very friendly and made us feel very comfortabe and welcome. We would like to thank everyone for the fantastic tour and would highly recommend them.

Het kost een rib uit je lijf maar wij vonden het waard. Wat een ervaring! De airport is makkelijk te vinden. Inchecken is zo gebeurd. Je vliegt eerst 5 minuten over bos en dan ineens valt de grond weg en hang je boven de canyon. Waanzinnig! Wij hadden de vlucht van 45 minuten. Had langer mogen duren. De canyon is zo enorm groot. Je ziet dat pas als je eroverheen vliegt. En dan nog is het moeilijk inschatten hoever het diepte ingaat. Had het niet willen missen.

review_title: Great Flight to see Mt. Hood, Rainier, Jefferson and St. Helen's
review_text: Great flight to Mt. Hood and down the Columbia River Gorge.    Had excellent views of not only Mt. Hood, but Mt. Jefferson, Mt. Rainier, and Mt. St. Helens.   Had all we really wanted to see.    Tour was private with only my 14 year old daughter and I.   She loved it.   Pilot pointed out as many viewpoints and waterfalls as possible.   He answered all our questions throughout the flight.    We were at ease the entire time.   Highly recommend this tour.

Our experience at AirVentures was very definitely the highlight of our trip to Kauai.  Ray was both a great pilot and an outstanding tour guide, and we enjoyed every minute!  We were able to see parts of the island that we couldn't have seen any other way.  Thanks for a great time!

Wings over Hawaii was a wonderful attraction.
We could see a lot of wonderful scenery and the pilot flew to the best spots and gave good information.
The price was very reasonable and the owners were very nice.
Our first helicopter tour!  The flight was smooth and very scenic.  Our pilot, Gim was friendly and informative.  Definitely worth it to see the most spectacular scenery in the world.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: Even as a retired fighter pilot this was one of my favorite aviation experiences. Our pilot/guide was Steve, a true professional that clearly enjoys his work. His knowledge of the area, skill and aviation skills made the tour exceptional in every way. The weather cooperated and added even more to the breathtaking scenery. I would not miss this tour, it is a great value in time and money!
Our pilot was amazing and we got to see a lot of the landmarks of Miami. Very nice experience for tourists or locals

review_title: This is how you should see Kauai
review_text: What a wonderful way to see the island! We took the private 2-person tour on the Cessna and were treated like family. Capt. Bruce (he’s also Dr. Bruce, a retired research scientist!) and Val were very professional and took good care of us. We were unsure of this morning’s trip as the weather forecast was not looking good. Rain and clouds were about to roll in when we got to the airport. Val greeted us cheerfully, checked us in and went through the safety briefing with us thoroughly. I immediately knew that they took safety seriously. We then waited as we were early for our scheduled departure. It started to rain shortly thereafter and Bruce then called us into the office and showed us the big rain clouds over the Lihue & Hanalei area on the computer. He was very honest and told us that we will likely not have clear views over some areas. So he gave us a choice to reschedule, a refund or to go ahead with the tour (assuring us it was safe to do so). What an honest and professional business! We decided to go ahead and was prepared for a less than stellar experience. Boy, were we wrong! While it was cloudy, the sights were still wonderful as Bruce expertly navigated through the clouds and showed us the spectacular Na Pali Coast and the breathtaking Waimea Canyon. We had to turn around at Hanalei due to the storm clouds (again safety first!) while some other operators decided to go through the area. I knew this as I could hear all the chatter over the radio. A couple others did turn around and followed Bruce’s lead. He must be well respected by the flying community! We made it back to Lihue airport safely with full of wonderful memories. Thank you Bruce for your wonderful sense of humor and knowledge about the island. I enjoyed being your “co-pilot”!
What a beautiful and truly amazing experience!! Eric is a great pilot and allowed us to capture the most stunning photos.

It is absolutely one of the beat ways to see some of the Grand Canyon! The flight was amazing and our pilot was full of fantastic information about the area and canyon. We surprised our boys with the trip and they loved it!! The four of us have the ride to our family only and it made the adventure even more special. I definitely would recommend doing this adventure!!
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text: I gave the biplane ride to my husband as an anniversary gift.  He had done a biplane ride before on Oahu, but this was the first time for me.  Our pilot put us at ease right away explaining the plane and what we would see during the tour.  He was knowledgeable of the island and kept us entertained and informed throughout our 1 hour trip. I would highly recommend the 1 hour trip.  You get to see parts of the island you just can't see any other way.  This company and the biplane ride is a must do for your activities while on the island.

Wow, what an amazing trip! Nothing compares to that experience, really. We just took the 45 min tour from the South Rim airport. Checking in went smooth and the staff was friendly. The ride itself was just incredible. Those views are remarkable. If you're visiting the Grand Canyon, please don't skip this attraction.

We recently flew with Kim, a pilot with Redtail Aviation, and had a wonderful time.  We have spent a lot of time in the Moab, Utah area in our Jeep.  We visit every spring and are always amazed by the awesome landscape we find while 4-wheeling in the area.   This flight put a whole new perspective to the area!  We could look down and see some of our 4-wheeling trails but now could see on the 'other side' of the rocks.   There are arches in Canyonland that would be very difficult to see from the trails, but Kim pointed them out for us!    We highly recommend this flight!

review_title: Take this tour if you can!
review_text: Took the tour during the last week of May with my two adult sons.  Excellent operation from reservations to landing. Felt very safe and enjoyed spectacular views. Fantastic memory for the rest of my life.
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text:
Amazing tour,better than our helicopter tour as everyone gets a window seat. Marcus was wonderful as our pilot and was very knowledgeable regarding the beautiful surroundings. 
Front office lady was very welcoming,  made it easy to book, locate the place, describe where we were going and provided us a free picture with soundtrack of our trip without even asking. One of our favorite things we did on our trip, would highly recommend.

Surprised my husband with an instructional flight on our honeymoon. <3 
Captain Bruce did an AWESOME job - husband loved getting to help fly the plane and I enjoyed the beautiful sights from the back seat.
Very warm and professional service and an EXCELLENT way to see the island! 
Mahalo Captain Bruce!

Awesome! Definitely add the glacier landing. We all enjoyed the flightseeing, and the glacier landing made it perfect. We had good weather, not perfect so didn't get to see Mt Denali, but the pilot tried hard, talking with other flyers in the area. This was a Big highlight for our trip and so glad we did this.

Eric is an amazing pilot, host and he really made the whole experience from beginning to end an enjoyable one. He's a great coach as well in case you want to take a crack at flying the plane at takeoff then he'll guide you through what to do. 

This was a bucket list item that has been fulfilled by Maui Plane Rides!!! I would highly recommend you book this tour with Eric right away!! Well worth the money and the experience is unforgettable. Thank YOU Eric/Maui Plane Rides for the amazing flight, beautiful views and experience.

Pilot Nick led us on a wonderful air tour of the island. Our family of 6 had the plane to ourselves and enjoyed the dramatic cliffs, canyons, beaches and more of Kauai. We made a full loop around the island and Nick pointed out and explained many interesting locations. Thanks for a very memorable day!

Unfortunately, the weather did not cooperate for us to take our scheduled flight and glacier landing.  We rescheduled and tried the next day, but still weren't able to go.  So we ended up flying towards Palmer and seeing the Knik glacier instead.  Since this didn't include the glacier landing, our cost was less than the original tour we booked. Everyone at the front desk was very polite and easy to work with for the rescheduling and check in process. Mike was our pilot, and he did a great job of turning the plane so that everyone on both sides could see well.  My daughter got to ride in the front with him as his "co-pilot", and she was thrilled!  There were four of us, myself, my husband, and our two kids (age 9 and 11).  We all four enjoyed the flight.  It is definitely worth doing even if you don't get to actually see Denali!

I only bought the shortest flight they offered, then thought it might be too short to enjoy it. It definitely wasn’t. We had a great time, got to see so much. The pilot was awesome. It was a little windy during  the flight, but he kept it smooth and it was the softest landing I’ve ever experienced.

review_title: Wonderful experience!  Everyone should do this!
review_text: My husband is a private pilot, so he was able to sit in the left seat with the instructor in the right seat.  It was a wonderful experience for my husband as he has not been  pilot in command for 12 years.  Our flight took us all around the island while the instructor pointed out sights (including Julia Roberts home!).  This tour is open to everyone, not just pilots.  In the plane was a cooler filled with beverages for our flight which lasted a little more than an hour.  At the end of the flight we were given a CD of a typical flight, but the beginning did show us, and our picture was on the cover of the CD case.  Also, pictures were taken before the flight, and emailed to us.  This by far was the highlight of our trip.  This is a top notch group.  They will make you feel like family!

This was such an amazing experience! I’m such a big aviation nerd, and Eric catered to my interests. My husband and I had such a great time in the air seeing the sites and learning about piloting. Fabulous time!
Great flight and narration of peak highlights, points of interest and mountain and glaciers. It was a spectacular flight!

review_title: Great staff. Wonderful tour. Good price!
review_text:
We had a great time. The bus tour of the north-west coast, the airplane tour of the rest of the island, the fern grotto, the boat ride ... All in one package. The staff made it special.
A heliocapter tour would get you closer to the scenery, but would cost so much more.

Loved it.

Great experience with knowledgeable and caring pilot.  Views of Napoli Coast and Waimea Canyon only available by air.  However, I was unable to keep the plane’s wings out of most of the pictures. Having taken a helicopter over the Big Island, I was disappointed in not getting closer to the amazing views.
What a blast...after hikiing the parks for four days, we got an entirely different perspective from the air.  Our pilot was engaging and informative.  Just super!
This was such a special and wonderful experience! We cannot wait to book another tour with Redtail. Cannot recommend enough!
Incredible and absolutely beyond exceptional. An elevated experience a true adventure of a lifetime. Cross it off the list!
