Super profissionais a equipe da Wings! É um passeio imperdível pela Kauai Island. Do alto, se tem idéia do litoral maravilhoso da Ilha. As paisagens são diversas: praias paradisíacas que se tem acesso só por barco ( ou pelo ar); formacões rochosas cobertas por vegetaçāo que lembram catedral gótica; plantação de café - a maior dos EUA-; cachoeiras e mais cachoeiras. Um show! Inesquecível!!

review_title: Beautiful Denali flight and Glacier landing
review_text: Such a beautiful and breath taking experience!  The flight was incredible and the Glacier landing on Ruth Glacier was such a thrilling event!

We drove past Alaska Bush Plane on our way down to Talkeetna so came across them purely by chance as opposed to researching them first which is what we usually do but what a find they turned out to be! The weather was really changeable but we could be a bit flexible with our plans and Molly in the office was brilliant at keep us updated on the weather and what flight we could do. In the end, we did a 1 hour wildlife tour because it was too cloudy for Mount McKinley but the 1 hour was awesome despite the mountain staying hidden. Our pilot Jason was really knowledgable and an excellent spotter of wildlife! Black bears and a whole heap of moose on top of the mountains were the highlight. Great experience!

Wings over Kauai is the best value way to see the beautiful sites of Kauai such as the Napali coast by air. 

The plane used is a small 4 seat Cessna (1 seat for the pilot) so all passengers have a perfect window seat to take in the amazing views. Bruce, who runs the company is a great guide providing interesting insights into every aspect of the trip. The island of Kauai has some of the most dramatic scenery of anywhere in the world and seeing it by air is a real must if you visit Hawaii and Wings over Kauai is a really great way to do it. Highly recommended!

review_title: Best way to see Misty Fjords!
review_text: My husband and son booked this flight after getting off the ship.  From the booking through the flying experience everything was top notch!  There was an excellent view from the plane, the pilot knew the area very well and constantly pointed out sights and animals during the flight.  This is a highly recommended attraction is Ketchikan.
Great flight. Denali stayed hidden but, what else is new. All the rest was nothing short of awesome.
We were treated to a fantastic mornng tour! Our pilot Justin(JT)  and crew Thomas were professional and efficient. Lots of fun. We would def do it again!
Spectacular airplane ride, tour and non-stressful lesson! Great for any age from 10 up and a once in a lifetime experience. We have flewn many airlines but amazing experience!
We had an awesome flight! Our pilot, Eric was informative and entertaining! The views were unbelievably gorgeous!!! Thank you Maui Plane rides for a spectacular experience!!!

review_title: The personal touch makes the difference
review_text: My wife and I took the private tour in the Cessna with Bruce at the controls. Two things really make the private tour terrific - you're never on the wrong side of the aircraft for sightseeing, and the commentary and conversation is tailored to your interests. We didn't miss any of the beauty of Kauai while discussing agronomy, education, economics and the like. We'd asked if all of the humpbacks had headed back north; when Bruce spotted a trio off Na Pali he circled around so we could get a good look. The personalization of the tour really made it memorable.

This was a great flight. The folks in the office were helpful in working to get us a worthwhile flight with clouds moving in and out and it turned out great. The pilot, Michael, was great before and during the flight to point out features and get us the best viewing advantages. Great group!

We went on a flightseeing tour of Misty Fjords.  Our pilot was great, plane seated 8.  The views were spectacular, and we would not have been able to see as much by sea.  We enjoyed the stop midway where we landed in the park, got to see seals swimming nearby, and the natural beauty of the park was overwhelming.  I lost count of how many waterfalls we saw. I had the back row to myself, and got a little motion sickness.  Dramamine would have been a good idea.  My husband did not have any issues with that.  This was an amazing experience, we felt safe - the aircraft felt very well maintained, and the Bush Plane Certificates we got at the end were the icing on the cake!  Money well spent, we would do this again in a heartbeat!

review_title: Outstanding flight over the south side of Denali!
review_text: Oh my goodness, you MUST take this flight if you go to Talkeetna! It was fantastic, and the pilot, Michael, was wonderful. I had never been in a 6-seater plane, and I sat up front. It was magical. A storm had passed to the north, and so we had dramatic clouds and views - and rainbows! It was breathtaking to see the glaciers, the mountains, the clouds, and the top of Denali! The mountain was just visible for a few moments and we were all excited to see it as it can be very elusive. The flight was smooth, Michael educated us and answered all our questions so kindly and thoughtfully. It was a magnificent flight and I would do it again in a heart beat.
Views were amazing! You don’t fly as low as helicopters but u can’t beat the price! Everything run smoothly, on time…when u go solo u might even end up as a copilot like I did.
He is the absolute best pilot in the world ! I totally recommend him . Smooth landing every time ! I will be back again ! And he’s the only pilot I’ll fly with in Maui ❤️thank you !

This was a bucket-list flight for my husband and me and the centerpiece of our trip/cruise to Alaska. We were fortunate to have Patrick as our pilot. He was experienced and very knowledgeable about the area. The weather had been iffy, but cleared enough for him to take us above the clouds to see top of Mt. Denali. Our flight through the Alaska Range was truly spectacular, culminating in our glacier landing. Patrick explained the weather situation and landing procedure to us in advance, and we felt completely at ease. It was breathtaking, a once-in-a-lifetime experience! We knew we were in very good hands. As a result, we would highly recommend K-2 flights to anyone considering a flight-seeing tour of this area!

from the friendly beginning to the photo-op end
the flight was total excitement. 
Beautiful scenery, interesting conversation, ...
a lot to remember 
well needed in these times

You have to do this!!! The reviews are "spot on". My wife and I just got back from a 2.5 week trip to Oahu and Kauai, and this has to be the highlight of our trip. It's hard to add to all the positive things others have already said. From the time we were greeted by Bruce's (the pilot) wife, son, and daughter to the end of the flight, it was a very positive experience. 

It was just Bruce, myself, and my wife in the plane. My wife rode shotgun and had a good time going through the checklist with Bruce as he explained a bit about all the gauges. That was interesting to both of us, as neither of us are pilots. 

Just to give you some background, I only fly when I have to, and I'm not at all a fan of small planes. In spite of that, I had no problems with the flight. Bruce kept it nice and smooth. He did a great job of keeping us engaged in conversation the entire flight, and as someone else noted, he will position the plane to give you clear views of the Na Pali Coast. He's a funny guy too (he entertained us with a short rendition of a couple of songs from the musical South Pacific! haha).  

We really can't say enough about this "mom and pop" operation. Don't waste your money on the chopper rides. Wings Over Kauai is MUCH more personal than any chopper ride and you'll see amazing scenery the whole time. And I believe a small plane is safer than a chopper (if a chopper rotor goes, that's it. If a plane's engine goes, you at least have a chance of gliding back down to the nearest clearing, or glide into the water). 

A BIG thanks to Bruce and his family for giving us the experience of a lifetime!!!

Andy and Stephanie

review_title: Fantastic views of the Grand Canyon
review_text: All people very friendly - We spent all day visiting also Antelope canyon and rafting on Colorado River

We did the Grand Denali tour in August 2016. The day we were scheduled to go was cloudy and rainy so the office was able to reschedule us for a few days later when we came back through town. I am a nervous flyer and was very nervous going into this tour but it was actually very easy and I was never afraid. There is no other way to get a sense of the vast and dramatically different landscape. The views were incredible and we were able to see Denali. It's a must do if you are in the area.

review_title: Full package worth hefty price tag
review_text: As probably a once in a lifetime visit we did the full package which although expensive we felt we got full value. Pick up from Las Vegas hotel  to Boulder City 30min or so then a small plane ride passing over Hoover dam. Great views and get to see the Canyon and the approach to it. Both had window seats for great views. Helicopter ride along Canyon then down into it for landing and a boat trip of 30 min or so. Spectacular views and felt we were the only ones there. Quiet season but most people at top of rim. Helicopter back  out then 2 hrs to explore viewpoints around the West Rim before plane trip back and drop off at hotel. Each bit of the package gave a different perspective but maybe river view with Indian boat guide gave the least touristy viewpoint

review_title: Highly Recommended and Would Do Again
review_text: Have no fear!  For those that are slightly apprehensive (as I was), this company is top notch with very experienced pilots.  Our pilot was Ray who completely puts you at ease during the entire flight.  He has many years as a commercial pilot and it is more than obvious that he knows how to maneuver the mountains and valleys of the island.  We saw the most beautiful waterfalls from every angle.  Ray gave us lots of information about the island.  Luckily we picked a beautiful day and could see the entirety of everything.  This was a trip of a lifetime and is difficult to put in writing what a great experience this was.  This is a must-do in my opinion.

Desi, our pilot, was fantastic! Full of energy, good vibes, super informative and a very experienced pilot. The GA8 Airvan is like riding a Chevy Suburban in the sky. Absolutely recommend this trip while you’re on Kauai.

This trip was awesome. Our pilot was so sweet and went out of his way to make sure everyone got a good view. Landing on a Glacier was icing on the cake. The whole experience was the best thing we've ever done except for the births of our children. We will definitely come back again and again. Well worth the $!

I purchased tickets for a biplane ride for my parents' 40th anniversary. I happened to make a HUGE error and booked their trip for May and not March as I intended. Despite us showing up on the wrong day they were able to get a pilot and plane set up for my parents! Everyone was an absolute delight, friendly, funny, and so very accommodating. Despite my terrible mistake, all was worked out to the best of their abilities/resources and my parents had an absolute blast. 
HIGHLY recommend based off of the fabulous customer service!
The Tour was Great from Start to Finish. the pilot was amazing and funny person and provide guidance in entertaining way

I would like to say how much we appreciated our flight tour of your beautiful Island of Kauai.
It was our intention to see the island from the air because of the island being so remote.
Also I wanted our six family members to experience the island together. which would have been impossible by helicopter.  
Our pilot was terrific!!!!!!!
He made us feel very comfortable and safe.
 He also named and pointed out all the waterfalls , towns, canyons, previous native villages, coffee plantations on this incredible island.
If you are planing to visit Kauai I highly recommend taking this extraordinary experience with Air Ventures Hawaii!!!!!
Aloha!!!!!

We found a really nice fishing experiance in Talkeetna.Starting with Molly the office manager to the pilots and guides. All were friendly and accomodating. Yes we did catch many fish. We arrived on a full moon and and a front coming through. These two things combined with the guide's knowledge led to a wonderful fishing trip for my wife and I.The weather was challenging for the pilot,but he was smart and confident and overcome the winds on the lake.The office is located on a picturese Fish Lake just outside of Talkeetna. I would highly recoomend this compant to any interested in a float plane trip out of Talkeetna.

We left a little early than expected. Mokoa(our captain) did an awesome job giving us the pre flight instructions and getting us up to provide a really nice tour. The flight was very smooth and the views were just brilliant. He had a good eye and also helped us catch a glimpse of whales swimming by the nOrth shore.

We weer looking to do a cruise and everything was sold out. Out of a whim I booked this tour and am so happy we did it.
The helicopter ride gives a great view of the canyon and allows you to see more than possible by car
tour_name: 9-691_45-minute Helicopter Flight Over the Grand Canyon from Tusayan, Arizona_attraction_product_review_2025-02-27

review_text:
We took the 2 hour "Grand Denali" tour and what brought us to Talkeetna Air Taxi (TAT) was that they are very community focused and had a killer coupon in the local high school by giving a 25% discount on all flight for ALL people in the group which equated to HUNDREDS of $$$'s OFF on our trip all to support their high school?...WOW...All flights between the multiple air taxi's are essentially the same in price but for TAT to give this discount to support their high school says a lot.  The discount book cost minimal when compared to what we saved so that tells you the kind of business this is.

The flight around the mountains and landing on Ruth Glacier were amazing and a once in a lifetime experience that we'll always remember!

On a scale of 1 to 5, this is worth a 25!!! Words cannot describe how majestic and gorgeous Denali is! And, if you’re lucky enough to get the “sports plane” of the fleet, you’re in for an incredible treat! Small, agile, with a terrific Pilot, Nick, you can thoroughly explore all the nooks and crannies, mountains and valleys, and be completely surrounded with indescribable majesty!!!! ...A great company with a truly remarkable flight tour!

review_title: Great time and even better pilot
review_text: Although the weather curtailed our flight the sites were still incredible and the pilot was the absolute best. First class service!

review_title: A new perspective on our own backyard!
review_text: My wife purchased this flight as a gift for my birthday this year and it was an absolutely amazing experience! We chose the Gorge and Waterfalls flight, which lasted about 45 minutes total. We took off out of Troutdale, flew up the Gorge past Vista House, Multnomah Falls, the burn from the last years big fire. We turned around at Cascade Locks, flow over Skamania Lodge, and circled around Beacon Rock on the way back. I've driven through the Gorge plenty of times, but this was so cool to see it from the air. Our pilot was great (Devin I think? Sorry, I've spaced on your name!) was great and informative and totally competent. This was my first time flying in a smaller Cessna, and I felt at ease during the flight. Awesome experience, whether you are here vacationing, or as a local looking for a new view of your backyard. Highly recommended!

Staff and flight crew were very polite and professional. We booked this excursion through CostcoTravel.com and received no problems. Though at first we thought our flight was going to be cancelled due to acclimate weather in the area. Thankfully it was all clear by the time we got to the dock.
The pilot showed us around and trued his best to spot any animals, but we did not luck out.

Kind and enthusiastic and extremely helpful people are just the start -- Courtney in the office rocks! The flight was smooth and special, providing a memory a minute with jaw-dropping sites. A few locals in Talkeetna suggested TAT, and now we know why. They gave us an unforgettable experience.

There were six of us getting off the cruise ship and after a short walk around the cute town we met our guide.  Also, they have a kiosk in the visitors center if you need to talk to someone.  It was very rainy so I was nervous about the flight, in general, and also being cancelled.  The staff was very nice and accommodating and after a safety talk, we were off!  The plane was comfortable and safe.  The pilot was great and played music when he wasn’t narrating which was very soothing to me.  The views were spectacular and this is one of those experiences I will never forget.  We all agree that we would do this again with this great company!

We had booked a flight to celebrate my in-laws 50th wedding anniversary, and Ellen and John were very friendly from the get go. Josh, our pilot, was also congenial and offered an excellent narrative throughout our air tour. The views were remarkable, though Kauai is beautiful at any angle :) All that being said, be aware that the 6-seater plane is very cozy (read: I'm 5'3" and had no leg room) and could use a little sprucing up. Also, not all our headphones were in working order which made it difficult to ask questions of our guide as we flew over the various landscapes.
A six star experience and my favorite part was the feeling of floating in Mauis sky and part of the circling over a special spot!  Beyond special.

review_title: viewing Denali by air and landing on a glacier the most amazing experience
review_text: My husband and I were one of the last flights of the day and we flew in the tiniest Cessna and I felt like I was knee-to-knee with our pilot. The Cessnas are specially modified to land on glaciers and fly at these altitudes and in Alaskan weather so it was all very safe and our pilot experienced and professional. Talkeetna Air Taxi have other larger planes but we were the last ones for the day and we were pleased to experience a 'private' Grand Denali tour with glacier landing. If there is inclimate weather, see if you can wait another day or try to be flexible in your travel itinerary because it's worth it to do the glacier landing and get views of Denali. The weather was iffy on our day so we chose to wait around and then were in luck to be able to land on one of the smaller glaciers. You see so many glaciers that it really didn't matter to us which glacier we landed on as there are so many to view. I'm glad we chose to go with Talkeetna Air Taxi as it was nice to do the flightseeing from Talkeetna itself. And we did get intermittent views of Denali despite the not-so-perfect day. Well worth the money.

review_title: No better way to see Kauai!
review_text:
What an amazing way to see the beautiful Garden Island! Our pilot/instructor/guide, Jacob, let me fly while my wife did the photos from the back seat. We explored the whole island from the air which gave us a great preview of all the fun activities we were going to do the rest of our visit. He even gave us some tips for beautiful hikes we could take and he was totally right!

A huge highlight was spotting humpbacks and flying over to see them up close. That was so cool!

Setting up the tour was easy and the customer support by Ellen was top notch. She was very communicative and helped me make sure we'd make the absolute most of our trip. I highly recommend this as a great way to start your Kauai visit, but really is excellent any time.

We watched the weather and when the forecast showed clear weather for the next afternoon, we booked a flightseeing tour that included a glacier landing. They were almost completely booked and they will refund if the flight is cancelled due to weather so you may not want to wait to book.

The information shows that you shouldn't bring a backpack or purse on board. I think that's due to a lack of secure storage space. My sister and I were both able to take our purses which we wore with cross-body straps and were small enough to sit in our laps during the flight. Upon arrival we were told to get everything we intended to take on the flight then we were each weighed with our gear. Long pants and closed toed shoes are required for a glacier landing and you should also have a jacket, hat, gloves and sunglasses. After we were checked in and weighed, we were given boots that slipped on over our shoes. They are easy to put on with velcro straps and a clip. My sister was wearing ankle height waterproof hiking boots and she was allowed to just wear those but the boots they provided were comfortable. We put those on before we got on the plane.

The pilot was friendly and knowledgeable. Our trip actually left a little early since the pilot and all of us (6) were ready to go. We flew through the clouds and also had fantastic views throughout the flight. Don't forget your camera. If you are prone to motion sickness, you might want to take something beforehand. Our flight was a little bumpy and swoopy. Every person has their own window.

Landing on the glacier was mostly smooth and we got out and walked around for about 20 minutes. You can't explore too far for safety reasons, but you can see a lot while you're there. Our entire trip took the exact amount of time advertised and it was great. If the weather cooperates, this is something to do. I was scared before we left but got over that quickly and really enjoyed it.

review_title: Well-run company with highly experience pilots
review_text: Maverick Helicopters came highly recommended and now I understand why. It is organized and well-run. From initial contact to make the reservation until the flight was over, we were given clear instructions, efficient time schedules, and professional interaction. Our pilot had decades of flight experience, both military and civilian, so we knew we were in good hands. As a business owner, I'm very impressed with the company and the way they treat their guests.

review_text: Book your flight well ahead and cross your fingers for good weather! The K2 staff was very upfront with us regarding the weather and offered to allow us to cancel or reschedule.  Denali viewing is historically fickle with all of the cloud cover.  The average viewing is 30% of visitors but, with this summer's extra rain and clouds, it's been more like 20%.  But go for it! We were part of that 20% and our pilot Josh flew us in patterns surrounding Denali that gave us multiple spectacular, breathtaking views. This was one of the best things we did during our two weeks in Alaska and we'd definitely do it again!

I spent 10 days in Alaska with a friend,and our flightseeing tour was a definite highlight! Our pilot was very personable, knowledgeable, and safety conscious. We were supposed to do the slightly longer tour, but due to clouds it was shortened to the one hour flight. It was breathtaking. My friend asked if she could sit in the co-pilot seat and enjoyed it so much (She said it was "not for the faint-of-heart" lol) I've included a picture she took that has the propeller showing as we approached Denali. The glaciers were incredible to view and we were lucky to have blue skies at Denali's summit. It was Sept 5th and the fall colors were beautiful. We were still awestruck for several hours after the flight. I wish I could remember our pilot's name (I think Daniel?) because he was great.  Thanks K2!

Out of all my experiences during my stay on Kauai, this was by far the best investment. I would do it again in a heartbeat. Not one, not two, FIVE GoPros are mounted on the plane that capture every view and conversation between the pilot and passengers. The conversation piece didn’t seem as significant until I saw my video, heard the soundtrack from the flight, and basically wept. (Videos available for purchase for a very reasonable price via dvd or Vimeo link. - Thank you for offering streaming media!!) Their website is super informative, especially for scheduling. Their staff was accommodating and just a complete pleasure to interact with. This company goes above and beyond to personalize your experience and make you feel comfortable during the whole process. 9,000% recommend.
This was an experience to remember! Great ground crew, a wonderful pilot and guide, and a memorable flight! Thanks to you all.

review_title: Kauai by Air Tour--Put this on your bucket list!
review_text: The pilot, Kevin (?), was friendly, fun,  and full of stories and information about Kauai.  He even had wonderful cool towels for our use if we got too warm or felt queasy while in the air.  This 1 hour tour gave us such an amazing view of the island-- now we can say we saw Kauai by land, by sea, and by air. What a treat! We reserved ahead of time, thought the price was very good, and didn't mind having to "publically" get on the scale --safety first, of course. My group of four recommend Air Ventures.

I'm a commercial pilot and flight instructor, so I flown a few times before, but this was one of the most incredible flights I've ever taken. I flew with Kim, and he taught me a lot of things about backcountry and mountain flying. He's an excellent instructor and a safe pilot. He also had a really good idea for where we could go and what we could look at, and the two friends I brought along had a great time looking at all the canyons and rivers. It was gorgeous!

review_title: Great Aerials of Maui and CLIFFS
review_text: Incredible experience soaring above Maui in my private plane. The flight was longer and the price was right. The pilot was amazing. He let me fly which was a lifetime dream come true. HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
Amazing trip. The pilot was very knowledgeable and nice to us. Time and money well spent, if you in fence about doing it, you should definitely do it.

We did the flightseeing tour with Glacier landing. We made last minute appointment and the staff were very helpful and courteous. Our pilot, Andy, was very experienced and prepared us well and made the flight so comfortable. It was the highlight of our trip. Must do!
This was a fantastic experience viewing Maui from the airplane. E we loved looking at the whales with calves. Lovely blue and aquamarine life.

We saw the whole island.  Our mouths were hanging open the whole time and we were speechless.  There were whales swimming along the Na Pali Coast and our pilot circled them so we could admire the beauty.  This was truly an awesome adventure.

This was my 3rd trip to Kauai, but to see it from the air was even more breathtaking than i imagined! Nick not only is a skilled pilot, but also did a fine job describing the gorgeous scenery. Robin, manning the phone and front desk, greeted us warmly, and took & emailed photos of us in front of the plane.
See parts of Canyonlands that there is no other way to see! Angel Arch is huge, but this about the only way most people will ever see it. See the main attractions at Arches from a bird's eye view.

review_title: The staff was accommodating with our last-minute booking.  It was a spur of the moment trip n a beautiful Alaskan day. ,
review_text: Our pilot, Chris, was not only a great pilot, but an excellent tour guide. He was a wealth of knowledge about the Denali Park, the mountain range, the glaciers and even the geology and formation of the land that we’ve come to love; Alaska. I’ve flown as a helicopter crewman for many years and found this service, plane, and pilot to be the best!

review_title: My favorite way to see Kauai
review_text: Air Ventures Kauai provided us with the most  spectacular view of Kauai possible.  The trip was incredibly smooth and we were able to view all the scenery from the large bubble windows.  We flew over parts of Kauai that are not visible from land nor sea.  It was fantastic!!

This is a great way to see the beautiful island of Kauai.  The staff on the ground were very helpful and friendly.  The pilot was both skillful and knowledgeable.  Doing this excursion by plane instead of helicopter was less expensive.  I would highly recommend trying this company.
We had a private flight with Bruce and he was great, very friendly and chatty and so was his daughter who ckecked us in.Saw loads of gorgeous Kauai. Absolutely recommend it!

Huge thanks to Pilot Dan and the wonderful conservationist for a once in a lifetime adventure. Great 20 minute flight in to the Tongass forest and a breathtaking time watching black bears catching salmon in their own habitat.

JT the pilot, Jill the owner and ticket agent, and everyone at Air Ventures Hawaii in Kauai are the greatest.  JT told us about the flight as we went, and what we were seeing below.  The Na Pali Coast was fantastic, what a beautiful view.  We also saw some of the devastation from the rains, it was sad to see, but it was a first-hand way to see the damage caused by the rain.  The tour was fantastic, really the best way to see all the island, and Air Ventures Hawaii is the best way to fly the Island of Kauai.

Mahalo,
Mike Samac

A very well organised & professional company.  Quick check-in and a delightful pilot called David who was very funny & informative.  An incredible experience that we will never forget.  We would highly recommend.

review_text: We are so grateful that we took our friends' recommendation to fly with K2 Aviation. The air tour truly was the highlight of our Alaskan vacation. A family business with decades of experience, K2 offers breathtaking views of snow-covered mountains and glaciers, narrated by knowledgeable pilots on various sizes of aircraft. We were on a 10-seater that flew around three mountains, including Mt. McKinley, and landed on a glacier where we got out and walked around  Absolutely majestic! So much fun! My apprehension about flying up there in a small plane quickly subsided as I was overtaken by the beauty and thrills. Dealing directly with K2 is cheaper than booking glacier flights through cruise and tour companies.
The ride over to BC Canada was wonderful and scenic. Service was wonderful and the pilots were professionals.

Happy accident finding out about this ride over the red rocks on our way into Moab! So amazing we got to experience this most beautiful part of the country this way. Thank you Redtail for taking great care of us as we oohed and aahed our way through the entire trip. "HIGHLY" recommend!
Amazing time. Eric did a phenomenal time taking care of us and kept it super romantic. We will come again!

review_title: Best Way to see Misty Fjords
review_text: We decided to splurge and see Misty Fjords by air.  The Taquan Air staff were exceptionally professional and their ternimal is very nice.  The pilot was very skilled and since we had a beautiful day we were able to fly a little higher and further.  It was a gorgeous trip and we thought landing on the lake and standing on the pontoons was a fun touch.

I had planned an Envi Adventure for my boyfriend and I with the intention on doing something spontaneous. To my surprise, the experience that Envi Adventures had to offer completely exceeded my expectations. Prior to our scheduled flight, the team was receptive, communicative, and detailed about instructions for our flight. Adam was the pilot on our flight and he was warm, welcoming, and a total expert. Adam was awesome as he pointed out and explained the beautiful scenes. We highly recommend him and the Envi Adventures team for your next experience!

Wow, what a great flight. We did the 2 hr round the mountain and land on the glacier trip, and as soon as you get into those snow capped mountains, it’s magical. This was a friendly, knowledgeable and reassuring group of people, so just DO IT. If you are obsessed with Denali, sit on the right side, but I was on the left and was happy to be awed by all of the other mountains around. And we did a 360 anyway so I did get a good view. Be good and give your pilot a tip at the end—it’s worth it.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: You can sum up this experience in one word.  INCREDIBLE!!!  Well worth the price.  Would highly recommend them.
Brilliant viewing from the plane as I was in the front seat. Th pilot was very informative. Weather was perfect.
I was visiting some friends on Maui and decided to go and do a solo excursion flying around the island on some free time and it was the best choice that I could have made.

Last weekend I experienced Moab in a completely unique way. We took a private flight with Redtail Air Adventures over canyonlands and arches National parks. It’s hard to put into the words the beauty and unique way to experience moab from the air vs just hiking down below. It was truly a special experience. 
This is not your typical airport. It’s very laid back and felt safe and chill. Very easy to book and friendly staff. 

Thanks to our amazing pilot and tour guide Craig for an unforgettable experience. He was so knowledgeable and fun. We had personal headsets that we could listen to him and talk and ask questions.

This is Definitly a must do on your  bucket list in moab and shockingly affordable too!

review_title: Birds eye view of the unlimited beauty of kauai
review_text: We were able to see amazing scenery from above the entire island. Jill greated us and handed us over to Nate. He was awesome and informative with fun facts,history and serene beauty

review_title: Amazing birds eye view of an exceptionally beautiful island
review_text: We loved this tour and recommend taking the opportunity to see Kauai from the air, you get to see the diversity and beauty of the island. The pilot Paul was great, super friendly. This was a great option over the helicopter tour, Air Ventures offer an air and sea combo with HoloHolo charters which is excellent value for money so keep an eye out for it, we did the Air Ventures flight and a sunset cruise to Napali coast for $209. The Air Ventures was definitely the highlight, we have some amazing photos - we were concerned they may fly a lot higher than the helicopters that operate tours but this wasn't an issue at all and if anything, they navigate the island at a slower pace therefore you have great photo opportunities.

Absolutely Amazing! Definitely recommend this tour to everyone 
Spectacular views 
Great Pilot 
Wonderful experience

Absolutely a must do.  I would highly recommend including the glacier landing. What impressed us the most was there customer service. My son was very nervous about flying in a small plane.  He actually backed out right before we boarded so my wife stayed behind with him.  K2 gave us a refund, no questions asked.  They went the extra mile and offered to let my son come back the next day and tour the inside of the planes.  A worker took him out and let him sit in the cock pit of several planes to help ease his nerves if he wanted to attempt to fly again.  

I own my own small business.  I truly appreciate that K2 was honest, caring and truly wanted us to have a great experience.

Amazing Tour and perfect way to see the entire Island. Marcus was a wonderful pilot and we felt safe the entire time. Seeing Kauai from the sky is breathtaking. And Wings over Kauai did not disappoint. The six passenger plane has a window seat for everyone on board. Highly recommend.

I have wanted to see Denali since I was a kid and it was still named Mt. McKinley. It took my breath away when I saw it from Talkeeta. But up close from the air it was sublime. Landing on a glacier was something I never even dreamt was possible. Thanks for the once in a lifetime thrills.

I decided to go on this trip with my husband for his 60th birthday with Air Ventures.  I chose this type of aircraft over a helicopter because I felt more secure in it.  The trip was fantastic and our pilot Harry was great.  The weather was wonderful.  We got to tour the entire island from the sky.  We had toured the island by car prior to this flight.  I'm glad we did the flight after visiting ourselves because it gave us perspective of what we saw on the island by ourselves.  This tour showed us things you would never see by car.  The island is truly beautiful and has such a diverse topography.

It was such a nice experience flying through Moab canyon lands and seeing hidden arches that are hard to see if hiking, Our pilot Dan was so amazing we loved it, 100 % recommend to do this while in Moab, is such an amazing experience

Wings Over Kauai provided us with a marvelous overview of the island upon our visit to Kauai. We opted for the Grand Tour and we were satisfied in very aspect. Capt. Bruce provided a spectacular sunny day and a very calm ride. His extensive information on history, geography, botany, films made here, etc. kept us tuned in and glued to the windows. My special request to see whales was treated seriously and sure enough, from the air we spotted two of them! 

The plane was comfortable and Bruce proved to be an able, competent and confidence-inspiring pilot. His wife and son were wonderful complements on land to the entire program. We give the company our heartiest recommendation!
Did the floatplane tour to Misty Fjords as a cruise shore excursion. It was wonderful! Felt very safe in the plane and the views were phenomenal!!

Even on an overcast day, this was a phenomenal experience.  We originally were going to pass on flightseeing as the price quoted by the cruise line was quite high.  However, we were able to save about 35% off that price (for the same tour) by just showing up at their office at the airfield and asking if they had any discounts.  Our plane went up about a half hour later and the views were unworldly.  Our guide was very informative with facts and figures and tuned for safety. Our trip to Alaska was fantastic and this was the highlight ! Do it !  You will view it as money well spent.

These Folk are very professional and adept at their tasks. The trip includes pick up and return from your LV accomodation and a bus trip out to Boulder City Airport. This trip in itself (approx 1 hour) was most interesting, climbing out of LV on a very busy motorway. The plane (a twin engined high wing Otter) was basic with each passenger (12) having individual windows, the Pilots were immediately in front of us and We could watch their every move. Beautiful sunny and hot day, the views and commentary were perfect and most memorable.
Well done GCA, a top flight organisation.

Wij werden er stil van, zó mooi ziet de besneeuwde bergwereld er uit vanuit de lucht! Snelwegen van gletschers, landen op  grote hoogte, ruig landschap, knalblauwe meertjes! Als je het kunt betalen: doen!!

review_title: Jaw-Dropping Views on Maui and the surroundings small islands
review_text: The highlight of our trip to Maui for sure. New views and stunning perspectives of the islands every minute. The pilot gave great orientation and background information. A fantastic way to explore Maui.

review_title: Can't hike the trails? You gotta do this!
review_text: This is the way to see the waterfalls on the Road to Hana and experience an easily accessible rainforest. Rick, our pilot, is a great host, providing intermittent commentary and allowing us time to soak in the gorgeous views. When we landed in the rainforest, we celebrated with bubbly and snacked on some of the fruits available there. He shared interesting information about the rainforest, was knowledgeable and attentive to the needs of all passengers. The ground crew was well organized, friendly and clearly communicated everything we needed to know.

Very enjoyable in an 8-seater plane allowing everyone to have a window seat.  Views of McKinley and the Glacier were amazing.  The pilot did a great job providing information, which made the flight even more interesting.  This is a wonderful company (with shuttle service) to see the glaciers by air.

My flight with Miami Seaplane Tours far exceeded my expectations - which were already high! I am a Miami native and really enjoyed seeing my beautiful city from the sky. The pilot was kind, funny and incredibly knowledgeable about all the local landmarks, even the celebrities' houses! Was truly a wonderful time and can't wait to fly again, hopefully with my husband next time!

review_title: Don’t miss out on this awesome ride it’s nothing like riding in an airplane so much smoother and more fun!!!
review_text: It was our favorite experience so far! Felix was an excellent tour guide and we enjoyed every minute of it! Our favorite on our list of things to do in Maui so far! Would definitely recommend!

We did the Southside tour with the glacier landing and it's by far the best trip! What an amazing experience and wonderful views during the trip. Our guide was great at explaining history and what features we were flying over throughout the trip.

Muchas gracias a Bruce y Ellen por su cordialidad y simpatia a la hora de hacer el check in y no digamos nada sobre el vuelo en si.
En nuestro viaje a la costa oeste y Hawaii,hicimos varios tours de helicoptero y de largo lo mejor estaba por llegar en Kauai.
Una hora y 10 minutos de vuelo con Bruce en su simpatico aeroplano.
Menudas vistas,explicaciones amenas de Bruce,opcion de fotografiar las vistas con la ventana abierta...
En conclusion una de las mejores cosas que hicimos en nuestro viaje de novios.
Recomendable totalmente.
Para los españoles tambien recomendable ya que Bruce trata de explicar pausadamente lo que estamos viendo.Slowly...

Outstanding --- We have done many helicopter triptsand this tops them all.  The pilot and receptionist were both super friendly.
They were helpfuland and very knowledgeable about the island.
The flight was smooth, nformativeand absolutely beautiful.  Highly recommend Air Ventures to all

Mike and Evanice
Michigan

review_title: Flying in the Red Baron Byplane
review_text: My husband wanted to fly in this plane. I kind of got drafted into doing it, because you need 2 people (And the pilot of course). We really enjoyed the flight. The weather was perfect, we got to see the island up close. Eric and the entire staff members were awesome.

We had an outstanding trip.  We weren't sure if the glacier landing was going to be worth it but it was definitely one of the highlights of our trip.  The pilot was extremely helpful and informative as well as professional.  I would highly recommend this trip.

review_title: Excellent views and guided 120 minutes flight
review_text: Ray, the pilot was excellent and flyed through many views of the entire Kauai island - many water falls, Canyons, Napali Coast. The views on Napali coast in North-West were awesome. I highly recommend anyone visiting Kauai to view Napali coast views either through air or boat or hike (permit needed). Canyons can be visited by car.

Line service guys were right there when we taxied in. Van came down from the FBO and took the passengers into Tusyan to catch a ground tour. FBO staff made my wait comfortable. Even the tower folks were extraordinary friendly and accommating. Was a great visit.

My wife and I took the Denali Flyer tour with Glacier Landing and it was an awesome experience. Our pilot was friendly and explained everything to us clearly.  There was a certain euphoric feeling when we exited the plane at the glacier landing - the view and overall feeling was breathtaking.  We were also very fortunate that it was a mostly sunny day.  We highly recommend this trip to all, but please spend the extra money for the glacier landing in order to experience this to it's fullest.

We traveled to Talkeetna, Alaska late this summer with the sole mission of completing the glacier landing on Denali.  Our trip last year was foiled by rain every day.  When we arrived, there was not a cloud in sight, so we immediately traveled to K2 Aviation in order to take full advantage of the beautiful weather.  The weather this year completely caught us off-guard for the good.  We hadn't made any advance reservations for this trip, but had planned to accomplish the flight, weather permitting.  What a pleasant surprise.  We were greeted by K2 personnel and the trip was outlined and priced for us and we immediately booked a flight within just a few minutes.  All aspects of the flight were explained and our questions answered thoroughly and completely.  We were soon introduced to our pilot, Patrick.  What a surprise to discover that he was from our home state.  With just a few pre-flight instructions, we were off to the wild blue yonder.  The scenery was absolutely breath-taking.  The glacier landing was smooth and awesome.  Our pilot got so close to the mountain on the flight over that it seemed that you could reach out and touch the mountain.  Patrick took some snap shot of us with the plane on the glacier and after a reasonable amount of time there, we were once again airborne to the vastness of the Denali range.  Upon return to K2, we learned that our flight had been recorded and we immediately ordered a copy.   The K2 video staff advised us that if we had any photos taken while on the glacier, to email them and they would incorporate them into the video for us to further personalize our project.  The hard part was limiting the number of photos.  When the USB video arrived, we have nearly worn it out showing it to family and friends.  What a treat to have them experience what we saw on our trip.  Thank you to the folks at K2 for a wonderful experience.  We are already planning a return trip with kids and grandkids and look forward to flying with K2 again.  The HD video is as close to the real thing as you can get.  I HIGHLY recommend this when you fly with K2.  Most folks don't realize that Denali is only viewable to visitors about 30% of the time.  And we can certainly attest to that from our trip there last year.  But to our good fortune, we saw it cloud-free for six consecutive days....something that even the locals were amazed to see. The K2 flight experience was something that I will cherish for many years to come.  And the flight video allows us to relive this near-miraculous feat over and over again.

review_title: Fantastic flight over SF and Marin!
review_text: It was so much fun to fly low over the Bay Bridge and SF and the GG Bridge and the hills of Marin County. My teenage son absolutely loved it as a birthday gift. The staff and pilot were top notch. It's not cheap but worth every penny!

By plane it's certainly not as "exciting" as by helicopter, but the flight is really great, you see a large area, the audio guide is very well done, a great way to get an overview of the size of the Grand Canyon

review_text: My husband and I decided that a Helicopter ride was too expensive.  When I jumped on Trip Advisor it showed that Wings over Kauai was the best airplane tour on Kauai and reasonably priced.  And we are very, very happy that we did the tour.  Captain Bruce Coulombe is an amazing pilot who is highly experienced, witty and super smart!  He made the trip exciting, informative and fun.  We Loved it!!!  We would highly recommend them over any of the air tours over Kauai!

Had a brilliant sunset tour to the canyon courtesy of Jarred our pilot. Would definitely recommend paying extra to go by helicopter than plane. We know a couple of people that went by plane and they were disappointed. Would also recommend the sunset tour - the different colours in the canyon were amazing and the flight back over the 'Strip' was just superb. We found Maverick were efficient and good value for money. Thank you to Jarred you were great fun!
This is the best way to see the Grand Canyon!  The pilots were very knowledgeable about the Grand Canyon.

review_title: Amazing Views, Once in a lifetime experience
review_text: Friendly and very helpful staff. The pilot was also very friendly and explained in detail of what we were seeing during flight. The views are amazing. We took the Grand Denali tour and highly recommend it along with glacier landing.
This was a gift for my 40th birthday and was a wonderful experience.  Amazing views brought tears of joy to me eyes.

Nous avons fait le 'Higlights Air Tour', c'était juste incroyable! 
Le vol a duré plus d'1h, donc nous avons bien eu le temps d'admirer le Grand Canyon (rive ouest), et franchement c'est top car chacun est assuré d'avoir une place côté fenêtre dans l'avion.
Tout était très bien organisé, depuis le pick up à l'hôtel jusqu'au drop off retour. 
Bref je recommande à 100%!
Unique perspective of the islands that you can only get in a small plane. Eric was friendly, knowledgeable and entertaining. Great time!

Flight and Glacier landing was breathtaking, in a good sense. The staff were all super friendly and helpful. We loved every minute of it. Took the 2 hour flight. I felt like I would have preferred about 20 minutes less time in the air and 20 more minutes on the glacier. But It was the highlight of our Alaskan trip, no doubt. What an adventure!

review_title: Helicopter tour of the Grand Canyon
review_text: Our pilot was excellent, fun to listen to and knowledgeable of the area we flew over. My fiancée and I felt like kids again. The views were endless and breathtaking!

review_title: Fabulous, once in a lifetime, experience.
review_text: This was the BEST experience!  The flight was smooth, the pilot was great, the scenery was fabulous and we landed on the glacier, where without COVID, the base camp for climbers would be.  It was the most beautiful day on top of it all, cloudless and the sun was shining.  There is not one thing I can talk about because it was all so wonderful.

review_title: Felt Like We Were In A Movie!
review_text:
Just an hour or so after arriving on Kauai, we took the air tour around the island. Wow! What a ride this was. Josh, our pilot and was extremely pleasant and knowledgeable about the island. Of all of our traveling experiences, this one is one of the very best! We flew over the clear, blue water of the ocean and could see golden sand beaches for miles as well as coral reefs. Over the interior we could see down into the depths of Waimea Canyon & waterfalls in every direction. We felt like we were in a movie! 
The price was only $125 per person but was worth every penny. Also, you can purchase a DVD of your actual tour with audio. You can relive your flight for years to come. It was only $35, so I highly recommend buying it. 
Thanks, Josh & Mary for such a great experience!

review_title: The Only Way to See Arches and Canyonlands
review_text: If you're at all nervous about flying in small aircraft, my advice would be to just get over it, or you're going to miss an an unbelievable experience. We took the Arches and Canyonlands combination flight a little over a week ago, and I'm still coming to grips with the views. PIctures just don't do it justice. Our pilot, Kim, was great, and the descriptions and overview flight were a great way to plan out what you might want to spend more time seeing from the ground. This was  a great thing to do at the start of visit to the Moab area. Redtail was full of nice people, and made the whole experience memorable from start to finish.
Absolutely amazing flight with close up views of those magnificent mountains. Smooth flight with very good commentary from the pilot

review_title: Glacier Landing so very worth it!
review_text:
We did the South Side Explorer with a Glacier Landing. It was the most amazing one and a half hour trip of our life! It is hard to describe the beauty and majesty of this adventure. We would highly recommend the glacier landing. Our pilot Daniel, was a great guide and made the adventure safe and informative. It was just wonderful. 
Two thumbs up!

An airborne tour of Kauai is an essential part of your trip to this island.  You cannot appreciate its beauty from the ground no matter how good the weather is.  Yes, helicopters are more maneuverable but they are more expensive and one had unfortunately crashed into Pearl Harbor during our visit to Oahu which closed the water shuttle to the Arizona memorial during our stay.  AirVentures Cessna fixed wing airplanes are an excellent compromise.  They are surprisingly maneuverable and our pilot, Eric, with over 7000 flying hours, was as safe a "driver" as he was an entertaining narrator.  We saw whales at 1000'; we saw Waimea canyon as you will never see it from the road and Eric's tour of the Na Pali coast was incredible.  The grand finale was a flyby the Wailua falls (Da Plen!, Da Plen!).  Book morning flights- clouds cause more problems in the PM.  Do this trip first for an overview or last to fill in the details but do it! Oh, BTW, sit on the right side of the plane for best views. Aloha!

Tom picked us up exactly where stated, and JT then gave us an excellent plane ride.
Both Tom and JT were very informative, friendly, and just genuinely made the experience an excellent life memory. JT had recorded music that were timed perfectly to the flight tour, and it was a nice touch. We had done a helicopter tour on a different Island, but this was far better for pictures, and viewing. Highly recommend this tour.

This was a trip not to many people take - especially Alaskans like us.  We had a wonderful pilot, Jeff Babcock, a neat little plane and some awesome scenery.  We flew over trees, lakes, rivers and streams, mining camps and cabins.  Then we came to the glaciers - it's a totally different view flying OVER one.  The weather, unfortunately, changed and we weren't able to land on a glacier, but the trip was wonderful and well worth the time and effort.  I wouldn't have missed it for the world now that I've done it!
The plane is very small.  If you are not size 30 waist or less and shorter than 510"you will be very uncomfortable.  Pilot was great and views were nice but I would never do it again.

Had booked a flight around Mt. Denali with a glacier landing. Unfortunately weather did not cooperate. Cloud ceiling too low and too much snow on the glacier. K2 offered full refund or reduced trip with a partial refund. The latter still worth the chance to fly into the canyons and see the glaciers from above.

I did my research. I looked at the pictures. I read the reviews. When it was time to make the reservation, my expectations were high. We were lucky that we had a beautiful day ahead of us. Nothing compares to when that plane is flying towards Denali. But when it came time to land....... words can't express it. It is one of the most beautiful sights I've ever seen. The entire crew, from the aviation center to the pilot (Chris) were true professionals. Highly recommend it. Highly enjoyed it. Highly met all my expectations. Thank you.

review_text: The flight was the most unbelievable experience!  If you have the opportunity to do this, I absolutely recommend it.  The circle island flight allowed us to see Maui in a manner that not many can.  Maui Plane Rides was 5 star from start to finish, a memory that I will never, ever forget!!!
Great views of Denali, the Ruth Gorge and much of the surrounding country. Wish we could do this every day.

This trip was excellent.  Stan, our pilot, was extremely knowlegeable of the topography and past history.  We weren't able to fly completely around Denali due to high winds, but the aerial views flying around the south side were spectacular.  The landing and takeoff on the glacier was particularly memorable as were the views of the Denali area.  Definitely worth doing,  a memorable experience.

This small family run company was excellent with a personal touch and great care to provide service that was warm, friendly and highly efficient. They went the extra mile to make sure we got a memorable experience. When the Misty Fiords trip was cancelled due to weather conditions they arranged for us to fly out to see bears instead. We flew to a remote area and were rewarded with close views of a mother and two babies on a salmon fishing walk. A Memorable moment of our Alaskan trip

We did the Grand Denali flightseeing tour and opted to include a glacier landing. OK, so it was expensive, but it was worth every penny. Our pilot and tour guide Johnathan was the best. He made sure that everyone seated on the right side and the left got to see everything. He was very informative, very cheerful, and didn't rush us once on the glacier. Everyone at Talkeetna was very pleasant. If you want to see Denali, this is the way to go!

signed up for the summit tour but they called 2 hours before and said they did not meet quota so we were put on the Grand Denali Tour w/ Glacier Landing. It was the most fantastic tour imaginable. Absolutely incredible. Pilot was excellent narrator.
tour_name: Grand Denali Flightseeing tour from Talkeetna

review_text: Wonderful team of dynamic young people who want to make this excursion one to remember. Would recommend this to anyone and do this at the start of your vacation at Kauai.

We were absolutly lucky to be there on th best day of the year. The sky was blue, the air was clear. On our 90 minute flight in a twin turbo prop we saw lots of glaciers, mountains and most important Mt. Mc Konöey without clouds in the bright sunshine. The pilot gave good exülanations and showed everything to left and right seat passengers - perfect day!!
Seeing the mountains in full view was magnificent.  The flight made me realize just how special Alaska is.

review_title: Experiance Of A Lifetime - Unforgetable - A Must Do
review_text: If this was an Olympic Event, It would be Gold medals all round for “Wings Over Kauai”, starting from our initial contact with Ellen via email to the actual pick up, pre flight preparation, flight then drop off back at the Cruise Ship everything was superb. This was our 1st flight over the island and we flew with Bruce in the Cessna, weather and vision for sightseeing and photography was superb and Bruce`s knowledge of the island and his commentary was excellent, he kept both my wife and I enthralled for the full 65min flight (even got a song out of Bruce while flying over the “Waimea Canyon”). This without doubt was the high point of this our 3rd trip to Hawaii but our 1st to beautiful Kauai. It has been very hard to pinpoint what we liked the most on the flight as it all was awesome and we have superb photo`s, DVD and unforgettable memories of this experience. This is definitely a must do tour and so easy to organise yourself online.
Trato excelente y buena organización. Merece la pena a pesar de que no es barato. El avión está muy bien preparado y los 40 minutos que dura el vuelo son muy entretenidos.

Great flight and great island perspective😊
Fun narration and interesting maui facts.
Cool sunset😎🌴

review_title: Best photos we got on our trip to Kauai. Truly wonderful experience.
review_text: We wanted to see Kauai by air and Air Ventures was a reasonable price. The lady who came to the Wyndham  Balj Hai gave a very good description of what the flight would be like.The plane was very comfortable.The pilot inspired confidence and had a great spiel. We learned a lot about the island, its history and geology. I even got some pictures of a whale with its calf off the Napali coast from 1000 feet up. I took over 100 photos with a 200 mm lens. They came out great. We got a very good overall education about Kauai that helped us the rest of the week to find the best snorkling beaches, coffee plantation, tunnel road, waterfalls, canyon road and rivers. Thanks.

We were in Talkeetna in late September, 2018, and hadn't booked anything to do in advance, considering chances of unpredictable weather and visibility. When it turned out to be an amazingly clear and gorgeous Saturday, we started thinking it would be a great chance to do flightseeing. Our Airbnb host highly recommended K2. We called and they happened to have 2 seats available on an afternoon trip. Jeremiah and the office crew are very helpful!

Our pilot, Dallas, is their head of maintenance, and he made us very comfortable with the operation and safety before and during the flight. He was great with answering our questions and providing a lot of information about the area geography - mountains, glaciers, valley, and rivers, as well as our geeky plane questions. 

Highly recommended!
We had an amazing time very memorable staff were very hospitable kind and very friendly pilot was great and the man that drove us to the event can’t speak more highly of them
I can't imagine visiting Ketchikan without seeing it by air.  1 senior, 1 adult, 1 child - 3 impressed visitors!
Awesome experience.  The views were amazing.  Professional and friendly.  Had a blast!  It was close to the cruise area and we walked there within 5 minutes.  Would highly recommend this business!

So happy Tim (Denali Outlook) recommended Air Taxi for flight up to the glaciers. What an experience. Pilot was GREAT. Process at the desk was seemless. Highly recommend this flight if you are ever in Talkeetna.

This was a special trip I planned for my fiance and I wanted everything to be perfect.  I knew the flight tours were going to be expensive so I wanted to shop around.  I found some places with low rates but they had all these hidden charges, which drive me crazy, the customer service was also lacking over the phone.  I then found this company on trip advisor and thought I would give them a call.  They had very competitive rates and no hidden charges.  The service was above and beyond from the initial phone call to the last email they sent us!

Now about the flight!  Josh the pilot was spectacular.  He was friendly and very knowledgeable.  He had a very sincere personality and had some good jokes!  He was also a very talented Pilot.  He played music on the flight; which correspond to all the sites we saw. ie Jurastic Park with the waterfalls!   The company had every based covered!  They gave us ginger to help with air sickness and even gave my Fiance a free Hawaiian necklace and even flew over the exact trees where it was made! They took pictures of us and even gave them to us for free, unlike most other tour companies which charge you a fortune.  And last of all, they gave us a FREE DVD with highlights of the flight.  I have traveled all over the world and own a tour company myself and Wings over Kauai is the BEST company I have ever encountered.
The entire flight from Phoenix to the Grand Canyon was amazing! Fabulous views of the Grand Canyon! Highly recommend!
Wonderful experience with our pilot John. Super professional and pleasant. I will definitely repeat. Wonderful views

Great Morning with my best friend, our Pilot Eric and a Five Star Maui county Flight. We toured Maui county 5 Islands by Air. The only way to see Maui. Very courteous and informative Flight. I even got to take the Flight controls. What Great Experience! A Maui must do!

review_title: Great way to see the whole island
review_text: My husband and I have been to Kauai several times and have taken one tour by land and have done numerous hikes, the views from the air are by far the best. I would recommend this to anyone visiting the island for the first time or the 5th time.

Excellent tour to Neets Bay and salmon hatchery.  Saw bears, eagles, seals, and other wildlife in their natural habitat.  Beautiful scenery on flight and at tour location.  Knowledgeable friendly and professional staff, guides & pilot. Highly Recommend!

My wife and another couple just came back from visiting Kauai, Hawaii and had a wonderful time.  We took the flight over the island on board the six passenger airplane conducted by Air Ventures at the airport in Lihue.  It was a great experience and I would recommend those who want to see the island take this method of flying.  The flight was smooth and slow enough to see everything. The people at Air Ventures are so friendly and accommodating from the moment we arrived until we left them, and no one got sick on the flight.  Our plot Joel Christofferson was informative and very helpful, as was the young woman helping us prepare for the flight and making sure we were secure and able to communicate while in the air.  We had planned to take the helicopter flight but this experience as presented by the  young lady at our time share convinced us to try the airplane and all of us were glad we did, not to mention the great savings we enjoyed.  Bob Bennett

If you are blessed to be in Talkeetna on a clear day take this trip! It might take a chunk out of your souvenir budget but the memories will beat that hands down. Steve hooked us up with the flight and was happy to answer all of our questions. The pilot was wonderful and flew around so everyone could get a view. We got to get out on the glacier and it was breathtaking. Take this trip you won't be sorry.

review_title: Don't leave Denali without doing this!
review_text:
We visited Alaska and Denali in Aug 2008. 
We hadn't planned to take the air taxi, but made a last minute reservation (just 2 days in advance) when we realized what we might be missing. We were a little apprehensive of going in a little plane, but it was very exciting and probably our best experience in Alaska. 
It was just my wife, me, and the pilot (Bob) on the little plane - Bob was very knowledgeable and explained everything there is to know about the rivers, glaciers, moraines, and the mountains. We wree lucky to have clear weather. We flew past the peaks and landed on the little Pica glacier - we spent almost 20 minutes on the glacier, and there are no words to explain how we felt about it.

The flight itself was smooth and we took plenty of pictures. Hats off to Bob and Talkeetna Air Taxi for a great experience!

Wow!  Had a such a fantastic flight over Arches National Park and Canyonlands that I had to take a second flight a couple weeks later!  Very professional and informative pilots - the scenery is absolutely spectacular!  Wonderful staff and beautiful unique landscape makes this the flight of a lifetime!  Do not miss this when visiting Moab!
Thanks to all of you at Red Tail Aviation!
Katherine

We have experienced a number of scheduled trips with this organization and find them to be above and beyond.  They are so willing to work with you if the weather isn't "just right" for Denali viewing or glacier walks.  We would recommend them to anyone visiting the area

very friendly staff, and a fantastic way to discover Kauai, most of it being inaccessible by land. Our pilot was very friendly and provided great info and context as he flew us over the island. Compared to an helicopter, a small aircraft definitely give a less noisy environment, our pilot even played some Hawaiian music during the flight!

SeaWind Aviation was amazing.  They were able to find us a replacement pilot on short notice and he was a terrific pilot.  We landed at a remote lake that was the most beautiful and quietest place I have ever been.  I would highly recommend SeaWind Aviation for any flight.
This was an incredible experience! Everything was perfect from the time we left our cruise ship until our return! Pilot was very informative and skilled. Highly recommend

Amazing tour with lots of information about Maui. Eric was an attentive pilot, very kind. The view over Maui is astonishing, truly a unique experience. We were so overwhelmed and impressed after the flight, full of feelings, that we completely forgot to tip! So sorry Eric!

Regula & Michael

The K2 flight was the highlight of our Alaska visit.  We may have gotten lucky with the weather, but the sights and experience were amazing; the flight couldn't have been smoother and our pilot was great!

review_title: The Most Awesome Place I've Seen
review_text: On a recent vacation to Talkeetna Alaska we took a flightseeing trip with K2 Aviation our pilot was Al . Al knew a lot about the area and when the weather did not cooperate on one side of McKinley he took us the other way. He showed us alot about the Mountains and surrounding glaciers. He brought us to an easy landing on one of these glaciers and when he opened the plane door, we were awestruck by the beauty and vastness of Denali and the park. K2 was knowledgeable, concerned with safety, and run a very classy operation. It was one of the highlights of our trip and if we ever go back  would fly with them in a minute

Despite the bad visibility, we had an amazing trip! The stuff was very helpful and informative, the plane was in good condition and everything was just excellent! They even helped us to plan the rest of the day for us and gave some calls to local businesses to check who can provide us other services! Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi!

We took to the air with pilot JT as part of the “Best of Kauai” tour.  My husband got to be the co-pilot.  We had a smooth ride, and JT pointed out landmarks on the island.  He also made sure everyone got to see everything.  There were so many waterfalls, especially since it had rained earlier that day.  This was truly the best thing we did on our two-week stay!
Whether you are an Alaska resident or visitor, this is an awesome experience! It is worth the money!

review_title: An experience I will never forget
review_text: My flight with glacier landing was an amazing experience. The pilot was fantastic! He was very knowledgeable and we felt very safe with him. They really know what they are doing.

review_title: Great value for a Grand Canyon 'must'.
review_text:
Booked the Grand Discovery plane tour (through Papillon) for a 9am flight. The check-in staff and pilot were friendly and we boarded with minimal fuss. The tour itself was a 45 minute flight, and we had an 8-seater plane. The high wings and seat placing meant everyone gets an uninterrupted view, which I thought was brilliant! The guided audio tour is fine, with some information interspersed between music - you can choose not to listen though. 

The views are stunning and the plane tour, which was the cheapest flight over the Canyon we could find, was an excellent way of seeing the Canyon on a lower budget.
It was great flying thru the mountains and landing on the glacier.  I got some fantistic pictures sitting in the front seat.

review_title: Tour on November 22, 2019 with Wings over Kauai
review_text:
We had a great experience with the two seater Sessna plane tour with Bruce.
He made us feel extremely comfortable going on the tour . There was no sales pressure . Bruce and his wife are amazing and I will surely fly with them again.

A little bit of history by the native Hawaiian pilot.  Amazing views we circled the entire island.  On the windward side a little rain and a rainbow with many waterfalls.  On the leeward side beautiful beaches.

Our tour was scheduled for 8AM but it was too windy when it was time to leave so they got us on the 11AM tour and we were able to still do the tour. It was an absolutely amazing experience. The BEST way to see Ketchikan. I would highly recommend this tour and Seawind Aviation.
We were very fortunate to have Chuck as our pilot and his passion for Alaska and flying were inspiring.  It was a magical experience.

review_title: Excellent tour at half the price of a helicopter!
review_text: This was an outstanding tour, and a great value for the money.  Our pilot, Eric, was extremely personable, knowledgeable, friendly and a very safe pilot. I'm not sure why someone would spend twice the money for helicopter tour? We saw the entire island, all the great scenic views, and it was extremely comfortable! I give this a five star rating!

review_title: Highlight of our tour to Kauai
review_text: Terrific!  Great views, fun pilot. I liked the plane tour better than Helicopter tours. I'll do again when I return.

The trip was phenomenal! Everyone should experience it at least once. We originally booked glacier landing along with the fly tour, but the weather didn’t permit landing do we did the fly tour of the Denali. We had to postpone a few flight times due to weather. K2 was great in providing us with updates on fly conditions and let us chose our flight time. They were great to work with. 
For future reference give yourself a couple days, for weather is predictable, to schedule the best flight for you.
Everyone that worked there was very pleasant and attentive they made the trip fun. We enloyed flying with Shane

We three of our family took 1.30 PM glacier landing tour on 12th june 14 and it was a really a life time experience. Unfortunately it became a lot of  torture for me for one and half hours of one way flying and landing because of second row of seating a highly cramped one with the knees closer to the chest, which was not suitable for  a six feet taller and the pilot ( Mr Richards) who was supposed to take care of these things did not care. I took the front seat on request  for the short return journey which was a real comfort seating for any any tall  person.  He put a short person  in the pilots adjacent seat  which is a high seater for most part of the journey. I appreciate his care otherwise for  my co passenger son who is  a junior.  The pilot's carelessness has spoiled my journey which i did not expect from a company having no 1 ranking in this site.  They  compensated me without asking for but the  unpleasantness still ranks. The ground staff are really genuine and the pilot is also otherwise good but for the lack of professionalism. The fact is that the final location is beyond comparison but the journey,  any of their competitors could have done it in a better way in my case, i feel.  The service provider is not much of importance  for this kind of out of the world experience. 
 
I highly  recommend  Mt Mc kinley  with glacier landing tour (glacier landing a must)  for the surreal life time experience with any of the tour operators and it makes very little difference in choosing the airliner. It is my personal opinion. 
I suggest  one has to be assertive in getting  equivalence in services otherwise will have to regret for the treatment meted out as in my case.
We had an excellent tour of all five islands. Got to see waterfalls, humpback whales, a World War II ship, and even a mini flight lesson for my son!! What a great flight!!

review_title: Don't even consider another Denali flightseeing company!
review_text: Another couple was staying at the same B&B and had booked with another company for the same trip. Weather was "iffy" (cloudy). We got the go-ahead and enjoyed an excellent excursion on board an "Otter" aircraft with our pilot, Will Boardman. When we got back to the B&B, the other couple was still sitting waiting for their company to call w/ the OK! TAT had the right equipment and the experienced pilot to make this experience one of the highlights of our Alaska vacation.

review_title: The PRIMO aerial view of Kauai
review_text: Air Ventures delivers on their promise of a quality experience!  Our pilot, Paul, did an exceptional job of providing awesome views of the Garden Island from the coast, to the canyons, to the NaPali coastline, including a closeup of whales swimming offshore.  He obviously cared about each passenger having a comfortable, informative and exciting adventure as he exhibited excellent piloting skills and communication of information.  I found this trip just as exciting and effective a tour as our helicopter trip 2 years ago and I loved that each of us had our own window for viewing.  Many thanks to Paul and Air Ventures for an awesome ending to 2 weeks on our favorite island.  It served as a great way to get a birdseye view of all the beauty we had visited throughout the vacation and a great reminder of why we love the island of Kauai so much!!  (We loved the complimentary group photo that was emailed to each of us before we left the airpcort!  A nice touch of class!)

The pilot was friendly and really cool :) we had such a great time flying with this company! 

Great conversation and sights! Really recommend!
