review_text:
It was an amazing experience and our pilot was so informative and friendly!
It was a little scary but the pilot made us aware of the turbulence before it happened so that helped!
We loved it! It was such a beautiful tour. The colors were lovely and our tour guide was the best. I’d definitely recommend.

I was a bit hesitant to do this, because I have never been in a helicopter. But I am SO glad I did! These $3 million plus machines are amazing and feel so safe. Our pilot was very professional and gave us facts about everything we flew over. What a way to see the strip, Grand Canyon and everything in between.  It was very very windy but the flying was always steady. Not a cheap thrill but we and our 2 children will never forget it!

I had never been in a small craft before, so I was scared and relictant even as I buckled in while still on the tarmac. Even after the smooth take-off, and cruise past landmarks, I still expected the plane to buck and pitch and to cause me to use the air-sickness bag. However, none of the former or latter happened. Our pilot, Eric, with his 30 years of flying expertise, flew that plane rock steady. His calm demeanor, seemingly effortless flying, and his abundant knowledge of the island distracted my mind from my unfounded fears of a plane-crash death.
As for the sights, we were able to see most of the must-see places all over the island. The views were so good in fact, that we didn’t even feel the need to see them up close anymore. Why go to the (Fantasy Island) waterfalls by car just to see it from the freeway, when we’ve already seen it from the best angle available? The same went for spouting horn and other attractions. We even saw sea turtles from our vantage point in the air.
But what goes up must come down. Again, Captain Eric did not disappoint. The landing was so smooth I didn’t even feel the moment when the wheels actually touched the ground.
All in all a great flight. I highly recommend it!!
Awesome views.  Everyone must see the island from an air view.  The staff at Air Ventures were awesome, very friendly. Would definetly use them again.

review_title: Awesome {AFFORDABLE} Float Plane Flight with Lake Landing in Misty Fjords
review_text: There are lots of Misty Fjords float plane flight options to choose from in Ketchikan. We decided to save a little money by booking direct with Seawind Aviation avoiding the mark-up fees charged when reserving through the cruise lines.  We were not disappointed! Fantastic customer service! We called their toll free number in advance of our arrival and spoke with Leslie about flight options. She kept in touch with us via email and phone. We didn't actually reserve anything until the day we arrived in Ketchikan - we wanted to "see" the weather before committing. We were fortunate in that there were 5 of us, so they were willing to add another flight for the day. I don't recommend waiting until day of arrival to reserve but it did work for us (In late May, before the real heavy tourist season). They picked us up on the dock near the ship and drove us to there private pier departure dock (It was about a 5 minute ride away). There we checked in, got a safety briefing, and snapped a few photos of nearby eagles. Steve was our pilot. He is very familar with his aircraft, Ketchikan, and Misty Fjords. He provided narration during the flight and everyone could talk to each other via the headsets. When no one was talking, there is a great music sound track playing in the background. The flight heads out over the cruise ships, crosses the Ketchikan island, and proceeds into the monument. We enjoyed a fantastic clear, sunny day. The sights were phenomenal. After about 40 minutes of flight, Steve landed on a lake high above sea level where we were able to get out on a small island, stretch our legs, and enjoy a private paradise somewhere in the middle of the monument for about minutes. All in all, it was a great adventure, well worth the cost (especially considering the savings over the cruise ship options) with over an hour of flight time! If you are looking for float plane options in Ketchikan, I would recommend calling Seawind Aviation for sure! Top Notch!
Awesome trip with my husband.   Beautiful pictures and wonderful experience will do again. Awesome trip and awesome pilot.

review_title: Exclusive flight and crab fest George Inlet Inn
review_text: The best excursion my husband and I have ever done!! Totally cool. Smooth take off and landing. Beautiful sight seeing. I would do it again and again.

We highly recommend taking a flight with Wings Over Kauai.  Ellen and Captain Marcus changed our flight for us at very short notice as the day we had originally booked was due to rain. We  got clear skies and the most incredible views of the entire island. The scenery from the air is truly breathtaking.  We all agreed that our flight was definitely a highlight of our entire Hawaiian holiday.

As an aeronautical geek this trip ticked all the boxes for me! Captain Marcus was both a great pilot and tour guide giving us lots of info as we flew around the island and it was fabulous to see views that are inaccessible by any other means.  He did his best to find us some whales but, apart from a very fleeting glance, we were unlucky - but lovely that he tried so hard.  

The whole experience from my initial email exchanges on was seamless.  Having drinks, sweets and cool towels available on the flight was a lovely touch.  As were the photos emailed to us after the flight and the CD of music played during the trip that we were given when we got back to Lihue.

Would I recommend Wings Over Kauai?  Most definitely!!

review_title: La meilleure façon de voir la grandeur du grand canyon
review_text:
Nous avons fait le tour de 45min depuis le South Rim, dans un avion qui peut accueillir jusqu'à 18 personnes: 6 rangées de 3 donc on peut se trouver au milieu mais on voit quand même tout très bien. On est placé en fonction de son poids sur un des 3 sièges.
Nous en gardons des magnifiques photos comme souvenir.
Et pourtant nous avons eu partiellement de la pluie et le ciel était en grand parti couvert de nuages. Le vol à failli être annulé pour risque d'orages.
Nous avions le vol de 14h et a 11h le ciel était tout bleu. Cela montre avec quelle rapidité le temps peut changer ici!
La prestation vaut largement son prix et on vient ici une fois dans sa vie, donc il faut en profiter.

review_title: Cool pilots, cool area, cool thing to do
review_text: Jon and KJ were fantastic guides on this highly recommended flight around Mt St Helens! The day before we caught up on the event from 1980 by watching docs so we knew exactly what we were looking at.

review_title: Perfect experience for a visiting pilot!
review_text: My wife and I flew this morning with Cameron. A perfect experience for a pilot visiting from the continental 48. Our sightseeing flight allowed me to fly the plane, while Cameron manned the radios. He was both a CFI and a tour guide. Our 1.1 hr Hobbs flight felt like 2+ hours (in a good way!). I will return for another flight with Wings over Kaua'i any time I visit this lovely island.

review_title: So much to see that can only be seen from the air! Great adventure
review_text: There is so much to see in Kauai that can only be seen from the air. This tour lasted about 70 minutes and it was well worth it. The scenery you get to see from the plane is breathtaking. The windows of the plane are large and you get a good view from both sides of the plane, although most of what there is to see is on the left side because of the route the plane takes. The staff was very welcoming and our pilot J.T. provided very informative commentary throughout the tour. I had limited time during my trip to the island so I'm glad I got to see a great deal in a short time because of this tour.

We appreciated the professional and thorough booking process; everything went smoothly for check-in too- very welcoming. The ride was great- worth doing the glacier landing. Our guide Daniel put us at ease and was informative. Thanks K2!

Overcast day with a hint of sun! Pilot Samuel provided an awe inspiring trip through the mountains! With his expertise, I now have a new perspective of these mountains and Denali, which did make an appearance.

We decided to take the small plane rather than the helicopter as we liked the idea of just the two of us plus pilot in the plane. We were lucky with the weather and the Napali Coast even threw a rainbow in as well, breathtaking from the air. Bruce was charming and so informative he clearly loves his job and sharing the beauty of the island with visitors. We can't rate our experience highly enough. I'll remember this trip for a long time.

Absolutely breathtaking. Our pilot was friendly, attentive, skilled and had a calm and trust-inspiring demeanor, that for me, as not particular comfortable flying, made all the difference in the world. I felt soooo safe in the air, and our pilot had a huge knowledge of the canyon and surroundings. One of the absolute highlights of our 17-day visit to the US.

review_text: We had a great tour with Eric! He is an experienced and knowledgeable pilot and tour guide. He was warm and friendly and gave us a really unique experience.

We took a Grand Canyon Helicopter ride and rafting trip booked with Maverick Helicopters - it was fantastic - When we booked I had seen the comments on tripadvisor and I tried not to be put off by the price. I am so glad I wasn't - it is expensive but this trip was worth every penny - it was amazing. Our pilot Joe was so knowledgeable about the area and was so professional.  Our Rafting Guide Scotty (not with an 'H') was so passionate about the Colorado River and made the trip lively and fun. Truly a trip to remember.

I booked the tour from Australia and even used the online chat. Very friendly service and managed to book the right tour at the right time. We were coming from Vegas too. Made it on time and even got on the earlier flight...had the chopper all to ourselves. It was the first chopper flight for my sons (12&14). They both sat in the front.  Pilot was young, professional and had a great  play list.
We loved every second and the landing in the canyon.
Trip of a lifetime! Thanks Maverick for the experience! Would recommend to all.

review_text: We had a superb experience with Airventures Tours.  We reserved our tour one day prior and were able to book exactly the day and time we wanted. However, on the day of our flight, 20 minutes after takeoff an unexpected and rapid deterioration of weather conditions along the north coast of Kauai (so normal/unavoidable for this time of year) forced our pilot, Isaac, to turn around and return to the airport.  Before we even landed we were given the option for a full refund or rebook for the day and time of our convenience.  We rebooked for the following morning.  No problems this time and Isaac gave us a superb ride.  His commentary on the history and geography of what we were seeing was very informative, he spotted some whales for us, knew how to avoid the bumps and find all the spectacular scenery that is Kauai.  Couldn't say enough about Isaac and Airventures!  Highest rating possible from me - hugest shout out and thank you!

review_title: An amazing and unique way to view Kauai.
review_text: This was a trip highlight. Just me and my husband with the pilot. The ability to see the interior and the coast from 3,000 feet was very special. The noise level was ok with the headphones and it was easy to communicate with the pilot. We were happy to have done this and not the helicopter. Our pilot, Jeff, was knowledgeable and friendly.

We debated on whether or not to do this trip as it was quite expensive but we were so pleased that we did.  A fantastic trip of a lifetime and a brilliant way to see the canyon.  Joel, our pilot, was great and told us lots about the canyon and surrounding area.  This is a trip that we will never forget.

review_text: Through misinterpretation on their website, I screwed up our reservation and had booked us for a non-glacier landing although we wanted to do that on our flight.  When I told them what had happened, they managed to squeeze us on a glacier landing flight even though they were jam-packed that day since it was so clear and such wonderful weather.  Our pilot was fantastic, and the glacier landing is one of the coolest things I've done--being out in an almost inaccessible place, surrounded by mountains and snow.  The price tag can be a shocker but I'd say it was worth it!
It was an amazing experience. Highly recommended for everyone. The staffs were very nice and the pilot was great ( Eric). He gave us great information and lots of fun on the trip.
The weather was bad when we took off. The weather cleared and we saw Denali. Our pilot did a great job of giving us the max view of the range. This is a top notch tour company.
Captain John was great pilot and very informative during the canyonlands helicopter tour. we highly recommend this helicopter tour and Captain John.
if you're a climber, don't bother looking anywhere else. they are worth the extra couple of bucks. if you're a tourist, they are the most skilled pilot's in the state.
Amazing views! The pilot does a great job talking about the views in detail. And both sides get the views ( they turn around so everyone can enjoy). Will absolutely recommend.

This was definitely one of the highlights of our week in Kauai.  I have taken a helicopter tour in Kauai before and while it is definitely what you want to do if you have the extra cash and don't get motion sickness, this is an excellent (and significantly cheaper) alternative.  Ellen and Captain Josh could not have been more friendly during both the booking process and the flight itself.  We lucked out with amazing weather and the ride was incredibly smooth.  It will definitely be one of the best hours you spend in Kauai and I could not recommend Wings Over Kauai more strongly.  There is a reason they are ranked #1!

review_title: Amazing experience, half the cost of a helicopter and none of the motion sickness
review_text:
One of us had been on a helicopter before and it was a sickening experience (literally) so we had ruled that out though we wanted to see Na Pali. Saw one of these planes and called them right away. They didn’t have any times available before our leave date but arranged a special trip just for us at no extra cost. A family run business, they were so flexible, and great at making my kids feel safe and special. The kids loved it!

And I got a ton of amazing photos, including the free family pic they provided.

The pilot, Michael,was fantastic. Very skilled and informative and made you feel very safe. The view of the glaciers and Mt McKinley were unbelievable. It really gave you a feeling of seeing Alaska. Landing on and taking off from the glacier was such a thrill. Well worth the cost and time.
I highly recommend this excursion.Bring your camera!
Professionali e competenti. Splendido giro sotto la vetta del Mckinley, tour indimenticabile. Il costo è alto ma lo merita tutto!

Our flightsee to McKinely was the highlight of our Alaskan vacation.  It was so exciting to see up close the McKinely and glaciers.  K2 and our pilot were well organized, professional and friendly and made you feel very safe.  An experience of a lifetime. I highly recommend K2 for your trip to Alaska.  You will love it!

review_title: I would do this very same tour each time I came back to Kauai!
review_text: Eric was awesome!  He was very accommodating because the weather was not being very cooperative and was very informative.

What an amazing experience. Michael was personable, knowledgeable, and professional. He provided a helicopter tour that you hoped wouldn’t end. Incredible views of arches and the changing terrain while he expertly handled our chopper. The real takeaway is the perspective. You aren’t getting that from the ground. Best money we have spent in a while. Highly recommend.
It was great! Thank you for the amazing! The cliffs were incredible and so was seeing the true color of the water and beaches
It was an excellent trip. Great views and a detailed commentary from an awesome pilot. Family had a great experience. We would highly recommend this to all who plan to visit Kauai.
The itinerary and the sights are hard to fault but my goodness the tour guide Mel talked non stop the whole 10 hours and he realllly loved his own voice and believed his own stories.

review_text: What a wonderful adventure. Took an early morning flight around the island, giving us a great look at the natural wonders of Kauai.  Our pilot was fun and very aware of my sister's fear of the "little plane."  Seeing the island from above gave me a deeper appreciation of the beauty I saw on the ground.  Great trip.
Amazing experience!  Truly unique view of the Maui Islands. I would recommend for anyone who loves to fly!

My husband and I took the 20 minute gorge flight with Adam as our pilot. He was professional, knowledgeable and had a great sense of humor. It is amazing how much you can see in 20 minutes. This was so worth it!  We highly recommend it!!  The sunset was a nice bonus!

review_text:
yesterday was my birthday and my wife surprised me with this flight tour.I have never been to one before and and yesterday was really special to me.The views were awesome and the aircraft was super clean.
The customer service was super nice and welcoming.Everything was grea,Thanks a lot❤️🙏🏻

Our flight around Denali was the highlight of a wonderful trip.  The views we spectacular!  Talkeetna Air Taxi worked with us to make sure we flew when the mountain was visible.

Fantastic

We booked this trip through our Disney cruise.  The day we went the weather was beautiful.  But Ketchikan is in an artic rain forest so I understand these tours are often cancelled.  Our pilot was telling us the day before it was pouring rain, and all flights had been cancelled.  Wind and fog are also issues, so booking a Misty Fjords flight is a bit of a gamble.

The planes are small (we had 5 passengers in our plane, all with a window view).  They are also old (our pilot explained the Dehavilland Beavers aren't manufactured anymore), but apparently folks in Alaska rely upon these planes to get around.  The pilot was very friendly, and had logged a lot of hours.  They were careful to balance our weight out.  The view from the jump seat, where my brother sat, is the best.  The Fjords are beautiful.  We saw snow covered mountains, and beautiful forests.  We saw eagles and bears down below.  The ride at times could be bumpy but the pilot was careful to adjust, and we even got a fly by over our cruise ship.  My 5 year old travelled with us...I thought for sure he'd freak out and not go through with it but he did, and pilot was very friendly and even showed my enthusiastic son all about the controls.  So all in all, a wonderful trip.

There were a few things that suprised me in our litigious society-- the safety briefing was a little short and you don't have to sign a bunch of waivers....the docks had no safety railings and a bit of a steep incline which could get slippery...we stopped at a fjord and could get out on the pontoons to look around.  It was refreshing, however, that lawyering up hasn't come to Alaska yet, so enjoy it while you can.

Great service, wonderful views, and an excited 5 year old.  A wonderful trip.  I recommend, though there is a moderate possibility your trip may get cancelled due to weather concerns, and knowing such flights are not entirely risk free.
Capt Bruce was an amazing guide. The sights were breathtaking. And you get keepsake at the end!! Couldn’t have had a better experience.

review_title: Highlight of our trip to Hawaii
review_text:
Just returned from a trip to Hawaii.  We did several amazing activities including swimming with sharks on the North Shore of Oahu with Hawaii Shark Encounters, driving the entire Road to Hana in a rental car using the Gypsy Guide Road to Hana app, and doing a whale watching tour on a raft with the Pacific Whale Foundation.  Each of those were great and could have been the highlight of our trip but the best thing we did was our flight with Wings Over Kauai.

Arranging the trip on line with Ellen was easy.  We were able to reserve the whole plane for our group at the internet rate.  Once at the airport, the check in process was quick and easy, even the dreaded weigh-in was handled with discretion and was painless.  Our pilot, Josh was incredible and very engaging.

The views were fantastic.  Much of what we saw was on private land and only viewable from the air.  Highlights included the Na Pali coast, Waimea Canyon and the valley and waterfall featured in Jurassic Park.  We had driven up through Waimea Canyon the day before and it was interesting to see the same views from the air that we saw from the ground.

The flight was smooth, everyone had an unobstructed view and headsets so we could hear Josh and each other's comments.  There was even a coordinated musical soundtrack.

We were on a cruise and Ellen picked us up from a shopping center near the cruise port and returned us to the ship.

We were offered a video of our flight for purchase and given a generic video and our photograph in front of the plane for free.

It was a first class experience the whole way.  Couldn't have been happier.  Big thanks to Ellen and Josh.

My wife and I did a plane tour on our honeymoon and had a great experience.  We actually did the introduction to flight package (where I got to fly the plane part of the time) because it was the same price as a regular flight. Our pilot/instructor/tour guide was Jacob and he did a great job! Really cool way to get to see the whole island as well as parts you wouldn’t otherwise see and a little nicer price than the helicopter tours. Highly recommend!

Very professional from booking by phone months earlier. We arrived, and everything went like clockwork. Our pilot, Luke, explained everything preflight and narrated our trip as we flew over glaciers and pointed out all the peaks and landmarks. Flying through Ruth Gorge was so cool. We were blessed with sunny weather and a great view of Denali. Landing on the glacier was smooth. Walking around on the glacier put everything in perspective. So worth the extra money. Once in a lifetime experience!!  Thank you Talkeetna Air Taxi.

Had a great experience flying in to the Pika Glacier (a.k.a. "Little Switzerland") with Talkeetna Air Taxi.  Paul is the best pilot I've flown with and put us down right where we wanted to be.  He picked us up again 5 days later and even gave us a scenic detour on the way back to Talkeetna.  All of this after he participated in a 25k XC ski race in the morning!

review_title: Awe-inspiring flightseeing with glacier landing, and heli-hiking
review_text:
Alaska is awe-inspiring no matter which way you turn, but our flightseeing trip with a glacier landing with TAT in Denali National Park was a once-in-a-lifetime experience. The group included our family of 3 plus 3 other passengers. Our pilot provided information about the aircraft as well as the geography, and pointed out specific rivers, glaciers and mountains as we flew among them. He also pointed out several of the camps for the climbers and rangers on Denali. The vantage point of flying through mountain passes and around peaks was breathtaking. It seemed as if you could reach out and touch the rock faces despite the fact that they were miles away. Landing on the glacier at over 5000' elev. was incredible. Amazing to think we were standing on many feet of snow and a couple thousand feet of ice. It was so quiet and peaceful in the bowl where we landed and we felt so small among the towering peaks.
We also took a TAT helicopter for a heli-hiking trip into the Talkeetna Mountains. It was amazing hovering over the rivers and lakes and the tundra, spotting a moose, and landing in the high country for a guided hike. Everyone at TAT was welcoming and professional. We highly recommend them.

review_title: Excellent Flight with Kim from Redtail
review_text: I just did a return flight with pilot Kim of Redtail, flying from Lake Powell to Moab. It was a great flight, professionally handled by Kim, who also served as a wonderful tour guide as we flew over the incredible Canyonlands and surrounding landscape. I felt totally safe and thoroughly enjoyed the trip.
Absolutely breathtaking. Gorgeous views throughout the trip. Best thing to do on a day in port. Best excursion of our entire Alaskan cruise.

We did the mountain voyager trip and we were able to see awesome views. I wanted to do glacier landing but found out the glaciers were not safe for landing that time.  It was 1.5 hour trip, the pilot was great. He took us in the mountains and showed some awesome glacier. They were very professional and the experience was great. We were also travelling with almost 2 year old, she slept in the plane so we had a quite trip.

This was the pinnacle (pun intended) of our trip!  What an unexpected thrill!  To get to see the mountains at peak level and above, understand glaciers because you could fly their entire distance and view this Alaskan terrain which can't be accessed any other way....spectacular doesn't describe it.  Of course, weather plays a part and (full disclosure) we had sun and blue skies.
The ride felt safe and was comfortable.  Everyone has access to a window with a view!
This is how to spend your money!

Best part was the flight and the staff, the views were amazing! The glacier landing was also amazing, a first for myself and the view on the glacier was top notch! Chad the pilot was terrific, very professional, accommodating, and knowledgeable! A must do on your state visit!

We found  Westwind Air to be very friendly and professional.
We would use Westwind Air again.
When and if we use Westwind Air again we would like our pilot to be Jim who was very helpful and help us a lot at the Grand Canyon. 
Jim is also a very good pilot, he was also very safety minded.

My wife, 8 year old granddaughter and I experienced the Grand Canyon on a 45 minute Maverick helicopter tour with our pilot Greg.  Seeing the Grand Canyon from the sky was simply jaw dropping spectacular.  Greg patiently answered every question that was thrown at him and had a great deal of knowledge.  It was a memorable experience.

Talkeetna Air Taxi picked us up in downtown Talkeetna and took us to their location.  Everyone gets a window seat and headset to wear to hear the pilot.  Pilot was awesome!  Felt very safe.  Did the Grand Denali Tour with a glacier landing.  SPEND THE EXTRA MONEY AND DO THE GLACIER LANDING!  It was the highlight of our trip!  It's surreal landing onto a glacier and stepping out into the vastness all around you.  Also, seeing the climbers basecamp from above was pretty cool too.

My husband and I had a fabulous time touring Kauia by air with Air Ventures Hawaii.  All the staff including our pilot, were pleasant, accommodating, professional, caring and just a breath of fresh air!  The price that we paid for this tour was also reasonable!  Consider flying with them on your next visit to Kauai!  Cheers!

Ray and Jill were excellent hosts - even when I got sick on the flight.  It was so amazing - I would even go again!  We saw rainbows, waterfalls, gorgeous canyons, and a whale!  We took this tour the first day we were on Kauai and it really helped us get a lay of the land. Definitely recommend!
We went on the Ultimate Denali hike.  We flew out on a float plane, landed on Moraine lake and hiked up into the tundra!  Beautiful! and then we were served wine and cheese.

We have been all over the world, and I have to say this is at the top ! Over the top !! Put it on your bucket list today ! They were great, Andy our pilot was informative, knowledgable, and just a cool guy ! Thx again for the life long memories!

We did a helicopter tour the last time we visited Kauai.  Since there is so much to see from the air, I wanted to do an aerial tour again.  After reading the great views for Wings Over Kauai, I decided to give the small plane tour a try.  Not sure I'll ever do another helicopter tour again, if there is a small plane option.

We opted for the Cessna, and it was just me, my wife and the pilot.  Bruce was our pilot and he was fantastic!  Great commentary along the way, and his experience flying this tour showed as he charted a perfect path around the island.

The flight seemed so much smoother than the helicopters.  And my original concerns about just flying past sights without the ability to hover were unfounded.

Not sure if it is always the case, but when they say 65 minute tour they mean it.  Pretty sure we were in the air for the full 65 minutes, though it went by way too fast.  No discounting for taxi time, etc. or rounding an hour down to 50 minutes.  

At the end of the flight they provided us with a list of Bruce's favorites.  Wish we had that at the beginning of our visit as his recommendations were spot-on.

This is the way to see Kauai from the air!

Had a great experience!
Would definitely recommend to friends and family. Thanks for making our birthdays special.

This was definitely a highlight of our trip. There were 10 of us so we had our own plane! It was a beautiful sunny day and the views were spectacular!  The landing on the glacier was fun and our group had a competitive snowball fight. Thank you for the memories.

review_title: See Arches and Canyonlands National Parks in 90 minutes
review_text: How clearly we "got the picture" of both Parks in a 90 minute flight piloted by Larry, of Red Tail Aviation.  He explained the various parts of the Parks in a most engaging way with a sense of humor in the Kodiak aircraft.  From this flight we had more of a concept of what we wanted to visit during our stay at Moab, Utah.  Larry worked for the Bureau of Land Management and the National Park Service over 30 years, so he knew the area well  from several viewpoints.  He was a skilled pilot who, with co-pilot Bronson, handled the flight smoothly and safely while sharing his love and knowledge of the area.  The flight with Larry was a very worthwhile experience.
